About Cira Apps Limited

Cira Apps is a SaaS company building solutions that enhance Microsoft 365 productivity for iPhone and Android business users. Our flagship product, CiraSync, helps more than 12,000 companies automate contact and calendar management—driving measurable productivity gains and cost savings across the enterprise.

We’re a B2B provider trusted by organizations from 10 to 10,000 employees. Our team is smart, humble, and relentlessly focused on customer delight—our current NPS is 65, and our customers love our products. Our CRM is Salesforce.

The Role

We’re growing and have a high volume of inbound sales inquiries, including active trial prospects. We’re hiring high‑energy, dynamic Sales Development Representatives who can confidently manage inbound activity and, overtime, outbound prospecting. You’ll engage prospects worldwide via email, phone, and video, rapidly assess business needs, present the right solution, and own the entire sales cycle from qualification to close.

This is a full‑time, remote role covering both US and European time zones. This posting is for a current job opening.

What You’ll Do

  • Become an expert with lead generation tools to build targeted prospect lists.
  • Proactively prospect freemium accounts with relevant, human touches.
  • Qualify prospects using targeted, relevant questions; nurture them and understand needs prior to an initial sales meeting.
  • Schedule discovery calls for our Customer Success Team and consistently meet/exceed monthly quotas for attended discovery calls.
  • Execute multi‑channel outreach (phone, email, social) using a sales development platform
  • Counter top‑of‑funnel objections gracefully—demonstrating excellent interpersonal and technical skills.
  • Collaborate closely with Marketing and Account Executives to build and execute account communication plans.
  • Coordinate demos with Sales Engineering and log all activities in Salesforce.
  • Conduct thorough research and mine our existing database to build monthly call lists.
  • Close sales by educating prospects on our product value and guiding them through the buying process.

What You’ll Bring

  • Proven sales experience in a similar role with a strong track record (internships, projects, or early‑career wins count).
  • 0–1 years of telemarketing experience, preferably in IT Enterprise Software.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with a distributed team.
  • Strong, professional communication skills in English—written and verbal—with great listening skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to achieve daily sales metrics.
  • Ability to deliver engaging presentations (virtual and phone).
  • Drive, grit, team‑orientation—a strong desire to compete and win.
  • High integrity and perseverance—you follow through.
  • An athlete mindset: coachable, goal‑oriented, and resilient.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • A great product to sell—clear value, real customer outcomes.
  • Executive support for the sales process.
  • Work from anywhere with flexible hours.
  • International exposure—collaborate with a global team.
  • Compensation that matches your experience and skill set.

Ready to Grow Your Career?

If you’re looking for a long‑term home where you can shine, learn fast, and make a meaningful impact—apply and join us. Let’s build together. It’s going to be fun!

jobs.title: Senior Security Operations Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Who we areSamsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a member of our Security Operations Team, you will collaborate with a global team of engineers to monitor and respond to security events, lead security incidents as Incident Commander, and lead digital forensic investigations in support of Employee Relations, Legal, Compliance, or Information Security cases.

Although you will be focused on security incident response, you will also have the opportunity to create and maintain runbooks, and automated workflows, and assist in process refinement and implementation. You will collaborate with a diverse team of engineers, and key stakeholders on security initiatives across the company. Above all, your focus is bringing Security expertise to the table in a collaborative, humble, and practical manner.

Location: This role is open to candidates residing in Netherlands

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Monitor security events and provide technical analysis on alerts
  • Lead information security incidents and employee insider investigations by developing the incident response strategy, lead the execution through incident closure, while providing incident updates to key stakeholders throughout the incident
  • Deliver security guidance clearly and concisely for incident response and insider threat initiatives
  • Coordinate the building of services, capabilities, integrations, and implementations of technologies to support security operations, incident response, and insider threat
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Participate in our on-call rota covering weekends

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years of experience in Security Incident Response
  • Ability to communicate investigative findings and strategies to technical staff, executive leadership, and legal
  • Ability to build scripts or tools to support Samsara’s investigation processes, with proficiency in Python
  • Mentor and train security operation engineers on data collection, analysis, and reporting technical analysis
  • Practical experience acting as a lead during security incident response, including monitoring and triaging alerts, and coordinating across teams
  • Understanding of analysis and forensics techniques on macOS, Windows, and Linux
  • Experience utilizing SIEM tools to perform log reviews
  • Experience in cloud architecture and security (AWS, GCP) and cloud-based services
  • Participation in an on-call rotation, with the potential to work outside standard business hours, including late evenings, when responding to high-severity incidents as part of our global incident response team.
  • This role will be part of our EMEA so your hours will be aligned to the UK. As an operational time you may be expected to work flexible hours around this to support the load of the team

An ideal candidate also has:

  • 2+ years of experience working on insider threat initiatives or employee investigations
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field - or relevant industry experience
  • GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH) or similar Certification
  • Familiarity with common security frameworks and standards, including NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 27001, FedRAMP

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.title: Senior Back End Software Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Our software engineers at Epistemix show a clear passion for quality and love to bring software to life.
jobs.description:
Our software engineers at Epistemix show a clear passion for quality and love to bring software to life. You are energized by the idea of building something new and want to work on problems that matter.

In order to do this job well, you must be a curious and eager problem solver with a hunger for building well-designed, high-quality solutions. You have a passion for great work and strive to produce simple solutions to complex problems. Knowing there are always multiple answers to a problem, you know how to engage in a constructive dialogue to find the best path forward.

About Epistemix

The most consequential decisions in public health, life sciences, insurance, and enterprise strategy share a common problem: they involve human behavior, network effects, and downstream effects that cannot be safely tested before action is taken. Traditional analytical techniques built on historical data were not built for this. Epistemix was.

We build simulation and data-driven modeling tools that let leaders visualize how strategies will unfold across populations and systems before they commit resources. By clarifying which variables drive outcomes, where leverage exists, and how they interact, we help organizations move from uncertainty to conviction. Getting these decisions right means faster interventions, better-allocated resources, and measurable improvements in human and economic outcomes. We exist to make that possible.

Our platform gives organizations access to realistic, high-resolution population data and the modeling infrastructure to run scenario planning at scale. Together, these capabilities let decision-makers stress-test strategies in a controlled environment before deploying them in the real world across healthcare, consumer industries, insurance, and government. We are approaching our Series B and actively building the team that will define what comes next.

Responsibilities

As a Senior Back-End Software Engineer, you will be at the forefront of our product's evolution. Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Design, develop, and maintain clean, testable, and highly maintainable code, ensuring top-tier performance and reliability.

  • From initial requirements gathering to deployment and ongoing maintenance, take full ownership of the software development lifecycle, ensuring seamless delivery and operation.

  • Design, build, test and deploy a highly scalable and resilient system architecture that supports current needs and future growth.

  • Define the technical direction for engineering solutions, actively collaborating with internal teams to ensure technological advancements are perfectly aligned with the company's strategic goals.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field, or equivalent work experience

  • 7+ years of back-end software development experience,with a significant portion in a senior role.

  • Expert proficiency in Python, particularly with FastAPI.

  • Strong experience with TypeScript for backend development (Node.js/NestJS experience is a plus).

  • Deep hands-on experience with AWS cloud services, including but not limited to EC2, EKS, Lambda, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, CloudWatch, and IAM.

  • Proven experience designing, building, and operating microservices architectures.

  • Extensive experience with Kubernetes for container orchestration.

  • Expertise in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform.

  • Hands-on experience with Atlantis for Terraform pull request automation.

  • Demonstrated experience or strong understanding of data science orchestration platforms, such as .

  • Solid understanding of relational and NoSQL databases, including advanced querying, optimization, and data modeling.

  • Experience with API design principles (RESTful, GraphQL) and security best practices (OAuth2, JWT).

  • Strong understanding of distributed systems concepts, asynchronous processing, and message queues.

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and tools (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins).

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly.

  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, agile environment.

Why Join Epistemix?

By joining Epistemix, you will become part of a collaborative and rapidly growing team that values curiosity and creativity. We are fully remote, with team members in the United States and Europe. Benefits include:

  • Equity & Incentives – Participation in our stock option program.

  • Flexible Time Off – Autonomy to manage your schedule and work-life balance.

  • Health, Welfare and 401(k) Programs – Eligibility for benefits (for U.S. employees).

  • Meaningful Impact – Apply your creative talents to revolutionize data-driven decision-making and make a real-world difference.

This is a remote position open to applicants located in the United States. Candidates must possess the legal right to work in their intended work location, as we are currently unable to sponsor or transfer employment visas for any country, including the United States.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps/Build System Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Acronis is a global leader in cyber protection, delivering AI-powered protection for productive MSPs in a single, natively integrated platform that unifies operations management, cybersecurity, and data protection.
jobs.description:
Acronis is a global leader in cyber protection, delivering AI-powered protection for productive MSPs in a single, natively integrated platform that unifies operations management, cybersecurity, and data protection. Driven by our mission to protect, manage and automate every workload that businesses and lives depend on, we’ve built the industry’s only all-in-one solution.

We are looking for a candidate who will be responsible for the build system and build infrastructure of a large, complex software product — from compiling and packaging hundreds of interdependent components to assembling, signing and publishing the artifacts we release — and for making the build fast, reproducible and trustworthy for everyone who depends on it.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own, design and evolve the build system for a product assembled from a large number of interdependent components written in several programming languages.
  • Build and maintain the build pipelines end to end: isolated and reproducible builds, dependency and version management, build agents and build farms, artifact repositories and caching — and keep build times, success rates and reproducibility under control as the product grows.
  • Assemble and validate release deliverables: packages, images and installation artifacts, and the repositories they are distributed from, for several supported release lines maintained in parallel.
  • Build and operate the release pipeline: automated build validation and regression gating, artifact signing, promotion between channels, and the publishing and rollback procedures around a release.
  • Keep the product buildable through toolchain and dependency upgrades: resolve compiler, library and dependency conflicts, and keep build definitions and downstream patches maintainable instead of accumulating.
  • Maintain traceability of everything we ship: versioning and changelogs, artifact provenance, license and SBOM data, and the integration points that security scanning and audits rely on.
  • Automate build tooling, release steps and the provisioning of build environments in Python and shell, and integrate the build with the team's source control, review and issue tracking workflows.
  • Support developers and QA day to day: fast self-service builds of branches and merge requests, quick diagnosis of build and packaging failures, and unblocking people whose work is stuck behind the build.
  • Extend CI/CD coverage: validation on every commit, promotion of artifacts between environments, and integration of automated test suites into release gating.
  • Own the build infrastructure itself — build hosts and builder images, artifact storage, capacity planning — working with IT and operations where infrastructure is shared.
  • Investigate complex and intermittent build failures and drive them from root cause to a permanent fix rather than a retry.
  • Leverage AI-assisted engineering tools for development, code and log analysis, debugging, root-cause investigation and technical research.
  • Document the build and release processes so that they are reproducible by someone else, and share that expertise with the development and QA teams.
  • Maintain clear communication with the development lead on build and release status, risks, dependencies and critical issues.

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years in build, release or DevOps engineering for complex software products, including ownership of a build system as a whole and not only of individual CI jobs.
  • Strong CI/CD engineering: Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions or comparable; pipelines as code, build agents, and artifact repositories.
  • Solid experience with software packaging and the distribution of binary artifacts on Linux, including artifact signing and repository or channel management.
  • Ability to read, fix and take over build definitions written by other teams across multiple languages and build tools (make, CMake, autotools, and language-native build and packaging tooling).
  • Deep understanding of dependency and version management, reproducible and hermetic builds, incremental builds and build caching.
  • Solid Python and shell scripting for build tooling and release automation.
  • Strong Linux systems knowledge, plus containers and configuration management tooling.
  • Confident with Git and with branching and release models in a product that maintains several releases at once.
  • Experience delivering updates to already installed software — channels, staged rollout, acceptance and rollback — is a strong advantage.
  • Familiarity with software supply chain practices: signing, SBOM, dependency and vulnerability scanning.
  • Experience scaling a build system — parallelism, distributed builds, cutting build times from hours to minutes — is a strong advantage.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, and the patience to take over a large inherited build system with incomplete documentation.
  • AI-assisted engineering experience is mandatory, including practical use of AI for development, debugging, log analysis, investigation and technical research.
  • Demonstrated ability to treat the build as a product that the rest of engineering depends on, and to share technical expertise across teams.
  • Excellent English communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

*Please submit your resume and application in English


WHO WE ARE

A Swiss company founded in Singapore in 2003, Acronis offers over twenty years of innovation with 15 offices worldwide and employees in 50+ countries. Acronis Cyber Protect is available in 26 languages in 150 countries and is usd by over 21,000 service providers to protect more than 750,000 businesses.


Our corporate culture centers on innovation, accountability, and impact. We encourage our people to think boldly, challenge conventional approaches, and take ownership of outcomes. As a member of our global “A-Team,” you’ll operate in a high-growth, fast-paced environment where resilience, adaptability, and a commitment to continuous improvement drive success.


OUR INTERVIEW PRACTICES

To ensure a fair and genuine hiring process, candidates are expected to participate in interviews without the use of AI tools, automated prompts, or third-party assistance. Interviews are designed to assess individual skills, experience, and communication style, and we value authentic, real-time interaction.

Use of AI or external assistance during live interviews may result in disqualification. For roles where AI skills are being evaluated, permitted use of AI tools will be clearly communicated in advance. Candidates may be asked to disable virtual backgrounds or participate in in-person interviews. All employment offers are contingent upon successful completion of applicable criminal, education and identity background checks


Acronis is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, medical condition, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

About the Role

We are looking for an organised, confident, and detail-oriented Clinical Training & Documentation Coordinator to support our client's ABA (Applied Behavior Analysis) team.

In this role, you will be responsible for training Registered Behavior Technicians (RBTs) on the correct use of clinical software, monitoring session documentation, and ensuring records are completed accurately and on time.

You will play an important role in maintaining documentation standards, supporting staff with system-related questions, and following up on outstanding items to ensure compliance with internal requirements and deadlines.

Experience with CentralReach is highly preferred. However, candidates with experience using similar healthcare platforms, electronic medical records (EMR/EHR) systems, or clinical practice management software are encouraged to apply.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Staff Training & Onboarding: Conduct virtual training sessions to help RBTs understand how to use clinical software and follow documentation procedures correctly.
  • Clinical Documentation Monitoring: Review and track session documentation to identify incomplete, missing, or incorrectly completed records.
  • Follow-ups & Accountability: Proactively follow up with RBTs to ensure outstanding documentation is completed within the required deadlines.
  • Quality & Compliance: Identify documentation errors and inconsistencies, communicate required corrections, and help maintain accurate clinical records.
  • Progress Tracking: Maintain trackers and reports to monitor outstanding documentation, completion rates, and recurring issues.
  • Communication & Support: Provide clear instructions, answer process-related questions, and support staff in resolving documentation challenges.
  • Process Improvement: Identify recurring issues and help improve training materials, documentation processes, and follow-up procedures.

Requirements

  • Experience in healthcare administration, clinical operations, quality assurance, compliance, staff training, or clinical documentation.
  • Experience training or onboarding staff on software, systems, or operational processes.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify errors and incomplete records.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
  • Confidence conducting virtual training sessions and communicating expectations professionally.
  • Experience using task trackers, spreadsheets, or similar tools to monitor outstanding work and deadlines.
  • The ability to follow through consistently and hold staff accountable for completing required tasks.

Software Experience

Experience with CentralReach is highly preferred, particularly in an ABA or clinical setting.

Candidates with experience using similar healthcare systems or EMR/EHR platforms are also encouraged to apply. Examples include:

  • GoodX
  • Healthbridge
  • Elixir Live
  • HealthONE EHR
  • Solumed
  • FlowMed
  • Cliniweb
  • eMD
  • Navitas

Experience with these platforms does not replace the need to learn CentralReach, but may provide a useful foundation in clinical documentation and healthcare workflows.

What Success Looks Like

  • Staff are confident using the required clinical software.
  • Session documentation is completed accurately and within deadlines.
  • Missing or incorrect records are identified and addressed promptly.
  • Follow-ups are completed consistently, without outstanding tasks being overlooked.
  • Documentation processes remain organised, and staff understand their responsibilities.

Ideal Candidate

You are a confident communicator who enjoys training and supporting others but is also comfortable following up firmly and professionally when tasks remain incomplete. You are proactive, highly organised, and take ownership of ensuring that documentation is accurate, deadlines are met, and processes run smoothly.

About Matter Health

Matter Health delivers primary and preventive healthcare directly to older adults living in public housing communities.

We lead with Love in Everything We Do.

About the Role

The Patient Advocate & Liaison (PAL) is the face of Matter Health within the communities we serve. This field-based role is responsible for building trusted relationships with older adults living in affordable housing communities and helping them stay engaged in their healthcare journey.

Working alongside an Nurse Practitioner (NP), you'll serve as the primary relationship-builder for your assigned communities—educating patients about Matter Health, supporting enrollment, coordinating follow-up, identifying barriers to care, and helping patients stay connected to the services they need.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working directly with people, thrives in community settings, and is passionate about improving healthcare access for underserved populations.

What You’ll Do

  • Build trusted, lasting relationships with older adults living in assigned communities

  • Serve as the primary community representative for Matter Health

  • Educate prospective patients about Matter Health's care model and available services

  • Support patient outreach, enrollment, scheduling, and ongoing engagement

  • Conduct in-person outreach, phone calls, and community events to connect with patients

  • Partner closely with Advanced Practice Providers (APPs), Social Workers, Care Navigators, and Operations teams

  • Identify barriers to care and connect patients with appropriate community resources

  • Assist patients throughout their healthcare journey—from initial introduction through ongoing engagement

  • Maintain accurate documentation in Salesforce and Athena

  • Ability to collaborate with clinical and operational teams

Why Matter Health?

We believe that where someone lives should never determine the care they receive. Every team member at Matter Health plays an essential part in improving healthcare access for older adults historically underserved by traditional healthcare systems.

This is not just our mission statement—it's the work we do every day.

jobs.description:
About MedReview

MedReview is a leading provider of payment integrity solutions that help national and regional health plans promote population health, ensure payment accuracy, reduce administrative waste, improve provider relationships, and optimize financial performance. For more than four decades, MedReview has partnered with health plans, third-party administrators, and other healthcare organizations to deliver technology-enabled solutions that identify savings opportunities, drive operational efficiency, and improve healthcare outcomes.

The Opportunity

MedReview is seeking a Pricing Resolution Processor II to join our Payment Integrity Operations team. This role is responsible for reviewing, grouping, and pricing routine healthcare facility claims to identify potential overpayments and ensure reimbursement accuracy. The Pricing Resolution Processor II applies client-specific reimbursement methodologies, payer requirements, regulatory guidelines, and internal operational standards to support accurate and timely claim pricing decisions.

The ideal candidate will possess healthcare claims processing experience, strong analytical skills, and a high level of attention to detail. This position requires the ability to evaluate claim information, identify discrepancies, validate data accuracy, and ensure compliance with reimbursement policies and contractual obligations while maintaining productivity and quality standards in a high-volume environment.

This position is remote. Candidates must maintain a secure workspace that protects protected health information (PHI) and HIPAA-regulated data.

Key Responsibilities

Claims Review and Validation

  • Review assigned healthcare claims for completeness, accuracy, and eligibility for review.
  • Validate claim information and supporting documentation before pricing activities begin.
  • Analyze claim details to ensure all required information has been submitted and appropriately documented.
  • Identify missing, inaccurate, or inconsistent claim data and initiate appropriate resolution steps.
  • Maintain high levels of accuracy while managing assigned workloads and turnaround expectations.

Claim Grouping and Pricing

  • Group facility claims using client and internal systems in accordance with established methodologies.
  • Apply reimbursement methodologies based on client requirements, regulatory guidance, and contractual obligations.
  • Ensure claims are priced accurately and consistently according to payer-specific guidelines.
  • Review claim information to identify potential overpayments and reimbursement discrepancies.
  • Utilize internal applications and client platforms to support pricing and claim review activities.

Compliance and Quality Assurance

  • Ensure adherence to payer contract requirements, regulatory standards, and internal operational procedures.
  • Validate data entry and pricing calculations to maintain pricing accuracy.

jobs.description:
FireMon delivers Network Security Policy Control for the Modern Enterprise.

Most enterprises run firewalls from multiple vendors alongside cloud security groups and microsegmentation platforms, and no single console can say whether it all works together. We believe policy is the control plane for network security: it defines what the environment should do, and the infrastructure carries it out. FireMon gives security teams one place to see, govern, and prove that their policy is doing what they intend, across on-prem, cloud, and hybrid environments.

That mission shapes how we work. At FireMon, being proactive is rewarded, and your work has a direct line to the product our customers rely on and to the success of the business. You’ll share ideas, collaborate across departments, and learn parts of the company beyond your own role.

THIS POSITION IS FULLY REMOTE AND NOT BASED WITHIN A FIREMON OFFICE

The Customer Support Engineer will leverage strong technical awareness, research skills, and equally strong customer service skills. You will be responsible for engaging with customers via chat, meeting software, email, and phone to work toward a technical resolution of FireMon products. Due to the complexity and breadth of the FireMon products supported, strong research and documentation skills are key to success in this role. For technical issues that cannot be resolved the Customer Support Engineer will follow documented processes to prepare and escalate the ticket to an advanced solutions engineer.

About the role

  • Manage multiple tickets and prioritize ticket responses based on urgency.
  • Demonstrate strong critical thinking, and self-driven research skills utilizing FireMon and external resources during the lifecycle of the ticket.
  • Contribute to projects and tasks as delegated by management as a part of professional development.
  • Triage, troubleshoot and reproduce customer issues in labs to resolve product issues for partners and customers.
  • Enhance FireMon services to meet partners’ and customers’ business needs through knowledge sharing, and team collaboration.
  • Your shift is a crucial component to the 24/7 “follow the sun” coverage provided by our team. This position will cover an on-call shift for our customers facing production-down issues. On-call payments will be provided.
  • Shifts may vary and require flexibility throughout the year depending on customer support needs. An applicant applying for this role should be able to work any shift deemed necessary by customer support leadership.

Responsibilities

  • “Wow” customers by providing best-in-class customer service and support by telephone, web, email, and/or chat.
  • Proactively demonstrate empathy when appropriate.
  • Ownership of customer issues throughout the lifecycle of the ticket up to resolution or escalation.
  • Assess customer’s Support Contract status to determine support eligibility.
  • Independently investigate all resources available including internal FireMon resources, and external resources.
  • Analyze, evaluate and determine the urgency of all customers reported Support tickets.
  • Translate and route customer support tickets into an appropriate format and follow established ticket handling processes.
  • Demonstrate technical knowledge through assessments showing proficiency within the first 90 days by completing a 30/60/90-day onboarding plan.
  • Ongoing personal development through completion of additional certification and education on an annual basis.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Familiarity, and experience administrating any of the following: Cisco, Palo Alto, Juniper, Checkpoint, and Fortinet products.
  • Fast learner with the ability to accept and act on critical feedback.
  • Ability to follow customer support process and procedures.
  • Technical certifications such as Cisco, Microsoft, Linux, Network or Security +, computer science degree, cyber security degree, or currently enrolled in a computer science, or cyber security program at a technical college.
  • Experience and demonstrated knowledge of Network Security, Firewall, Linux, and/or Endpoint Vendors.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of the OSI model, Linux file system, network security industry compliance, firewall packet handling, syslog, and intermediate level firewall administration.
  • Excellent communication skills both written and verbal as well as excellent organizational skills.
  • Excellent decision-making and problem-solving capability, efficient multi-tasking in a fast paced, constantly evolving environment.
  • Be an expert researcher and self-starter.
  • Experience with incident management tracking systems Zendesk & Jira (Case or Ticket Management), or other CRM.
  • Intermediate knowledge of networking protocols: OSI model, NAT & PAT, TCP/UDP, and HTTP.
  • Intermediate experience in researching & identifying solutions in log files for different systems: Firewall, Unix/Linux System logs, Windows Event Logs.
  • Ability to manage customer expectations and re-align those expectations around product functionality.
  • Strong time management skills.
  • Demonstrate ability to identify & understand different FireMon Ecosystem components, collect, and then investigate appropriate log files based on the issue presented.

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Previous work experience with FireMon User Interface and configuration.
  • Advanced Linux & Firewall logs troubleshooting and analysis.
  • Beginner scripting knowledge (BASH, Perl, Python, PHP).
  • Previous technical support call center or help desk experience.

What it Takes to be Part of the FireMon Team

FireMon provides persistent network security for hybrid environments through a powerful fusion of real-time asset visibility, continuous compliance, and automation. Since creating the first-ever network security policy management solution, FireMon has delivered command and control over complex network security infrastructures for more than 1,700 customers.
Our customers have unique and complex security problems that are difficult to solve. This doesn’t intimidate us, it inspires us. It pushes us to be more creative and find solutions to ensure their success. If this sounds like a movement you'd be interested in joining, we invite you to apply today.

jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position. Embrace Healthcare Group powers some of the most innovative healthcare technology solutions in North America, with a focus on enhancing clinical efficiency and compliance across emergency care settings.
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Embrace Healthcare Group powers some of the most innovative healthcare technology solutions in North America, with a focus on enhancing clinical efficiency and compliance across emergency care settings.

EPOWERdoc, a leading SaaS platform within the Embrace Healthcare Group portfolio, specializes in Emergency Department Information Systems (EDIS) tailored for hospitals of all sizes. Designed by clinicians for clinicians, EPOWERdoc streamlines emergency room documentation with intuitive workflows, customizable templates, peer-reviewed clinical content, and real-time coding assistance—helping providers reduce documentation time and focus more on patient care.

We’re looking for a Senior QA Engineer to build EPOWERdoc’s next-generation quality engineering practice, AI-native from day one. This is a hands-on builder role: you’ll choose and architect our test automation stack, write much of the code yourself, and use AI coding agents every day to design, generate, maintain, and triage tests.

You’ll also own how we test AI itself. You’ll design the evaluation harnesses and guardrails that show EPOWERdoc’s AI-powered capabilities are accurate, safe, and dependable enough for an emergency department. You’ll partner closely with developers, product managers, designers, and clinical content experts.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead QA strategy: Own the end-to-end quality strategy for EPOWERdoc, defining test plans, risk-based coverage goals, and quality gates for every release.
  • Architect the QA tech stack: Evaluate, select, and document the tooling for UI, API, performance, accessibility, and security testing, recording each decision and its trade-offs in architecture decision records.
  • Build automation and expand coverage: Design and maintain scalable test frameworks for web applications, APIs, and integrations. Set standards clear enough that engineers and AI agents can extend them reliably. Use these frameworks to replace manual regression with automated coverage of critical clinical workflows such as triage, documentation, orders, and discharge.
  • Performance and reliability: Build load, stress, and soak tests that model real emergency department peak volumes, establish performance baselines, and catch regressions before they reach production.
  • Own CI/CD quality: Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines so every pull request and build is validated quickly. Use parallel execution and AI-assisted test impact analysis to keep feedback loops short as the suite grows.
  • Defect management: Work with engineering teams to identify, document, prioritise, and resolve defects early in the development lifecycle, and drive root-cause analysis.
  • Exploratory testing: Lead exploratory testing of new features and complex clinical user flows, combining human judgement with AI-driven exploration where automation alone adds less value.
  • Agile partnership: Bring a quality perspective to sprint planning, refinement, and retrospectives, including estimates, acceptance criteria, and release readiness.
  • Quality advocacy: Champion a quality-first culture from code reviews to release management. Report on quality metrics and trends such as escaped defects, flakiness, and test cycle time.
  • Security and compliance: Ensure testing practices, test data, and the use of AI tools meet HIPAA and healthcare data security standards, with no real PHI in test environments or AI prompts.
AI-NATIVE QUALITY ENGINEERING
AI is part of how this team works every day. In this role you will:
  • AI-assisted test design: Use LLMs to turn user stories, acceptance criteria, and clinical specifications into test scenarios, edge cases, and boundary conditions, then review and sharpen them with sound test-design judgement.
  • Agentic test authoring: Use AI coding agents and Playwright’s MCP server and test agents (planner, generator, and healer) to create and maintain automated tests. Hold generated code to the same review and quality bar as production code.
  • Self-healing and failure triage: Apply AI to locator healing, flaky-test detection, and automated failure analysis: clustering failures, summarising likely root causes, and routing defects to the right owner.
  • Synthetic test data: Make realistic, PHI-free synthetic patient records and clinical scenarios the default for functional, performance, and AI evaluation testing, using tools such as Synthea or LLM-driven generators.
  • Testing AI features: Design evaluation frameworks for AI-powered EPOWERdoc capabilities. These include golden datasets, scoring rubrics, LLM-as-judge grading calibrated against human review, and regression gates that run whenever a model, prompt, or knowledge source changes.
  • AI safety and guardrails: Test AI features for hallucination, clinical and coding accuracy, bias, PHI leakage, prompt injection, and graceful failure. Work with clinical experts to define what “good enough for the ED” means in measurable terms.
  • Measure and share impact: Track how AI changes test authoring time and maintenance effort, and share what works with other Embrace engineering teams.
THE STACK YOU’LL SHAPE
This is our starting point, not a mandate. You’ll own the final decisions and the reasoning behind them.
  • UI and end-to-end: Playwright with TypeScript, including visual regression and automated accessibility checks (axe-core).
  • API and integration: Playwright API testing, contract testing (for example Pact), and validation of HL7 and FHIR interfaces.
  • Performance: Locust or k6 for load, stress, and soak testing.
  • Security: OWASP ZAP and dependency scanning in CI, plus the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications as the baseline for AI features.
  • AI tooling: AI coding agents (such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor), Playwright MCP and test agents, and LLM evaluation frameworks such as Promptfoo, DeepEval, or Ragas, with tracing through Langfuse or LangSmith.
  • CI/CD and reporting: Tests running on every pull request, with Allure or a similar dashboard for trends, flakiness, and release readiness.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • First 30 days: You understand EPOWERdoc’s clinical workflows, existing test assets, and release process. You’ve proposed the target QA stack and AI-native approach as written architecture decision records.
  • By 90 days: Playwright smoke and regression suites cover the most critical clinical workflows and run on every pull request. A performance baseline exists for peak load. AI-assisted test authoring is in daily use with measured results.
  • By 6 months: Manual regression effort is a small fraction of today’s. Flaky tests are tracked and trending down. An evaluation harness gates every release of AI-powered features.

Requirements

  • Experience: 5+ years of professional QA or software testing experience, including at least 3 years building test automation, ideally in a SaaS or web application environment.
  • QA foundations: Solid understanding of QA methodologies, risk-based testing, test design techniques, and software development life cycles.
  • Programming: Strong coding skills in TypeScript or JavaScript and working proficiency in Python. You write test code with the same care as production code.
  • Test automation: Hands-on experience with modern automation tools, with Playwright strongly preferred (Cypress or Selenium also considered). This includes building scalable frameworks from the ground up, managing test data, keeping suites stable and fast, and a record of well-reasoned tooling decisions.

jobs.description:
Tech Lead - New Customers Team

Hybrid in London, UK

We’re looking for a Tech Lead.

You'll lead the engineering behind how new businesses become iwoca customers – the application they fill in, the checks they go through, and the offer they get.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The New Customers team owns everything from a business's first application to a funded loan: the application flow, the logic that routes each application, the documents we ask customers for, and the models that set loan amounts and pricing. Its measure of success is the customer lifetime value it adds between sign-up and first loan.

The team sets its own goals and direction. It brings together engineers, data scientists, and product and strategy people. It partners closely with credit risk on the trade-offs behind every lending decision. Knowledge sharing is central to how the team works, supported by regular forums to share findings, and dedicated research and development time.

You'll lead two engineers and report to the head of engineering for iwoca's customer journey, from first application to repeat lending.

The role

As the Tech Lead, you'll spend most of your time building. The team is moving its offer logic out of a legacy monolith into multiple services.. The next phase is yours to lead.

  • Autonomy and ownership. You'll shape what the team builds, decide how to build it, and own what goes live. You'll set its engineering roadmap, including what to pull out of the monolith, what to rewrite, and in what order.

  • Technical depth. You'll design the services that turn the team's models and rules into a lending decision for each application. You'll keep them reliable in production and easy to change as the models evolve.

  • Experimentation and learning. You'll build the systems that let data scientists test new models on live applications. Some experiments run for years, until each loan reaches the end of its term. You'll see the long-term results of the team's lending decisions.

  • Leadership and growth. You'll line-manage and coach the team's engineers, setting context and helping them own projects end to end. As the team grows, you'll decide the skills and make-up it needs, and hire the engineers to match.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Technical leadership. You've led a team of engineers for at least two years, including line management, while still remaining hands on.

  • Backend engineering. You have deep expertise in at least one object-oriented language. You've designed, built, and run customer-facing backend systems in production.

  • Commercial or product thinking. You take a business goal, get to the root of what's needed and why, and turn it into a technical plan. You can explain a trade-off in terms of what it means for customers and the business.

  • AI leverage. You've built agentic workflows, or used AI to deliver engineering work you couldn't have done alone. You help your team do the same. You judge where it's useful. You check its output before it reaches production.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

Bonus:

  • Lending or payments experience. You've worked in lending, payments, or another domain where engineering decisions carry financial risk.

  • Experimentation. You've built systems that run controlled experiments, especially long-running ones.

  • Legacy migration. You've moved business-critical logic out of a complex legacy monolith and kept everything that depends on it working.

  • Working with data scientists. You've worked with data scientists from prototype to production, and know their work well enough to challenge it.

  • Python stack. You've worked with Python, Django, and PostgreSQL.

  • Frontend. You've built frontend features as well as backend services.

The salary

We expect to pay from £90,000 to £120,000 for this role. But, we're open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Useful links:

  • iwoca benefits & policies

  • Interview welcome pack (TAP)

Compensation Range: £90K - £120K

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title: Lead Control Systems Engineer

Position Location: Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States

JOB SUMMARY

The Lead Control Systems Engineer provides leadership, expertise, and delegates work for construction document

deliverables for building automation system (BAS), electrical power monitoring system (EPMS), and software

integration design projects in hyperscale data center and similar mission critical / technology sectors.

The Lead Control Systems Engineer will work with internal and external MEP/FP trade engineers, equipment

representatives, product vendors, and BIM / Revit / AutoCAD production resources.

The Lead Control Systems Engineer will be self-directed on day-to-day work and receive high level instruction on new

projects, tasks or assignments. Will execute and lead teams and projects, tasks or assignments of complex scope. This

role also will coordinate activities of other personnel and serve as a people manager.

This person will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals / values, and departmental objectives.

  • projects and / or programs.

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

POSITION REQUIREMENTS (ADVANCED LEVEL FOR ALL THE FOLLOWING)

  • Skilled in navigating clients through BAS project designs including identification of standards, needs, and option evaluation
  • Skilled at using MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams), along with exceptional organizational skills for file management
  • Knowledge of Revit and AutoCAD
  • Skilled in completing assignments accurately and with attention to detail
  • Skilled in designing BAS and EPMS packages

  • Knowledge of IoT and smart building solutions
  • Knowledge of networking including addressing, VLANs, LANs, switches, and routers
  • Knowledge of OT protocols (BACnet, Modbus, SNMP, and MQTT)
  • Knowledge of DDC systems used in building automation designs

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

Your expertise will help drive the successful execution of studies from site qualification through closeout, supporting the delivery of reliable data that advances clinical research.


In this role, you'll serve as a trusted partner to investigative sites, study teams, and sponsors, building strong relationships while providing leadership, guidance, and oversight across clinical trial activities. Your contributions will directly support high-quality study delivery by ensuring protocol adherence, regulatory compliance, timely data collection, and effective site performance throughout the clinical trial lifecycle.

Candidates must reside within the territory to effectively support site visits and study activities. You will collaborate with sites, sponsors, and global study teams while traveling to investigative sites approximately 8-10 days per month.


To best support our sites, we're seeking candidates who are based on the East Coast United States. Travel will primarily be regional, with occasional travel to support sites in other locations as needed.

  • Train site personnel on protocol requirements, data collection processes, and safety reporting expectations.
  • Monitor site performance and provide ongoing support throughout study maintenance activities.
  • Ensure compliance with informed consent requirements, safety reporting obligations, and applicable regulatory standards.
  • Partner with sites and study teams to drive data quality, participant safety, and overall study success.
  • Support site closeout activities and ensure study requirements are completed at the conclusion of the trial.

  • Required experience monitoring Psychiatric clinical trials.
  • Requires travel within the specified region; 8 – 10 DOS monthly
  • Experience in full-service monitoring preferred.

Summary:

We're hiring a Systems Engineer to work directly alongside our Senior Systems Engineer, taking ownership of the day-to-day, high-volume execution work across identity and access management, SaaS/vendor administration, and AI tooling support. This person will handle routine and escalated tickets, keep recurring operational work (access provisioning, certificate renewals, procurement intake, license/access requests) moving reliably, and free up the senior engineer to focus on architecture, vendor strategy, and higher-risk security work. This is a strong role for someone who wants hands-on exposure to modern identity infrastructure and emerging AI platform administration, with a clear growth path toward a senior identity/systems engineering role.

What You’ll Do:

  • Process day-to-day Azure AD/Entra access requests: group membership changes, access package assignments, and standard onboarding/offboarding.
  • Monitor and action alerts for registered-app secrets and SSO/SAML certificates approaching expiration; execute routine renewals under senior engineer guidance.
  • Handle first-pass triage and provisioning for SCIM-based app access requests.
  • Support Atlassian (Jira/Confluence) group access requests and routine permission changes.
  • Own intake and initial documentation for new SaaS vendor procurement reviews (e.g., Zip requests), preparing them for senior/security review.
  • Execute standard software lifecycle tasks — user provisioning/deprovisioning, license tracking, renewal reminders — for existing SaaS tools.
  • Assist with license and cost audits to support ongoing SaaS cost-management initiatives.
  • Handle routine AI tool access requests (e.g., Claude/Anthropic license grants, Bedrock access requests) and standard troubleshooting for existing MCP integrations.
  • Support configuration and rollout tasks for AI vendor tools (e.g., Letter AI, Clay, Granola) — SSO/SCIM setup, basic integration troubleshooting — under senior engineer direction.
  • Document AI tool setup procedures and known issues to build a self-serve knowledge base for common requests.
  • Execute assigned phases of endpoint management rollouts (Intune Suite, NinjaOne) and OS end-of-life remediation projects.
  • Apply routine patches and respond to standard CVE remediation tasks as assigned.
  • Serve as first-line owner for escalated help-desk (ITHD) tickets involving access grants, credential issues, and standard cross-system troubleshooting.
  • Triage incoming escalations, resolve what's within scope, and flag higher-risk or ambiguous issues to the senior engineer with clear context.
  • Execute routine MFA/conditional access policy changes as directed.
  • Flag anomalous activity or potential security events for senior engineer review; assist with documented remediation steps.

What Success Looks Like…

In 3 months…

  • Gain proficiency in the organization's core platforms (Entra ID, SaaS applications, endpoint management, and AI tooling) and independently perform routine access, provisioning, and lifecycle management tasks.
  • Resolve standard identity, access, SaaS, and endpoint-related tickets while adhering to documented procedures, security controls, and SLA expectations.
  • Build foundational platform knowledge by completing required training and creating or updating documentation for common processes, troubleshooting steps, and support workflows.
  • Identify at least one opportunity in your role to pilot or apply AI or automation (e.g., streamlining a task, summarizing data, generating content).

In 6 months…

  • Independently manage assigned operational responsibilities, including SCIM provisioning, SSO/SAML certificate renewals, license management, endpoint administration, and AI platform support.
  • Troubleshoot cross-platform issues involving identity, authentication, device management, and SaaS integrations, escalating only higher-risk or complex issues.
  • Contribute to process improvement efforts through documentation enhancements, automation opportunities, cost optimization initiatives, or workflow standardization.

In 12 months…

  • Serve as the primary owner for one or more technology areas, consistently delivering reliable administration, maintenance, and support for assigned platforms.
  • Lead assigned components of system implementations, upgrades, integrations, or remediation projects while collaborating effectively with security, infrastructure, and business stakeholders.
  • Demonstrate engineering-level impact by identifying operational risks, implementing efficiency improvements, and acting as a technical resource for peers and service desk teams.

What You Need:

  • 2+ years of experience in IT support, systems administration, or a related identity/access role.
  • Working knowledge of Azure AD/Entra ID, SSO/SAML concepts, and basic SCIM provisioning (or strong aptitude and willingness to ramp quickly).
  • Comfort working in a ticketing system (Jira Service Management or similar) and managing a queue of concurrent requests with competing priorities.
  • Familiarity with common enterprise SaaS administration (user provisioning, license management) is a plus.
  • Interest in AI tooling and willingness to learn enterprise AI platform administration (Claude/Anthropic, Bedrock, MCP integrations) — no prior AI-specific experience required.
  • Strong written communication — this role documents its own work and hands off context clearly.
  • Comfort being the first point of contact on escalated, sometimes urgent, end-user issues.
  • Comfort using or learning AI-supported tools (e.g., ChatGPT, CoPilot, or role-specific tools) to improve daily workflows.
  • A forward-thinking, curious mindset with an openness to experimenting with new technologies.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with sound judgment and creativity in designing solutions.
  • Proven ability to thrive in fast-paced, high-growth, and rapidly evolving environments.
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote-first environment, ensuring high-quality virtual interactions with minimal distractions.
  • The ability to travel periodically for work.

What You Get:

  • Join one of the most innovative healthcare technology companies in the country.
  • Have the autonomy to build something with an enthusiastically supportive team.
  • Learn from working at the highest levels and on the most strategic priorities of the company, including from world class investors and advisors.
  • Receive competitive compensation including health, dental, vision and other benefits.

Every human being has the right to the best possible healthcare. Our Real-Time Care Intelligence™ solutions enable healthcare professionals to see and treat every individual as a whole person by providing the right information, at the right time – regardless of physical, behavioral or social barriers.

You will serve as a trusted partner throughout the customer lifecycle, helping clerks, administrators, IT teams, council members, and other stakeholders manage agendas, meetings, voting, minutes, livestreaming, public transparency, and records access. Who You Are

You are an analytical, highly organized, and collaborative professional who thrives in building structure out of ambiguity. You enjoy solving complex problems, improving processes, and enabling teams to operate more effectively. You are equally comfortable working with data, developing scalable frameworks, and communicating with stakeholders across different functions and levels of leadership.

You are a proactive problem-solver who can balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution. We are looking for a hands-on engineer with a strong combination of systems engineering, software development, infrastructure, and technical implementation experience.

The candidate will develop software components, configure and deploy systems, integrate applications, and resolve technical challenges across infrastructure and application layers. The role requires the ability to move between coding, system administration, deployment, and implementation based on business and technical requirements.

The ideal candidate is a practical problem-solver who can work independently, understand complex technical environments, and take ownership of solutions from development through deployment and ongoing support.

Key Responsibilities

1. Systems Engineering and Infrastructure

  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Linux servers and application environments.
  • Manage cloud infrastructure, virtual machines, networking, DNS, firewalls, and SSL/TLS configurations.
  • Diagnose system-level issues involving resource utilization, connectivity, permissions, and application availability.
  • Maintain system reliability, performance, security, and operational stability.
  • Automate routine administrative and infrastructure tasks wherever possible.

  • Build backend services, REST APIs, scripts, and automation utilities.
  • Work with databases, including PostgreSQL and MySQL, for application development and troubleshooting.
  • Understand existing codebases, identify defects, implement fixes, and develop new functionality.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and testable code following established engineering practices.

3. Deployment and DevOps

  • Deploy and manage applications using Docker and container-based environments.
  • Configure and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment.
  • Manage Git-based development workflows, application configurations, environment variables, and deployment processes.
  • Troubleshoot build failures, runtime errors, failed deployments, and service interruptions.
  • Implement monitoring, logging, backup, recovery, and operational procedures.

4. System Integration and Forward Deployed Engineering

  • Translate business and operational requirements into practical technical solutions.
  • Integrate software applications with third-party APIs, databases, services, and external systems.
  • Configure and deploy solutions across different infrastructure and operating environments.
  • Work directly with stakeholders to understand requirements, investigate issues, and validate implementations.
  • Adapt existing software and develop supporting components to address real-world technical challenges.
  • Collect implementation feedback and work with engineering teams to improve product functionality and reliability.

5. Troubleshooting and Technical Ownership

  • Investigate and resolve issues across application, infrastructure, database, and network layers.
  • Perform root-cause analysis and implement sustainable corrective actions.
  • Take ownership of technical issues from initial investigation through resolution and verification.
  • Document system configurations, integrations, deployment procedures, and troubleshooting steps.
  • Identify opportunities to improve automation, maintainability, security, and system performance.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3–5 years of relevant experience in systems engineering, software development, infrastructure engineering, DevOps, or a combination of these disciplines.
  • Strong hands-on programming skills in Python or JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Practical experience administering and troubleshooting Linux environments.
  • Understanding of backend applications, REST APIs, databases, and software integration.
  • Experience with Docker, Git, and application deployment workflows.
  • Working knowledge of AWS, Google Cloud Platform, or Microsoft Azure.
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, ports, firewalls, and SSL/TLS.
  • Experience with SQL databases, preferably PostgreSQL or MySQL.
  • Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure automation tools such as Terraform or Ansible.
  • Experience with monitoring, centralized logging, and performance troubleshooting.
  • Exposure to Kubernetes, distributed systems, background workers, or message queues.
  • Experience implementing integrations with external platforms and APIs.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML application deployment or LLM-based systems.
  • Experience working in environments that require direct technical implementation and stakeholder interaction.

Expected Competencies

  • Hands-on engineering: Comfortable writing code, working with servers, and debugging applications.
  • Systems thinking: Understands how software, infrastructure, networking, and databases interact.
  • Execution and ownership: Can take a problem from investigation to implementation, testing, and deployment.
