jobs.excerpt: Location: 100% Remote Employment: Full-time, long-term position Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility About UsWe are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies.
jobs.description:
Location: 100% Remote
Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve our engineering workflows, and build practical knowledge across the team.

We are looking for a senior developer who can take ownership of mobile development, deliver reliable software, and help our team become more effective at building applications with AI.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior Mobile App Developer with strong Kotlin Multiplatform expertise and an excellent background in native Android development with Kotlin.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will develop and improve our application, solve complex technical problems, and establish effective workflows for AI-assisted and agentic development. Experience with GPS, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Ultra-Wideband (UWB), or related location and proximity technologies would be particularly valuable.

You will also share your knowledge with our internal team, including mentoring a junior team member who is learning to build Android applications through AI-assisted development, often referred to as “vibe coding.”

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and improve our Android application using Kotlin and Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Design shared application logic and integrate it with platform-specific functionality.
  • Implement and troubleshoot location and proximity features involving GPS, BLE, UWB, and related device capabilities.
  • Address practical mobile challenges such as permissions, background execution, battery consumption, connectivity, and differences between devices.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents extensively to implement features, investigate defects, refactor code, and support testing.
  • Set up and improve agentic development workflows, including task decomposition, project context, automated checks, and review processes.
  • Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
  • Test relevant functionality on real devices and resolve problems that automated tests alone may not reveal.
  • Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and understandable explanations.
  • Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production Android applications with Kotlin.
  • Strong practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform, including shared code, platform-specific integrations, and the boundaries between them.
  • Solid understanding of Android architecture, Jetpack Compose, coroutines, Flow, application lifecycle, and state management.
  • Strong debugging skills and the ability to investigate problems across application code, APIs, and device behavior.
  • Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
  • A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
  • The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain why an implementation is appropriate.
  • Willingness and ability to teach less experienced team members patiently and clearly.
  • The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • GPS positioning, location accuracy, sensor data, and proximity detection.
  • BLE discovery, advertising, connections, and signal-strength limitations.
  • UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility.
  • NFC and other device-to-device interactions.
  • Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • Ownership of meaningful mobile development work.
  • The opportunity to shape how our team uses AI and coding agents.
  • Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your role in developing Android applications and Kotlin Multiplatform solutions.
  • Any practical experience with GPS, BLE, UWB, or similar technologies.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with an example of how they helped you deliver a working application or feature.
  • Your experience mentoring junior developers or colleagues learning AI-assisted development.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio or GitHub links are welcome where available.

jobs.description:
SS&C is a leading provider of mission-critical, AI-powered technology and services empowering financial services and healthcare organizations to work smarter, faster, and securely. Founded in 1986, SS&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has offices worldwide. More than 23,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid-market firms, rely on SS&C for expertise, scale, and technology.


Job Description


AI Engineer – Marketing Intelligence & Automation

SS&C Intralinks | Marketing – Digital & Intelligence

About the Role

SS&C Intralinks is building an AI-enabled marketing intelligence model that connects data, digital experiences, automation, and AI to improve how Marketing understands customers, makes decisions, and activates across the funnel. We are hiring an AI Engineer to help build the technical foundation behind that model.

This role sits at the intersection of AI engineering, marketing technology, data engineering, and digital experience. You will design and deploy the agents, integrations, data pipelines, orchestration workflows, and intelligence services that turn fragmented marketing data and manual processes into connected, scalable systems.

This is not a traditional campaign execution role. You will build the engineering layer beneath an increasingly AI-enabled marketing organization: connecting platforms and data, enabling agents to reason over trusted information, automating workflows, and creating reusable services that can support personalization, attribution, predictive intent, conversational experiences, content operations, and executive intelligence.

You will partner closely with Digital Marketing, Marketing Operations, Demand Generation, Field Marketing, Content/Creative, Analytics, IT, Data, and other stakeholders. The initial focus is establishing a strong architecture and reusable foundation; over time, the role will help operationalize increasingly autonomous marketing capabilities.

What You’ll Build

  • AI agents and agentic workflows: Design, build, evaluate, and maintain AI agents that can retrieve trusted marketing and business context, analyze information, recommend actions, and execute approved workflows across marketing systems.
  • Marketing intelligence infrastructure: Build the services and pipelines that unify first-party marketing and CRM data, website behavior, campaign performance, search/AI visibility, intent signals, attribution inputs, and other relevant sources into an accessible intelligence layer.
  • API and platform integrations: Connect marketing, data, CMS, CRM, analytics, AI, and workflow platforms through secure APIs, event-driven integrations, and reusable services rather than brittle one-off automations.
  • Retrieval and knowledge systems: Create RAG and related retrieval patterns that allow AI systems to work from approved messaging, product information, campaign assets, customer insights, brand standards, and other governed enterprise knowledge.
  • Predictive and next-best-action capabilities: Help develop models and decisioning services that combine first-party behavior and third-party signals to identify in-market accounts, prioritize opportunities, and recommend appropriate next actions.
  • Digital journey orchestration: Build the technical capabilities required for adaptive website and digital experiences, including profile- and account-aware messaging, content recommendations, calls-to-action, and journey logic.
  • Conversational AI: Develop LLM-powered experiences that can engage and qualify visitors, answer questions using approved enterprise knowledge, route inquiries, and integrate with downstream sales and marketing workflows.
  • Measurement, attribution, and forecasting: Engineer data and AI services that improve multi-touch measurement, channel contribution analysis, pipeline intelligence, forecasting, and executive decision support.
  • Content and publishing automation: Build systems that connect AI-assisted content creation, governance, CMS workflows, structured data, localization/personalization, and distribution while maintaining human review where required.
  • Search and AI visibility automation: Support SEO/AEO/GEO systems that monitor traditional and AI search visibility, structured data, content performance, citations, and opportunities for optimization at scale.
  • Experimentation and evaluation: Create test harnesses, observability, quality controls, and evaluation frameworks for prompts, agents, models, workflows, and digital experiences so deployments are measurable and reliable.
  • Reusable engineering standards: Codify successful patterns into components, templates, documentation, and playbooks that allow the broader Marketing organization to scale AI safely and consistently.

How This Role Supports the Marketing Roadmap

The AI Engineer will provide a shared technical foundation for several planned Marketing 4.0 capabilities. The role is not expected to own each business program independently; instead, it will build the architecture, services, integrations, and AI components that make these capabilities possible.

  • AI-driven journey orchestration and website personalization
  • Hyper-personalized event and account intelligence
  • AI-driven multi-touch attribution and forecasting
  • Predictive intent and next-best-action routing
  • Conversational AI and increasingly autonomous inbound qualification
  • Content personalization and production systems at scale

What Success Looks Like

  • Marketing data and knowledge can be accessed by AI systems through governed, well-documented interfaces rather than manual exports and disconnected point solutions.
  • High-value workflows move from manual execution to reliable human-in-the-loop or autonomous orchestration where appropriate.
  • Agents produce traceable, measurable outputs grounded in trusted enterprise data and content.
  • Digital, campaign, search, intent, attribution, and pipeline signals can be connected to produce actionable intelligence rather than isolated reporting.
  • New AI use cases can be deployed faster because core components—identity, retrieval, integrations, evaluation, observability, permissions, and orchestration—are reusable.
  • Marketing teams spend less time assembling data and executing repetitive processes and more time interpreting insights, making decisions, and improving customer experiences.

Who You Are

  • 4+ years of experience in AI engineering, software engineering, data engineering, ML engineering, marketing engineering, or a similar role building production technical systems.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and experience with JavaScript/TypeScript or another modern application language.
  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs, including APIs, tool/function calling, structured outputs, prompt design, agent frameworks, and production evaluation.
  • Experience designing RAG or enterprise knowledge-retrieval systems, including embeddings, vector search, metadata, chunking, permissions, and source grounding.
  • Experience building data pipelines, APIs, event-driven integrations, and workflow automations across SaaS and enterprise platforms.
  • Working knowledge of cloud architecture and data platforms; experience with AWS and Amazon Redshift is particularly relevant.
  • Understanding of data modeling, identity resolution, data quality, observability, security, access controls, and governance.
  • Experience with marketing technology, CRM, CMS, analytics, digital experience, or marketing automation platforms is strongly preferred.
  • Systems thinker who favors durable architecture and reusable services over isolated scripts or one-off solutions.
  • Able to translate ambiguous business problems into technical designs, prototypes, production systems, and measurable outcomes.
  • Clear communicator who can explain architecture, tradeoffs, risk, and business impact to both technical and non-technical partners.
  • Comfortable testing emerging AI capabilities while applying appropriate controls for accuracy, privacy, security, and brand risk.
  • Experience in B2B, enterprise software, financial technology, or regulated environments is a plus.

Technical Experience We Value

  • Python; JavaScript/TypeScript; REST/GraphQL APIs; webhooks and event-driven integration patterns
  • LLM APIs and agent frameworks; RAG; vector databases/search; model and prompt evaluation; observability
  • AWS services and cloud-native application patterns; Amazon Redshift; SQL and modern data transformation/orchestration approaches
  • CRM and marketing automation integrations, CMS/publishing APIs, web analytics, and customer/digital data sources
  • Git-based development, CI/CD, testing, logging, secrets management, role-based access, and production monitoring
  • Structured data and metadata frameworks such as schema.org/JSON-LD are useful for digital/search-oriented use cases

Operating Principles

  • Build the intelligence layer, not another silo. Solutions should connect and strengthen the broader marketing ecosystem.
  • Ground AI in trusted information. Accuracy, provenance, permissions, and data quality matter as much as model capability.
  • Automate with intent. Use autonomy where it creates measurable value; retain human review where judgment, compliance, or brand risk requires it.
  • Design for reuse. A successful solution should make the next use case easier to build.
  • Measure everything. Agents and automations should have clear success criteria, telemetry, and feedback loops.
  • Business outcomes over AI novelty. Technology choices should improve decision quality, customer experience, speed, efficiency, or revenue impact.

Why This Role Matters

Marketing is moving from a collection of channels and tools toward a connected intelligence system. This role will help create the engineering foundation that allows SS&C Intralinks Marketing to use AI across measurement, digital experiences, content, demand generation, field marketing, and full-funnel engagement—without creating a new set of disconnected AI point solutions.

Our benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage; a 401(k) plan with company match; paid time off, holidays, and parental leave; and professional development reimbursement opportunity.

Company Overview:

Our company is a start-up that specializes in episodes of care benefit plans. We have a deep expertise in episode pricing and analytics and our goal is to bring transparency and efficiency to the healthcare market. Our company is committed to providing high-quality, affordable healthcare to our customers.

Role Description
The Senior Manager, Stop-Loss Risk and Proposals owns the front end of our sales process for self-funded cases. You will evaluate the risk on each case, prepare it for our stop-loss carrier underwriting partners, and manage the proposal through to a quote. This is not a carrier underwriting seat. It is a role for someone who has underwritten stop-loss, knows how underwriters will look at a case before they see it, and wants to use that knowledge on the business side to help our sales team bring better-prepared cases to market and win them.

Responsibilities

Risk Evaluation and Management

  • Review incoming cases and assess the risk before they go to underwriting, including claims experience, census, and plan design.
  • Advise sales leadership on how a case is likely to be viewed and priced by stop-loss carriers, and on which cases to pursue.

RFP and Proposal Management

  • Own the RFP and proposal process for self-funded stop-loss cases, from intake through submission, quote, and follow-up.
  • Check every submission and proposal for accuracy and completeness before it goes out.
  • Gather and compare carrier quotes and recommend the best placement for each case.

Carrier and Underwriter Relationships

  • Work as the day-to-day contact for our stop-loss carrier underwriting partners.
  • Stay current on how each carrier evaluates specific and aggregate stop-loss risk, and on pricing and competitive trends in the self-funded market.

Sales Enablement and Team

  • Partner with sales, brokers, and consultants on case strategy and quotes.
  • Work across sales, finance, and actuarial partners so that pricing, risk, and proposals stay aligned.
  • Build the tools and repeatable processes behind submissions and quoting, and coach junior sales support staff.

Qualifications

  • Describe the experience and attributes of the ideal candidate
  • Stop-loss underwriting experience, ideally at a stop-loss carrier, reinsurer, or managing general underwriter and/or Business-side experience supporting a sales team or broker channel through the RFP, proposal, and quoting process.
  • 7+ years of combined experience in self-funded group health stop-loss on either the carrier or business side.
  • Working knowledge of specific and aggregate stop-loss, including how cases are underwritten and priced.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

Benefits

  • Health: Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Retirement: 401(k) with company match
  • Paid leave: Vacation, Sick, and company holidays
  • Ancillary: Company-paid life and disability insurance

jobs.excerpt: Who are Tyk, and what do we do? The Tyk API Management platform is helping to drive the connected world and power new products and services.
jobs.description:
Who are Tyk, and what do we do?

The Tyk API Management platform is helping to drive the connected world and power new products and services. We’re changing the way that organisations connect any number of their systems and services. Whether internal, external, public or highly encrypted systems, Tyk helps businesses drive value across the retail, finance, telecoms, healthcare, or media industries (to name just a few!)

If you’ve banked online, used an app to check the news, or perhaps even driven a connected car, API’s, and by extension, Tyk, make that possible. Founded in 2015 with offices in London - UK, London - Ontario, Atlanta and Singapore, we have many thousands of users of our B2B platform across the globe. Brands using Tyk range from Lotte, Bell, T Mobile, to RBS, Capital One and Vinci. We have a varied user base hailing from every continent – even Antarctica.

Our Mission

Tyk is on a mission to connect every system in the world. We’ve started by building an API Management platform.

Total flexibility, default remote, radical responsibility

We offer unlimited paid holidays and remote working from anywhere in the world, for everyone, Why? Tyk was founded on the principle of offering flexibility and autonomy to our employees, we believe this allows our employees to achieve their best results. It also means we can build the best possible team, location and working hours are no barrier.

If this sounds like an environment that you believe could work for you then read on to find out more.

As a Principal Support Engineer at Tyk, you’ll serve as a strategic and technical leader within the Customer Success organization. This role goes beyond reactive support—you're a cross-functional enabler, responsible for driving technical excellence, leading high-priority escalations, mentoring engineers, and shaping the future of post-sales support.

You’ll work closely with Engineering, Account Management, and Product teams to improve platform stability, customer satisfaction, and the scalability of our support operations. You're the person people turn to when things get complex—technically and strategically.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Escalation Management

  • Proactively oversee the Zendesk queue, ensuring SLAs are consistently met, owning tickets across priority levels, and stepping in on critical, high-impact escalations.
  • Act as a point of escalation for systemic issues, leading incident resolution and partnering with cross-functional teams - escalations would first come to you before going to Product.
  • Work with Pod Leads to identify and resolve recurring support workflow challenges.
  • Guide triage practices to ensure fast, accurate issue isolation across the team.

Technical Excellence & Innovation

  • Lead deep technical investigations, including complex debugging and source code analysis.
  • Identify and implement process improvements, automation, and AI tools to improve operational efficiency and reduce response/resolution time.
  • Maintain ticket quality across the board, ensuring product teams receive actionable, high-quality submissions.
  • Contribute bug fixes, tooling, or workarounds to the codebase to unblock customers.
  • Anticipate platform-wide issues and proactively work to prevent them through architecture awareness and preventive strategies.
  • Ensure critical knowledge is documented and shared, maintaining a robust Zendesk knowledge base, debugging guides, and external documentation

Operational & Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Adhere to escalation SLAs and act as a key player in the on-call rotation to maintain 24/7 global support.
  • Take ownership of high-severity incidents and critical customer escalations.
  • Regularly review team metrics to identify improvement areas and help set team-wide goals and focus areas.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to drive product-level changes based on support data and customer impact.
  • Represent the Customer Success Engineering team in company-wide strategic initiatives, shaping the future of post-sales support.
  • Support the evolution of internal support policies (e.g., SLAs, escalation procedures, “won’t fix” standards).

Customer-Centric Engagement

  • Serve as a trusted, senior post-sales contact for high-value customers, ensuring a seamless and proactive support experience.
  • Champion initiatives that improve the customer journey, including better routing, issue ownership, and self-service capabilities.
  • Take an active leadership role, ensuring timely and technically accurate responses.
  • Advocate for the voice of the customer in internal planning, identifying feature needs or systemic weaknesses from real-world usage.
  • Join customer onboarding to introduce the support team, understand the customer's goals, and help establish how we'll work together.
  • Participate in recurring client meetings to discuss tickets, technical challenges, and customer needs, bringing relevant feedback back to the wider team.

Continuous Improvement & Long-Term Impact

  • Lead root cause analysis (RCA) and post-mortems for major incidents from a customer success position, ensuring long-term resolution and process adaptation.
  • Drive ticket volume reduction by identifying recurring pain points and proposing durable solutions at a platform or documentation level.
  • Play a critical role in evolving support strategy to scale as Tyk grows, influencing structure, tooling, and hiring decisions.

Requirements

What We’re Looking For

  • Extensive experience in technical support or success engineering roles, with proven leadership in complex escalations and systemic improvements.
  • Strong background in dealing with large Enterprise customers.
  • Strong background in an API / APIM driven environment.
  • Someone who isn’t afraid to get their hands dirty in new technologies. A great senior engineer not only knows the Tyk component/technologies but they often will have to know and set up other technologies that the customer uses, i.e kubernetes, docker, databases, SSO/IDPs etc
  • Strong debugging skills—able to read source code and diagnose issues in distributed systems.
  • Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead without authority, influencing product, engineering, and customer success peers.
  • Passion for operational excellence, automation, and scalable support strategies.
  • A growth mindset—you lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to continuously improve yourself and those around you.
  • Comfort working with different region customers, with willingness to participate in rotational on-call shifts (including weekends).

Benefits

Here’s why you should join us:

  • Everyone has unlimited paid holidays.
  • We have total flexibility in hours, as we believe creativity flows better when our people are given freedom to decide when they are most productive. Everyone is unique after all.
  • Employee share scheme
  • Generous maternity and paternity leave
  • Volunteering Days
  • Company retreats
  • Employee Wellbeing platform

We all share the same vision - we value authenticity, respect, responsibility, independence, honesty, diversity and inclusion and most importantly treating others how you wish to be treated. We look for like-minded people who bring their personalities to work everyday, strive to achieve their personal goals and who are willing to challenge the way we do things, why? - to make what we do even better!

Our values tell the story of Tyk - here’s how:

  • It’s ok to screw up!

We’ve found that it’s often the ‘stupid’ or unexpected ideas that turn out to be the successful ones - so try it, at least we can say we have!

  • The only stupid idea, is the untested one!

It’s in our DNA - starting a business with founders 12 hours apart, giving our gateway away for free - sure, we did that, and we’d do it again!

  • Trust starts with you - make it count!

Trust is a two-way street - instil it from day one!

  • Assume best intent!

We have each other’s back - we’re all on the same team. Think before you speak or act.

  • Make things better!

Always try to leave things better than when you found them - change is constant, inevitable and embraced! Be that change we want to see.

What’s it like to work here?! check it out:

jobs.description:
About the Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled Senior AI Full-Stack Engineer who has a proven track record of building, deploying and scaling AI-powered applications in production.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who can take ownership of technical architecture, integrate large language models (LLMs), build intelligent automation workflows and turn business challenges into practical, scalable technology solutions.

The ideal candidate goes beyond experimenting with AI. They have built real products used by thousands of users, understand how to integrate AI into existing systems and can demonstrate the impact of their work through live projects, a GitHub portfolio or technical walkthroughs.

You’ll work closely with leadership to identify opportunities for AI-driven automation, improve internal business processes and develop reliable applications that deliver measurable results.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

AI Development & Integration

  • Build and deploy production-ready AI-powered applications using LLMs such as OpenAI, Anthropic Claude and Google Gemini.
  • Design and implement AI workflows, prompt engineering strategies and intelligent automation solutions.
  • Integrate AI capabilities into existing applications, business systems and internal tools.
  • Evaluate and optimize AI outputs for accuracy, reliability, performance and cost.
  • Apply fine-tuning and other model-customization techniques where appropriate.

Full-Stack Development

  • Design, develop and maintain scalable applications using JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, React and Next.js.
  • Build and maintain robust APIs, webhooks and integrations with third-party platforms.
  • Design, manage and optimize PostgreSQL databases and data models.
  • Develop secure, maintainable and high-performance applications that can support growing user bases.
  • Troubleshoot technical issues and continuously improve application performance.

Technical Architecture & Deployment

  • Take ownership of technical architecture and make independent engineering decisions.
  • Build scalable systems capable of supporting thousands of users.
  • Manage deployment workflows and cloud-based environments using tools such as Vercel and Docker.
  • Use Git and GitHub for version control, collaboration and code management.
  • Establish sound development practices around testing, reliability, security and maintainability.

Business Automation & Collaboration

  • Identify opportunities to streamline business processes through AI and software automation.
  • Develop internal tools and integrations that reduce repetitive manual work.
  • Collaborate directly with leadership to understand business needs and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Communicate technical decisions, progress and challenges clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

Minimum Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional full-stack development experience.
  • Demonstrated experience building and deploying AI-powered applications in production.
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js and modern front-end frameworks such as React or Next.js.
  • Strong experience with PostgreSQL, database design and optimization.
  • Hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs, including OpenAI, Anthropic or Google Gemini.
  • Experience building REST APIs, third-party integrations and automated workflows.
  • Experience deploying and maintaining scalable applications in cloud-based environments.
  • Proven ability to independently design and architect systems used by thousands of users.
  • Strong Git/GitHub skills and the ability to explain technical contributions clearly.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with prompt engineering, AI workflow orchestration and model fine-tuning.
  • Experience with CRM platforms, internal business systems and operational automation.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Vercel and modern cloud deployment workflows.
  • Experience integrating multiple AI models or selecting models based on specific use cases.
  • Experience working directly with business leaders to turn operational challenges into software solutions.

Portfolio & Practical Assessment

Candidates must be able to demonstrate their practical development experience. Applicants should be prepared to share a GitHub profile, portfolio, live application or detailed project walkthrough.

During the interview, candidates should be able to explain:

  • An AI-powered application they personally built and deployed.

The Raspberry Pi Foundation has developed a range of high-quality, research-informed learning experiences that support computing education for young people aged 6–18, across both formal and non-formal learning contexts. These include:

This is a hands-on player-coach role. Alongside delivering your own hires, you’ll help colleagues strengthen their search strategies, assessment judgement and stakeholder management. You’ll lead through expertise, coaching and influence, with success reflected in both the hires you deliver and the capability you build across the team.

What you'll be doing

Lead senior and business critical hiring

  • Own end-to-end recruitment for senior leadership, specialist and business critical positions, including sensitive or confidential searches where required.
  • Translate business priorities into clear hiring briefs, advising leaders on role scope, candidate profiles, seniority, location, compensation and assessment.
  • Build and execute targeted search strategies, using talent mapping, direct sourcing and personalised engagement to reach senior and hard-to-find candidates.
  • Lead kick-offs, calibration sessions and hiring discussions that clarify expectations, challenge assumptions and support timely, evidence-based decisions.
  • Apply sound judgement when assessing leadership capability, relevant experience and transferable backgrounds, particularly where requirements are evolving.
  • Manage complex offers, counter-offers and sensitive candidate conversations, maintaining trust and momentum throughout the process.

Coach colleagues and strengthen team delivery

  • Provide regular, practical coaching through search reviews, candidate calibration and feedback on sourcing, assessment and stakeholder conversations.
  • Help colleagues diagnose stalled searches, refine their approach and resolve difficult hiring challenges, building their confidence and independence.
  • Support priority searches beyond your own portfolio, stepping in where your expertise can help unblock progress or improve outcomes.
  • Partner with the Global Talent Acquisition Lead to prioritise critical hiring, identify capacity constraints and recommend where additional support or a change in approach is needed.
  • Share effective practices and turn successful approaches into tools, guidance and ways of working that the wider team can use.

Improve recruitment performance

  • Use recruitment data, market insight and candidate feedback to identify risks, explain trade-offs and recommend action across priority searches.
  • Maintain accurate records and clear reporting in Greenhouse, giving stakeholders visibility of progress, blockers and next steps.
  • Strengthen structured, inclusive assessment practices and ensure a thoughtful candidate experience, including for senior candidates navigating confidential moves.
  • Lead practical improvements to sourcing, assessment, workflows and automation, demonstrating their impact on hiring quality, conversion, speed and candidate experience.

What you'll bring

  • A strong track record of personally delivering senior, complex and business-critical hires across commercial and business functions, ideally within iGaming and/or FinTech.
  • Experience leading targeted searches for leadership and director-level appointments, from initial scoping and market mapping through to offer acceptance.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate as a player-coach: delivering your own recruitment portfolio while improving the judgement, capability and effectiveness of colleagues.
  • Credibility with senior stakeholders, including evidence of constructively challenging requirements, influencing hiring decisions and navigating competing priorities.
  • Strong hands-on capability in direct sourcing, candidate assessment, offer negotiation and closing.
  • Commercial understanding and the ability to connect hiring decisions to business priorities, quickly building knowledge of unfamiliar functions or talent markets.
  • Sound judgement and discretion when handling ambiguous requirements, sensitive appointments and complex candidate conversations.
  • The ability to translate recruitment data and market evidence into clear recommendations and practical interventions.
  • Significant hands-on experience using Greenhouse for workflow management, data quality, reporting and stakeholder visibility.
  • Evidence of improving recruitment processes or tools. Experience with Greenhouse integrations, automation or other recruitment technology would be an advantage.
  • High autonomy, accountability and a consistent commitment to inclusive, evidence-based and candidate-centred hiring.

What's in it for you

  • Sporty is a remote first company in pursuit of sustainability
  • A competitive salary + individual performance based bonuses every quarter

Description

We are looking for a Marketing Analyst to own the intersection of CRM analytics and growth data across Muse Group's product ecosystem.

This is a role for someone who thinks in models, not just dashboards — someone who can build Marketing Mix Models, architect social analytics pipelines, and bring statistical rigour to complex questions. You will be a part of the Marketing Team and will partner closely with other relevant teams and stakeholders including CRM, Product and Content teams.

What is in it for you?

  • Full ownership from day one — build the analytics infrastructure for marketing attribution, social performance, and campaign modelling, rather than inheriting someone else's half-finished stack.
  • Real breadth — your scope covers CRM analytics, paid and organic growth, offline/online event modelling, and social targets. No two weeks look the same.
  • People First, AI Fuelled environment— we actively use and build with LLMs across the business. You will be expected to, and empowered to, automate and augment your own workflows.

We are actively integrating AI automation into relevant areas of the business and expect candidates with mindset focused on improving efficiency and deliver a better user experience.

Key responsibilities

  • Deep dive into marketing data, build attribution models, research new markets
  • Build CRM measurement framework from scratch across multiple audiences (B2B/B2C) and CRM-tools
  • Build marketing mix models for offline and online events revenue imact estimation
  • Build social analytics from scratch, build models for targets for social posts
  • Perform comprehensive data analysis and develop insightful dashboards summarizing data for marketing team
  • Help Marketing team to find growth points
  • Develop tools and analyses to aid decision-making regarding product initiative prioritization
  • Collaborate with the backlog, prioritizing hypotheses based on predicted impact
  • Actively participate in project work by helping to formulate hypotheses and detailing logic and events to provide insights and new knowledge
  • Work closely with team members to implement and launch experiments successfully
  • Foster collaboration with engineers, product managers, and partners to address user-centric data problems effectively
  • Share knowledge and promote standard methodologies, fostering team improvement through mentorship and constructive accountability
  • Leverage LLMs to automate and optimize key processes, reports and marketing decision making

Requirements

  • Minimum 5 years of experience as a Marketing Analyst
  • Understanding of marketing-specific data and tools: attribution, metrics/KPIs, GA4, Google Ads, Meta Business Manager, HubSpot
  • Experience in building complex marketing analytic frameworks for multiple products, channels, audiences (B2B/B2C) and goals
  • Experience in Social Media, Brand, CRM and Digital Marketing analytics
  • Experience in building MMMs and Attribution models
  • Proficiency in SQL (any dialect), with familiarity with Clickhouse being advantageous
  • Proficiency in Python/R, including basic statistical, data engineering, and visualization libraries (or experience with other programming languages)
  • Proficiency in LLMs like Claude or Perplexity, including experience with building AI agents
  • Strong grasp of math, probability theory, and mathematical statistics, including practical experience conducting A/B tests and hypothesis testing
  • Experience with BI tools and ETL tools (e.g., Airflow)
  • Excellent communication skills, capable of collaborating and maintaining relationships with both business and technical teams
  • Product-oriented mindset with strong task-setting, planning, hypothesis generation, and project management abilities
  • Fluent in written and spoken English (B2 level or higher)

Nice to have

  • Experience with on/off-line Event measurement
  • Experience in marketing automation

Strategic Leadership

  • Ensures adherence to company policies and SOPs, execution of field medical plans and strategies, and support of research initiatives as appropriate.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title: Senior Design Project Manager

Position Location: Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States

JOB SUMMARY

The Senior Design Project Manager is accountable for leading all aspects of a project. This person will work as part of the project team and interact closely with the owner, designers, contractors, subcontractors and other trades on projects in commercial and mission critical environments.

On a per project basis, the role will include leading the design and construction administration phases of projects including performing site visits, leading and representing DLB in client meetings, coordinating with internal and external members, and general project overhead tasks.

The Senior Design Project Manager will be self-directed on day-to-day work and receive high level instruction on new projects or assignments. Will lead project teams of routine or complex scope. May coordinate activities of other personnel.

The Senior Project Manager will communicate and operate in line with organizational and client goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Manage all Elements of Routine and Complex Projects (50%)

  • Drive project design from inception (site acquisition) through design and construction
  • Develop owner project requirements (OPR) and initial space planning efforts / schematic design
  • Represent DLB at site visits including existing condition surveys and punchlists
  • Evaluate and review subcontractor proposals and provide recommendations on contract award
  • Lead pre-construction elements including project initiation, kickoff, RFIs and submittals
  • Coordinate resource and material forecasting
  • Develop, manage and monitor schedule
  • Lead project meetings
  • Coordinate / perform QA / QC plans and specifications to ensure completion in accordance with the project scope and appropriate guidelines and manuals

  • Coordinate or oversee start-up, cutover, pre-functional or functional testing and project closeout

jobs.description:
The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation:

For this principal development role, with 6+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD per month, based on experience level and gross amount. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience

About the Role:

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Security Engineer, Network & Zero Trust, to own the network pillar of Sezzle's zero-trust program: every connection explicitly allowed, authenticated by service identity, and attributable after the fact — across our Kubernetes clusters, AWS accounts, and the paths between them.

You will take ownership of our network-policy program — default-deny micro-segmentation across our Kubernetes clusters — and carry the rest of the pillar forward with it: identity-aware service-to-service transport, per-application private access, flow-level visibility, and network configuration managed as reviewed code.

This is an engineering role: you will write the policies, the tooling, and the rollout automation yourself, and you will carry changes through other teams' services without breaking delivery. You will report to the Director of Information Security and work alongside the engineers who own the security platform and detection and response, and with the platform and IAM teams on service identity — your network controls are what their work relies on, and your telemetry is what their detections run on.

At Sezzle, AI-assisted engineering is a standard part of how we work. In this role you will use and build agentic workflows — flow analysis, policy generation from observed traffic, drift review — that let the team segment a large estate.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own east-west segmentation across our Kubernetes clusters: design the segmentation model, derive network policies from observed traffic, and keep every workload reachable only through explicitly allowed, identity-bound paths — a default that holds as the estate grows, not a one-time project.
  • Deliver identity-aware transport — design and roll out mutually authenticated, encrypted service-to-service connections (mTLS), so that authorization decisions rest on verified service identity.
  • Keep a live map of the network: VPC peerings, tunnels, cross-account links, and every public entry point — built from cloud APIs and reconciled continuously, so every path into production is known and justified.
  • Own segmentation of production and the cardholder-data environment: implement and enforce the CDE and high-trust-tier boundaries, review every peering and public exposure against them, and run segmentation testing with the security team.
  • Partner with IT on private access: evaluate and help deliver per-application access (ZTNA) for engineers and operators reaching production systems.
  • Own network telemetry: flow logs east-west and north-south, with enough identity on both ends that "who talked to what, when" is answerable in minutes — and feed it to our SIEM for the detection team.
  • Own cluster admission control and hold the line on drift: workload admission policy (pod security, image provenance, network policy), security groups and firewall rules declared in git, applied only through the IaC pipeline, with admission control at the gate and drift detected and reverted automatically.
  • Contain: build the levers that let us isolate a workload or segment quickly when detection flags lateral movement, and take part in incident response when the network is in play.
  • Participate in threat modeling and design reviews for anything that changes how traffic flows, and in the on-call rotation for the controls you own.

What We Look For:

  • 6+ years of experience in security, network, platform, or infrastructure engineering, with hands-on ownership of network controls in cloud production environments.
  • Deep, practical Kubernetes networking knowledge: CNI, NetworkPolicy semantics, DNS, ingress/egress — and experience rolling segmentation out on live clusters without outages.
  • Strong AWS networking: VPCs, subnets, security groups, peering and Transit Gateway, PrivateLink, load balancers, flow logs.
  • Hands-on experience with mTLS and service-to-service authentication (service mesh, proxies, or CNI-level encryption).
  • Infrastructure as code as your default way of working — Terraform and Helm or equivalents, through merge requests and CI, across repositories you don't own.
  • Ability to write real code (Go, Python, or Bash) for tooling and automation, not only configuration.
  • Ability to investigate directly with packet captures, flow logs, and system-level data.
  • Working knowledge of PCI DSS network requirements — segmentation, scoping of the cardholder-data environment, segmentation testing.
  • Demonstrated AI-forward engineering: you actively use AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or custom LLM integrations) in your work today and have opinions grounded in practice about where it helps and where it doesn't.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • Cilium / eBPF in production, including Hubble or equivalent flow observability.
  • mTLS at fleet scale, including certificate lifecycle — service mesh (e.g., Istio, Linkerd, Cilium service mesh) and workload identity standards such as SPIFFE/SPIRE.
  • You have built AI-assisted workflows that others adopted — flow analysis, policy generation, drift review.
  • Experience evaluating or deploying ZTNA / identity-aware proxy products. ● Policy-as-code and admission control (OPA/Gatekeeper, Kyverno, conftest).
  • Experience with network detection — IDS/IPS, anomalous-flow and lateral-movement detection — and with containment during incidents.
  • Familiarity with SOC 2 and with FFIEC-style examination expectations for network security. ● Experience in fintech, payments, BNPL, or other regulated environments.

About You:

  • You'd rather close a path than document it - an allow-list that exists in production beats a diagram of how the network should look.
  • You change other teams' systems without breaking them - you roll out in observe mode first, measure, and earn the right to enforce.
  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
  • Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
  • Backend: Golang
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Testing: Developer and AI-driven, focus on automated end-to-end, integration, and unit tests
  • Open Source: Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. Check out this Loom video for more details:

We're looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

This is not a traditional engineering role. You won't be writing production code. You'll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.

What this role actually is

You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios, focusing on:

• Whether the response makes sense

  • Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful
  • Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment
  • Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste. Syntax correctness is the easy part.

What you'll be doing

  • Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end to end
  • Judge whether outputs are useful, correct at a high level, and aligned with how a strong engineer would think
  • Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just the code
  • Distinguish between levels of response quality (what makes something a 2 vs a 4)
  • Give clear, opinionated feedback in writing on what worked, what didn't, and what felt off or misleading
  • Help define what great looks like when working with tools like Cursor, Codex and Claude Code

What we mean by "taste"

We're looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

  • Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?
  • Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?
  • Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output?
  • Would this interaction build or erode trust?

You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments, and explaining them clearly.

jobs.title: Chief of Staff to the CEO
jobs.excerpt: Panorama Education is one of the fastest growing startups working at the intersection of education, technology, and AI.
jobs.description:
Panorama Education is one of the fastest growing startups working at the intersection of education, technology, and AI. Across the United States, 15 million students - 1 in 4 in the country - go to a school that's using Panorama to improve outcomes for students. Panorama's flagship technology platform helps school systems improve teaching and learning, student support, special education, and college and career readiness. More than 2,000 school districts and 10 state agencies use Panorama and our investors include Y Combinator, Owl Ventures, Emerson Collective, Uncork Capital, and General Atlantic.

As Chief of Staff, you will play a central role in building Panorama. In partnership with the CEO and the Executive Team, you will help translate our ambitious vision and goals into clear strategy, strong execution, and rigorous operations across the business. You'll take on hard, ambiguous problems that matter for our future and figure out how to solve them; you'll lead important growth initiatives that change the trajectory of Panorama. You'll provide critical support and staffing to Panorama's CEO, enabling him to focus his time and energy where it will have the greatest impact for the business.

On any given day you will work through competing priorities, decide what is urgent and what is not, manage unforeseen challenges, navigate complex relationships, operate as the CEO's proxy in key decisions, and do it all at a fast pace. You'll be the connective tissue that keeps Panorama's engine running at full speed. You'll be a strong collaborator and partner across Panorama.

This role requires an operator mindset, curiosity, a hunger for learning, complex problem solving, influence, emotional intelligence, and exceptional judgment and communication skills. The role is highly demanding, but for the right person, a tremendous opportunity to push yourself as a leader and to build a generational company that matters for students.

What You Will Do

Your work spans executive operations and planning, strategic communications, cross-functional program management, board and investor relations support, and special projects and initiatives. You will work across every function of the business, with a clear view of our most important goals and the biggest risks to hitting them. You won't be perfect, but nothing important gets dropped on your watch.

1. Run the Operating System

Your job is to make the CEO's vision real. You'll design and run the rhythms that keep the Executive Team aligned, accountable, and moving at speed: weekly staff meetings, quarterly planning, annual strategy and goal-setting that drives focus. You'll eliminate the overhead that drains momentum (not through process, but through clarity), and you'll proactively surface problems before they become fires. You build, manage, lead, and iterate the operating system and are accountable for its effectiveness. When the team needs to recalibrate, you're the one who sees the pattern and brings people together to solve it. You're the keeper of how we operate.

2. Staff the CEO

You help the CEO focus on the work that matters most to Panorama, and you help the CEO be highly effective in their role. You'll help him organize and protect his time, take work off his plate, and keep an eye on operations across the business so that issues get solved without needing him. A key part of the CEO's role is external - with superintendents and state leaders, foundation executives, board members, investors, and media. You'll make sure he walks into those meetings prepared with the right materials and background. Sometimes you're in the room; sometimes you're running the follow-up.

3. Lead Strategic Initiatives

You will drive high-impact initiatives that either open up new growth or fix something important in how we operate. You own them end to end: diagnosis, getting the right people aligned, execution, close. Sometimes you'll do the work yourself; sometimes you'll lead a small cross-functional team. Examples of the kind of work: evaluating an M&A opportunity, running a philanthropic fundraising effort for a key initiative, drafting a cross-functional strategy around a goal, planning the executive team offsite, fixing an operational issue.

4. Write in the CEO's Voice

Much of what the CEO sends and says will start with you: team meeting talking points, investor updates, board materials, follow-ups to customers. You'll learn how he thinks and write things he can send with a quick sign-off rather than a heavy edit. That takes clear writing, compelling story-telling, making complicated things simple, and getting the details right.

5. See & Act on Organizational Signals

You will have the pulse of the organization. You talk to product teams, you drop into customer calls, you pick up on tensions in the organization, you understand what's working and what's broken. You'll bring that back to the CEO with a point of view: here's what I'm hearing, here's what I think it means, here's what we should do about it.

6. Thought Partner to Leaders Across Panorama

You will be a strong thought partner to the Executive Team and senior leaders across Panorama. You're a peer who knows enough about GTM, finance, product strategy, and talent to ask hard questions and contribute meaningfully. You'll challenge the CEO and leadership team when their thinking isn't crisp or misses the big picture, including telling the CEO things he doesn't want to hear. You'll spot when two functions are working at cross-purposes and broker alignment.

Other Expectations

  • Travel: 15-20%.
  • Availability: candidates may work from any US time zone, but please note the CEO is based on Pacific Time.

Requirements

What You Will Bring

  • Our ideal candidate brings K-12 education experience or high-growth technology startup experience (a bonus if you bring both).
  • 6+ years of experience in chief of staff, strategy, operations, management consulting, and/or banking roles, or a directly comparable role supporting senior executive leadership.
  • Exceptional written and oral/presentation skills at the executive level. You can write in someone else's voice, for a range of audiences, and make complicated things simple.
  • Deep commitment to learning and continuous improvement. You bring genuine curiosity about how AI and emerging technologies are reshaping business and education. You're never satisfied with 'that's how we've always done it' - you're the person who challenges the team to evolve and helps Panorama stay ahead of what's possible.
  • Proven ability to manage cross-functional initiatives, drive decisions, and deliver results without direct authority.
  • Strong analytical and structured thinking skills; ability to synthesize complex information and translate it into clear recommendations.
  • Experience designing and running operating cadences including leadership syncs, goal/OKR processes, and strategic planning cycles.
  • Demonstrated ability to ramp quickly in a complex domain and think strategically across multiple functions.
  • High level of integrity, discretion, and professionalism in handling sensitive business, team, and strategic information.
  • Passionate about about improving education for every student
  • Preferred: strong experience using and building AI agents.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and performance-based bonus structure
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Remote work arrangements

  • Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.

Culture & Values

At vCluster Labs, we value and stand for:

  1. Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business.

  2. Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.

  3. Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights.

  4. Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.

  5. Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms.

The Vice President of Product Marketing will own the go-to-market narrative for Rackspace's product portfolio, including the platform capabilities such as GPU-as-a-Service (GPUaaS), Inference-as-a-Service (IaaS), and the company's broader AI product line. This leader will translate deep technology partnerships and capabilities, including Palantir, Uniphore, AMD, and VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF), into clear category language, customer-ready collateral, and competitive positioning that sales, partners, and customers can act on. The VP will work closely with Engineering and Product leadership to stay ahead of the roadmap, with Sales and Field Marketing to ensure messaging lands in-market, and with Brand and Corporate Communications to build Rackspace's external voice in the AI infrastructure category.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Product & Category Positioning

  • Own the market narrative for Rackspace's platform, GPUaaS, Inference-as-a-Service, and AI product lines, translating technical capability into a clear, differentiated category story.
  • Turn deep technology partnerships, including Palantir, Uniphore, AMD, and VCF, into positioning and messaging that customers and partners can understand and act on.
  • Partner directly with Engineering and Product leadership to stay ahead of the roadmap and ensure messaging evolves alongside what is actually being built.
  • Define how Rackspace's AI and infrastructure products are positioned relative to hyperscalers and specialized GPU cloud providers in the market.

Competitive Intelligence & Sales Enablement

  • Build and maintain competitive positioning materials and battle cards, keeping sales equipped with current, accurate points of differentiation.
  • Develop persona-based sales collateral, including decks, one-pagers, and case studies, tailored to the buyers for GPUaaS, Inference-as-a-Service, and platform products.
  • Continuously track the competitive landscape in AI infrastructure and cloud, translating market shifts into updated messaging and enablement.

Launch & GTM Execution

  • Lead go-to-market planning and execution for new product launches and major partner announcements across the AI and platform portfolio.
  • Partner with Field Marketing and Demand Generation to ensure new product messaging flows into regional programs, campaigns, and pipeline generation efforts.
  • Create segment-focused materials and campaigns for priority segments, tailoring positioning, content, and proof points to each segment's specific buying criteria.
  • Define launch success metrics and track adoption of new messaging and positioning across sales and marketing channels.

Thought Leadership & External Voice

  • Represent Rackspace's product and technology story with press, analysts, and industry events, building the company's external voice in the AI infrastructure category.
  • Develop executive-ready content, including keynote materials, briefing documents, and bylines, that position Rackspace leadership as credible voices in AI and cloud infrastructure.
  • Partner with Brand and Corporate Communications to keep external messaging consistent across every channel and audience.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Build and lead a product marketing team capable of covering the full portfolio, from core platform capabilities to emerging AI products.
  • Partner with Field Marketing, Brand, and Sales leadership to ensure product narrative is consistent everywhere it shows up in-market.
  • Represent product marketing in leadership and product planning reviews, providing visibility into market feedback and competitive dynamics.

QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS


Product Marketing & Technical Expertise

  • 15+ years of product marketing or technical marketing experience, with a strong background in cloud computing, AI/ML, or high-performance infrastructure.
  • Proven ability to translate complex technical capabilities and partner ecosystems into clear, differentiated market narrative and customer-facing content.
  • Direct experience building competitive positioning, battle cards, and sales enablement programs in a fast- moving technical market.
  • Track record leading go-to-market for major product launches, ideally in GPU compute, AI infrastructure, or cloud platforms.
  • Strong writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to produce everything from technical positioning docs to executive keynote content.
  • Familiarity with GPU-as-a-Service, Inference-as-a-Service, or comparable AI infrastructure business models preferred.
  • Experience building customer reference and advocacy programs, and developing segment-specific marketing strategies for priority verticals such as Healthcare and Financial Services.

Leadership Profile

  • Experience building and leading a product marketing team supporting a multi-product portfolio.
  • Comfort operating as a public-facing voice for the company, including with press, analysts, and at industry events.
  • Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, Sales, Field Marketing, Brand, and Corporate Communications leadership.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • MBA preferred.

About Rackspace Technology

If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role

We are seeking a data-driven, highly organized Marketplace Operations & Experimentation Specialist to join our Marketplace team and report to the Product Manager for Marketplace. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

The Marketplace is where shoppers discover stores, products, and deals inside the Sezzle app. Our team runs a lot of features, and there's almost always something being tested. You'll be the person who knows what's live, who it's live for, and how it's performing.

This is an operations role with a strong product and data lens. You'll launch and track A/B tests, keep an eye on our shopping partners, and turn results into clear recommendations on what we do next. You'll work closely with product, engineering, data, design, and partnerships. If you like running a lot of experiments at once and keeping every one of them organized, this role is for you.

The salary range for this role is $2.000 - $2.666 per month (Gross in USD)

What You’ll Do

Experimentation

  • Set up, QA, and launch A/B tests across Marketplace features. Make sure targeting, variants, and tracking are right before anything goes live.
  • Monitor running tests, flag issues early, and call results once they reach significance.
  • Keep a single source of truth for every test: what's live, who sees it, and what we learned.

Partner & Marketplace Operations

  • Create and manage placements, promotions, coupons, and offers across the Sezzle app.
  • Set up and manage cashback programs in our internal admin tools.
  • Onboard new online stores into the marketplace and activate their store domains, so more stores are shoppable in the app.
  • Keep a clear map of which user and merchant segments see which features, placements, and offers.
  • Run regular QA audits, work through user-reported issues and broken links, and set up alerts so problems get caught before users notice.

Reporting & Process

  • Benchmark our shopping experience against competitors and bring new ideas for placements, deals, and offers that get more users shopping.
  • Document test plans, results, and processes, and find parts of the workflow that can be automated with AI.

What We Look For

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
  • 1 to 3+ years of experience in operations, experimentation, or product analytics.
  • Highly organized. You can run many tests and workstreams at once without anything slipping.
  • Clear written and verbal communication in English, with teammates across the business and external partners.
  • Strong analytical skills. Comfortable with SQL and dashboards, and able to read A/B test results (lift, significance, sample size).
  • Comfortable in a fast-changing environment where priorities shift.
  • Detail-oriented with a QA mindset. You catch the targeting mistake before it launches.
  • Daily user of Claude or a similar AI tool. You use it to analyze data, write queries, draft docs, and automate repetitive work, and you can walk us through real examples.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with A/B testing or feature flag tools, such as Optimizely, LaunchDarkly, Statsig, or Firebase.
  • Experience with affiliate, cashback, or advertising partnerships.
  • Experience with Jira and Confluence.
  • Experience with mobile apps and product analytics tools, such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, or similar.

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Medical Receptionist & Clinical Administrative Coordinator

Remote | Gastroenterology Practice | 40 hours/week | $5-$6/hour
Schedule: Sat - Wed 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM Central Time

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly organized Medical Receptionist & Clinical Administrative Coordinator to support a growing U.S.-based gastroenterology practice operating across two physical clinic locations.

This position combines patient scheduling, front-desk operations, prescription coordination, medication prior authorizations, and clinical administrative support.

The primary focus will be managing patient communications, coordinating appointments, processing prescription requests, obtaining medication authorizations, and scheduling laboratory and radiology services. The selected candidate will work closely with Physicians, Nurse Practitioners, and onsite clinic staff to ensure efficient patient care coordination and timely completion of administrative tasks.

The ideal candidate has experience supporting a U.S. medical practice, is comfortable handling patient-facing responsibilities, and has hands-on experience using eClinicalWorks (eCW).

Key Responsibilities

1. Patient Scheduling & Front Desk Operations

  • Handle inbound and outbound patient calls, respond to inquiries, and provide professional patient support.

  • Schedule, reschedule, and coordinate patient appointments, follow-up visits, procedures, and other clinical services using eClinicalWorks (eCW).

  • Manage appointment requests, prospective patient leads, reminders, and patient communications through phone, email, and text.

2. Prescription & Medication Coordination

  • Process prescription requests, new medication orders, and refill requests using Squad Health according to provider instructions and clinic protocols.

  • Coordinate prescription-related communications between patients, providers, and pharmacies.

  • Maintain accurate medication documentation, follow up on pending requests, and resolve prescription-related administrative concerns.

3. Medication Prior Authorizations & Insurance Verification

  • Initiate, process, and follow up on medication prior authorizations, ensuring timely submission of required documentation.

  • Verify patient insurance eligibility, benefits, and coverage information for medications, procedures, and services.

  • Monitor authorization statuses, address pending or denied requests, and coordinate with insurance representatives and providers.

4. Laboratory, Radiology & Diagnostic Scheduling

  • Coordinate and schedule laboratory tests, radiology appointments, imaging studies, and other diagnostic services ordered by providers.

  • Communicate with laboratories, imaging centers, and patients regarding appointments, preparation instructions, and scheduling requirements.

  • Track pending diagnostic orders, follow up on incomplete appointments, and coordinate the receipt and routing of results to providers.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 1 year of hands-on experience supporting a U.S.-based medical practice.

  • Direct, hands-on experience using eClinicalWorks (eCW) is required.

  • Experience in medical reception, patient scheduling, and Medical Assistant-related administrative responsibilities.

  • Experience coordinating prescription requests, medication refills, and pharmacy communications.

  • Knowledge of medication prior authorizations, insurance verification, and authorization follow-up procedures.

  • Familiarity with laboratory, radiology, imaging, and diagnostic appointment scheduling.

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple administrative tasks.

  • Comfortable communicating directly with U.S. patients, Physicians, Nurse Practitioners, pharmacies, and insurance representatives.

  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining consistent communication with the clinic team.

Tools & Systems

Candidates should be comfortable using or learning the following systems:

  • eClinicalWorks (eCW): Patient scheduling, electronic medical records, prescriptions, and clinical documentation.

  • Zoiper5: Inbound and outbound patient calls.

  • TriFetch: AI-assisted clinical workflow support.

  • Clinic Communication Platforms: Email, text messaging, and patient communication tools.

  • Secure Workspace Tools: VPN, security applications, and approved productivity software.

Schedule & Working Conditions

  • Employment Type: Full-Time, 40 hours per week

  • Work Arrangement: Fully Remote

  • Hourly Rate: 5–6 per hour

  • Regular Schedule: Saturday to Wednesday

  • Shift: 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM Central Time

  • Schedule Flexibility: Occasional Thursday or Friday availability may be required depending on patient volume and operational needs. Any required schedule changes will be communicated at least one week in advance.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for a dependable, detail-oriented medical professional who can confidently manage patient scheduling while supporting essential clinical administrative workflows.

The successful candidate should be comfortable balancing front-desk responsibilities, prescription coordination, medication prior authorizations, and laboratory and radiology scheduling, ensuring that patient requests are handled accurately, efficiently, and professionally.

Prior experience supporting a gastroenterology practice or coordinating specialty-care procedures is an advantage.
