The Opportunity

BlackHawk Data is seeking an experienced Cloudflare Engineer with strong hands-on expertise across the Cloudflare platform to support the design, implementation, optimization, and ongoing support of Cloudflare solutions for our customers.
BlackHawk Data is one of the fastest-growing, woman-owned IT solution providers in the country. Here, you won’t just do a job—you’ll build a career that matters. Our culture thrives on curiosity, collaboration, and grit.

We invest in our people, challenge them to grow, and celebrate wins together. If you are driven to learn, take ownership, and make an impact, BlackHawk Data is where you belong.
The primary focus of this role is Cloudflare. We are looking for someone who has strong technical knowledge and hands-on experience working with Cloudflare networking, security, application delivery, and Zero Trust technologies.

Beyond Cloudflare, the ideal candidate will bring broader technical experience across cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), as well as systems, networking, automation, scripting, or coding.

Make an impact. Build what matters. Grow with us.

Position Overview

The Cloudflare Engineer will serve as a technical resource for the implementation, configuration, troubleshooting, and optimization of Cloudflare solutions across customer environments.

This individual will work closely with customers, engineering, architecture, operations, and other technical teams to understand requirements, implement solutions, troubleshoot complex issues, and ensure Cloudflare technologies are effectively integrated into customers’ broader network, cloud, security, and systems environments.
The ideal candidate is a Cloudflare specialist first, but also has the technical breadth to understand how Cloudflare interacts with the broader technology stack.

Key Responsibilities

Cloudflare Engineering & Implementation
  • Design, configure, deploy, manage, and troubleshoot Cloudflare solutions across customer environments
  • Serve as a technical resource and subject matter expert for Cloudflare technologies
  • Implement and support Cloudflare networking, security, application delivery, and Zero Trust solutions
  • Configure and manage Cloudflare DNS, CDN, Web Application Firewall (WAF), DDoS Protection, SSL/TLS, Load Balancing, and related services
  • Implement and support Cloudflare Zero Trust technologies, including Access, Gateway, Tunnel, and Cloudflare One/SASE solutions
  • Assist with onboarding and migration of applications, domains, networks, and services to the Cloudflare platform
  • Review existing Cloudflare environments and recommend improvements related to security, performance, availability, and architecture
  • Maintain awareness of new Cloudflare products, capabilities, features, and best practices
Troubleshooting & Technical Support
  • Troubleshoot complex issues involving DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, network connectivity, security policies, traffic routing, application performance, and Cloudflare services
  • Investigate technical incidents and identify root causes and appropriate resolutions
  • Work across networking, cloud, security, and systems technologies to resolve issues that extend beyond the Cloudflare platform
  • Support escalations and work directly with customers and technology partners when necessary
  • Provide technical guidance and recommendations to internal teams and customers
Customer & Team Collaboration
  • Work directly with customers to understand technical requirements and translate them into effective solutions
  • Collaborate with engineering, operations, security, architecture, project management, and other internal teams
  • Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Participate in technical planning, implementation, testing, and customer handoff activities
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, diagrams, configurations, implementation plans, and troubleshooting procedures
Automation & Continuous Improvement
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive Cloudflare deployment, configuration, and operational tasks
  • Utilize APIs, scripting, or infrastructure-as-code tools where appropriate
  • Develop or improve technical processes, documentation, and deployment standards
  • Continuously evaluate customer environments for opportunities to improve performance, security, reliability, and operational efficiency
Qualifications
Experience & Education
  • Strong hands-on experience implementing, administering, and troubleshooting Cloudflare technologies in production environments
  • Demonstrated experience working across multiple Cloudflare products and services
  • Experience supporting enterprise networking, cybersecurity, cloud, or infrastructure environments
  • Experience working directly with customers and supporting complex technical implementations
  • MSP, VAR, professional services, or consulting experience is a strong plus
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is desirable but not required
  • Relevant Cloudflare certifications or technical training are a plus
Professional & Technical Skills
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of Cloudflare technologies, including several of the following:
    • Cloudflare DNS
    • CDN and application performance
    • Web Application Firewall (WAF)
    • DDoS Protection
    • SSL/TLS
    • Load Balancing
    • Cloudflare Zero Trust
    • Cloudflare Access
    • Cloudflare Gateway
    • Cloudflare Tunnel
    • Cloudflare One / SASE
  • Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, routing, firewalls, VPNs, proxies, and network security
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity concepts, including Zero Trust, web security, secure access, threat protection, and security policies
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to independently investigate complex technical issues and drive them through resolution
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Comfortable working directly with customers and communicating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Additional / Nice-to-Have Skills
  • Experience with one or more major public cloud platforms, including:
    • Amazon Web Services (AWS)
    • Microsoft Azure
    • Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
  • Experience supporting hybrid-cloud or multi-cloud environments
  • Windows and/or Linux systems administration experience
  • Experience with virtualization, containers, Kubernetes, or related infrastructure technologies
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code and automation tools such as Terraform or Ansible
  • Scripting or programming experience using Python, PowerShell, Bash, JavaScript, or similar technologies
  • Experience working with APIs and automating Cloudflare configurations or deployments
  • Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and version control
  • Broader networking and cybersecurity experience with technologies such as Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto Networks, or similar platforms
  • AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, networking, or cybersecurity certifications are a plus
What Success Looks Like
Within your first 90 days, you’re becoming a trusted technical resource for Cloudflare-related projects and customer needs. You are independently handling Cloudflare configurations, implementations, troubleshooting, and technical support while developing a strong understanding of our customer environments.
Customers and internal teams know they can rely on you to take ownership of Cloudflare-related technical challenges, troubleshoot issues through resolution, and provide knowledgeable recommendations.
Over time, you’ll also leverage your broader experience across cloud, systems, networking, security, automation, and development to help customers maximize the value of Cloudflare within their overall technology environment.
Work Environment & Location
  • New York/New Jersey-based or Remote
  • May require onsite customer visits for implementations, troubleshooting, or technical meetings if you are local.
  • Supports commercial and public sector customer environments
  • Works closely with internal engineering, architecture, operations, project management, and customer teams
Benefits
At BlackHawk Data, we provide a comprehensive benefits package to support your well-being in and out of work. This includes:
  • Medical, dental, and vision plans
  • 401(k) with company match
  • 15 days of PTO in your first year
  • Paid company holidays
  • Hybrid work options based on role and business requirements
Why Join Us
You’ll be part of a team delivering modern networking, cloud, cybersecurity, and technology solutions to organizations across commercial and public sector environments.
We value people who take initiative, own their work, continuously expand their technical knowledge, and can be trusted to take complex technical challenges from investigation through resolution.

For this role in particular, we’re looking for someone who can bring deep Cloudflare expertise while also contributing broader knowledge across cloud, networking, security, systems, automation, and emerging technologies.

The Data Scientist supports data integration and modeling for a portfolio of customers, supporting adoption and high-impact use of the Epistemix software platform. This role contributes to profitable growth by driving customer satisfaction, accelerating time to insights, and accelerating our time to value for customers. Ultimately, your work supports customer satisfaction, customer retention, and revenue growth from existing customers.

About Epistemix

The most consequential decisions in public health, life sciences, insurance, and enterprise strategy share a common problem: they involve human behavior, network effects, and downstream effects that cannot be safely tested before action is taken. Traditional analytical techniques built on historical data were not built for this. Epistemix was.

We build simulation and data-driven modeling tools that let leaders visualize how strategies will unfold across populations and systems before they commit resources. By clarifying which variables drive outcomes, where leverage exists, and how they interact, we help organizations move from uncertainty to conviction. Getting these decisions right means faster interventions, better-allocated resources, and measurable improvements in human and economic outcomes. We exist to make that possible.

Our platform gives organizations access to realistic, high-resolution population data and the modeling infrastructure to run scenario planning at scale. Together, these capabilities let decision-makers stress-test strategies in a controlled environment before deploying them in the real world across healthcare, consumer industries, insurance, and government. We are approaching our Series B and actively building the team that will define what comes next.

Responsibilities

Support customers’ and colleagues’ efforts to use our platform to deliver data integration, visualizations, models and recommendations that create meaningful impact

  • Work with customer teams to understand their goals and help develop data integration, modeling, and visualization plans to support decision making

  • Collaborate with customer and internal teams to develop, test, and validate simulation models, ensuring their accuracy and relevance for healthcare use cases

  • Provide guidance for proposals on feasibility of scope and how to ensure impact

  • Contribute to customer onboarding experiences and content, helping to ensure customers quickly achieve their first successes with the platform

  • Engage with customer users to provide informal support, tips, and troubleshooting

  • Collaborate with premium support customers by integrating data and creating models, simulations, or visualizations. Support recommendation development and action plans

  • Participate in reviews with customers to document and improve measurable impact

  • Provide feedback to Product and Sales teams to align offerings with customer needs

  • Follow advancements in data science, machine learning, and healthcare analytics

Qualifications

  • Commitment to understanding customer needs and helping them achieve goals

  • Creative mindset with a passion for tackling challenging problems with data

  • Ability to collaborate with diverse users and internal teams

  • Strong communication skills: verbal, code, visualizations, and maps

  • Strong foundation in machine learning, data modeling, and predictive analytics

  • Understanding of key concepts of the healthcare industry required. Prior healthcare experience (broadly defined) very strongly preferred

  • Comfort working in a dynamic environment with evolving priorities and customer needs

  • Proficiency in Python and associated data science technologies

  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, and/or GIS tools

  • Masters or Ph.D in Data Science, Computer Science, Epidemiology, Economics, Public Health, Statistics, Mathematics, or similar quantitative field

  • Experience with more than one company size or business stage preferred

  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States and not require employer sponsorship now or in the future.

Why Join Epistemix?

By joining Epistemix, you will become part of a collaborative and rapidly growing team that values curiosity and creativity. We are fully remote, with team members in the United States and Europe. Benefits include:

  • Equity & Incentives – Participation in our stock option program.

  • Flexible Time Off – Autonomy to manage your schedule and work-life balance.

  • Health, Welfare and 401(k) Programs – Eligibility for benefits (for U.S. employees).

  • Meaningful Impact – Apply your creative talents to revolutionize data-driven decision-making and make a real-world difference.

Zelh is a fast-growing outsourcing company focused on providing reliable, high-quality services and building long-term relationships with customers, employees, and vendors.

At Zelh, we're looking for an Intermodal Dispatcher who thrives in a fast-paced logistics environment and enjoys coordinating transportation operations, solving problems, and providing excellent customer service.

In this role, you'll be responsible for managing a fleet of 10–15 intermodal drivers during overnight operations, tracking shipments and containers, coordinating rail activities, and ensuring smooth communication between drivers, customers, rail providers, and the daytime team.

Responsibilities

Dispatching & Shipment Coordination

  • Dispatch and coordinate 10–15 intermodal drivers during overnight operations.

  • Support drivers finishing their shifts and those starting their working day.

  • Coordinate driver schedules, container pickups, deliveries, and reload opportunities to maximize equipment utilization and minimize empty miles.

  • Track shipments and containers, monitor driver progress, and update shipment statuses in the TMS.

  • Monitor incoming operational emails and take timely action to prevent delays.

  • Escalate critical issues and provide clear updates to the daytime team.

Customer Service & Administrative Support

  • Review incoming emails, identify customer requests, and determine the appropriate responses or next steps.

  • Communicate with customers regarding shipment statuses, additional charges, rail delays, warehouse delays, and traffic disruptions.

  • Schedule appointments and coordinate pickup and delivery arrangements.

  • Enter work orders and shipment details into the company's system.

  • Scan and upload documents, maintain accurate records, and update Excel tracking sheets and operational reports.

  • Follow up on pending requests to ensure timely resolution and accurate information.

Rail Operations & Billing

  • Track containers through rail carrier websites and verify container availability and release statuses.

  • Coordinate rail billing for containers through email and steamship line portals.

  • Process payments for rail lift fees and storage charges through rail websites.

  • Manage container pickup notifications, export and empty container releases, depot release requests, and street turn requests.

  • Coordinate with customers, terminals, depots, warehouses, and rail providers to ensure smooth container movements.

Driving Operational Efficiency

An important part of this role is identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce unnecessary driver movement. You'll help coordinate reloads, including unloading import containers and loading export containers at the same facility whenever possible.

These efforts help reduce empty miles, minimize driver downtime, improve customer service, and increase profitability. Additional bonuses are available for operational efficiency improvements.

Systems & Tools

Transportation Management System (TMS):

  • Profit Tools

Rail Tracking Platforms:

  • BNSF, Union Pacific (UP), Canadian National (CN), Canadian Pacific Kansas City (CPKC), Norfolk Southern (NS), CSX

Customer & Steamship Line Portals:

  • BLUME, IMC, OOCL, ONE

Driver Communication & Tracking:

  • Intermedia texting platform

  • Motive (ELD)

  • Phone and email communication

You'll also use Excel, internal work order systems, document management tools, and rail carrier websites for tracking, billing, and container coordination.

Training on customer-specific portals and processes will be provided.

Requirements

We're looking for someone who has:

  • Previous experience in US freight dispatch including intermodaloperations.

  • Strong understanding of container transportation and dispatch workflows.

  • Experience working with US trucking operations.

  • Excellent multitasking and prioritization skills.

  • Strong problem-solving mindset.

  • Ability to stay calm under pressure and make decisions quickly.

  • Great communication skills in English (written and spoken).

  • High attention to detail.

  • Comfort working independently during overnight hours.

  • Strong computer skills and confidence learning multiple software systems.

  • Experience using Transportation Management Systems (TMS) is highly preferred.

  • Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel.

Working conditions:

  • Remote or office mode of work

  • English courses

  • Equipment provided

jobs.description:
AECOM is actively seeking a Senior Data Analyst - Asset Management to join the U.S. West Digital Consulting team. This position will support the management, analysis, quality control, visualization, and delivery of data for large facility condition assessment, asset management, and capital planning programs.

The Senior Data Analyst will work closely with project managers, technical staff, field assessment teams, and technology specialists to transform large and complex datasets into reliable, structured, and actionable information. The position will support the full lifecycle of project data, from establishing data structures and project requirements through data collection, quality assurance, analysis, reporting, visualization, and final client delivery.

A key focus of this role will be improving the efficiency, consistency, and reliability of our data processes. The successful candidate will be comfortable working with large datasets, identifying data-quality issues, developing repeatable and automated processes, and translating technical data into information that can be readily understood and used by project teams and clients.

Department Description

The U.S.West Digital Consulting group consists of a diverse, multidisciplinary team of professionals working across the United States. We collaborate extensively with various departments and business lines within AECOM. A key focus area for us is providing asset advisory services, which assist organizations in formulating effective capital and operations and maintenance (O&M) strategies. These strategies are crucial for managing the maintenance, repair, and replacement of assets and infrastructure to meet organizational objectives.

We emphasize the importance of clients having access to critical asset data to facilitate informed decision-making. This data enables accurate, credible, and defensible investment decisions by predicting costs, timelines, impacts, and alternative options for identified needs. Our condition assessment process offers a comprehensive analysis of buildings and their systems, providing clients with a detailed understanding of their facilities and infrastructure.

Our integrated assessment teams collect and analyze facility, asset, condition, cost, lifecycle, and other data using digital tools. The resulting information supports capital planning, data visualization, reporting, and integration with client enterprise systems. By leveraging this data and analysis, clients can better align long-term capital projects with strategic priorities and make proactive, data-driven investment decisions.

To learn more about our group, please visit AECOMassetmanagement.com

The responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to:

  • Manage, organize, analyze, and validate large datasets associated with facilities, building systems, assets, deficiencies, costs, lifecycle information, and capital improvement needs.
  • Develop and maintain data structures, data models, relationships, naming conventions, and standardized data requirements for asset management projects.
  • Perform data cleaning, transformation, reconciliation, and quality control to identify missing, duplicate, inconsistent, or anomalous information.
  • Develop automated and repeatable processes for data validation, analysis, transformation, and reporting.
  • Use SQL and other analytical tools to query, manipulate, combine, and analyze data from multiple sources.
  • Develop scripts and tools, including Python-based solutions, to improve data-processing efficiency and reduce repetitive manual tasks.
  • Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and visualizations that communicate facility condition, asset performance, capital needs, costs, priorities, and program progress.
  • Support the configuration, testing, and deployment of digital data collection tools used by assessment teams.
  • Establish project-specific data requirements, validation rules, and QA/QC procedures and perform ongoing data QA/QC throughout project delivery.
  • Support the integration, import, export, and migration of project data between AECOM tools and client asset management, computerized maintenance management, and facilities management systems.
  • Analyze client-provided datasets and determine how existing information can be incorporated into assessment and capital planning programs.
  • Prepare data tables, summaries, graphics, dashboards, and other deliverables for technical reports and client presentations.
  • Translate complex technical and analytical findings into clear information for project teams and clients.
  • Document data workflows, methodologies, calculations, business rules, and quality-control procedures to support repeatable and defensible project delivery.
  • Collaborate with project managers, facility assessors, engineers, architects, planners, and technology staff to develop appropriate data solutions.
  • Support continuous improvement of the team's data management, reporting, automation, and technology processes.
  • Assist with proposals and business development activities related to data analytics, technology, and asset management.

The following skills and experience are essential for success in the role:

  • Experience managing, analyzing, and quality-controlling large and complex datasets.
  • Experience using SQL to query, manipulate, and analyze relational data.
  • Experience developing data visualizations and dashboards using Power BI or a comparable business intelligence platform.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel.
  • Experience developing repeatable processes for data cleaning, transformation, validation, and reporting.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, written, and verbal communication skills.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a closely related field plus 4 years of relevant professional experience, or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
  • Ability to pass drug and background checks to work on Federal grounds, military installations, and school grounds.
  • This position requires U.S. citizenship due to federal contract/security requirement.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency with Python for data analysis, automation, transformation, and quality-control processes.
  • Advanced experience with SQL, relational databases, database design, and data modeling.
  • Advanced experience developing Power BI dashboards, data models, relationships, calculations, and interactive reporting.
  • Experience with ETL processes and combining information from databases, spreadsheets, APIs, or other structured data sources.
  • Experience developing automated data-quality checks, validation rules, and exception reporting.
  • Experience with facility, asset management, infrastructure, engineering, construction, or capital planning data.
  • Familiarity with facility condition assessments, asset inventories, lifecycle planning, cost data, or capital improvement programs.
  • Experience integrating data with enterprise asset management, CMMS, or facilities management systems.
  • Experience translating business requirements into data structures, analytical processes, dashboards, and technical solutions.
  • Ability to communicate technical data concepts to nontechnical staff and clients.
  • Experience documenting technical workflows, data dictionaries, and business rules.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Partnership Sales
jobs.excerpt: RTS is an enthusiast culture company that builds at the intersection of gaming, creators, and brands.
jobs.description:
RTS is an enthusiast culture company that builds at the intersection of gaming, creators, and brands. From global live events to bespoke branded content, we exist to create meaningful connections between fans and the worlds they love. Our team brings deep expertise across partnership sales and marketing, talent management, event production, media, community building, and IP development.

As the parent company of Evo, the world’s premier fighting game tournament and community platform, RTS operates a growing global portfolio of live events, media, creator, and talent-driven experiences. As the company expands its footprint, we are continuing to invest in the commercial infrastructure, partnerships, and leadership needed to scale our revenue engine across our properties and capabilities.

Role Overview

We’re looking for a strategic, proactive, and solutions-oriented Senior Director of Partnership Sales to drive new business across RTS, Evo, and our broader portfolio of capabilities. This is not a transactional sponsorship sales role. We’re looking for an experienced seller who leads with a marketing mindset, understands how brands and agencies define success, and can translate business objectives and KPIs into compelling, integrated partnership solutions.

The ideal candidate brings a strong understanding of sponsorship sales, intellectual property, and integrated marketing across digital, media, content, experiential, creators, and live events. They will have deep experience and a proven track record of opening doors, diagnosing client challenges, building a strategic narrative, and leading a sophisticated pitch from first conversation through negotiation and close.

Reporting Structure

You will report to the VP, Partnership Sales/marketing and work closely with the Head of Sales and the broader Global Partnership Sales & Marketing team.

Key Responsibilities
New Business & Revenue Growth
  • Tap into individual network of live event sponsorship and media buyers to own and grow a high-quality pipeline of non-endemic brand and agency prospects.
  • Prospect proactively and build relationships with senior decision-makers across brands, agencies, media buyers, and marketing organizations.
  • Develop new partnership opportunities across live event sponsorship, media, content, experiential, creators, gaming programs, production, consulting, and other RTS capabilities.
  • Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting and discovery through proposal development, negotiation, contracting, and handoff.
  • Consistently deliver against individual revenue targets while contributing to broader team goals and commercial priorities.
  • Identify whitespace across categories, markets, and client portfolios and turn those opportunities into actionable sales strategies.
Client Strategy & Solution-Oriented Selling
  • Lead discovery with a strong understanding of the client’s business, marketing objectives, audience priorities, challenges, and KPIs.
  • Break down client and agency KPIs to identify the role RTS, Evo, and our capabilities can play in delivering against those goals.
  • Move beyond asset-led selling by developing customized, insight-driven solutions that connect client objectives to the right combination of IP, audience, platforms, and experiences.
  • Build compelling sales narratives that clearly articulate the strategic 'why,' the consumer opportunity, the activation idea, and the measurable business value.
  • Challenge traditional event sponsorship thinking and proactively bring clients ideas they may not have asked for but that solve a real marketing or business need.
  • Balance creativity with commercial discipline, ensuring recommendations are differentiated, executable, scalable, and aligned with client budgets.
Integrated Partnerships & IP Commercialization
  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of how to commercialize intellectual property and translate rights and assets into meaningful brand programs.
  • Develop integrated partnership programs spanning digital, social, content, media, experiential, creators, talent, hospitality, live events, and branded activations.
  • Understand the role of media, content, and experiential extensions in increasing the reach and value of a core sponsorship platform.
  • Identify opportunities to connect Evo with the broader RTS ecosystem to create larger, more strategic partnerships.
  • Work with internal teams to develop new commercial products, packages, and scalable offerings based on market demand and client needs.
Agency & Client Leadership
  • Build trusted relationships with senior client and agency stakeholders and establish RTS as a strategic marketing partner, not simply an inventory provider.
  • Navigate complex agency and client structures, including brand teams, media agencies, creative agencies, experiential agencies, and sponsorship decision-makers.
  • Lead high-level presentations, strategic workshops, negotiations, and partnership discussions with confidence and credibility.
  • Maintain an informed point of view on the client’s category, competitive landscape, consumer trends, and business priorities.
  • Create long-term relationships that generate repeat business, renewals, upsells, and introductions across additional brands and business units.
Cross-Functional Leadership
  • Partner closely with Partnership Marketing, Strategy, Creative, Production, Operations, Finance, Legal, Talent, and other internal teams to develop strong and executable solutions.
  • Bring internal subject-matter experts into the sales process at the right moments while maintaining clear ownership of the client relationship and commercial opportunity.
  • Provide clear, thoughtful handoffs to Partnership Marketing following the close of a deal, including client objectives, KPIs, commitments, expectations, and renewal opportunities.
  • Share market intelligence, client feedback, category trends, and competitive insights to help evolve RTS’s commercial story and product offering.
  • Mentor junior team members and contribute to a collaborative, accountable, high-performance sales culture.
Sales Management & Commercial Discipline
  • Maintain accurate pipeline management, forecasting, opportunity stages, and next steps within the company’s CRM.
  • Build thoughtful account plans for priority prospects and identify the stakeholders, timing, budgets, and business triggers required to advance opportunities.
  • Prioritize opportunities based on revenue potential, strategic fit, probability, and resource requirements.
  • Partner with leadership on pricing, packaging, deal structure, and negotiation strategy.
  • Use data, insights, and performance learnings to continuously improve the quality and effectiveness of the sales process.
Qualifications
  • 8+ years of experience in sponsorship sales, partnerships, integrated media sales, entertainment, sports, gaming, experiential, or a related commercial role.
  • Proven track record of generating meaningful new business revenue and closing complex six-to-seven figure deals across multiple platforms.
  • Strong understanding of sponsorship, intellectual property, integrated marketing, digital media, experiential marketing, content, and live-event sales.
  • Demonstrated ability to uncover client needs, understand KPIs, and translate marketing objectives into strategic partnership solutions.
  • Existing relationships with major brands, agencies, and senior marketing decision-makers.
  • Strong presentation, storytelling, negotiation, and consultative selling skills.
  • Ability to think like a marketer while operating with the urgency and accountability of a seller.
  • Strong commercial judgment and comfort working across both strategic and executional details.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial, remote-first environment.
  • Excellent collaboration skills and experience working cross-functionally across sales, marketing, creative, production, operations, finance, and legal.
  • Based in the United States.
  • Available for event and client-related travel.
Bonus Points
  • Experience selling live events within gaming, esports, sports, entertainment, media, creator, or enthusiast-culture businesses.
  • Experience representing or commercializing major live events, leagues, properties, or entertainment IP.
  • Experience developing seven-figure, multi-year integrated partnerships.
  • Deep relationships across major holding companies, agencies, and Fortune 500 brands.
  • Passion for gaming, fighting games, live events, and the communities RTS serves.
Our Culture

We’re very proud of the culture we’ve nurtured within RTS. We enjoy a high retention rate and value the relationships our employees build with one another, even in a fully remote environment. As a senior member of the commercial organization, we want you to embody and perpetuate the following values:

  • Lead with empathy — Ensure clients and colleagues feel heard, especially when navigating difficult decisions or competing priorities.
  • Challenge everything — Bring critical thinking to ideas in their earliest stages, help shape them into stronger concepts, and encourage creative experimentation in a safe and supportive environment.
Compensation

The compensation for this role is $140k to $160k, plus commission.

Benefits
  • Medical, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance
  • 401k plan available for employee contributions
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Generous PTO and company-observed holidays
  • Remote-first culture

jobs.description:
Description

Remedio is transforming how organizations reduce cyber risk.

While most security tools focus on finding problems, Remedio focuses on fixing them.

Our Autonomous Remediation Platform helps enterprises continuously and safely reduce exposure by remediating vulnerabilities and misconfigurations, closing patching gaps, hardening systems, enforcing compliance, governing applications, and controlling AI risk.

By combining deep dependency awareness, pre-execution validation, automated remediation, and instant rollback, Remedio enables organizations to eliminate risk across endpoints, servers, applications, and AI systems - without disrupting business operations.

Founded in 2019, Remedio spent its first years as a bootstrapped, profitable company, building a strong enterprise customer base before raising a $65M Series A led by Bessemer Venture Partners.

Today, more than 300 enterprise organizations trust Remedio to protect over 3M devices worldwide, including Amazon, Colgate-Palmolive, Kansas Health, Coca Cola Hellenic Bottling Company, and many more.

As we continue expanding our platform and growing our global business, we're looking for exceptional people who want to take ownership, solve meaningful challenges, and help shape the next chapter of Remedio's journey.

Responsibilities

Remedio is growing fast, and we're adding a Regional Sales Director to bring our Autonomous Remediation Platform to enterprises across the US

Security teams already have plenty of tools that find problems. What they're missing is a safe way to fix them at scale without breaking production. Detection is nice. Correction is what makes you secure. That's why enterprise buyers take the meeting, and it's what you'll be selling.

As Regional Sales Director, you'll own new business, selling to CISOs and IT and security leaders who are tired of chasing alerts. You won't be starting from a blank page. You'll carry a platform already trusted by more than 300 enterprises and 3M devices, backed by leading investors, and you'll have the proof points to open doors.

You'll work alongside experienced leadership, Solutions Engineers, marketing, and our channel team, all focused on helping you win. If you want a high-impact seat on a team that's growing quickly, with real influence on how we go to market and the upside to match, come join us.

﻿Sales Territory: DC, MD & VA

﻿Location: Remote-US

﻿What you'll do

  • Drive new business. Build and execute a regional plan focused on new logos and revenue growth, with a clear view of your target accounts and buying centers.
  • Create pipeline your way. Combine outbound, networking, events, and partner introductions, backed by marketing and Solutions Engineers who want you to win.
  • Build a local partner network that sells with you. Develop relationships with security resellers, VARs, MSSPs, and system integrators who bring you into deals and co-sell with you.
  • Lead the full enterprise sale. Own strategic deals from first conversation through technical validation, negotiation, and close, working with stakeholders across security, IT, and risk.
  • Win on safety as well as speed. Earn trust on the question IT operations asks first: will this break production? Show how pre-execution validation and instant rollback answer it.
  • Forecast with confidence. Keep Salesforce current, call your number accurately, and flag risk early.
  • Shape how we go to market. Partner with leadership, marketing, and channel teams, and bring back what you hear in the field on objections, competitors, and pricing. It will change what we do.

What your first 90 days looks like?

We'll set you up with a clear path and the support to follow it:

  • First 30 days: get up to speed on the platform and our buyers, and build your territory plan and a list of target accounts.
  • First 90 days: build pipeline, with qualified opportunities, active partner conversations, and your first POV underway.

Requirements

  • 8+ years selling enterprise cybersecurity or IT infrastructure software, with a record of consistently exceeding quota.
  • Senior-level experience owning and growing a large territory or region, with a history of opening new markets and winning new logos.
  • Established relationships with security resellers, VARs, and partners in your region, and deals you've closed through them.
  • Domain depth in vulnerability management, exposure management, misconfiguration, or patch management.
  • Experience selling complex solutions to CISOs and to IT and security leadership.
  • A structured sales method (we use MEDDICC) and the pipeline discipline to back it up.
  • A startup or high-growth mindset: urgency, self-direction, and energy for building something new.

Nice to have

  • You've built or scaled a regional sales presence.
  • You've mentored sellers or channel partners.
  • You already know enterprise security buyers in the region.
  • You know the endpoint security, EDR/XDR, or exposure management ecosystems.
  • You've worked with MSSPs and global system integrators.

jobs.description:
What success looks like in this role:

The Senior Director, Global Managed Cybersecurity Services is a client-facing managed services business and delivery leadership role responsible for the global operation, commercial performance, modernization, and client outcomes of Unisys' external managed cybersecurity services portfolio. This global leader owns client-facing service delivery and operational execution across Managed Detection & Response (MDR), Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM), and managed cloud security services, with room to expand into additional revenue-generating managed security offerings as the business evolves.

This leader will drive delivery excellence, client retention, service economics, portfolio growth, and scalable global operations while building a high-performing, inclusive, and engaged global workforce. The ideal candidate combines deep cybersecurity expertise with exceptional leadership, client management, project management, and business acumen. They can understand complex technical challenges, translate them into practical solutions, and deliver measurable business, operational, and risk-reduction outcomes for external clients.

As a key member of the Cybersecurity Solutions & Services leadership team, this individual will serve as a trusted advisor to clients, a mentor to associates, and a strategic partner across sales, product, engineering, operations, finance, and executive leadership. This role does not own Unisys' internal enterprise cybersecurity program, corporate security policy, regulatory control framework, or enterprise security architecture; its primary accountability is the performance, growth, modernization, and client outcomes of external managed cybersecurity services.

Global Client-Facing Service Delivery Ownership

  • Own end-to-end delivery and operational performance for Unisys managed cybersecurity services globally.
  • Lead and continuously improve MDR, CTEM, and managed cloud security service delivery.
  • Ensure consistent, scalable, resilient, and high-quality service execution across regions and delivery centers.
  • Establish and maintain managed services governance, delivery standards, service management practices, operational controls, and clear accountability for external client delivery.
  • Drive continuous improvement focused on service quality, efficiency, resilience, and client value realization.
  • Ensure delivery organizations consistently meet or exceed contractual obligations and service-level commitments.

Managed Services Business Performance & Growth

  • Operate the organization with a managed services P&L and business-owner mindset, balancing client success, associate engagement, operational excellence, growth, and financial performance.
  • Drive and be accountable for revenue growth, margin improvement, client retention, and service portfolio expansion.
  • Identify market opportunities and collaborate with sales, solution, and product teams to develop differentiated offerings.
  • Support business planning, forecasting, resource planning, investment decisions, pricing inputs, capacity planning, portfolio investment cases, renewals, expansions, and strategic growth initiatives.

Strategic Client Outcomes & Retention

  • Build trusted executive-level relationships with strategic clients and act as an executive escalation point when required.
  • Ensure cybersecurity services support each client's business objectives, security priorities, and risk reduction goals.
  • Create a culture centered on measurable client outcomes, transparency, accountability, and delivery excellence.
  • Establish executive reporting frameworks that demonstrate client value, contractual performance, operational health, and measurable risk reduction through meaningful metrics, trends, insights, and performance data.
  • Collaborate with clients to resolve complex technical and operational issues pragmatically and sustainably.

Service Capability & Platform Modernization

  • Maintain broad and current expertise across cybersecurity operations, threat detection, incident response, cloud security architecture and operations, vulnerability management, threat exposure management, and emerging security technologies.
  • Demonstrate intellectual curiosity and the ability to rapidly understand technical issues, challenge assumptions, and guide teams toward practical, scalable solutions.
  • Partner with security architects, engineers, and service leaders to strengthen client-facing managed service architectures, delivery patterns, platform integrations, automation, and delivery quality.
  • Guide modernization efforts through automation, platform optimization, AI-enabled operations, and repeatable service catalog and delivery model improvements.
  • Balance technical rigor and operational discipline with a clear focus on business outcomes.

AI & Innovation Leadership

  • Champion the responsible adoption of artificial intelligence across cybersecurity operations and service delivery.
  • Use AI, automation, and analytics to improve security outcomes, associate productivity, operational scale, and client experience.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and determine how they can be practically incorporated into the service portfolio.
  • Foster disciplined experimentation while protecting service stability, security, and client trust.

Managed Services Transformation & Portfolio Execution

  • Lead complex global initiatives involving multiple clients, teams, technologies, regions, and business stakeholders.
  • Manage competing priorities across daily operations, client delivery, transformation, growth, and talent objectives.
  • Establish clear plans, delivery governance structures, dependencies, milestones, risk management, and performance measures tied to client commitments, service economics, and transformation outcomes.
  • Drive execution, remove barriers, and ensure strategic programs deliver intended outcomes without compromising operational performance.

Talent Development & Culture

  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing global cybersecurity organization.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, trust, innovation, inclusion, collaboration, and continuous learning.
  • Create opportunities for professional development, technical excellence, career progression, and leadership advancement.
  • Increase associate engagement, retention, team health, and a sense of belonging while maintaining high performance expectations.
  • Actively mentor future leaders and build a diverse, sustainable leadership pipeline.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Align managed cybersecurity services strategy, delivery execution, go-to-market priorities, and portfolio investment with broader organizational growth objectives.
  • Influence outcomes across complex stakeholder groups through strong communication, credibility, and relationship management.
  • Promote a One Unisys approach to client success, innovation, and business performance.

Preferred:

Location: This position may be performed remotely, but requires the flexibility and willingness to travel as needed.

The Opportunity

Praxis is seeking an experienced Program Executive to lead one of our high-priority development programs in earlier-stage clinical development. This leader will own the cross-functional strategy, execution, and governance required to advance a potentially best- or first-in-class therapy through proof-of-concept and key value-inflection milestones, while building a clear path toward later-stage development.

Working across Research, Development, Regulatory, Technical Operations, Translational Sciences, Medical, and other functions, you will align teams around the most important questions, translate emerging data into decisive action, and drive high-quality execution. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, challenges assumptions, and knows when to accelerate, adapt, or stop.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead the integrated program strategy and development plan through early clinical development, proof-of-concept, and preparation for later-stage development.
  • Drive cross-functional execution, governance, and decision-making against program objectives, timelines, and key scientific, clinical, and business milestones.
  • Own program strategy, budget, resource planning, and investment recommendations, including acceleration, adaptation, and go/no-go decisions.
  • Partner across Clinical Development, Research, Translational Sciences, Regulatory, Technical Operations, Medical, Biometrics, Finance, and other functions to build an integrated evidence-generation strategy.
  • Evaluate emerging clinical, translational, regulatory, competitive, and operational data to identify risks, opportunities, and alternative development paths.
  • Lead preparation for key health authority interactions and ensure alignment across clinical, regulatory, CMC, and evidence-generation strategies.
  • Represent the program with executive leadership, governance committees, partners, and external stakeholders while fostering accountability, transparency, and high performance.

Qualifications and Key Success Factors

  • Demonstrated experience leading or co-leading therapeutic programs through early clinical development and meaningful value-inflection points, including first-in-human, dose optimization, proof-of-mechanism, proof-of-concept, or transition to later-stage development.
  • Proven cross-functional leadership with accountability for integrated program strategy and execution in Phase 1 and/or Phase 2 development.
  • Direct ownership of program strategy, budgets, resource planning, governance, and investment recommendations for complex development programs.

About Improvado

Improvado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams. We are looking for a technical specialist who owns the performance of the Improvado website end to end: how it is found (SEO and GEO), how fast and healthy it is, and how well it converts visitors into pipeline. Because the website is our main product-facing marketing surface, you will also shape how the product is presented on it. Technical SEO and GEO

Website optimization and conversion

  • Continuously improve page performance, UX, templates, and key conversion paths (demo requests, sign-ups, high-intent pages).

  • Work with engineering, design, and external contractors to ship improvements to the website stack (CMS, CDN, caching, tracking).

Analytics and measurement

  • Analyze data to find growth opportunities, and report findings in clear, decision-ready form.

Product and messaging input

  • Use search demand, AI-visibility, and on-site behavior data to guide positioning, messaging, and landing page strategy.
  • Work with stakeholders so website content reflects ICP needs and the product’s value propositions.

What We Are Looking For

Must have

  • 3+ years in SEO and/or website optimization, with measurable results in organic growth or conversion.
  • Strong technical SEO skills and a good understanding of how websites are built, served, and rendered.
  • Ability and willingness to work in the Eastern Time (EST) time zone, with working hours aligned to the US East Coast.

  • Strong analytics experience: GA4, Google Search Console, and BI or dashboard tools (Looker Studio, Superset, or similar). You build your own reports and draw conclusions from the data.
  • Proficiency with SEO tooling (Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, or equivalents).
  • Ability to work effectively with developers, designers, and marketers in a distributed team.

Nice to have

  • B2B SaaS or marketing technology background.
  • Experience with Webflow or a similar CMS, plus basic HTML/CSS and JavaScript.
  • SQL or advanced spreadsheet skills; experience with AI-assisted or automated workflows.
  • Experience with CRO and experimentation platforms.
  • Exposure to product marketing, positioning, or messaging.

You are

  • Analytical, curious, and driven by measurable outcomes.
  • Self-directed and comfortable owning a channel without heavy supervision.
  • A clear communicator across time zones.

What We Offer

  • Remote-first environment
  • Strong product/market fit: marketing data product for US-based enterprises
  • 20 working days of PTO per year
  • US holidays and additional days off
  • Professional development reimbursement

jobs.excerpt: About Matter HealthMatter Health delivers primary and preventive healthcare directly to older adults living in affordable housing communities.
jobs.description:
About Matter Health

Matter Health delivers primary and preventive healthcare directly to older adults living in affordable housing communities. Our mission is simple: to improve healthcare access by meeting patients where they are and building trusted relationships within the communities we serve.

As we rapidly expand across the country, we are building a team of mission-driven professionals who thrive in fast-paced, collaborative environments and are passionate about making healthcare more accessible.

We Lead with Love in Everything We Do.

About the Role

Matter Health is seeking a dynamic, hands-on Senior Vice President, Clinical Quality & Population Health to build, lead, and scale the clinical quality programs, population health strategies, and operational infrastructure that support our continued growth.

Reporting to the Chief Medical Officer, this executive will have enterprise-wide accountability for Medicare Star Ratings, HEDIS, CAHPS, clinical quality improvement, clinical programs, clinical operations, coding and risk adjustment, and provider credentialing.

We are looking for a builder, not simply someone who has managed established programs.

The ideal candidate brings demonstrated healthcare startup experience, with a track record of personally building and scaling clinical quality, population health, or clinical operations functions.

This is an opportunity for a leader who is comfortable creating structure where it doesn't yet exist, establishing processes and accountability, building high-performing teams, and personally driving initiatives from strategy through implementation.

Success requires someone who can move seamlessly between executive discussions, payer relationships, board presentations, and the day-to-day operational work necessary to achieve measurable results.

The SVP will serve as a strategic dyad partner to the SVP of Operations, ensuring clinical and operational priorities remain closely aligned. This leader will also partner with the Chief Medical Officer's Clinical Affairs function and represent clinical quality and population health in executive, payer, regulatory, and cross-functional discussions.

This is a highly visible leadership opportunity for an executive who thrives in a growing organization, takes ownership, and isn't afraid to get their hands dirty.

Key Responsibilities

Clinical Quality, Medicare Stars & HEDIS

  • Own the development, implementation, and execution of Matter Health's enterprise clinical quality strategy.

  • Lead Medicare Star Ratings performance improvement initiatives, including HEDIS, CAHPS, and applicable Medicare Part D quality measures.

  • Establish measurable quality goals, performance dashboards, accountability structures, and continuous improvement processes.

  • Identify gaps in quality performance and translate clinical, claims, and operational data into actionable improvement strategies.

  • Develop and execute interventions that improve quality outcomes, close care gaps, and support value-based performance.

  • Partner with payers, clinical leaders, and operational teams to drive performance against contractual and regulatory quality measures.

  • Establish scalable quality improvement processes that can be replicated across new and existing markets.

  • Maintain accountability for measurable results, including quality performance, regulatory readiness, and operational effectiveness.

Build & Scale Clinical Programs

  • Design, build, implement, and scale clinical and population health programs that support Matter Health's value-based care model.

  • Develop the processes, workflows, governance structures, and performance expectations needed to support organizational growth.

  • Translate strategic priorities into practical programs that can be successfully implemented by clinical and operational teams.

  • Establish consistent clinical standards and evidence-based practices across markets.

  • Evaluate existing programs, identify opportunities for improvement, and lead initiatives to strengthen effectiveness and scalability.

  • Partner with clinical leadership to ensure programs are patient-centered, operationally practical, and aligned with quality and population health goals.

  • Build infrastructure and processes that support rapid market expansion without compromising quality or compliance.

Clinical Operations & Execution

  • Provide executive leadership and direct operational accountability for clinical quality and clinical program execution.

  • Partner closely with the SVP of Operations to align clinical strategies with day-to-day care delivery and operational performance.

  • Identify workflow inefficiencies, operational barriers, and performance gaps, then lead the implementation of practical solutions.

  • Establish operating rhythms, performance reviews, and accountability measures to ensure consistent execution across teams.

  • Work directly with clinical, operational, and administrative leaders to resolve challenges and improve performance.

  • Support the development of scalable clinical workflows that improve efficiency, consistency, and patient outcomes.

  • Remain actively engaged in execution, particularly when new programs, processes, or teams are being established.

Provider Credentialing & Compliance

  • Own the strategy, operational performance, and continuous improvement of Matter Health's provider credentialing function.

  • Establish and optimize credentialing and recredentialing workflows, processes, systems, and accountability structures.

  • Ensure credentialing operations support timely provider onboarding, market expansion, and organizational growth.

  • Oversee compliance with applicable payer, regulatory, and accreditation requirements.

  • Identify and resolve credentialing bottlenecks, operational inefficiencies, and process gaps.

  • Partner with clinical leadership, operations, compliance, and other stakeholders to ensure credentialing requirements are met consistently.

  • Build scalable credentialing processes, reporting mechanisms, and quality controls that support growth across multiple markets.

  • Maintain executive accountability while remaining closely involved in resolving complex credentialing and operational challenges.

Coding, Risk Adjustment & Documentation

  • Oversee clinical documentation improvement, coding accuracy, and compliant risk adjustment programs.

  • Partner with clinical, coding, compliance, and finance teams to strengthen HCC capture, RAF accuracy, and documentation quality.

  • Establish processes and accountability measures that support accurate, compliant documentation and coding practices.

  • Identify opportunities to improve clinical documentation workflows and provider education.

  • Use performance data to identify gaps, monitor outcomes, and support continuous improvement.

  • Ensure coding and risk adjustment initiatives align with regulatory requirements and value-based care objectives.

Executive Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Serve as a trusted strategic partner to the Chief Medical Officer and executive leadership team.

  • Build, lead, coach, and develop multidisciplinary teams across clinical quality, clinical programs, and related functions.

  • Establish clear organizational structures, responsibilities, performance expectations, and accountability.

  • Represent Matter Health in executive meetings, payer discussions, board presentations, regulatory interactions, and other high-level engagements.

  • Translate complex clinical quality and operational performance information into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leadership.

  • Collaborate across clinical, operations, finance, compliance, technology, and other functions to drive organizational priorities.

  • Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders while maintaining a focus on measurable results.

  • Lead effectively through ambiguity, competing priorities, and the evolving needs of a high-growth organization.

  • Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, collaboration, and operational excellence.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in clinical quality, population health, clinical operations, clinical program management, or a related healthcare function.

  • Experience working in a healthcare startup, personally establishing the teams, processes, and operational infrastructure needed to support growth.

  • Significant senior leadership experience within a Medicare Advantage organization, value-based healthcare organization, health plan, health system, multisite medical group, or comparable healthcare environment.

  • Demonstrated experience personally building, launching, scaling, or significantly transforming clinical quality, population health, or clinical operations functions.

  • Proven ability to operate successfully in a startup, high-growth, rapidly expanding, or transformational healthcare environment where processes and infrastructure must be built or substantially improved.

  • Direct accountability for Medicare Star Ratings, HEDIS, CAHPS, and clinical quality performance improvement, including demonstrated experience translating strategy into measurable results.

  • Experience directly leading or owning provider credentialing operations, including process development, operational performance, compliance, and provider onboarding.

  • Strong understanding of Medicare Advantage, value-based care, and quality performance requirements.

  • Demonstrated experience leading clinical operations and multidisciplinary teams across complex healthcare environments.

  • Experience developing, implementing, and scaling clinical quality or population health programs.

  • Knowledge of clinical documentation improvement, coding accuracy, HCC/RAF, and risk adjustment.

  • Experience using clinical quality dashboards, claims data, analytics, and operational performance reporting to guide decision-making.

  • Strong executive presence, communication skills, and the ability to influence C-suite leaders, payers, clinical stakeholders, and cross-functional partners.

  • Proven ability to establish structure, build teams, create accountability, and drive execution in evolving or resource-constrained environments.

  • A hands-on leadership approach with a willingness to work directly through operational challenges rather than relying solely on delegation or oversight.

  • Ability and willingness to travel moderately to Matter Health locations and markets, including Nashville and Memphis.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Healthcare Administration, Public Health, Nursing, Business Administration, or a related field.

  • Active clinical licensure, such as Registered Nurse, Nurse Practitioner, or an equivalent clinical credential.

  • Experience supporting Medicare Advantage populations, including dual-eligible or special needs plan populations.

  • Experience with NCQA or URAC accreditation.

  • Experience preparing for regulatory surveys, payer reviews, and external audits.

  • Experience supporting clinical quality and operational functions across multiple geographic markets.

  • Experience working within home-based care, primary care, geriatrics, or other value-based care delivery models.

  • Experience serving in a dyad or shared-accountability leadership model.

  • Demonstrated success presenting clinical quality and operational performance information to boards, executive leadership teams, payers, or regulatory stakeholders.

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will be a visible, accountable leader who builds the infrastructure, teams, and processes necessary to support Matter Health's continued growth.

Success in this role includes:

  • Establishing a scalable, enterprise-wide clinical quality and population health strategy with clear priorities and measurable accountability.

  • Demonstrating meaningful improvement in Medicare Star Ratings, HEDIS, CAHPS, and applicable quality measures.

  • Building or strengthening clinical programs that deliver measurable improvements in patient outcomes and operational performance.

  • Creating reliable, scalable provider credentialing processes that support timely onboarding and market expansion.

  • Strengthening clinical documentation, coding accuracy, and compliant risk adjustment performance.

  • Developing high-performing teams and clear operating structures that support consistent execution.

  • Building effective quality dashboards, governance processes, reporting structures, and performance management systems.

  • Improving alignment and shared accountability between clinical leadership and operations.

  • Establishing trusted relationships with executives, clinicians, payers, regulators, and other key stakeholders.

  • Demonstrating the ability to move between strategic leadership and hands-on execution while delivering meaningful organizational results.

Work Location

This is a remote position with moderate travel to Matter Health locations and markets, including Nashville and Memphis.

Candidates located near Nashville are welcome to work from Matter Health's Nashville office when desired.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.
