jobs.title: Helpline Contact Center Supervisor
jobs.excerpt: Health Resources in Action, Inc.  (HRiA) is a non-profit organization working to improve and reimagine public health.
jobs.description:
Health Resources in Action, Inc. (HRiA) is a non-profit organization working to improve and reimagine public health. We connect, consult, and collaborate to solve complex challenges of access and equity in our health and social systems. Together with our partners, clients, and collaborators, we create actionable solutions so that all people can thrive.

In 1957, The Medical Foundation (TMF) was created to primarily fund biomedical research in Massachusetts. Since then, we’ve been on a journey of evolution. We changed our name to Health Resources in Action (HRiA) to reflect our impact in the field of public health. Today, HRiA works with individuals, organizations, and communities to drive a policy and systems change approach to advance health and racial equity.

HRiA seeks sustainable solutions for complex problems using an anti-racist approach. We aim to be adaptable and flexible in meeting clients and partners where they are, offering our decades of knowledge and resources to collectively realize our dream of equitable, sustainable health for all. The foundation of this work is centered on our values:

  • Health and racial equity by identifying and addressing the root causes of health inequities, intentionally working to shift narratives and power imbalances and disrupt all systems of oppression.
  • Leading with heart by demonstrating our passionate commitment to our work, continuously challenging ourselves with humility and vulnerability while pursuing and holding ourselves accountable to our mission.
  • Collaboration by intentionally and respectfully leading, partnering, and following to strengthen relationships, uplift different voices and build trust.
  • Innovation by driving toward new strategies, questioning norms, and continuously learning and evolving to support the needs of our clients and communities.

HRiA offers exciting, engaging, and challenging employment opportunities for facilitators, trainers, researchers, analysts, policy specialists, grant managers, and more. People come to HRiA because of our commitment to advancing health equity and inspiring work; they stay for our wonderful clients, partners, and dedicated and dynamic staff. With our growing portfolio of high-impact work, person-centered policies, and generous benefits, our team continually invests in making HRiA a great place to work. Our diverse staff of over 270 people hail from 30+ states, with a homebase in Boston’s Chinatown neighborhood.

As part of our Public Health Services, HRiA manages an extensive portfolio of behavioral health initiatives, including statewide substance use helplines in Vermont and Oregon and substance use and problem gambling helplines in Massachusetts and Illinois. The Illinois Helpline for Opioids and Other Substances (Illinois Department of Human Services, Division of Substance Use Prevention and Recovery) was launched in 2017, building upon our experience operating the MA Substance Use Helpline (Massachusetts Department of Public Health, Bureau of Substance Addiction Services) for over 23 years. HRiA launched the Vermont Helplink (Vermont Department of Health, Division of Substance Use Programs) in 2019. HRiA began operating the MA Problem Gambling Helpline (Massachusetts Department of Public Health, Office of Problem Gambling Services) in 2020 and the Illinois Problem Gambling Helpline (Illinois Department of Human Services, Division of Substance Use Prevention and Recovery) in 2022. In December 2023, HRiA launched the Oregon Recovery Center Hotline, now the Oregon Hopeline (Oregon Health Authority).

The Helpline contact center is the hub for the Helplines. Screening & Information Specialists (SIS) comprise most of the contact center team and respond to incoming Helpline inquiries. Four Contact Center Supervisors provide Helpline services and provide direct supervision to a portion of the SIS team. Three Masters-level Clinicians supervise a portion of the SIS, implement follow-up services, and provide additional coverage and support. Additional Helpline team members deliver and support program operations, marketing and communication, web management, and data analysis and management, supervision, and leadership. The larger team is overseen by the Managing Director, Behavioral Health.

To learn more about HRiA and our helplines, visit the following:

  • HRiA:
  • IL Problem Gambling Helpline:
  • MA Problem Gambling Helpline:
  • IL Helpline for Opioids and Other Substances:
  • VT Helplink: www.VTHelplink.org
  • MA Substance Use Helpline:
  • Oregon Hopeline:

Opportunity

We are seeking a full-time Helpline Contact Center Supervisor to join our team on the Oregon Recovery Center Hotline (Oregon Hopeline), Massachusetts Substance Use & Problem Gambling Helplines (MA Helpline), the Illinois Helpline for Opioids and Other Substances (IL Helpline), the Illinois Problem Gambling Helpline, and the Vermont Helplink (VT Helplink). This is an exciting opportunity to take on a newly developed position to support substance use treatment access across three states and supervise a diverse team of staff.

Position Description

We are seeking a full-time Helpline Contact Center Supervisor to join our team for the MA Helpines, the IL Helplines, and VT Helplink. We refer to these projects collectively as “the Helplines.” This is an exciting opportunity to support substance use treatment and problem gambling treatment access across three states and supervise a diverse team of staff.

The Contact Center Supervisors are responsible for handling incoming Helpline inquiries and providing supervisory support to the contact center team. A portion of their time is providing scheduled and as-needed Helpline coverage, in addition to our dedicated team of 22 Screening & Information Specialists (SIS). This includes responding to incoming calls, online chats, and SMS text messages from people seeking information about and help with accessing substance use and/or problem gambling services for themselves, a family member or friend, and/or a client. In this capacity, they assess Helpline users’ needs, determine the most appropriate substance use prevention, treatment, and/or recovery support service options, identify available options (through the Helplines’ databases), and refer callers to those services. They provide accurate information, education, support, and referrals in a non-judgmental, respectful, and culturally competent manner.

About half of their time, Contact Center Supervisors provide supervisory support to the SIS team. Each Supervisor acts as a shift supervisor for SIS while they are working. This includes monitoring SIS consumer interactions, consulting with SIS and intervening during difficult interactions, and addressing any urgent issues as well as supporting the social-emotional wellbeing of staff and fostering their skill-building and professional growth. The Contact Center Supervisor will provide on-going training to SIS through periodic in-service trainings on relevant topics and will assist in the onboarding of new SIS.

Each Supervisor also directly supervises up to six SIS team members. This includes providing bi-weekly supervision, processing timesheets, and assisting with schedule coordination. (SIS also receive regular, group-level supervision from one of our Clinicians.) Contact Center Supervisors are responsible for supporting contact center operations, including helping to coordinate a 24/7 coverage schedule, staffing, and technology needs. They are the liaisons between the contact center team and information technology (IT) support. The Contact Center Supervisor will also be called upon to contribute expertise to the development of policies, procedures, protocols, and curricula to support the Helplines, and may be engaged in providing this expertise to other HRiA teams and projects focused on substance use, problem gambling, and/or behavioral health equity.

This is a full-time, remote position with a salary range of $57,000 to $64,000 based on skills and experience. Supervisors will receive training to assess the needs of Helpline users, provide appropriate information and referrals to services, and engage with and motivate Helpline users to follow through on referrals. They will also receive training on Contact Center operations, supervision essentials, and addiction, screening, treatment services, and resources.

Benefits

HRiA offers strong benefits to its employees, including:

  • Competitive salaries
  • Health insurance
  • Retirement plan
  • Flexible summer hours
  • Vacation starting at four weeks
  • 13 paid holidays, and office closure at the end of December

Duties and Responsibilities

Management

  • Coordinate and implement projects related to contact center operations, including technology, equipment, onboarding & training, among others, as assigned.
  • Work with Helpline Management to coordinate Helpline staffing schedules to ensure continuous 24-hour staffing coverage.
  • Serve as liaison between SIS and other project and organizational teams, to ensure appropriate representation and facilitate team integration.
  • Supervise up to six SIS.
  • Participate in on-call rotation.

Project Work

  • Troubleshoot technical contact center issues, and serve as liaison to IT support.
  • Assist with coordination and implementation of onboarding and professional development activities.
  • Assess the needs of Helpline users by telephone, online chat, and SMS texting.
  • Provide appropriate information and referrals to substance use, problem gambling, and/or related services.
  • Engage and motivate Helpline users to follow through on referrals by using active listening and motivational interviewing techniques.
  • Obtain feedback on interactions with Helpline users.
  • Gather and record data from Helpline users in Helpline database.
  • Verify Helpline users’ insurance status, as applicable.
  • Escalate Helpline user interactions to Helpline Managers as needed.
  • Represent the Helpline at outreach events, meetings, and/or presentations as needed.

Thought Leadership

  • Continue to build and develop expertise in substance use disorders, problem gambling, and behavioral health equity.
  • Suggest ideas/improvements through participation in teams and committees.
  • Attend and actively participate in Helpline meetings and other activities to develop skills and make suggestions for project enhancements.

New Business Development

  • Maintain updated resume and bio for use in new business proposals.
  • Assist with technical components of new business proposals as needed.

Candidate Qualifications

  • Five years of related experience (lived or professional) in the fields of substance use, recovery, problem gambling, and/or harm reductions Services, and manage mentor bachelor’s degree in psychology, social work, human services, or related field in lieu of experience.
  • Certified Resource Specialist (through Inform USA) preferred or willingness to obtain certification (at HRiA expense) within one year of hire.
  • Demonstrated experience and ability to supervise staff, and provide appropriate guidance, feedback, mentorship, and support.
  • Experience in information and referral services, customer service, counseling, substance use, problem gambling, or human services required.
  • Ability to adapt to changes in work environment and expectations.
  • Customer/consumer focused with excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Good computer skills and experience and/or ability to use online systems and databases.
  • Openness to information that may be different from personal views.
  • Willingness to work with consumers who may be ambivalent, resistant, impaired or have psychological disorders.
  • Must be open to providing information about a variety of treatment options and paths to recovery based on a caller’s needs.
  • Must be respectful of cultural differences and value diversity of thought, backgrounds, and perspectives.
  • Must have high ethical standards and a willingness to comply with professional expectations.
  • Demonstrated history of dependability needed.
  • Two years of sobriety requested for people in recovery.
  • Fluency in a language other than English (e.g., Spanish, Portuguese, Mandarin) is a plus.

Hours for this position will be non-traditional, requiring either early morning or late evening and weekend availability. The position includes weekend or overnight on-call duties. The Helplines are open 24 hours/day, 7 days/week, 365 days a year.

This description is intended to indicate the kinds of work duties that will be required in this position. It is not intended to limit, or in any way modify, the rights of any supervisor to assign, direct, and contract work of staff under his/her supervision. The use of a particular illustration describing duties shall not be held to exclude other duties, not mentioned, that are of a similar level or difficulty.

Procedure for Candidacy

HRiA is actively seeking to build a diverse and experienced staff. The organization encourages multiple perspectives and experiences, supports a multicultural environment, and strives to hire and retain a diverse work force that reflects the populations we work with and the communities where we work. Diversity is a core value of HRiA resulting in culturally competent services, materials, resources, and programs. Our hiring and business practices appreciate the strengths offered through different backgrounds.

HRiA is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer and is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.

Generally, our interviews take place between 9am-5pm ET. If you are contacted for an interview, please let us know if this timeframe is a challenge, so we can work with the interview team to find alternatives.

JAVA ENGINEERING LEAD – CUSTOMER COMMUNICATION MANAGEMENT (ENGINEER II/III)
Brand, Marketing & Communications | Mutual of Omaha Information Services

Mutual of Omaha is expanding its Brand, Marketing & Communications (BMC) program to launch a newly approved, enterprise-wide Customer Communication Management (CCM) platform. This is not a backfill – it is a new role created to help build something from the ground up. The CCM platform will give our customers control over how they receive information from Mutual of Omaha, moving statements and benefit communications that were traditionally printed and mailed to secure digital delivery. The result: a better customer experience and meaningful cost savings for the company.

As the Engineering Lead for the CCM platform, you will set the technical direction and engineering standards across a set of interconnected applications – spanning greenfield development, enterprise scaling of existing applications, and integration with vendor and internal systems. You will serve as a Solution Lead, starting with a newly formed discovery team and continuing as the platform expands into dedicated delivery teams.

This role combines technical leadership with hands-on engineering (approximately 40–50% coding). The ideal candidate is an experienced solution or engineering lead who enjoys building new platforms, keeps teams honest on engineering practices, and is energized by shaping a multi-year transformation of how Mutual of Omaha communicates with its customers.

WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU:

  • Estimated Salary:
    • Engineer II - $125,000 - $140,000, plus annual bonus opportunity
    • Engineer III - $150,000 - $163,000, plus annual bonus opportunity
  • Benefits and Perks: 401(k) plan with a 2% company contribution and 6% company match
  • Time Off: Up to 15 days of vacation annually, plus 11 paid holidays including 2 floating holidays
  • Work Arrangement: Remote, with occasional in-person team events (approximately once per year for 3–4 days)
  • Eligibility: Applicants must not now, nor in the future, require employment sponsorship

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Platform Engineering Leadership: Serve as the overall engineering lead for the CCM platform, establishing and enforcing engineering standards, patterns, and practices across interconnected applications to ensure they are scalable, maintainable, and ready for future growth.
  • Solution Leadership: Act as Solution Lead for the CCM discovery team and future delivery teams, coordinating closely with other Solution Leads to align designs, dependencies, and delivery across the program.
  • Hands-On Development: Spend roughly 40–50% of your time coding – building greenfield applications and enhancing and scaling existing applications using Java, MuleSoft, and AWS.
  • Discovery & Build-vs-Buy Analysis: Assess the capabilities and gaps of existing applications, estimate the effort to make them enterprise-ready, and evaluate vendor solutions to recommend where to build versus buy. Findings will directly shape the 2027 critical path plan.
  • Platform Capabilities: Help design and deliver core CCM capabilities, including a decision engine, a customer consent and preference center, workflow management, and analytics tracking – along with integrations to Salesforce and third-party tools.
  • Mentorship & Collaboration: Mentor and guide engineers on the team and partner with QA, business analysts, and technical leadership within a SAFe Agile environment (three-week sprints, quarterly PI planning).
  • AI-Enabled Engineering: Champion the use of AI tools and agents to accelerate development, improve code quality, and increase team productivity.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including experience as a Solution Lead, Engineering Lead, or Technical Lead.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Java and AWS cloud services.
  • Experience with MuleSoft or similar integration platforms, including API design and system-to-system integration.
  • Proven track record of building applications from scratch and taking them from concept to production.
  • Experience scaling and modernizing existing applications for enterprise-wide use.
  • Ability to define and uphold engineering standards across multiple applications and teams.
  • Experience with CI/CD practices and tooling, including GitHub.
  • Experience leading and mentoring other engineers.
  • Comfortable working in SAFe Agile environments and contributing to PI planning within Agile Release Trains (ART).
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to coordinate across teams and stakeholders.

PREFERRED:

  • Experience with Vue.js.
  • Experience with TypeScript and AWS CDK.
  • Experience or strong interest in AI-assisted engineering, including using AI agents in the development process.
  • Experience with Salesforce integrations.
  • Experience with customer communication management, digital document delivery, or consent and preference management solutions.
  • Experience evaluating and implementing vendor solutions.
  • Insurance or financial services industry experience.

We value diverse experience, skills, and passion for innovation. If your experience aligns with the listed requirements, please apply!

Business Operations Coordinator – CRM, Billing, Scheduling & Excel | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours – EST Required

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Business Operations Coordinator to manage the day-to-day operational execution of the business across CRM management, billing and invoicing, scheduling, client communication, data management, and administrative workflows.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role, not a strategy or leadership position.

You’ll be responsible for keeping operational systems accurate, invoices moving, schedules organized, records up to date, and client follow-ups on track.

If you’re highly organized, detail-oriented, comfortable working across multiple systems, and enjoy making sure nothing falls through the cracks, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

CRM & Data Management – Critical

  • Maintain clean, accurate, and up-to-date CRM records
  • Manage operational data across:
    • Excel / Google Sheets
    • OneDrive
    • CompanyCam
    • CRM systems
  • Ensure information remains consistent across systems
  • Identify and correct discrepancies before they create billing or reporting issues
  • Maintain organized digital records and documentation
  • Keep pipelines current with no stale records or missed follow-ups

Billing, Invoicing & Accounts Receivable

  • Prepare and process invoices accurately and on time
  • Ensure billing aligns with completed work and operational records
  • Track outstanding balances and payment statuses
  • Follow up on accounts receivable when needed
  • Coordinate with accounting on reconciliations and supporting documentation
  • Maintain accurate and organized billing records
  • Identify discrepancies and resolve or escalate them promptly

Scheduling & Job Tracking

  • Coordinate crew and job schedules using systems such as Aspire and Azuga
  • Monitor active jobs, schedules, and operational workflows
  • Identify scheduling conflicts, job delays, and time discrepancies
  • Maintain accurate time-tracking records
  • Support accurate data for:
    • Payroll processing
    • Job costing
    • Operational reporting
  • Communicate scheduling changes to the appropriate stakeholders

Client & Lead Coordination

  • Manage inbound client inquiries and routine communication
  • Track leads, clients, and follow-up activity within the CRM
  • Ensure inquiries receive timely responses
  • Coordinate follow-ups so opportunities and client requests aren’t missed
  • Maintain clear notes and communication history
  • Escalate urgent client matters appropriately

Reporting, Documentation & Research

  • Prepare operational reports and summaries
  • Assist with proposals and RFP responses
  • Conduct vendor and pricing research
  • Support contract and operational research
  • Maintain structured documentation and shared files
  • Compile accurate information for leadership decision-making

Administrative & Executive Support

  • Support leadership with execution-heavy operational responsibilities
  • Assist with executive email and communication workflows
  • Coordinate meetings and scheduling
  • Manage communication through Microsoft Outlook and Teams
  • Keep action items organized and ensure follow-through
  • Identify process gaps or inconsistencies proactively
  • Escalate time-sensitive matters quickly and accurately

Must-Have Experience & Skills

  • Previous experience in one or more of the following:
    • Operations coordination
    • Administrative support
    • Billing and invoicing
    • Scheduling
    • Workflow coordination
  • Strong proficiency with:
    • Microsoft Excel
    • Outlook
    • Word
    • Teams
    • OneDrive
  • Experience working with CRM systems
  • Strong spreadsheet and data-management skills
  • Excellent written English communication
  • High attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to manage multiple workflows and deadlines simultaneously
  • Strong organizational and follow-through skills
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment
  • Availability to work U.S. EST business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Aspire
  • Experience with Azuga
  • Familiarity with CompanyCam
  • Experience in:
    • Construction
    • Landscaping
    • Field services
    • Operations-heavy service businesses
  • Experience coordinating payroll or employee time tracking
  • Understanding of job costing
  • Accounts receivable and payment follow-up experience
  • Experience preparing proposals or RFP responses

Tools & Tech

Microsoft Excel | Outlook | Word | Teams | OneDrive | Aspire | Azuga | CompanyCam | CRM Systems | Google Sheets

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You’re extremely organized and detail-oriented
  • You care about getting information right the first time
  • You naturally notice missing information, inconsistencies, and unfinished tasks
  • You’re comfortable working inside structured systems and processes
  • You can manage several operational workflows without dropping details
  • You proactively follow up instead of waiting to be reminded
  • You remain calm and organized when priorities shift
  • You take ownership of execution and follow-through

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may start your day reviewing schedules and active jobs, checking for time discrepancies or operational issues, and updating CRM records.

From there, you might process invoices, review outstanding payments, respond to client inquiries, coordinate scheduling changes, update spreadsheets, prepare a report for leadership, or follow up on incomplete operational tasks.

Throughout the day, you’ll keep systems organized and ensure important details don’t get lost between clients, crews, accounting, and leadership.

In short: you keep the business organized, accurate, and moving forward day-to-day.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Accurate and timely invoicing
  • Clean accounts receivable tracking
  • Scheduling and time-tracking accuracy
  • Zero missed client follow-ups
  • Timely completion of operational tasks
  • Proactive identification of discrepancies and issues
  • Leadership confidence in operational reliability

Operational Environment

This role is execution-heavy, systems-driven, and detail-critical.

You’ll have clear workflows, defined expectations, and direct access to leadership while taking ownership of:

Accuracy | Consistency | Follow-Through | Organization | Operational Reliability

Growth Path

Strong performance can create opportunities to grow into roles such as:

Operations Manager | Senior Operations Coordinator | Executive Operations | Chief of Staff-style responsibilities

  3. Operations / Systems-Focused Interview
  4. Practical Workflow or Scenario Task
  5. Final Interview
  6. Internal Review & Offer

Social Media Manager – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Social Media Manager to own and grow the company’s presence across multiple social media platforms.

This is not a scheduling-only role. We’re looking for someone who genuinely lives and breathes social media—someone who understands platform culture, creates content that feels native to each channel, and knows how to build engaged online communities.

From day one, you’ll take ownership of 10 social media accounts, beginning with a comprehensive account audit and strategic improvement plan. You’ll then execute platform-specific content strategies, create engaging short-form content, manage community engagement, and optimize performance across LinkedIn, X (Twitter), StockTwits, YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, Reddit, Bluesky, and Pinterest.

If you understand that what performs on LinkedIn is very different from what succeeds on TikTok, Reddit, or StockTwits—and can adapt accordingly—this role is for you.

Responsibilities

Social Media Strategy & Account Audits

  • Conduct comprehensive audits of existing social media accounts and identify growth opportunities.
  • Develop platform-specific content strategies aligned with audience behavior and business objectives.
  • Create and maintain structured content calendars across all active platforms.
  • Identify content gaps, engagement opportunities, and audience growth strategies.
  • Continuously refine social strategies based on platform trends and performance data.

Social Media Management

    • LinkedIn
    • X (Twitter)
    • StockTwits
    • YouTube
    • TikTok
    • Facebook
    • Instagram
    • Reddit
    • Bluesky
    • Pinterest
  • Monitor comments, direct messages, mentions, and community engagement daily.
  • Adapt messaging, tone, and content style for each platform’s audience.
  • Maintain a consistent publishing schedule and brand voice across all channels.

Content Creation & Video Production

  • Create and edit short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

Performance Optimization & Reporting

  • Manage small paid budgets to amplify top-performing posts.
  • Analyze engagement, reach, audience growth, and conversion metrics.
  • Prepare regular performance reports with actionable recommendations.
  • Continuously optimize content strategy using platform analytics and campaign insights.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You genuinely enjoy social media outside of work.
  • You understand how platform culture differs across channels.
  • You combine creativity with data-driven decision-making.
  • You can manage multiple accounts while maintaining quality and consistency.
  • You adapt quickly to trends, platform updates, and audience behavior.
  • You understand B2B, SaaS, finance, or investor-focused communication.

Required Experience & Skills

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Proven experience managing multiple social media accounts simultaneously.
  • Strong background in B2B, SaaS, finance, or investor-focused social media marketing.
  • Demonstrated success growing engagement and building online communities.
  • Strong short-form video creation and editing skills.
  • Experience managing:
    • LinkedIn
    • X (Twitter)
    • Reddit
    • Instagram
    • Facebook
    • TikTok
    • YouTube
  • Experience conducting social media audits and developing actionable content strategies.
  • Experience boosting and promoting content using native platform tools.
  • Strong understanding of platform-native content and audience behavior.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, or Google Ads.
  • Familiarity with HubSpot or Asana.
  • Experience working with investor-focused brands or financial audiences.
  • Experience managing StockTwits, Bluesky, and Pinterest communities.

Tools & Platforms

Candidates should already be comfortable using:

  • LinkedIn
  • X (Twitter)
  • StockTwits
  • YouTube
  • TikTok
  • Facebook
  • Instagram
  • Reddit
  • Bluesky
  • Pinterest
  • Canva (or similar design tools)
  • HubSpot or Asana
  • Native promotion tools across Meta, LinkedIn, and TikTok

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent audience and engagement growth across all social platforms.
  • High-performing short-form content that increases visibility and reach.
  • Strong community interaction and authentic audience engagement.
  • Consistent, high-quality publishing across all managed accounts.
  • Clear reporting and continuous optimization based on performance analytics.
  • Increased brand awareness and stronger online communities.

Interview Process

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps hiring managers evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful while reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed. Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation.

Work Location: United States; Remote

We are currently looking for contributors for our Ronia Raw Photo Collection Project.

What is the project about?

We invite photographers, photo hobbyists, visual creators, and anyone passionate about photography to participate in our RAW Photo Collection project.

Do you regularly capture high-quality photos in RAW format to expand your photo library? If the answer is yes, this project allows you to earn extra income by contributing your photos to the development of advanced AI and computer vision technologies. Your images can have a real-world impact beyond your personal library.

Task Description:

Participants may submit both existing photos from their personal archives and newly captured images in RAW format. We’re looking for a wide variety of subjects, styles, lighting conditions, and environments—including nature, events, everyday scenes, objects, and more.

Photos may be captured in RAW and other supported formats using eligible iPhones or digital cameras. Uploading is quick and easy via our mobile app or browser-based data collection tool.

We will be collecting the following types of photos:

  1. RAW Images: individual, unedited images captured directly from the device.

  2. Image Pairs: pairs of identical unedited photos, with specific objects present in one and absent in the other photo.

Accepted Formats:
The photos should be native RAW and DNG where applicable (including CR3, NEF, ARW, RAF, DNG, RW2, ORF, and PEF). These files retain the raw data captured by the device at the moment the photo was taken.

All submitted photos must be original and taken by you. Photos downloaded from the internet or generated using AI will not be accepted.

Intellectual Property Rights:Participants retain full ownership of all submitted photos, which will be used exclusively for internal purposes by our client and will not be distributed, or published.

Who is eligible?

To participate you should meet the following qualifying criteria:

  • Be 18 years or older.

  • Be a resident of the United States.

  • Be able to upload RAW images or a pair of two images following our instructions.

  • All images should be taken with one of the following devices:

    • iPhone models accepted:

      • 15 Pro, 15 Pro Max

      • 16 Pro, 16 Pro Max

      • 17 Pro, 17 Pro Max

        All accepted iPhone models should run iOS 14.3 or later.

        No other smartphones are permitted.

    • Digital Cameras

      • Full-frame mirrorless

      • Full-frame DSLR

      • APS-C mirrorless

      • APS-C DSL

Where is the project taking place?

This is a fully remote project. You can participate from the comfort of your home or preferred location within the US.

Please note the following location-based limitations:

  • Public Images

Public Images are photos taken in publicly accessible places and/or featuring identifiable individuals. We can accept Public Images only if they were captured in the following U.S. states: AL, AK, AZ, AR, FL, GA, HI, ID, KS, LA, ME, MA, MI, MS, MO, NM, NY, NC, ND, OH, OK, PA, SC, SD, VT, WV, WI, WY.

  • Non-Public Images

Non-Public Images (for example, photos taken in private settings without public access) are accepted from all U.S. states, except IL, WA, and TX.

Image

How much is the compensation?

You will receive $1.50 USD per each accepted photo. Participants may submit as many photos as they wish across all open categories. Please note that some categories may have submission limits, and once a category is filled, it will be closed. Submissions are accepted on a first-come, first-served basis.

Example earnings:
50 accepted photos x $1,50 = $75 USD

100 accepted photos x $1.50 = $150 USD

Please note that all submissions will be checked by our Quality Assurance team, and compensation will be provided for submitted and accepted photos. The project team will provide you with feedback once the Quality Check process is completed.

As payment methods we offer Wire Transfer, PayPal, Gift Card and Check according to your preference.

Referral Bonus Program
We offer a referral bonus of $15 USD for each participant you refer to the project who submits a minimum of 50 accepted photos.

Job Description:

Software Engineer III's design, code, test, and debug scalable applications and services using modern TypeScript and Node.js patterns; maintain and document program changes with a focus on reliability, performance, and integration quality. They competently perform work in complex sections of at least one major CSI application, with a strong emphasis on backend services and third-party integrations, including core systems within the online banking ecosystem. The role also includes working with and modernizing existing C++ codebases and services, helping to evolve legacy systems into more maintainable, service-oriented architectures. They maintain and document program changes while working on complex integrations and system migrations. This role requires use of imagination, originality, and ingenuity to uphold high programming standards and deliver resilient, secure, and high-performing integration solutions with significant business impact.

Responsibilities:

  • Project Leadership: Take ownership of the development and rollout of entire products or large projects, particularly those involving backend services, C++ modernization efforts, and complex third-party integrations.

  • Standards and Practices: Enforce department coding standards and best practices, with a strong emphasis on TypeScript, Node.js, API design, and secure integration patterns, while contributing to the modernization of legacy C++ systems.

  • Project Management: Demonstrate effective and efficient project management skills, ensuring successful delivery of integration-heavy initiatives and legacy-to-modern platform migrations.

  • Technical Specifications: Write technical specifications, including API contracts, integration patterns, and modernization approaches for legacy C++ systems; identify project and programming risks, particularly related to third-party dependencies and system interoperability.

  • Coaching and Mentorship: Champion processes and technologies (Agile, CI/CD, service-oriented architecture) while coaching colleagues on backend development, integration practices, and modernization strategies.

  • Expertise and Innovation: Showcase expertise in software engineering with a focus on backend systems, integration frameworks, and emerging Node.js and TypeScript technologies, while contributing to the evolution of legacy C++ platforms.

  • Programming Knowledge: Apply knowledge of TypeScript, Node.js, and related backend technologies effectively; demonstrate working familiarity with C++ and the ability to support, maintain, and modernize existing systems.

  • Thought Leadership: Provide proactive investigation, problem-solving, and thought leadership, particularly in integration design, system interoperability, and strategies for migrating legacy platforms to modern architectures within the online banking domain.

  • Mentorship: Offer coaching and mentorship to less experienced Software Engineers, especially in building scalable services, managing complex integrations, and navigating legacy-to-modern transitions.

Requirements:

  • Accredited university, college, or trade school education and training in applicable technology; advanced degrees or relevant certifications preferred.

  • 7+ years of successful, relevant software engineering experience, with a strong focus on backend service development and complex system integrations.

  • Advanced proficiency with C++, experience with TypeScript and Node.js, including modern backend development patterns, scalable service design, and application performance considerations.

  • Experience designing, building, testing, debugging, and maintaining scalable applications and services in a production environment.

  • Experience with financial systems, core banking platforms, online banking ecosystems, APIs, or third-party vendor integrations strongly preferred.

  • Working familiarity with C++ codebases, including the ability to support, maintain, and contribute to modernization of legacy systems.

  • Experience with API design, API contracts, third-party integrations, vendor dependencies, and system interoperability.

  • Ability to work within complex sections of major applications, preferably within online banking, financial technology, or other highly integrated enterprise environments.

  • Experience contributing to legacy-to-modern platform migrations, service-oriented architectures, CI/CD practices, and Agile development environments.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.excerpt: POSITION PURPOSEThe Full Stack Engineer builds and owns features across YPO’s layered, AI-first platform from the member-facing React experience through the GraphQL API layer, into the AI-powered intelligence and data services that drive personalized leadership insights for YPO’s global member base.
jobs.description:
POSITION PURPOSE

The Full Stack Engineer builds and owns features across YPO’s layered, AI-first platform from the member-facing React experience through the GraphQL API layer, into the AI-powered intelligence and data services that drive personalized leadership insights for YPO’s global member base.

This is a high-ownership, end-to-end role spanning the experience layer (React, TypeScript, Apollo GraphQL), API and orchestration (Apigee, Auth0, Redis, Kafka), the AI-powered Leadership Intelligence layer (OpenAI, Google Gemini, Neo4j, Snowflake, dbt, Airflow), systems of record (Salesforce, PostgreSQL), and DevOps/hosting (AWS/Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform, Datadog): taking features from concept through production release, instrumenting them, and iterating on data.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the full feature lifecycle architecture, implementation, code review, QA, deployment, and post-launch monitoring.

  • Build responsive React/TypeScript frontends integrated with Optimizely; design Apollo GraphQL schemas and resolvers served through Apigee; build modular Node.js/NestJS backend services using Redis for caching and Kafka for event-driven workflows.

  • Design and query PostgreSQL schemas (TypeORM/Prisma); collaborate on Snowflake pipelines and dbt models feeding the Leadership Intelligence layer.

  • Integrate OpenAI and Google Gemini APIs for AI-powered discovery, recommendations, and matching; work with Neo4j graph data for relationship-driven insights.

  • Use AI-assisted development workflows (pair programming, code generation, test scaffolding) to increase velocity without compromising quality; handle AI feature failures, timeouts, and token costs with a production mindset.

  • Instrument features with PostHog and Datadog; design and run A/B experiments and feature-flag rollouts via Optimizely; use data to drive iteration.

  • Contribute to architecture decisions, ADRs, and post-incident reviews; address performance bottlenecks across the stack (GraphQL resolvers, N+1 queries, frontend rendering, mobile time-to-interactive).

  • Partner with product, design, the Lead Security Engineer, and DevOps to ensure features are secure, well-architected, and operationally sound from the start.

SKILLS

  • Ability to work collaboratively in a multi-cultural organization with international members, helping them achieve excellence in voluntary roles for YPO initiatives. 

  • Excellent interpersonal skills, including strong diplomacy skills with the ability to build meaningful relationships with all levels of associates, members and vendors. Adaptable, insightful, empathetic and reliable. Great sense of humor and humility. 

  • Resourceful and able to work independently with initiative and common sense. Effective time management, organization and prioritization skills with the ability to focus on varied projects simultaneously. 

  • Possesses a distinct global mindset, sensitive to local and international customs and protocols.  

  • Demonstrate empathy through active listening and asking the right questions to find the source of an issue. 

  • Able to identify problems, research alternatives, provide solutions and/or resolve issues in a timely manner. Anticipates member/internal client needs and delivers with clarity. 

  • Analytical thinker with ability influence and guide processes with appropriate approach and execution. Natural curiosity and desire to learn more; proficiency and interest in applying new technologies and tools. 

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including proof reading, with a meticulous attention to detail. Adjusts communication style appropriately to the audience.  

  • Professional presence, appearance, and stature to interact easily with YPO members, C-level executives and peers at all levels within the organization.  

EXPERIENCE/BACKGROUND

  • 5–7 years of professional software engineering experience shipping production-grade products end-to-end.

  • Strong TypeScript/React skills (component architecture, state management, hooks, performance).

  • Backend experience with Node.js and NestJS building modular, tested services.

  • GraphQL experience (schema design, resolvers, subscriptions, Apollo client/server) and familiarity with API gateway patterns (Apigee or equivalent).

Lietotnes izstrāde un funkcionalitāte:

  • Izstrādāt un uzturēt starpplatformu mobilo lietotni (iOS / Android), izmantojot Flutter un Dart.

  • Izstrādāt un integrēt galvenās funkcijas: biļešu iegādi, QR kodu skenēšanu, paziņojumus (push notifications), lietotāja profilu u.c.

  • Integrēt lietotni ar uzņēmuma servera puses sistēmām, izmantojot REST API.

Lietotnes uzturēšana un attītība:

  • Pārņemt un uzturēt lietotnes koda bāzi, nodrošinot stāvokļa pārvaldību (state management) un veiktspējas optimizāciju. Izstrādāt un uzturēt lietotnes tehnisko dokumentāciju.

  • Sadarbībā ar DevOps komandu izveidot un uzturēt CI/CD un Git versiju kontroli, kā arī sekot līdzi atkarību un pakotņu aktualitātei.

Lietotnes publicēšana un kvalitātes nodrošināšana:

  • Sagatavot un publicēt lietotnes versijas App Store un Google Play veikalos, nodrošinot sertifikātu un piekļuvju drošu pārvaldību.

  • Rakstīt automatizētos testus (unit, widget, integration) un veikt koda pārskatus (code review).

  • Ievērot drošas mobilo lietotņu izstrādes principus atbilstoši OWASP MASVS standartam.

  • Uzraudzīt lietotnes veiktspēju un darbību produkcijā (Firebase Crashlytics), analizēt kļūdas un tās novērst.

Requirements

  • Vēlama augstākā vai nepabeigta augstākā izglītība IT jomā.

  • Vismaz 3 gadu pieredze mobilo lietotņu izstrādē, no tiem vismaz 1 gadu ar Flutter/Dart.

  • Pieredze lietotņu publicēšanā App Store un Google Play.

  • Pieredze ar REST API integrāciju un stāvokļa pārvaldību (state management).

  • Pieredze Git un CI/CD, un automatizēto testu rakstīšanas prasmes.

  • Labas latviešu un angļu valodas zināšanas.

Par priekšrocību tiks uzskatīta:

  • Pieredze esošas koda bāzes pārņemšanā. Izpratne par natīvo iOS (Swift) un Android (Kotlin) izstrādi.

  • Zināšanas par drošas mobilo lietotņu izstrādi (OWASP MASVS).

Location: This position may be performed remotely, but requires the flexibility and willingness to travel as needed.

The Opportunity

Praxis is looking for a talented and experienced leader for a key program expected to advance best in class or first-in-class products for areas of high unmet medical need. The ideal candidate is a strong, multi-faceted leader who thrives in environments with high ambiguity, limited hierarchy, and real ownership of outcomes as the program continues its rapid trajectory of transformational patient impact.

This results-oriented individual will be characterized by a strong strategic mind, a collaborative nature and intellectual curiosity, and will credibly and enthusiastically work across the spectrum of research, development, technical operations, and commercialization. They will lead a cross-functional program team and be responsible and accountable for Praxis’ program strategy, driving decision-making, and ensuring efficient and high-quality execution.

Praxis is committed to a high-energy, fast-pace and flat organization where individuals work as peers with singular objective to bring drugs to patients. This role is not about coordinating consensus; it is about building alignment, deeply understanding all aspects of the development activities for the product and driving the program forward. The Program Lead must embrace and exemplify this way of working.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Internally and externally communicate a shared and bold vision for the program.
  • Lead, manage, and maintain the Program Team, partnering with functional leads to ensure team effectiveness and operational excellence while retaining clear accountability for program-level decisions.
  • Lead the creation and execution of the program strategy and integrated development plan(s).
  • In collaboration with the Program Team, define and deliver against program OKRs.
  • Provide strategic oversight for program budgets and resourcing, actively shaping—not just tracking—investment decisions.
  • Architect scenarios to inform decision making and program planning; ensure that the right skills and capabilities exist on the team to effectively execute on the program plan.
  • Be a role model for Praxons: inspire ambitious goals, give and receive direct feedback, and build trust through transparency and follow-through.
  • “Roll up sleeves and get hands dirty” for the benefit of the team and the program; wear multiple hats, step into gaps, and hold yourself to the same standards as the team.
  • Serve as the primary integration point with corporate processes without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.

Qualifications and Key Success Factors

  • Demonstrated drug development experience with a strong track record of cross-functional leadership; experience across the full development lifecycle strongly preferred
  • Strong holistic understanding of the drug development process across functions
  • Ability to translate strategy into execution, driving decisions that create value under real-world constraints
  • Clear, compelling communicator across internal and external stakeholders

What Sets Successful Praxons Apart

  • Comfort operating with limited hierarchy and high personal accountability
  • Learning agility and intellectual curiosity; ability to rapidly develop deep understanding of new therapeutic areas
  • Willingness to challenge assumptions, surface risks early, and engage in healthy debate in service of the best outcome
  • Demonstrated ability to balance urgency with rigor in fast-moving environments

Praxis Precision Medicines is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company translating genetic insights into the development of therapies for central nervous system disorders characterized by neuronal imbalance. At Praxis we share a common vision of reshaping the human condition into a more freeing and fulfilled existence by developing high impact medicines for patients and families affected by and living with complex brain disorders. Our core Values of Trust, Ownership, Curiosity and Results are foundational to every aspect of our business and are exemplified by each and every one of our team members.

Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

jobs.excerpt: Who We AreFlosum is a bootstrapped, profitable B2B SaaS company building the leading Salesforce-native DevSecOps, Data Protection, and Security platform.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Flosum is a bootstrapped, profitable B2B SaaS company building the leading Salesforce-native DevSecOps, Data Protection, and Security platform. Our solutions are trusted by Fortune 500 enterprises in the most heavily regulated industries on the planet — financial services, healthcare, government, and insurance.

We’re not a startup burning cash and chasing vanity metrics. We’re a proven, scaling business that reached profitability on our own terms. As a Salesforce Summit Partner and Innovation Award winner, we’ve earned our seat at the table alongside the biggest names in enterprise software.

Built 100% on the Salesforce platform. Serving enterprises that demand zero compromise on security, compliance, and reliability.

Why This Role Exists

We are entering an aggressive growth phase — expanding our product surface, deepening our platform capabilities, and accelerating our delivery velocity. We need senior-caliber Node.js developers who can own significant parts of our architecture and ship production code that enterprise customers depend on daily.

This is not a staff augmentation seat. You will work directly with engineering leadership, product managers, and the CEO. Your decisions will have real consequences, your opinions will be heard, and your craftsmanship will be visible to the customers who rely on our platform.

What You’ll Build

  • High-performance backend services and APIs powering enterprise-grade SaaS applications
  • Scalable, secure Node.js micro services and integrations within the Salesforce ecosystem
  • Modern front-end experiences using Vue.js and TypeScript that serve demanding enterprise users
  • CI/CD pipeline tooling, automation frameworks, and developer productivity infrastructure
  • Real-time data processing and event-driven architectures handling sensitive enterprise data at scale

Requirements

Read this section carefully. We are specific about what we need because we are serious about who we hire.

Non-Negotiable Technical Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional Node.js development in production environments — not tutorials, not side projects, not bootcamp exercises. Real production systems serving real users at scale.
  • Expert-level understanding of asynchronous programming, event loops, streams, and the Node.js runtime. You should be able to explain backpressure, the differences between setImmediate and process.nextTick, and why unhandled promise rejections are dangerous — without Googling it.
  • Deep experience with TypeScript in production codebases. We write typed code, and we expect you to understand why.
  • Strong command of RESTful API design, authentication patterns (OAuth 2.0, JWT), and API security best practices for enterprise environments.
  • Proven experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, query optimization, data modeling, and understanding the performance implications of schema decisions at scale.
  • Proficiency with Git workflows, code review practices, automated testing (unit, integration, and end-to-end), and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Solid understanding of containerization (Docker), cloud services (AWS/GCP/Azure), and infrastructure-as-code principles.

Highly Preferred (These Will Set You Apart)

  • Salesforce development experience: Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, or Salesforce API integrations. If you know both Node.js and Salesforce, you are a rare and extremely valuable candidate to us.
  • Experience building or contributing to Salesforce ISV (AppExchange) products.
  • Vue.js front-end development experience, particularly with Vue 3 Composition API and state management.
  • Experience working in B2B SaaS companies serving enterprise customers with strict compliance requirements (SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, GDPR).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/DevSecOps toolchains and practices in the Salesforce ecosystem.

The Kind of Person We’re Looking For

Skills get you in the door. Mindset determines whether you thrive here:

Missionary, Not Mercenary

You care about what you’re building and why. You take ownership not because someone assigned it to you, but because that’s who you are. When something is broken at 2 AM, you don’t check whether it’s “your responsibility” — you fix it.

Builder, Not a Bystander

You don’t wait for perfect specifications. You dig in, ask hard questions, propose solutions, and ship. You would rather have a working prototype by Friday than a polished slide deck by next quarter.

Craftsperson Under Pressure

Enterprise customers depend on our uptime and data integrity. You write code that doesn’t just work — it survives. You understand that in regulated industries, your code is your reputation.

Direct Communicator

You say what you think, respectfully and clearly. If a technical decision is wrong, you speak up — regardless of who made it. We value candor over politeness-at-the-expense-of-quality.

This Is a Long-Term Commitment

Let us be direct: we are not looking for contractors who jump between projects every few months. We are building a world-class engineering team, and we invest heavily in the people who join us. In return, we expect commitment.

This role is designed as a long-term, full-time engagement. You will grow with us. You will own systems end-to-end. You will see the direct impact of your work in how Fortune 500 companies build, protect, and deploy on Salesforce.

If you’re looking for a short-term gig while you wait for something else, this isn’t the role. If you want to build something that matters and be part of a team that’s scaling from strong to dominant, keep reading.

Benefits

What We Offer

jobs.excerpt: Our Product organisation is entering an exciting new chapter at Rapid7.
jobs.description:
Our Product organisation is entering an exciting new chapter at Rapid7. As Product and Engineering come together under new executive leadership, we're investing in the next generation of our Product organisation. We're looking for exceptional Managers of Product Management who are passionate about building high performing and engaged teams and are excited by leading complex platform strategy, solving customer problems, and helping shape the future of cybersecurity products. At Rapid7 you will set the prioritization and direction for your team with the backing of a global software leader combined with a rich, people-centric culture that empowers you to execute your vision. Ready to drive next-gen innovation and own the product lifecycle? Explore the role below…


About the Team

Our Product Management team bridges the gap between vision and execution, driving the strategy behind our award-winning solutions to help over 11,000 organizations assess risk, detect threats, and automate their security programs. Utilizing best-in-class technology, leading-edge research, and broad market expertise, our PMs champion the customer's voice. We collaborate across engineering and UX to develop groundbreaking new features and maximize value for security teams worldwide.


In the age of AI the stakes for creating a safer digital world are greater than ever. At Rapid7, we believe it’s our responsibility to show up every day and innovate on behalf of the entire security community. Our global Product Management team is at the center of this mission, defining the roadmap for a cohesive, industry-leading platform that spans vulnerability management, cloud security, and automation.


Join our Product Management team to own the product lifecycle, drive strategic innovation on our Insight platform, and help shape the future of a safer digital space for everyone.


About the Role

As a Manager of Product Management, your primary responsibility will be to help shape the future of our cutting-edge platform solutions by guiding team execution and aligning cross-functional strategies. Specifically, your focus will be to:

  • Directly manage a team of Product Managers with responsibility for coaching, mentoring, and supporting them in scoping work and prioritizing tasks
  • Mentor your PMs and help grow their skills, identify growth areas, set expectations and provide feedback
  • Lead cross-team collaboration with Product, Engineering, and UX for product planning, prioritization, development, launch and on-going enhancements that balance responsiveness to customer needs with strategic market impact.
  • Work with executive leadership, product, and engineering teams to develop product plans aligned with market requirements and opportunities for growth.
  • Collaborate with customers and cloud ecosystem partners, leveraging market research to develop functional and technical requirements in partnership with engineering.
  • Encourage data-driven product decisions by leveraging utilization metrics, user feedback, and customer partnerships.
  • Work with product and marketing leadership to develop content, messaging, and competitive positioning based on solid value propositions.
  • Integrate AI into day-to-day product management practices to increase efficiency, insight, and customer value.

The skills and qualities you'll bring include

  • 7+ years of experience in product management roles with a demonstrated track record of shipping meaningful product in complex or ambiguous environments preferably within Cyber Security or an AI driven SDLC. With 3+ years experience in product team leadership
  • AI Fluency – Demonstrate the ability to select and use AI appropriately to solve problems, make better decisions, and increase productivity and and foster these practices across your team
  • Previous experience in managing engaged and high performing Product Management teams with a track record in developing and mentoring PMs at all levels
  • A customer-first mindset with the ability to drive that throughout your teams, solid understanding of customer needs, and integration of this customer impact into your team’s everyday decision making
  • You hold yourself and your team responsible for driving outcomes and owning both successes and failures.
  • You think big but act small, helping your PMs break down massive visions into actionable, high-impact components.
  • Establish clear credibility and the ability to build trust fast with engineering, design, data, and senior stakeholders.
  • Formulate a strong point of view and clear opinions about what good product looks like, using crisp communication skills to land them and foster commitment from others.
  • Display professional resilience and immense comfort working through organizational change, turning restructures or pivots into opportunities to come out sharper and focused forward.
  • Make efficient, transparent decisions that resolve roadmap challenges and maintain development momentum.
  • Build a strong global network and work across boundaries to deliver sustainable improvements that create business value.
  • Embrace difficult conversations, actively listening, asking questions, and checking for understanding to find common ground when driving consensus across disparate product cohorts.
  • Embody our core values to foster a culture of excellence that drives meaningful impact and collective success.

We know that the best ideas and solutions come from multi-dimensional teams. That’s because these teams reflect a variety of backgrounds and professional experiences. If you are excited about this role and feel your experience can make an impact, please don’t be shy - apply today.


About Rapid7

At Rapid7, our vision is to create a secure digital world for our customers, our industry, and our communities. We do this by harnessing our collective expertise and passion to challenge what’s possible and drive extraordinary impact. We’re building a dynamic and collaborative workplace where new ideas are welcome.


Protecting 11,500+ customers against bad actors and threats means we’re continuing to push the envelope just like we’ ve been doing for the past 20 years. If you ’re ready to solve some of the toughest challenges in cybersecurity, we’re ready to help you take command of your career. Join us.


Rapid7, Inc. is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. A candidate’s salary is determined by various factors including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, and certifications. We evaluate compensation decisions on a case-by-case basis, and it is not typical for an individual to be hired at the very top of the salary range.


The annual salary range for this role, depending on location, is:

Ireland: €71,600.00 - 96,800.00 EUR Annual

Salary ranges may vary based on geographical location. This range does not include variable/incentive compensation, equity and benefits (where applicable/eligible).

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or any other status protected by applicable national, federal, state or local law.

jobs.description:
beschreibung

Mit Everlast AI sorgen wir für mehr Umsatz mit weniger Arbeit. Mit einem messerscharfen Automatisierungs-Fokus, einer Passion für digitalisierte Geschäftsprozesse und der Implementierung von Künstlicher Intelligenz im Unternehmen haben wir die letzten Jahre einen neuen Markt in Deutschland erschaffen. Als KI-Pioniere haben wir den größten YouTube-Kanal für Künstliche Intelligenz im Geschäftskontext etabliert. Wir vereinen die holistische Unternehmensberatung sowie die Implementierung von KI-Prozessen und KI-Agenten (Done-For-You), sodass Unternehmen Zeit und Kosten sparen. Als zugelassener Bildungsträger nach der Akkreditierungs- und Zulassungsverordnung Arbeitsförderung (AZAV) schulen wir zudem alle Stakeholder, Mitarbeiter und KI-Enthusiasten, sodass das Wissen zu 100 % Inhouse in Unternehmen gesichert ist.

Die Zahlen dahinter: über 3.500 begleitete Kunden, kununu Top Company 2023 bis 2026, FOCUS Top Arbeitgeber 2026. Neben der Beratung bauen wir eigene Software, darunter RelationFlow und Voicely, mit denen tausende Nutzer täglich arbeiten. Über 95 % unserer befristeten Einstellungen gehen in die unbefristete Übernahme.

Die kommenden Jahre versprechen Großes. Unser Markt ist extrem zukunftssicher, wir wachsen schnell, personell und kundenseitig, um so noch viel mehr Unternehmen zu helfen, ihre Geschäftsmodelle erfolgreich in die Welt zu tragen. Dazu sind wir immer auf der Suche nach neuen Kolleginnen und Kollegen.

Deine Chance als AI Engineer:

Bei Everlast AI bist Du als AI Engineer genau an der richtigen Stelle. Wir glauben fest daran, dass Vielfalt und frische Perspektiven unser Team bereichern. Dank unserer digitalen Schulungsplattform helfen wir Dir, in Deinen neuen Job hineinzufinden und das Beste aus Dir herauszuholen.

deine benefits

  • Zukunftssicherer Arbeitsplatz: Jede Person, die wir einstellen, soll langfristig mit uns wachsen. Ziel jeder Einstellung ist die unbefristete Übernahme, unsere Quote liegt bei über 95 %. Deine Vergütung steigt leistungsbasiert und jederzeit, nicht erst zum Stichtag oder nach Ablauf der Probezeit.

  • Echte Ownership für Kundenprojekte: Du übernimmst Kundenverantwortung ab Tag 1, entscheidest in der Umsetzung selbst und wächst in Großprojekte hinein. Wir erwarten dafür, dass Du mitdenkst, Vorschläge machst und Verantwortung übernimmst.

  • Best-Hardware-Garantie: Du bekommst kompromisslos das Gerät, mit dem Du am besten arbeitest. MacBook Pro 16" mit M5 Pro, 24 GB und 1 TB als Minimum, dazu Studio Display und externes Setup nach Deiner Wahl. Wir diskutieren nicht über Ausstattung, wir stellen sie hin.

  • Unbegrenzter KI-Zugang, ohne Limit und ohne Wartezeit: Du hast vollen Zugriff auf alle gängigen KI-Tools, Claude Code, Codex, ElevenLabs und was sonst gerade führend ist. Ohne Token-Limits, ohne Kontingente, ohne die Frage, ob sich der nächste Prompt lohnt. Wenn eine neue Software Deine Arbeit voranbringt, hast Du sie innerhalb von 24 Stunden auf dem Rechner.

  • Weiterbildung, die Du selbst bestimmst: 2.000 € Hardware- und Weiterbildungsbudget pro Jahr, über das Du frei entscheidest. Fachbücher, Kurse, Zertifikate, Konferenzen oder eigene Experimentier-Hardware. Bei einer Technologie, die sich in Monaten neu erfindet, weißt Du besser als jeder Katalog, worin Du tiefer wirst.

  • Lernkurve, die Du sonst nirgends bekommst: Viele unterschiedliche Kundenprojekte, internes Wissen, ein Team mit verschiedenen Schwerpunkten und KI-gestützte Entwicklung im Terminal als Standard. Unsere KI-Manager sagen uns, dass sie hier in einer Woche lernen, wofür andere Firmen ein Jahr brauchen.

  • Maximale Reichweite für Deine Arbeit: Was Du baust, läuft bei über 3.500 Kunden, und der größte deutsche YouTube-Kanal für Künstliche Intelligenz zeigt, was das Team entwickelt. Statt in einer internen Präsentation zu verschwinden, wird Deine Arbeit gesehen.

  • Zugang zu einem Netzwerk, das Dich weiterbringt: Über Everlast bist Du an eines der größten Netzwerke von Zukunftsforschern, Professoren und Doktoren im Bereich KI und Robotik angebunden. Du diskutierst mit Menschen, die diese Technologie mitentwickeln, statt sie nur zu lesen.

  • Starke Arbeitsatmosphäre: Der Umgang untereinander ist kollegial und direkt, die Wege zu den Gründern kurz. Wir ziehen an einem Strang und motivieren uns gegenseitig zu Bestleistungen.

deine aufgaben

  • Implementierung von KI-Projekten für Kunden: Du setzt KI-Lösungen um, von Automatisierungen über RAG-Wissensdatenbanken bis zu Conversational AI (KI-Telefonagenten), und betreust die Projekte technisch von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung, gemeinsam für und mit unseren Kunden. Nach Bewährung übernimmst Du Großprojekte.

  • Prozesse analysieren und in Zahlen denken: Du nimmst Geschäftsprozesse auseinander, findest die Stellen, an denen Automatisierung wirklich etwas spart, und belegst den Nutzen mit Daten statt mit Bauchgefühl. Beratung und Schulung beim Kunden gehören dazu, der Schwerpunkt liegt auf dem Bauen.

  • Einrichtung und Optimierung von KI-Assistenten: Du richtest KI-Assistenten und Agenten für interne und externe Anwendungen ein, automatisierst Prozesse und steigerst die Effizienz durch den gezielten Einsatz modernster Technologien.

  • Auf- und Ausbau von internen Automatisierungen: Du entwickelst und optimierst interne Workflows, auch die Automatisierung von Schnitt- und Content-Prozessen für unser Marketing, und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Abläufe kontinuierlich effizienter und skalierbarer werden.

  • KI-gestützte Entwicklung als Standard: Claude Code und Codex im Terminal sind Dein tägliches Werkzeug. Du arbeitest überwiegend agentisch, liest und prüfst den generierten Code und bleibst am Puls der KI-Entwicklung, weil Du Teil der Speerspitze von Everlast AI bist.

deine qualifikationen

  • Laufende eigene Projekte: Du hast mindestens eine Automatisierung oder ein eigenes Produkt gebaut, das produktiv läuft und ein echtes Problem löst. Das ist für uns das Wichtigste, kein Abschluss ersetzt es.

  • Nachweisbar guter AI-Workflow: Du arbeitest täglich mit Claude Code oder Codex im Terminal und kannst erklären, wie Du generierten Code prüfst. Du hast den Paradigmenwechsel verstanden: Denken in Systemen und Steuern von KI statt Syntax auswendig.

  • Code lesen und Architektur verstehen: Python oder TypeScript/Next.js, idealerweise beides: Du kannst Code lesen, Änderungen nachvollziehen und begründen, warum eine Lösung so gebaut ist. Selbst produktiv damit gebaut zu haben ist ein Plus.

  • Zahlen, Daten, Fakten: Du misst, was Deine Automatisierungen sparen, arbeitest strukturiert und detailorientiert und triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Daten.

  • Cloud und Datenbank: Grundkenntnisse in AWS (Lambda, S3, SES) oder alternativ Azure oder Google Cloud, dazu Supabase oder PostgreSQL in realen Projekten. Erfahrung mit RAG, Vektordatenbanken oder Voice Agents ist ein Plus.

  • Hintergrund-Builder mit Kundenkontakt: Du baust lieber, als zu präsentieren, kannst aber mit Kunden sicher auf Deutsch sprechen, Anforderungen aufnehmen und Ergebnisse erklären. Deutsch auf nahezu muttersprachlichem Niveau.

  • Eigeninitiative und Ownership: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Deine Kundenprojekte, denkst voraus und treibst Dinge nach vorne, ohne auf Anweisungen zu warten.

  • AWS: Du hast mindestens grundlegende Kenntnisse in Amazon Web Services und idealerweise bereits praktische Erfahrung mit verschiedenen AWS-Diensten gesammelt.

  • Fachliche Qualifikationen: Deine Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker für Anwendungsentwicklung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation im Bereich der Informatik bilden die Grundlage für dein technisches Wissen und deine praktischen Fähigkeiten. Diese fundierte Ausbildung befähigt dich, komplexe IT-Projekte erfolgreich zu planen und umzusetzen.
