jobs.description:
About us:

Kiva is a global nonprofit, founded in 2005, with a mission to expand financial access and help underserved communities thrive. Kiva unlocks capital for borrowers through crowdfunded loans supported by individuals around the world. Lenders on Kiva can start with as little as $25 to support causes that matter most to them, whether that’s gender equity and support for women, refugees, climate change, small businesses, agriculture, and more. Since our founding, over two million people have invested over $2 billion in real dreams and real opportunity, spanning more than 100 countries and over 5 million borrowers

As we work toward our mission, Kiva invests in building and retaining a global team of talent to add to our values-driven and digital-first culture. Our organization is supported by over 700 volunteers and 130+ full time employees dispersed around the world, as well as within team hubs located in San Francisco, Nairobi, Bogota, and Bangkok. Kiva’s team is growing as we pursue exciting new opportunities to scale our impact and create a financially inclusive world.

Kiva's values:

Impact first - This is why we exist. This is the drumbeat we march to. Every day.

Extreme ownership - Own it; you, your relationships, your impact. Insist that others support you and hold you accountable.

Be curious and bold - Never stop learning. Question assumptions. Take Risks and dream big.

Inclusion. Equity. Diversity. - Without reservation and without caveat. In our hiring, in our workplace and in our impact in the world.

Honor and integrity - Do the most right thing in the most right way. Cherish diversity and respect each other.

Love and kindness always - Say what you mean. Mean what you say. And don't say it mean. Clarity. Courage. Kindness.

Role overview:

The Manager, Strategic Partnerships helps grow philanthropic support for Kiva by cultivating individual donors, engaging philanthropic advisors and donor-advised fund partners, and developing compelling donor communications. This role manages a portfolio of mid-level donors and prospects, builds pathways to major giving, and translates Kiva’s impact into opportunities for deeper engagement and support.

As an individual contributor on the Strategic Partnerships team, you will work closely with colleagues across Finance, Marketing and Communications, Product and Engineering, and impact-focused teams to strengthen donor relationships, improve the giving experience, and support proposals and reporting. Success requires sound judgment, strong writing, and the ability to independently manage complex work while collaborating across teams.

At this time, we can only consider applicants with authorization to work in the United States on a permanent, full-time basis; unfortunately we cannot provide visa sponsorship.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Individual and mid-level donor strategy and engagement (40%)
    • Manage and cultivate relationships with a portfolio composed primarily of mid-level and major-tier donors and prospects, with support from Strategic Partnerships colleagues. Develop tailored engagement, solicitation, and stewardship plans that deepen commitment and create pathways to major gifts.
    • Develop and implement an engagement strategy for donor-advised fund sponsors, philanthropic advisors, and other “gatekeeper” professionals who influence charitable giving. Equip Kiva relationship managers with approaches and resources they can use to build these partnerships.
    • Partner with colleagues to improve website journeys, digital communications, and unique Kiva offerings such as managed lending for mid-level and major donors.
    • Represent Kiva in donor and advisor conversations, bringing in colleagues with relevant expertise when needed. Pursue thought leadership opportunities through articles, conference presentations, and other relevant channels.
    • Plan and deliver in-person and virtual donor events with the Strategic Partnerships team to deepen engagement and generate qualified prospects.
  • Cross-functional partnership development (30%)
    • Work with Finance and SP colleagues to ensure accurate gift documentation and clear coordination on donor commitments and stewardship.
    • Partner with Product and Engineering, as needed, to implement improvements to donor communications and engagement.
    • Gather impact data and borrower stories with relevant teams and translate them into effective proposals, reports, presentations, newsletters, and other donor materials.
    • Maintain accurate donor records and track relationship activity, prospect pipelines, and progress toward agreed fundraising and engagement goals.
  • Communications and marketing (30%)
    • Collaborate with Marketing and Communications teams to coordinate donor messaging across Strategic Partnerships audiences and channels.
    • Plan, write, and edit clear, persuasive donor communications that connect Kiva’s mission and impact to donor interests.
    • Use campaign and event results to improve outreach, strengthen calls to action, and assess donor engagement and lead generation.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 5 years experience in nonprofit fundraising, strategic partnerships, or a related field, including cultivating and stewarding individual donors and prospects.
  • Experience developing donor engagement strategies and moving prospects toward meaningful philanthropic commitments.
  • Familiarity with donor-advised funds, philanthropic advisors, and major giving; experience engaging these audiences is a plus.
  • Strong writing and editing skills, with the ability to translate complex programs and impact data into compelling proposals, reports, and donor communications.
  • Experience collaborating across functions and managing multiple projects, priorities, and stakeholder relationships independently.
  • Comfort using a CRM such as Salesforce and digital engagement data to track activity, run reports, evaluate results, and refine strategies.
  • Sound judgment, strong relationship-building skills, and confidence representing an organization with donors and external partners.
  • A commitment to Kiva’s mission and values, including financial inclusion, equity, and respect for the communities we serve.

What we offer:

  • A work-from-home position; final candidate must be authorized to work in one of the states listed below.
  • An opportunity to improve real lives, solve hard problems, and change the world
  • Friendly, supportive, and adventurous environment with a team of engaged colleagues
  • A comprehensive, industry-leading benefits package including health, dental, and vision insurance, parental leave, professional development, 401k matching, and unlimited PTO. Some of these benefits have eligibility requirements. Many of these benefits are subsidized or fully paid for by Kiva.
  • Opportunities to connect with and learn from colleagues and partners around the world
  • Salary range: $71K - $92K; a final offer will be dependent upon a candidate’s location, skills, and experience.
  • Currently, we are only able to hire home employees residing in the following states: AZ, CA, CO, DE, FL, GA, IL, KS, LA, MA, MD, ME, MI, MN, NY, OH, OR, SC, TX, UT, VA, and WA.

A diverse and inclusive workplace where we learn from each other is an integral part of Kiva's culture. We actively welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer and a great place to work. Join us and help us achieve our mission!

We will only accept applications directly from candidates. Kiva will not be responsible for any recruiting agency fees, absent a formal agreement.

jobs.description:
Contract | Remote, worldwide | $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location | 10-20 hrs/week

Check out this Loom video for more details:

We're looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

This is not a traditional engineering role. You won't be writing production code. You'll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.

What this role actually is

You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios, focusing on:

• Whether the response makes sense

  • Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful
  • Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment
  • Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste. Syntax correctness is the easy part.

What you'll be doing

  • Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end to end
  • Judge whether outputs are useful, correct at a high level, and aligned with how a strong engineer would think
  • Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just the code
  • Distinguish between levels of response quality (what makes something a 2 vs a 4)
  • Give clear, opinionated feedback in writing on what worked, what didn't, and what felt off or misleading
  • Help define what great looks like when working with tools like Cursor, Codex and Claude Code

What we mean by "taste"

We're looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

  • Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?
  • Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?
  • Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output?
  • Would this interaction build or erode trust?

You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments, and explaining them clearly.

Who you are

  • Senior, Staff or Principal-level engineer (or equivalent experience)
  • Strong background in TypeScript/JavaScript or Python
  • Hands-on experience with at least one of OpenAI Codex, Claude Code or Cursor
  • Deep familiarity with modern AI-assisted dev workflows
  • Able to evaluate code without executing it or reviewing every line
  • Strong written and spoken English (B2 or above). You'll be writing detailed feedback and recording short video explanations, so this is a hard requirement
  • Comfortable giving direct, opinionated feedback
  • High bar for what good engineering looks like

Nice to have

  • Prior exposure to prompt design or evaluation workflows
  • Experience mentoring senior engineers or defining engineering standards

Engagement details

  • Rate: $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location

• Hours: 10-20 hours/week, flexible

  • Duration: ongoing. Projects run from about two weeks to a few months each, and we offer new ones to evaluators who do well
  • Start: as soon as you clear the take-home and a project has an open seat
  • Process: one take-home evaluation exercise with a recorded Loom walkthrough. No interview

About Agicap

Créée à Lyon en 2016 par trois entrepreneurs français, Agicap est l'une des scale-ups avec la plus forte croissance d’Europe, avec plus de 8 000 clients, 600 employés et une croissance rapide du chiffre d'affaires (multiplié par 7 entre 2021 et 2024). Agicap fait partie du French Tech 120, qui récompense les startups les plus prometteuses de France.
Agicap permet aux directions financières des entreprises de taille intermédiaire de gérer et de prévoir efficacement leur trésorerie, de payer leurs fournisseurs et de se faire payer. En combinant un système de gestion de trésorerie avec des solutions de gestion des comptes fournisseurs et des comptes clients sur une seule plateforme, Agicap ambitionne de devenir la nouvelle référence en matière de gestion de trésorerie pour les entreprises de taille intermédiaire.
Nous avons levé 145 millions d’euros depuis notre création, auprès de fonds de capital-risque prestigieux tels qu’AVP, Greenoaks, Partech et BlackFin, avec un dernier tour en novembre 2024.
Ces ressources supplémentaires alimentent encore davantage notre innovation produit, nous permettant de croître significativement et d’accélérer notre expansion internationale à travers le monde.
Nous sommes convaincus que notre succès réside dans nos équipes passionnées et dévouées, engagées à bâtir une entreprise où chacun peut évoluer et construire sa carrière. Nous sommes constamment à la recherche de nouveaux talents, visant l’excellence et prêts à rejoindre notre aventure ambitieuse !
Home page
Customer Stories
Our Values

Tu veux travailler sur une Data Platform qui irrigue toute une scale-up fintech — du Marketing au Produit, en passant par la Finance, le Customer Success et les sales — et qui est aujourd'hui au cœur de notre transition AI-first ? Tu as le recul pour maintenir des systèmes en prod ET l'énergie pour aller construire la couche sémantique qui va connecter nos données à l'IA ?

Chez Agicap, la Data Platform répond aux besoins analytics (reporting, IA) et de synchronisation de données au service de toute l'entreprise. Elle s'appuie sur Google Cloud Platform (notamment BigQuery et Composer), Airbyte, dbt et Looker pour maintenir et diffuser des données à jour, consolidées et fiables.
🔥 Le chantier qui change tout : l'ouverture de l'accès à la donnée d'entreprise par l'IA via notre serveur MCP Analytics. On a déjà posé les premières briques avec les Explores Looker gouvernés par les DA — la suite logique, c'est l'extension à BigQuery couplée à une couche sémantique. Et c'est là que tu entres en jeu.

👥L'équipe que tu rejoins

    Tu intègres une équipe de 3 Data Engineers qui collabore au quotidien avec 4 Data Analysts et Pauline (Head of Data). Tu seras en lien direct avec Kévin (Team Lead Data Engineering) et Pauline au quotidien. L'équipe Data est rattachée au département Revenue & Operations.

    L'équipe en 3 mots : soudée, pragmatique, exigeante techniquement. On porte beaucoup de sujets stratégiques en parallèle — c'est pour ça qu'on cherche un·e senior qui pourra prendre vite ses marques et apporter du poids sur les décisions d'architecture.

💪 Tes missions

    Tu alternes entre run exigeant et chantiers structurants :

    • Maintenir et fiabiliser la plateforme : Composer (Airflow), Airbyte self-hosted sur GKE, BigQuery, dbt, Terraform. Une part de ton temps va au run (gestion des incidents, support DA), réparti au sein de l'équipe DE. Tu conçois et enrichis tests, monitoring et alerting — technique et fonctionnel.
    • Industrialiser l'ingestion de données : collecter les sources via Airbyte (API ou CDC selon les cas), gérer l'évolution des schémas et les tables externes BigQuery.
    • Alimenter les outils métier : reverse-ETL et synchronisations entre outils (HubSpot, Gainsight, Intercom…) ou vers notre base temps réel PostgreSQL via notre architecture streaming (webhooks → Pub/Sub → Cloud Run).
    • Étendre la couche d'accès IA : prolonger le MCP Analytics vers BigQuery, construire la couche sémantique qui conditionne la qualité des réponses de l'IA. La qualité de la modélisation fait la qualité des réponses.
    • Maîtriser coûts et sécurité : réservations de slots BigQuery en autoscaling, routage dynamique du build dbt, revue FinOps mensuelle, least privilege, gestion des données personnelles et sensibles, sécurisation des accès data par l'IA.

👀 Comment on travaille

  • Daily DE + weekly Data pour partager les avancées et débloquer vite.
  • Décisions d'architecture co-construites et documentées, code review systématique, amélioration continue.
  • Full remote pour les DE — l'équipe est distribuée, on sait travailler ensemble à distance.
  • Une semaine par trimestre à Lyon avec toute l'équipe Data pour les sujets de fond et les moments humains.
  • L'IA est un outil de travail quotidien : Claude Code, consignes par repo, marketplace interne de skills. La relecture humaine reste obligatoire — on utilise l'IA avec exigence.
  • Contribution open source : on publie des connecteurs Airbyte.

⭐ Notre stack

    • GCP : BigQuery, GCS, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Composer, GKE, Looker
    • Ingestion : Airbyte self-hosted (CDC PostgreSQL et SQL Server), GCS Avro → tables externes BigQuery
    • Transformation & qualité : dbt, Elementary
    • IaC & CI/CD : Terraform, Cloud Build, GitHub Actions
    • Langages : Python, SQL, Docker
    • IA : Claude Code (skills et plugins internes), serveur MCP interne

🎯 Le profil qu'on cherche

    Indispensable

    • 5 ans d'expérience minimum en Data Engineering sur un Cloud Provider majeur, avec la responsabilité de maintenir des systèmes en production.
    • SQL confirmé + modèles dbt complexes (matérialisation incrémentale, snapshots, macros) que tu sais debugger (doublons, données tardives, suppressions, changement de schéma) et optimiser (durée, coût).
    • Expérience solide en ingestion et orchestration de pipelines : debugging, dérive de schéma, reprise, backfill, analyse d'impacts.
    • Python de qualité, testé et maîtrisé — maintenabilité et fiabilité au cœur de ta pratique.
    • Infrastructure as Code et CI/CD au quotidien.
    • Tu travailles avec un Coding Agent et tu sais prendre du recul pour vérifier ce qu'il produit.
    • Tu es force de proposition, rigoureux·se, humble, et tu aimes transmettre : partager tes découvertes, expliquer tes choix aux équipes techniques comme métier, faire progresser tes collègues.
    • Tu es à l'aise en équipe partiellement full-remote.
    • Anglais B2 minimum.

      • Un gros plus

      • Expérience sur une couche sémantique (dbt Semantic Layer / MetricFlow, LookML), sur le Knowledge Catalog GCP (ex-Dataplex) ou équivalent, ou plus largement sur la gouvernance de données : cataloging, lineage, classification, policy tags, ownership.
      • Traitements en architecture événementielle et leurs spécificités (Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, scaling, rejets, retries).

        • Un plus

        • Expérience GCP : BigQuery et son modèle de compute via réservations de slots, Composer, Cloud Run, GKE / Helm.
        • Tu as construit des tools pour agents IA (serveur MCP, skills).
        • Intégrations dans des outils métier (HubSpot, Gainsight, Intercom).
        • Pipelines data en Change Data Capture.
        • Contribution à l'écosystème Airbyte.

About Patch

Patch is the hyperlocal news and information platform for 15,000 U.S. communities, reaching 25 million monthly users and 3 million active email subscribers. We use AI throughout our business, from gathering and delivering the news to helping local partners connect with customers. Our 85-person newsroom helps people understand what is happening where they live; our events, classifieds, business listings and advertising products help local organizations reach them. Patch spans a high-traffic website, iOS and Android apps, email, a custom CMS, user-generated content, payments, data and advertising systems. We’ve used AI to expand our platform nationwide, to offer new digital products for our customers and to improve workflow and capabilities for local journalists.

The Role

We are looking for a hands-on Vice President, Product to lead AI innovation, own Patch’s product roadmap and lead our Product and Engineering organizations. The portfolio includes Patch’s core platform, web and mobile apps, owned-and-operated digital products, and advertising products developed in close partnership with Revenue. You will also spearhead Patch’s efforts to expand the impact of AI across every facet of the organization—from how our teams work to the products, services and experiences we create for customers and users.

This role is for a product builder who is obsessed with business outcomes—not output—and who can connect customer jobs, company priorities and technical reality. You will set direction, make hard trade-offs, stay close to the work and help strong teams ship products that matter to local users, businesses and event marketers.

What You Will Lead

  • AI initiatives and development. Lead AI products for end users, customers and internal workflows.
  • Product strategy and roadmap. Turn company goals and customer needs into a focused roadmap with clear outcomes, sequencing and trade-offs.
  • Jobs to Be Done product development. Build a rigorous practice around customer jobs, evidence, prototyping, validation and post-launch learning—without creating process for its own sake.
  • Patch’s digital portfolio. Advance the core platform, apps and owned-and-operated products while improving the shared capabilities that let Patch move faster.
  • Revenue product partnership. Work closely with Revenue to develop advertising and commercial products that solve real customer problems and produce measurable growth.
  • Product and Engineering leadership. Create strong operating alignment across the two functions, develop talent, raise the quality of decisions and delivery, and build genuine followership.

What You Bring

    • A record of building, shipping and scaling successful digital products, with clear evidence of business impact—not simply roadmap completion.
    • Meaningful technical credibility: experience as an engineer and/or managing engineering teams, and the ability to reason directly about architecture, data, feasibility and trade-offs.
    • Deep fluency in Jobs to Be Done product development and the judgment to apply it pragmatically.
    • Experience with scaled digital products for small and midsize businesses is a significant plus, as is exposure to programmatic advertising, marketplaces, subscriptions, local commerce or audience products.
    • Exceptional prioritization: the ability to say no, concentrate resources on the few bets that matter and change course when evidence demands it.
    • A hands-on operating style. You prototype, inspect the data, talk with customers and work through details with the team; you do not delegate the substance of product leadership.
    • A track record of developing talent, creating followership and leading with curiosity, candor, self-awareness and low ego.

Product and Technology Environment

    Patch’s products span consumer web and mobile, email, publishing, user-generated content, payments, data, search and advertising integrations. The technology environment includes JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Drupal/PHP, AWS, Heroku, Pantheon, GCP/BigQuery/GA4, Stripe, Auth0/Okta, Typesense/OpenSearch, GitHub/Jira and modern AI tools. You need not master the stack, but you must be technically fluent and able to earn the trust of engineers.

Working at Patch

    Patch is remote-first, with employees and contractors across countries and time zones. The ideal candidate feels a real connection to our mission: keeping people informed about their communities and helping local businesses and event marketers get the word out to the audiences that matter most.

Benefits

  • Ancillary benefits
  • 401(k)
  • Unlimited discretionary time off (DTO)
  • 10 paid holidays a year
  • Paid parental leave

Our commitment to equality extends to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, training, compensation, benefits, and general treatment.

Our Security & Network Solutions business protects and connects 12,000+ customers across convenience retail, fuel, quick-service restaurants, and automotive. The store networks that keep payments and fuel pumps running are the same networks attackers target. In the first five minutes, a network outage and a security incident often look the same, and our customers expect one team to own both.

We're looking for a senior leader to run our SOC and NOC as one operation: more than 150 people across onshore and offshore teams, delivering 24/7 monitoring, response, and uptime. jobs.description:
Standard Job Description

Proposal Analyst Sr

What You Will Be Doing:

As a Senior Proposal Analyst, you will play a critical role in shaping the financial strategy for AMMM (C-130J, C-5, and P-3) development and sustainment programs. As the pricing subject matter expert, you will develop accurate, data-driven cost estimates and pricing proposals that directly support competitive contract pursuits, customer negotiations, and long-term program success. This highly collaborative role partners with engineering, supply chain, contracts, finance, and customer-facing teams to deliver pricing solutions that align with customer requirements, business objectives, and corporate compliance standards.

Develops, plans & schedules proposals in accordance with estimating policy,Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR) & Defense Federal Acquisition Regulations (DFARS) requirements, USG Bus. System Requirements & other govt. regulations. Shapes, develops & matures bus. case analyses & cost methods resulting in a comprehensive bid/price strategy. Develops initiatives to increase profitability & cashflow. Acts as the estimating lead on proposals compiling cost, schedule, & technical elements to development proposals in accordance with Request For Proposal (RFP) specs. Coordinates the collection of cost, scheduling, & performance elements from functional departments. Performs financial modeling & analyses related to major proposals, including rate studies & analysis, bus. case development, cash flow analysis, NPV & IRR & presents analyses & recommendations to leaders. Researches & analyzes historical data, develops cost models to support proposal efforts & determination of accuracy of functional estimates. Participates in should-cost & pricing reviews with mngmt & customer reps. Participates as a member of the contract negotiating team & interacts with DCAA /other audit agencies. Initiates process improvements to enhance productivity & efficiency within pricing & estimating functions. May provide day-to-day direction & guidance to less senior Proposal Analysts. Develops, communicates, & implements Estimating & Pricing policies/procedures, & conducts monitoring & surveillance activities to ensure that the policies/procedures are being thoroughly & consistently implemented. Possesses comprehensive written & oral communications skills to support proposal development activities, executive proposal reviews, fact-finding & negotiations, & interaction with DCAA/other audit agencies.

Key Responsibilities:

- Develop, analyze, and deliver comprehensive cost estimates and pricing proposals for development and sustainment efforts across AMMM programs.

- Partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Supply Chain, Contracts, Finance, and Program Management to gather inputs and build competitive pricing strategies.

- Prepare pricing packages and financial analyses that support proposal submissions, customer negotiations, and contract modifications.

- Ensure pricing methodologies are accurate, compliant, and aligned with customer requirements, government regulations, and company policies.

- Analyze historical data, cost trends, and program requirements to develop defensible cost estimates and identify financial risks and opportunities.

- Support long-range business planning by providing pricing recommendations and financial insights that influence strategic decision-making.

- Present pricing assumptions, cost analyses, and recommendations to program leadership and executive stakeholders.

- Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance proposal quality, pricing efficiency, and estimating processes.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelors degree from an accredited college in a related discipline, or 5 years experience in the absence of a Bachelors Degree

- 3+ years of experience in a pricing / estimating related field

- Experience with Microsoft Office tools, especially Excel spreadsheets.

- Familiarity or experience with FAR, Part 15 proposal requirements.

Desired Skills

- Estimating and/or Pricing Experience.

- Negotiations experience.

- Knowledge of the proposal process and familiar with Basis Of Estimates (BOEs).

- Current Secret clearance.

- PROPRICER experience.

- Excellent written, oral, and task coordination skills.

- Experience coordinating complex estimates with changing requirements and deadlines.

jobs.title: Product Data Scientist
jobs.excerpt: About HipcampOver the past decade, Hipcamp has unlocked access to 5 million acres of private camping around the world.
jobs.description:
About Hipcamp

Over the past decade, Hipcamp has unlocked access to 5 million acres of private camping around the world. In addition to hosting over 120k campsites you won’t find anywhere else, Hipcamp also has the best collection of bookable tent, RV and cabin sites for all camping styles. Each year, Hipcamp helps millions of people happily sleep under the stars, boosting local economies and biodiversity along the way. Everything we do is guided by our belief that getting outside is good for the health of people and the environment. Our culture is built on a deep and genuine commitment to helping people connect with the outdoors. Hipcamp is also backed by top tier investors including Andreesen Horowitz, Benchmark, Bond Capital and Index Ventures.

About the role

We're looking for a Product Data Scientist to join our Analytics team, whose mission is to provide data insights that drive impact and guide strategy. You'll embed on the Host Camp, a small, cross-functional crew that spans across Product and Ops, to deeply understand the problems our Hosts face. You'll partner closely with team leads on strategy, dig into how people actually use Hipcamp to find growth opportunities, and make sure the team is investing in the most impactful projects.

As one of two Analysts, the ownership area is large and the autonomy is real. You'll work independently and collaboratively in equal measure, wear a few hats, help set the path when it isn't drawn yet, and find the signal in the ambiguity. You don't wait for a perfectly scoped question and hand a chart back over the fence. Instead, you spot the opportunity, form the hypothesis, validate it quickly, and land the answer that the team can act on. The foundational work that helps the team is as exciting to you as the big, deep analytical projects.

We're also big believers in putting AI to work, and we want someone excited to fold it into how they analyze, automate, and think, and to help the whole team do the same. You use statistics and models to inform your analysis and to co-design better experiments. You're literate enough in ML to read a model, reason about what it's telling you, and ask sharp questions of the people who build them. Above all, you connect the numbers to the decision.

What you'll do

  • Partner with Product and Ops to shape strategy for the Host Camp by uncovering growth opportunities, developing your own hypotheses, and making the analytical case for where the team should focus.
  • Co-design experiments, using model outputs and statistical thinking to shape smarter tests that you then set up and iterate quickly to pressure-test your conclusions.
  • Keep the Camp's key performance metrics visible and easy to reach, so everyone can see how they're doing.
  • Use AI throughout your analytical workflow to accelerate exploration, automate repetitive work, prototype ideas quickly, and spend more time on high-value thinking.
  • Partner with Data Engineering to build our AI-powered analytics platform, creating reusable workflows and self-service tools that make trusted data and insights easier to access across the company.

What you'll bring

  • 6+ years in product, growth, or marketing analytics or data science.
  • Strong SQL and data visualization skills.
  • Solid statistics. You design and read experiments well, reason about significance and causality, and know a real signal from noise.
  • Enough ML literacy to use models well: you can interpret model output, fold it into analysis, and co-design experiments around it.
  • A knack for storytelling and clear communication. You translate analysis into a decision, and move a team with it.
  • Comfort in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift and you adapt as we learn. You're happy finding impact where the path isn't obvious yet.
  • A full-stack way of working. You generate your own hypotheses, validate them pragmatically, and carry solutions through to implementation.
  • Fluency with AI, and eagerness to weave it into how you (and the team) work.
  • Ease working both independently and with a distributed, cross-functional team.
  • Curiosity to deeply understand the community we serve.
  • A real passion for our mission.

Don't check every box? Please apply anyway. Some of our best teammates came in a little outside the lines.

About our Work Environment

Compensation will be a mix of salary and stock options. It will be highly competitive compared to similar-stage companies and based on location.

Health is essential to happiness. In addition to full health insurance, all team members receive $1K in Hipcash because we believe getting outside is excellent preventative medicine in addition to increasing your creativity, lowering your stress, and making you an overall more awesome human.

We focus on results, not hours. We believe that clearly defined goals combined with great people, empowerment, and autonomy create the best results. We feel confident that inclusive and diverse teams working on an important cause can accomplish extraordinary things.

Hipcamp is an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. In fact we are confident that the most inclusive and diverse teams accomplish the most extraordinary results.

jobs.title: IC – Construction Estimator I
jobs.excerpt: Remote | Outside the United StatesBefore You ApplyIC means Independent Contractor.
jobs.description:
Remote | Outside the United States

Before You Apply

IC means Independent Contractor. This is an independent contractor service opportunity intended for professionals located in and providing services from outside the United States. It is not an employee position and does not include Company employee benefits.

Service providers are expected to provide their own computer, reliable internet connection, and two additional monitors (three screens total). High-Light Electric will provide access to the software, licenses, Company virtual desktop, systems, and platforms required to perform the contracted services.

Independent contractors control how they organize and perform their services, subject to agreed deliverables, bid deadlines, coordination requirements, confidentiality obligations, and the terms of the Independent Contractor Agreement.

About the Opportunity

High-Light Electric, Inc. is building an estimating structure that clearly separates quantity takeoff from full bid ownership.

Takeoff Specialists measure and organize quantities. Estimators take that work forward — reviewing the takeoff, verifying scope, pricing the work, managing bid communication, assembling the estimating package, and owning the bid from start to finish.

We are currently seeking professionals who can provide Estimator I-level services, owning standard construction bids from initial review through bid submission and post-award handoff.

Depending on a candidate's existing estimating experience and demonstrated readiness to own a complete bid, the path into an Estimator I scope may begin with a Takeoff Specialist II engagement to demonstrate advanced scope recognition, prime-bid takeoff capability, and readiness for full estimating responsibility.

Services & Deliverables

As an Estimator I, your contracted services will include:

  • Run standard construction bids from initial review through bid submission and post-award handoff.
  • Review and approve assigned takeoff packages, verifying quantities, plans, specifications, materials, installation requirements, scope completeness, coordination items, and bid risks.
  • Price and assemble complete estimating packages, including bid worksheets, vendor and subcontractor quotes, bidder questions, addenda, and subcontractor information.
  • Manage standard bid-related communication with vendors, subcontractors, owners, agencies, and other external project contacts through Company-authorized communication channels, escalating complex or nonstandard matters when appropriate.
  • Coordinate pre-bid and bid-closeout reviews and provide a clear estimating recommendation before submission.
  • After award, support contract execution, budget setup, required project documentation, and a clean handoff to the project team, and remain available for questions regarding the estimate and how the work was priced.
  • Coordinate with Takeoff Specialists on assigned bid packages, including deadlines, package review, corrections, and missing information needed to complete the estimate.

The Estimator I is accountable for the completeness and quality of the final estimating package, including work incorporated from supporting takeoff packages.

What We're Looking For

A strong Estimator I should already be able to independently manage a standard construction bid from start to finish, rather than only performing quantity takeoffs.

Strong candidates will demonstrate:

  • Practical construction estimating experience, including pricing and bid preparation.
  • Experience reading and interpreting construction plans and specifications in English.
  • Strong understanding of scope and the ability to identify missing, conflicting, or incomplete information.
  • Experience reviewing takeoffs, vendor/subcontractor quotes, addenda, and other bid documents.
  • Strong Excel proficiency required.
  • Experience with Bluebeam Revu strongly preferred.
  • Professional written and verbal English for estimating discussions and external bid-related communication.
  • Strong attention to detail while maintaining an understanding of the complete bid.
  • Clear, proactive communication when scope, pricing, quality, or bid deadlines may be affected.
  • Accountability for the accuracy and completeness of contracted deliverables.
  • Sound judgment when working with confidential pricing, plans, specifications, and competitive information.
  • Ability to work independently while coordinating effectively with Estimating, Operations, and project teams.

Experience with U.S. construction, electrical infrastructure, civil scope, or public works is highly valuable.

How the Engagement Works

This is a deliverable-based independent contractor engagement, not a fixed-shift or timesheet-based position.

Contractors determine how they organize their work as long as agreed deliverables and bid deadlines are met.

Because construction bidding depends on vendor quotes, agenda, bidder questions, pre-bid coordination, and bid closeouts, some activities occur according to external schedules. California business hours are generally 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. Pacific Time.

You are not expected to work a fixed 8–5 shift; however, you must be able to coordinate and remain reachable during the specific California-business-hour windows required for active bids.

All work-related communication and external bid communication must be conducted through Company-authorized systems and platforms so project information remains secure and properly documented.

Contractor Fees

Estimator I

Monthly Service Fee: $2,400 USD*

Productivity Bonuses: $533 USD per $1M on jobs won

*The monthly service fee is invoiced through the regular contractor payment cycle subject to a mutually agreed scope of work provided upon successful engagement.

Productivity Bonuses may be earned on jobs won and are paid at the end of the month following the month in which they are earned, provided there are no unresolved estimating errors or outstanding rework associated with the applicable bid.

Production compensation is variable and depends on successfully awarded work.

These amounts are independent contractor service fees, not salary or wages. Final payment terms and conditions will be documented in the Independent Contractor Agreement.

Estimator Scope & Growth Path

Estimator I is responsible for standard construction bids from start to finish.

Candidates with demonstrated experience owning complete bids may be considered directly for an Estimator I engagement. Depending on experience and technical assessment, however, we will gladly consider less experienced but highly motivated candidates who will be engaged in a hybrid agreement to work for a set period as a Takeoff Specialist - with a written plan and provisions to learn the Estimator role while earning and learning. Takeoff Specialist involves advanced takeoff work on prime bids, including identifying electrical and civil scope, subcontracted work, coordination items, and missing information within the bid documents. Consistently demonstrating the judgment, accuracy, and scope awareness required at this level can establish readiness for an Estimator I scope. Contractors who later demonstrate the ability to handle greater bid complexity, autonomy, accuracy, and judgment may become eligible for an Estimator II expanded scope as business needs develop.

Estimator II handles large, complex, or multi-discipline bids, manages owner and agency communication with greater autonomy, and helps develop the takeoff function.

Estimator II Monthly Service Fee: $2,750 USD*
Estimator II Productivity Bonuses: $667 USD per $1M on jobs won

Changes in scope are not automatic or tenure-based. Eligibility is based on demonstrated capability, results, technical readiness, and business need.

About Mendoza Companies

Mendoza Companies is a multi-entity ecosystem of construction, services, and investment businesses operating under The Mendoza Way. The ecosystem includes High-Light Electric, Inc. (HLE) — a California-based union electrical infrastructure contractor founded in 1996 delivering public works and complex electrical construction across California — along with Mendoza Trust and an international independent contractor workforce.

We partner with Caltrans, municipalities, transit authorities, and infrastructure programs throughout California, with active expansion into Nevada, Arizona, and additional U.S. markets.

Mendoza Companies is guided by Mission 2040: the Mendoza Companies will be a $1-billion-dollar company, connecting 1,000 families and communities through business.

What to Expect in the Selection Process

Our selection process may include an AI-assisted interview through an authorized interviewing platform, followed by a conversation with Talent Acquisition via Microsoft Teams and additional interviews with members of our Estimating team and Company leadership.

Candidates who receive an AI interview invitation as part of this process should know that it is an authorized step in Mendoza Companies' recruiting process.

Equal Opportunity in Contractor Engagement

We are committed to providing equal opportunity in the selection and engagement of qualified independent contractors and do not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable law. This opportunity is for an independent contractor relationship and does not constitute an offer of employment.

Salary: $2,400 USD monthly

jobs.title: CRO & UX Analyst
jobs.excerpt: CRO & UX AnalystLocation: Remote Employment Type: Full-TimeExperience: 5+ YearsSchedule: Must be available for overlap with Sydney hours, including availability from 2:00 PM AESTWhy this role matters We're hiring someone to help take our client to the next level.
jobs.description:
CRO & UX Analyst

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience: 5+ Years

Schedule: Must be available for overlap with Sydney hours, including availability from 2:00 PM AESTWhy this role matters
We're hiring someone to help take our client to the next level. This is not a freelance or contract role. You'll be all in with our team and our clients from day one.
We want a motivated person who lifts the team and inspires our clients. You have a can-do attitude. You believe every data problem can be solved, and you keep going until it is.

The role
You'll find out what users do once they land on a client's site, and why they don't convert. You'll spend most of your day in GA4 and behavioural tools like Hotjar, Contentsquare, FullStory or Microsoft Clarity. You'll also step back to spot trends and patterns, and explain what they mean for the client's business. You'll work closely with our senior CRO and CRO team.

Here's a typical task. A client's conversion rate dropped 15% last month. You work out which channel, device and landing page drove the drop. You check the ratios behind it, such as add-to-cart and checkout completion rates. Then you watch session recordings and heatmaps to see what users did. Then you write up the likely cause, what it's costing the client, and what to test. If the numbers look wrong, you check for a tracking issue first.

This role is not
We've had many applicants from adjacent fields. They're good backgrounds, but they're not this job. This role is not:

  • A tracking or tag setup role. Our developers handle implementation.
  • An A/B test build or development role. You'll analyse test results, but you won't build the tests.
  • A UX or UI design role.
  • A campaign, SEO, PPC or media reporting role. We care about what users do on the site, not how they got there.
  • A data science role. Python, SQL and BigQuery aren't required. If you have them, tell us how they'd add to the skills below, not replace them
What you'll do

GA4 analysis (the core of the role)

  • Build custom reports and explorations in GA4 to answer specific client questions.
  • Build funnel and path explorations to find where users drop off.
  • Create segments and comparisons, such as new vs returning, device, channel or landing page.
  • Find which pages, sources or user groups explain a change in conversion rate.
Business-level analysis
  • Spot trends and patterns over time, such as week-on-week, year-on-year and seasonal shifts.
  • Work with ratios, not just totals. For example: conversion rate, average order value, revenue per user, add-to-cart rate, and cart-to-checkout and checkout completion rates.
  • Tell a real change apart from noise or a shift in traffic mix.
  • Link site metrics to business outcomes like revenue, leads and lead quality.
  • Size opportunities. For example, what a 1% lift in checkout completion is worth to the client per year.
A/B test results and post-test analysis
This is critical to our business. We need to know why a test won or lost, not just that it did.
  • Analyse A/B test results and report them clearly, including confidence and sample size.
  • Break results down by segment, such as device, new vs returning, channel and landing page.
  • Dig into secondary metrics and funnel steps to explain what changed in user behaviour.
  • Use recordings and heatmaps of each variant to show why it won or lost.
  • Turn the findings into clear next steps and new test ideas.
Behavioural and UX analysis
  • Review session recordings, heatmaps and scroll maps to see what users actually do.
  • Run heuristic reviews of client sites and funnels to spot likely conversion blockers.
  • Check findings across GA4, behavioural tools and heuristics. Don't rely on one source.
Data quality
  • Spot when data looks wrong, such as missing events, duplicates, thresholding or sampling.
  • Work out whether it's a tracking issue.
  • Brief our developers clearly so they can fix it. You won't do the fix yourself.
AI and automation
  • Use AI tools to automate repeat work, such as reporting, data pulls and write-up drafts.
  • Use AI for basic data analysis, such as summarising exports, spotting outliers and first-pass trend checks.
  • Check every AI output before it's used. You own the accuracy, not the tool.
  • Look for new ways AI can speed up how we work.
Communication
  • Explain findings in plain English to the team and to clients.
  • Present and defend your own ideas live, on calls and in meetings.
  • Say so, politely, when you disagree.
  • Say "I'm not sure yet" when that's the truth. Then go and find the answer.
  • Double-check your findings before you share them.
  • Produce clear, well-structured write-ups.


What we're looking for
Skills
  • 5+ years working in the GA4 interface (or Universal Analytics before it) to answer conversion questions.
  • Strong skills building custom reports, explorations and segments in GA4.
  • Proven experience analysing A/B test results and explaining why tests won or lost.
  • Strong business sense. You're comfortable with trends, ratios and commercial metrics, and can explain what they mean for revenue.
  • Regular hands-on use of at least one behavioural tool: Hotjar, Contentsquare, FullStory or Microsoft Clarity.
  • Advanced use of AI tools for automation, reporting and basic data analysis, with a habit of checking the output.
  • Enough tracking knowledge to tell when data is wrong and explain the problem to a developer.
  • Strong written and spoken English.
Attitude
  • A curious mindset. You keep digging until you find the real answer, not the first plausible one.
  • A can-do attitude. No data problem is too hard for you.
  • You want to be part of a team long term and help it grow.
  • Confidence to share your own ideas, disagree politely, and admit when you don't know yet.
  • A habit of double-checking your work before you share it.
Nice-to-haves
  • A tracking or tagging background, such as Google Tag Manager. Useful for debugging, but not what the role is about.
  • Python, SQL or BigQuery skills, if you can show how they'd strengthen the GA4 and behavioural work above.
  • Certifications in Contentsquare, Hotjar, FullStory or similar tools.
  • CRO agency experience great to have but not necessary.
Logistics
  • Full time, permanent. Not a freelance or contract role.
  • Based locally or remote.
  • If remote, you must be online by 2pm AEST/AEDT to overlap with our Sydney team.
How to apply
Please answer these seven questions in a loom video or something similar. Short, specific answers are best.
  1. A client's checkout conversion rate fell 20% in two weeks. List the first five things you'd check in GA4 and your behavioural tools, in order, and why.
  2. A client's sessions are up 30% year on year, but revenue is flat. Which ratios would you look at first, and what would each tell you?
  3. An A/B test on a product page finished flat overall. How would you work out what actually happened, and what would you recommend next?
  4. Describe a time something didn't look right in the data. How did you find the cause, and how did it get fixed?
  5. Describe a custom report or exploration you built in GA4. What question did it answer, and what did you find?
  6. Describe a time you found something unexpected by combining GA4 with a behavioural tool. How did you investigate it, and what did you recommend?
  7. Describe one way you use AI in your analysis or reporting work. How do you check its output?

jobs.description:
The AI Engineer plays a critical role in making modeling and simulation accessible to non-data scientists. You will be designing, developing, and deploying AI-driven applications to make our software more accessible which will have a direct impact on the number of organizations we are able to serve. This position plays a critical role in our product roadmap and will directly contribute to the company's success and growth. Ideal candidates exhibit a high willingness to experiment and empathy for users.

About Epistemix

The most consequential decisions in public health, life sciences, insurance, and enterprise strategy share a common problem: they involve human behavior, network effects, and downstream effects that cannot be safely tested before action is taken. Traditional analytical techniques built on historical data were not built for this. Epistemix was.

We build simulation and data-driven modeling tools that let leaders visualize how strategies will unfold across populations and systems before they commit resources. By clarifying which variables drive outcomes, where leverage exists, and how they interact, we help organizations move from uncertainty to conviction. Getting these decisions right means faster interventions, better-allocated resources, and measurable improvements in human and economic outcomes. We exist to make that possible.

Our platform gives organizations access to realistic, high-resolution population data and the modeling infrastructure to run scenario planning at scale. Together, these capabilities let decision-makers stress-test strategies in a controlled environment before deploying them in the real world across healthcare, consumer industries, insurance, and government. We are approaching our Series B and actively building the team that will define what comes next.

Responsibilities

  • Craft clean, testable, and maintainable code to enable AI-generated agent-based models.

  • Own the software from requirements development through deployment and maintenance that enable decision makers to generate agent-based models that address critical business questions and data scientists to build agent-based models more quickly that answer the questions of decision makers.

  • Design, build, test, and deploy a scalable system architecture so that AI-generated models can be validated by data scientists and deliver results back to decision makers quickly.

  • Own the engineering solution and collaborate with internal teams to ensure alignment with company strategy.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

  • 3+ years of experience developing AI/ML applications in production environments.

  • Proven track record of working with LLMs, NLP models, or AI-driven systems.

  • Experience designing and optimizing high-performance, scalable APIs.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States and not require employer sponsorship now or in the future.

Required Skills

  • Python – Advanced proficiency in writing clean, efficient, and scalable code.

  • Pydantic – Strong experience in data validation, serialization, and structured model definition.

  • LLM Evaluation – Ability to assess model performance, optimize outputs, and fine-tune AI behavior.

  • Prompt Optimization – Expertise in crafting, refining, and iterating prompts for optimal AI performance.

  • SQLAlchemy – Hands-on experience with database modeling, ORM techniques, and performance tuning.

  • FastAPI – Proven ability to develop and maintain APIs with FastAPI for AI-driven applications.

Nice to Have Experience

  • Experience with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS) for efficient AI retrieval.

  • Familiarity with Docker & Kubernetes for containerized AI application deployment.

  • Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) for scaling AI infrastructure.

  • Understanding of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) techniques.

  • Background in MLOps practices for automating AI model deployment and monitoring.

Why Join Epistemix?

By joining Epistemix, you will become part of a collaborative and rapidly growing team that values curiosity and creativity. We are fully remote, with team members in the United States and Europe. Benefits include:

  • Equity & Incentives – Participation in our stock option program.

  • Meaningful Impact – Apply your creative talents to revolutionize data-driven decision-making and make a real-world difference.

jobs.title: Synthetic Population Engineer
jobs.excerpt: The Synthetic Population Engineer uses cutting edge data science techniques to continuously improve the Epistemix synthetic population.
jobs.description:
The Synthetic Population Engineer uses cutting edge data science techniques to continuously improve the Epistemix synthetic population. A synthetic population is a statistically representative model of a population of real people and their environment, including personal attributes, social connections, and associations between people and places. These datasets empower customers to solve problems in domains where empirical data is unavailable due to legitimate concerns for personal privacy or where desired data simply does not exist. The Synthetic Population Engineer contributes to profitable growth by making the synthetic population more useful and accessible to customers, increasing adoption and utilization. Having a synthetic population that is continuously updated and improved over time is critical to building trust in the models and solutions built with our platform.

About Epistemix

The most consequential decisions in public health, life sciences, insurance, and enterprise strategy share a common problem: they involve human behavior, network effects, and downstream effects that cannot be safely tested before action is taken. Traditional analytical techniques built on historical data were not built for this. Epistemix was.

We build simulation and data-driven modeling tools that let leaders visualize how strategies will unfold across populations and systems before they commit resources. By clarifying which variables drive outcomes, where leverage exists, and how they interact, we help organizations move from uncertainty to conviction. Getting these decisions right means faster interventions, better-allocated resources, and measurable improvements in human and economic outcomes. We exist to make that possible.

Our platform gives organizations access to realistic, high-resolution population data and the modeling infrastructure to run scenario planning at scale. Together, these capabilities let decision-makers stress-test strategies in a controlled environment before deploying them in the real world across healthcare, consumer industries, insurance, and government. We are approaching our Series B and actively building the team that will define what comes next.

Responsibilities

  • Identify and evaluate empirical datasets and use them to enrich the synthetic population to enable new use cases, including through adding new individual attributes and detailed social networks.

  • Utilize simulation techniques, including ABMs, to project future demographic trends.

  • Improve the geographical plausibility of synthetic environments, ensuring realistic placement of homes, workplaces, schools, and other points of interest (e.g., along roads, close to real world population centers).

  • Expand the geographical region covered by the Epistemix synthetic population, with the goal of creating a fully integrated and consistent representation of the global population.

  • Create visualizations for marketing and productizing synthetic populations.

  • Develop innovative methods for supporting external users in augmenting Epistemix synthetic populations with their own proprietary data.

  • Work with external vendors and marketplaces to expand the ecosystem of data providers that can be integrated with the synthetic population.

  • Support the synthetic populations team in engaging with customer success, professional services, and engineering teams to understand project specific synthetic population requirements.

Qualifications

  • Proficient experience in:

    • Using Python for data science applications.

    • Working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL (additional database management experience preferred).

    • Working with geospatial data.

    • Working with simulation or machine learning models.

  • Demonstrate empathy for users and decision makers by explaining how the synthetic population was created (e.g., which data sources and models were used) in an accessible way for all.

  • Possessing the passion to build the standard for synthetic populations globally to improve decision making across social, health, economic, and environmental policies and advancing data science into more commercial applications.

  • A PhD or master’s degree in Data Science or a relevant technical discipline such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Epidemiology, or Public Health.

  • Proven track record of success building data products and/or data marketplaces.

  • Having a startup mentality with understanding the risks and the ability to flex across needs of an evolving team in a fast-paced environment.

Why Join Epistemix?

By joining Epistemix, you will become part of a collaborative and rapidly growing team that values curiosity and creativity. We are fully remote, with team members in the United States and Europe. Benefits include:

  • Equity & Incentives – Participation in our stock option program.

  • Flexible Time Off – Autonomy to manage your schedule and work-life balance.

  • Health, Welfare and 401(k) Programs – Eligibility for benefits (for U.S. employees).

  • Meaningful Impact – Apply your creative talents to revolutionize data-driven decision-making and make a real-world difference.

This is a remote position open to applicants globally with a strong interest in US and Europe based candidates . Candidates must possess the legal right to work in their intended work location, as we are currently unable to sponsor or transfer employment visas for any country, including the United States.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Officer, Marketing & Events (EN-7)

Organizational Unit: Communications

Reports To: Chief Communications Officer

Supervises: This position does not supervise staff.

Location: Equality Now is a remote organization. This position may be based in Poland, Ireland, Moldova, Brazil.

MISSION OBJECTIVE:

To expand Equality Now's reach and strengthen relationships with priority audiences through effective marketing, events and external engagement. Working across Communications, Development and Advocacy, the role helps translate organisational priorities into compelling audience experiences and clear pathways for involvement that support advocacy, fundraising and long-term engagement.

PORTFOLIO OVERVIEW:

Officer, Marketing & Events sits within Equality Now's worldwide Communications Team. The portfolio covers major events and convenings, including the annual Gala; multi-channel marketing and audience acquisition; ambassador and talent stewardship; corporate, cultural and professional partnerships; and the promotion of strategic campaigns, products and knowledge.

The role also maintains audience and event data, supports CRM-based follow-up and cross-team hand-offs, and uses engagement data to improve future activity. It has a particular focus on growing and diversifying Equality Now's audiences, including the new and 'unusual suspect' audiences identified in the organisational strategy.

MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Purpose: Coordinates Connected Workflows

Marketing campaigns

  • Deliver marketing activity that supports the acquisition and deeper engagement of priority audiences, including Equality Now's Professionals Network, prospective funders, corporate audiences, senior decision-makers and other high-value supporters agreed with Development and Advocacy colleagues.
  • Help grow Equality Now's total addressable audience by identifying practical ways to reach people beyond our existing supporter base, particularly the 'unusual suspect' audiences prioritised in the organisational strategy across paid advertising, social acquisition, email, events, partnerships, external platforms and other appropriate channels, working within agreed campaign objectives, audiences and budgets.
  • Support the marketing and audience development of the Equal Justice Academy, working with relevant programme, Digital and Communications colleagues to increase awareness, participation and ongoing use.
  • Work with Digital, Advocacy Communications and Production colleagues to ensure Equality Now's knowledge products are packaged, promoted and distributed to the audiences most likely to use, share or act on them.
  • Help connect launches, knowledge products, events, partnerships and campaigns into coherent audience journeys rather than one-off moments, ensuring there is a clear next action for priority audiences.

Audience Data and Relationship Management

  • Maintain accurate and useful audience, stakeholder, ambassador and event data in Equality Now's CRM and agreed planning systems, ensuring records are current, appropriately segmented and usable across teams.
  • Build a practical understanding of who is in Equality Now's audience database, how different groups are engaging, where there are gaps and which contacts may be ready for deeper Development, Advocacy, partnership or ambassador engagement.
  • Work closely with Development, Advocacy and Communications colleagues to clarify relationship ownership, audience segments and appropriate outreach pathways so teams understand which contacts sit within their portfolios and where cross-team opportunities exist.
  • Ensure new contacts generated through events, campaigns, partnerships and external engagement are captured promptly and routed into appropriate supporter or stakeholder journeys.

Monitoring, Learning and Data Management

  • Maintain agreed KPI trackers and compile regular reporting on event attendance, audience acquisition, engagement, conversion, relationship progression, campaign performance and other agreed indicators.
  • Use campaign, event and CRM data to identify clear patterns, gaps and practical opportunities to improve targeting, follow-up, audience journeys and future activity.
  • Gather qualitative feedback from events, partners, ambassadors and priority audiences and feed useful learning into future planning.
  • Support good data-management and data-protection practice and ensure stakeholder, participant and talent information is handled appropriately.

Engagement: Align

Content creation

  • Produce and coordinate campaign materials including invitations, landing-page copy, email communications, presentations, partner materials, promotional assets and briefing information, working with Digital and Production colleagues to maintain brand and messaging quality.

Ambassadors and Talent

  • Work with Advocacy, Development, Executive Office, regional teams and other colleagues to identify ambassadors and external voices aligned to Equality Now's focus areas, geographies and wider organisational priorities.
  • Provide day-to-day coordination of Equality Now's ambassador and talent programme, maintaining accurate lists, relationship histories, interests, availability and previous engagement so that suitable people can be identified quickly for events, campaigns, speaking opportunities and advocacy moments.
  • Act as a consistent relationship point for agreed ambassadors and talent, coordinating communications, opportunities, briefings and follow-up and helping create clear pathways for people to deepen or broaden their involvement with Equality Now.

Strategic Partnerships

  • Research and coordinate agreed corporate brand, cultural and organisational partnership opportunities that can expand Equality Now's audience, strengthen campaigns or create new routes into high-value supporter and stakeholder groups.
  • Prepare concise background information, partnership materials and activation plans for review by the relevant manager, with strategic negotiation, major commitments and high-risk decisions retained by senior colleagues.

Delivery: Sustain Service

Events and Convenings

  • Coordinate the practical planning and delivery of Equality Now events, including the annual Gala and other in-person, virtual and hybrid events that support advocacy, fundraising, audience engagement and brand development.
  • Coordinate event logistics including venues, production suppliers, speakers and talent, invitations, briefing materials, run-of-show documents, travel and accommodation requirements, event communications and on-the-day delivery.
  • Support PR and promotional activity around the Gala and other events or campaigns where earned media can extend reach, coordinating with Media colleagues on assets, talent information, schedules and follow-up.
  • Project-manage assigned events from planning through delivery and follow-up, maintaining project plans, critical paths, task trackers, schedules and clear ownership so that colleagues and suppliers meet agreed deadlines. Inclusive of event administration including supplier liaison, contracts, purchase and payment processes, invoices, budgets, approvals, guest and speaker information, registration and other event records, escalating material risks or changes to the relevant manager.
  • Work across Communications, Development, Advocacy and relevant regional or focus-area teams to ensure each event has clear objectives, audiences, messaging, follow-up and relationship outcomes.

Event Marketing, External Moments and Follow-up

  • Coordinate event marketing across email, social, digital, paid and partner channels, working closely with Digital, Production, Media and other colleagues to maximise attendance, reach and post-event engagement.
  • Support Equality Now's presence at external convenings and high-value moments by coordinating materials, schedules, speaking opportunities, relationship follow-up and opportunities to extend the organisation's visibility.
  • Maintain an organisation-wide calendar of priority events and convenings, identifying moments where Equality Now can bring together priority audiences through repeatable, human-centred event formats and experiences.
  • Capture attendee, engagement and follow-up data after events and ensure agreed actions, new contacts and relationship opportunities are recorded and routed to the appropriate internal owner.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS & TARGET SKILLS PROFILE:

Substantive Knowledge

  • Working knowledge of integrated marketing communications, audience acquisition, event delivery and relationship-based engagement, gained through relevant practical experience.
  • Understanding of how events, marketing, partnerships and ambassador activity can support organisational reputation, advocacy, audience growth and fundraising.
  • Working understanding of audience segmentation, supporter journeys, CRM data and how communications activity can move people from awareness to deeper engagement.
  • Awareness of good practice in brand marketing, digital acquisition, partnerships, event promotion and stakeholder engagement.
  • An interest in social justice, human rights and Equality Now's mission, strategy and operating environment.

Communication Skills

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear audience-facing copy, event communications, campaign materials and concise stakeholder information.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and confidence building professional relationships with speakers, talent, ambassadors, partners, suppliers, donors and other external stakeholders.
  • Ability to adapt communications for different audiences while working within agreed messaging, brand and reputational guidance.
  • Tact and cultural awareness when working across countries, cultures and professional contexts.

Execution Skills

  • Strong event and project-management skills, with the ability to maintain plans, task trackers, deadlines, budgets, contracts, invoices and multiple workstreams simultaneously.
  • Experience coordinating in-person, virtual and/or hybrid events and working with venues, production partners, suppliers, speakers or talent.
  • Ability to deliver multi-channel marketing and audience-acquisition activity within agreed plans, processes and budgets.
  • Ability to coordinate cross-functional activity, keep colleagues and suppliers on track, identify delivery risks and escalate decisions outside agreed parameters.
  • Strong attention to detail and confidence maintaining accurate relationship, campaign and event records.
  • Ability to collect, organise and interpret routine marketing, CRM and event-performance data and identify clear trends or follow-up actions.
  • Ability to work flexibly when events or global time zones require work outside standard hours.

Targeted Specialised Knowledge

  • Experience using CRM, email marketing, audience-management or event-management systems.
  • Experience supporting paid, social, email or partnership-based audience acquisition campaigns.
  • Experience creating or coordinating content and assets for email, website, social media, events and partner channels.
  • Experience working with ambassadors, talent, creators, speakers, corporate partners or other external relationship groups is desirable.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Google Workspace, Canva and online event/webinar platforms.
  • Knowledge of data protection and good practice in managing stakeholder and supporter information.
  • Experience working in an international, charitable, campaigning or mission-led organisation is desirable.

CONSULTANCY FEE RANGE (Annual, Gross): USD $27,000 - $34,074.
The final consultancy fee within this range will be determined based on factors including geographic location, relevant experience, demonstrated skills, qualifications, and the agreed scope and duration of services.

Consultant fees are set with consideration for the scope of work, level of expertise, and market benchmarks, and are intended to reflect the independent and professional nature of consultancy engagements.

HOW TO APPLY

Please visit: and submit a resume/CV and cover letter. The applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the application period closes at
11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on November 13, 2026.

Due to the volume of applicants anticipated for this role, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.

Equality Now is strong because it is diverse. We actively seek a diverse applicant pool and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Equality Now offers a competitive compensation package, including base salary, savings, health and vacation benefits, and is an Equal Opportunity employer. Equality Now employees are selected on the basis of ability without regard to race, colour, religious beliefs, sex, gender identity and expression, language, political or other opinion, nationality, ethnic or social origin, disability, pregnancy, mental status, HIV status, age, marital status, or sexual orientation.

We welcome all kinds of diversity. Candidates are selected on the basis of ability, in accordance with all country and location-specific laws.

Salary: $27,000 - $34,074

Job Summary:

Mercer Advisors has served nonprofit organizations since our founding in 1985, and our Endowments & Foundations practice today serves 225+ nonprofit clients across the country.

Strategic Support & Business Planning
