jobs.title: Development Manager - Product Teams
jobs.excerpt: As Development Manager, you will lead one or two fully remote, cross-functional software development teams responsible for building and evolving OrbusInfinity, our flagship enterprise SaaS product.
jobs.description:
As Development Manager, you will lead one or two fully remote, cross-functional software development teams responsible for building and evolving OrbusInfinity, our flagship enterprise SaaS product. You will provide clear people leadership and delivery accountability, helping the teams focus on the work that matters most for our customers and the product.

This is a hands-off leadership role: Technical Leads within the teams will own day-to-day technical decisions and help maintain technical standards and best practices. Your focus will be on coaching, guiding and enabling the teams to succeed.

You will help the teams turn product goals into well-designed, maintainable software and deliver value to customers. You will work closely with Product and Engineering colleagues to create an environment of shared ownership, effective collaboration and continuous improvement.

Your focus will be on ensuring that the teams operate within clear, effective delivery processes. You will ensure responsibilities are understood, agreed workflows are followed and engineering best practices are applied consistently, working with Technical Leads, Product Managers and other relevant roles to address process gaps and improve ways of working. Day-to-day backlog and delivery management will remain with the appropriate roles.

You will be a strategic, people-first leader who earns the respect of skilled engineers not by doing their job, but by enabling them to do it brilliantly. This role is suited to an experienced Development Manager with several years of experience leading software development teams. You will bring previous hands-on experience as a software engineer or in another technical engineering role, together with enough technical understanding to ask the right questions, support sound decisions and lead the teams effectively. You will not be expected to be the hands-on technical owner.

You will lead between 6 and 12 direct reports and work closely with Product, Engineering and senior technical leadership. The role is fully remote, based in Poland, with quarterly (max) in-person events bringing together teams from across all regions. You will be employed on a permanent contract (umowa o pracę) with our Polish entity.

Our engineering environment

OrbusInfinity runs natively in Microsoft Azure. Our technology landscape includes modern C#/.NET, React, TypeScript, Cosmos DB, SQL, containers and Kubernetes, with a micro-frontend and microservice architecture deployed continuously to highly available, multi-region infrastructure.

We use Scrum for day-to-day development. Our engineering practices include automated CI/CD, shift-left testing and a focus on maintainable, high-quality code. Dedicated teams support build and release processes through Azure DevOps, Git and Azure.

Why this role matters

Your leadership will help one or two product development teams focus on the work that matters most, while enabling the wider engineering organisation to deliver and evolve OrbusInfinity with greater confidence.

What You Will Do

Lead and develop the teams

  • Lead, coach and develop one or two software development teams, supporting performance, engagement and career development.
  • Set clear expectations and support the growth of experienced technical professionals.
  • Hold regular one-to-ones and ensure direct reports have meaningful development plans.
  • Lead performance reviews, provide regular feedback and support career development for direct reports.
  • Lead hiring, onboarding and team capability development as required.
  • Create an environment in which technical professionals can work with appropriate autonomy and accountability.

Enable effective planning and delivery

  • Support clear prioritisation and roadmap planning by ensuring the relevant roles are aligned on outcomes, dependencies and responsibilities.
  • Help translate strategic goals into clear priorities, outcomes and delivery expectations.
  • Ensure the appropriate roles maintain visibility of commitments, progress, risks and dependencies.
  • Help identify organisational blockers and escalate issues when decisions or support are needed.
  • Ensure cross-team dependencies and delivery risks have clear owners and are addressed early.
  • Work closely with Product Managers, Development Managers and senior Engineering leaders to coordinate priorities.
  • Ensure agreed delivery processes are understood and followed throughout the software development lifecycle, from planning and design through delivery and continuous improvement.
  • Work with Product Managers to understand roadmap goals, identify the technical runway needed to support them and make dependencies visible.

Contribute to strategy and continuous improvement

  • Contribute to Product and Technology strategy, department-level initiatives and improvements to engineering standards.
  • Use team health, delivery and quality metrics to identify improvement opportunities and track progress.
  • Support changes to team shape, responsibilities and ways of working as the organisation evolves.

Support technical excellence and reliability

  • Provide thoughtful challenge on technical proposals, trade-offs and delivery approaches.
  • Support the connection between technical decisions, product goals and wider engineering needs.
  • Support consistent engineering standards, quality and technical decision-making.
  • Encourage attention to maintainability, reliability and continuous improvement.

Enable effective engineering delivery

  • Help the teams build, test, release and operate software effectively, working with relevant technical specialists where needed.
  • Support practical ways of working, tooling and collaboration that help engineers deliver with confidence.
  • Promote engineering quality, reliability and a culture of continuous improvement.
  • Ensure delivery and operational risks are visible, have clear owners and are followed through to completion.
  • Foster shared ownership and continuous delivery excellence across the Engineering department.

Work across Engineering

  • Represent the teams in relevant product and engineering forums.
  • Support knowledge-sharing and collaboration across teams.
  • Contribute to improvements in engineering standards, processes and ways of working.
  • Build trusted relationships with Product, Engineering and senior technical stakeholders.
  • Connect people across teams and departments to find the best path to success.
  • Work closely with Technical Leads, Product Managers, other Development Managers and relevant technical specialists to resolve blockers, manage dependencies and improve ways of working.

What You Will Bring

Essential

  • Several years’ experience as a Development Manager or equivalent, leading software development teams.
  • Experience leading, coaching and developing software engineers.
  • Experience working with cross-functional, agile teams and guiding delivery through the full software development lifecycle.
  • Previous hands-on experience as a software engineer or in another technical engineering role.
  • Experience working with our technology stack or a closely related one, including modern C#/.NET, React, TypeScript and cloud-native technologies.
  • Good understanding of software development practices, technical delivery and engineering quality.
  • Experience owning or managing priorities, roadmaps, dependencies and delivery risks.\
  • The ability to work effectively with technical specialists and support teams in making sound engineering decisions.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex issues clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working with distributed or international teams.
  • Fluency in English, as the working language of the team and wider organisation.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with cloud, CI/CD or modern software delivery practices.
  • Experience working in a SaaS product company.
  • Experience partnering with Product Managers on roadmap planning and technical runway.
  • Experience leading or coordinating work across multiple software development teams.
  • Experience with multi-regional or high-availability infrastructure.
  • Experience with production incident management and operational improvement.
  • Experience hiring and building software development teams.
  • Experience contributing to technical strategy, architecture, reliability or production operations.\
  • Experience working with agile delivery methods such as Scrum or Kanban.

A note on experience

We are interested in the capabilities that will help you succeed, not a perfect match with every tool or background listed above. Strong people leadership, delivery judgement and a solid technical foundation matter most. Specific product, cloud and engineering practices can be learned where the underlying judgement and curiosity are present.

Role Summary

As a Talent Acquisition Specialist, you’ll help grow Revamp’s high-performing, mission-driven team. You’ll manage full-cycle recruiting for technical and non-technical positions, with a strong focus on engineering and renewable energy disciplines, and partner closely with hiring managers to deliver a collaborative, relationship-driven recruiting experience. Success in this role calls for a proactive sourcing mindset, strong business acumen, and the ability to identify and engage top talent for highly specialized technical roles in competitive markets. You’ll represent Revamp’s values of Impact, Collaboration, Trust, and Equity at each stage of hiring, giving candidates an inclusive and exceptional experience while helping Revamp advance its mission in the energy transition. Candidates may be considered at either the Specialist II or Specialist III level depending on experience, technical depth, independence, and demonstrated ability to lead scope.

Duties & Responsibilities

Across both levels, this role may include:

Core Technical & Functional Responsibilities

  • Manage full-cycle recruiting for technical and non-technical roles, including job scoping, sourcing, screening, interviewing, and offer negotiation.
  • Partner with hiring managers to develop recruiting strategies aligned with departmental goals and company needs.
  • Manage requisitions across multiple engineering disciplines, including civil, electrical, structural, Power Systems, EPC, and related fields.
  • Source and engage passive candidates for highly specific technical positions using Boolean logic, LinkedIn Recruiter, and other sourcing tools.
  • Conduct candidate screens to evaluate technical qualifications, experience, and alignment with Revamp’s core values of Impact, Collaboration, Trust, and Equity.
  • Track and report recruiting metrics such as time-to-fill, pipeline health, and source effectiveness.
  • Support new hire onboarding, including coordinating equipment shipments, in-person orientation events, new hire core content training, and the scheduling of 90-day new hire reviews.

Quality, Standards & Compliance

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date candidate records within the applicant tracking system (BreezyHR).
  • Apply equal employment opportunity (EEO) laws and merit-based hiring standards consistently across sourcing, screening, and selection.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Build strong relationships with hiring managers and serve as a trusted advisor throughout the recruitment process.
  • Partner with HR leadership to enhance employer branding, interview best practices, and hiring initiatives.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of recruiting processes and candidate experience.

Additional Expectations at the Specialist III Level

  • Own the most complex and hard-to-fill technical requisitions independently, seeking guidance only on unusual cases.
  • Advise hiring managers on talent market conditions and sourcing strategy for their teams.
  • Mentor junior recruiting and coordination staff and review their screening work.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Perform essential duties including meeting deliverables and deadlines.
  • Perform additional related duties as assigned or directed.

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or similar applicable work experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in a full-cycle recruiting role (corporate or agency); Specialist III candidates typically bring 5+ years.
  • Demonstrated experience sourcing for hard-to-fill roles using creative and data-driven strategies.
  • Working knowledge of Boolean search logic and modern sourcing tools.
  • Proven ability to develop strong, trust-based relationships with hiring managers and prospective talent.
  • Familiarity with applicant tracking systems (ATS) and HRIS platforms.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple requisitions at once while staying detail-oriented, data-driven, and committed to operational excellence.
  • Demonstrated experience incorporating principles of diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging into outreach and candidate experience while maintaining strict adherence to all applicable EEO laws and merit-based hiring standards.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience recruiting for technical positions in engineering, construction, EPC, utilities, or architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC) environments.
  • Prior exposure to the renewable energy or utility power industry.
  • Certification in employment and labor law and recruiting best practices, such as SHRM-CP, CSP, or aPHR.

Benefits for Full-Time Positions

  • Participation in Revamp’s Employee Ownership ESOP program.
  • Competitive compensation with bonus.
  • Full benefits package offerings including 99% employer-paid health, vision, life, and dental insurance.
  • Medical, dependent care, and commuter FSA.
  • Monthly health and wellness stipend.
  • Attractive vacation, sick, and holiday pay.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • 401(k) savings plan with 100% match up to 6%, vested immediately.
  • Paid volunteer time off and charitable donation matching.

About Revamp

Founded in 2016, Revamp is the premier employee-owned engineering design firm dedicated to advancing large-scale renewable energy projects. Our team is united by a shared commitment to accelerating the global energy transition and creating a workplace where talented people can make a tangible impact in the fight against climate change.

As employee-owners, we take pride in building a culture of collaboration, innovation, and accountability where every individual’s contribution drives both company success and personal growth. Revamp engineers have supported the design of more than 10% of the utility-scale solar generation capacity in the US since 2020, contributing directly to the renewable energy transformation.

So much more than just an engineering firm; we are a diverse, international team of artists, singers, dancers, pastry chefs, outdoor enthusiasts, animal lovers, travelers and problem-solvers who bring curiosity and creativity to everything we do. For more information, visit www.revamp‑eng.com.

Any such checks will be conducted in compliance with all legal requirements, including providing notice, obtaining consent where required, and allowing candidates to access and correct personal information as permitted by law.

Revamp Engineering Inc. is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. We value diversity and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Revamp Engineering Inc. is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you require an accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us.

jobs.excerpt: Position SummaryFòs Feminista is inviting applications for new members of its Board of Directors and standing committees.
jobs.description:
Position Summary

Fòs Feminista is inviting applications for new members of its Board of Directors and standing committees. For the 2026 elections, we seek candidates whose experience and perspectives will complement the current Board and committees, in particular with financial and investment expertise and audit, risk, and governance experience. We encourage applications from feminist leaders under 25 at the time of election who have a record of leadership in youth-led movements, digital participation, or community organizing, especially in the Global South.

Opportunities in 2026

Board Directors

Fòs Feminista is governed by an 11-member Board of Directors. Board Directors guide strategy and share responsibility for the Alliance's governance and financial health. Board Directors attend three meetings each year, and each Director serves on at least one standing committee. All Board Directors carry the legal duties of care, loyalty, and obedience to mission; disclose potential conflicts of interest annually; and uphold Fòs Feminista’s safeguarding policy.

The term is for three years, renewable for up to two additional consecutive terms. Board service is unpaid. Fòs Feminista arranges, covers, or reimburses eligible travel expenses for organizational and governance work.

Standing Committee Members

The Board's work is supported by six standing committees: Advocacy; Audit and Risk Intelligence; Finance and Investment; Governance; Partnerships and Performance; and Resource Mobilization.

What We Are Seeking in 2026

To complement the experience already represented on the Board and its committees, we are prioritizing candidates with one or more of the following:

  • Youth leadership. Rights-based leaders under 25 at the time of election, with substantive experience in youth-led movements, digital advocacy, and community or health organizing, particularly in the Global South.
  • Finance and investment. Experience in financial leadership, gender-lens investing, innovative financing, or women's economic empowerment.
  • Strategic communications and external relations.
  • Movement and civil society leadership. Deep roots in civil society networks, feminist organizations, or social movements, particularly in Latin America and the Caribbean and across the Global South.
  • Governance. Board or senior leadership experience, particularly in Global South organizations.

What All Candidates Should Bring

  • Commitment to SRHRJ, and the ability to communicate about this work.
  • Understanding of the changing political, economic, and global public health landscape.
  • A horizontal approach to leadership, including a willingness to share and build collective power, interrogate established practices, and enable innovation.
  • Integrity, equanimity, active listening, confidence in taking risks, and the ability to build consensus across differences.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work across cultures and institutional contexts.
  • The ability to connect Fòs Feminista with new partners, funders, and other social justice movements.

How to Apply: Please submit your Curriculum Vitae and a cover letter (one page) here by October 12, 2026. Please state clearly whether you are applying for the Board, a standing committee, or both. Applications are accepted in English, Spanish, French, and Portuguese.
The Governance Committee will contact shortlisted candidates to arrange interviews in late October and early November.

Resumen de la Posición

Fòs Feminista invita a presentar candidaturas para integrar su Junta Directiva y sus seis comités permanentes. Para las elecciones de 2026, buscamos candidaturas cuyas experiencias y perspectivas complementen a la Junta Directiva y a los comités actuales, en particular con experiencia en finanzas e inversión, así como en auditoría, riesgos y gobernanza. Exhortamos a que se postulen líderes y lideresas feministas menores de 25 años al momento de la elección, que cuenten con una trayectoria de liderazgo en movimientos dirigidos por juventudes, participación digital u organización comunitaria, especialmente en el Sur Global.

Oportunidades en 2026

Integrantes de la Junta Directiva

Fòs Feminista está dirigida por una Junta Directiva de 11 integrantes. Las personas que integran la Junta Directiva orientan la estrategia y comparten la responsabilidad de la gobernanza y la solidez financiera de la Alianza. Las personas que integran la Junta Directiva asisten a tres reuniones al año y cada integrante forma parte de al menos un comité permanente. Todas las personas que integran la Junta Directiva asumen los deberes legales de diligencia, lealtad y obediencia a la misión; declaran anualmente los posibles conflictos de interés; y cumplen la política de protección de Fòs Feminista.

El mandato es de tres años, renovable por hasta dos mandatos consecutivos adicionales. El servicio en la Junta Directiva no es remunerado. Fòs Feminista gestiona, cubre o reembolsa los gastos de viaje elegibles vinculados al trabajo organizacional y de gobernanza.

Integrantes de los comités permanentes

El trabajo de la Junta Directiva se apoya en seis comités permanentes: Incidencia; Auditoría e Inteligencia de Riesgos; Finanzas e Inversión; Gobernanza; Alianzas y Desempeño; y Movilización de Recursos.

Lo que buscamos en 2026

Para complementar la experiencia ya representada en la Junta Directiva y sus comités, priorizamos candidaturas que reúnan una o más de las siguientes características:

  • Liderazgo juvenil. Líderes y lideresas que defiendan los derechos, menores de 25 años al momento de la elección, con experiencia sustantiva en movimientos liderados por jóvenes, defensa digital y organización comunitaria o de salud, particularmente en el Sur Global.
  • Finanzas e inversión. Experiencia en liderazgo financiero, inversión con perspectiva de género, financiamiento innovador o autonomía económica de las mujeres.
  • Comunicación estratégica y relaciones externas.
  • Liderazgo en movimientos y sociedad civil. Raíces profundas en redes de la sociedad civil, organizaciones feministas o movimientos sociales, en particular en América Latina y el Caribe y en todo el Sur Global.
  • Gobernanza. Experiencia en juntas directivas o en liderazgo de alto nivel, en particular en organizaciones del Sur Global

Lo que toda candidatura debe aportar

  • Compromiso con la SDJR y la capacidad de comunicar sobre este trabajo.
  • Comprensión del cambiante panorama político, económico y de salud pública mundial.
  • Un enfoque horizontal de liderazgo que incluya la disposición a compartir y construir poder colectivo, cuestionar las prácticas establecidas y facilitar la innovación.
  • Integridad, ecuanimidad, escucha activa, confianza para asumir riesgos y capacidad de generar consenso a pesar de las diferencias.
  • Sólidas habilidades de comunicación y la capacidad de trabajar en entornos interculturales e institucionales diversos.
  • Capacidad de conectar a Fòs Feminista con nuevas organizaciones socias, financiadoras y otros movimientos de justicia social.

Cómo postularse: Para postularte, favor preparar tu Curriculum Vitae y una carta introductoria (de una página) a ser enviados por aquí antes del 12 de octubre de 2026, Indique claramente si se postula a la Junta Directiva, a un comité permanente o a ambos. Se aceptan postulaciones en inglés, español, francés y portugués. El Comité de Gobernanza se comunicará con las personas candidatas preseleccionadas para programar entrevistas a finales de octubre y principios de noviembre.

Resumo do cargo

A Fòs Feminista convida à apresentação de candidaturas para novas pessoas integrantes de seu Conselho Diretor e de seus seis comitês permanentes. Para as eleições de 2026, buscamos candidaturas cuja experiência e perspectivas complementem o Conselho e os comitês atuais, em especial com experiência em finanças e investimento e em auditoria, riscos e governança. Incentivamos candidaturas de lideranças feministas com menos de 25 anos na data da eleição que tenham trajetória de liderança em movimentos juvenis, participação digital ou organização comunitária, especialmente no Sul Global.

Oportunidades em 2026

Integrantes do Conselho Diretor

A Fòs Feminista é governada por um Conselho Diretor composto por 11 integrantes. As pessoas que integram o Conselho orientam a estratégia e compartilham a responsabilidade pela governança e pela saúde financeira da Aliança. As pessoas que integram o Conselho participam de três reuniões por ano, e cada integrante atua em pelo menos um comitê permanente. Todas as pessoas que integram o Conselho assumem os deveres legais de diligência, lealdade e fidelidade à missão; declaram anualmente potenciais conflitos de interesse; e cumprem a política de salvaguarda da Fòs Feminista.

O mandato tem duração de três anos, renovável por até dois mandatos consecutivos adicionais. O cargo no Conselho Administrativo não é remunerado. A Fòs Feminista administra, arca com ou reembolsa as despesas de viagem elegíveis relacionadas ao trabalho organizacional e de governança.

Integrantes dos comitês permanentes

O trabalho do Conselho é apoiado por seis comitês permanentes: Incidência Política; Auditoria e Inteligência de Riscos; Finanças e Investimento; Governança; Parcerias e Desempenho; e Mobilização de Recursos.

O que buscamos em 2026

Para complementar a experiência já representada no Conselho e em seus comitês, priorizamos candidaturas que reúnam um ou mais dos seguintes elementos:

  • Liderança juvenil. Lideranças com enfoque de direitos, com menos de 25 anos na data da eleição, com experiência substantiva em movimentos juvenis, incidência digital e organização comunitária ou em saúde, especialmente no Sul Global.
  • Finanças e investimento. Experiência em liderança financeira, investimento com perspectiva de gênero, financiamento inovador ou autonomia econômica das mulheres.
  • Comunicação estratégica e relações externas.
  • Liderança em movimentos e na sociedade civil. Raízes profundas em redes da sociedade civil, organizações feministas ou movimentos sociais, especialmente na América Latina e no Caribe e em todo o Sul Global.
  • Governança. Experiência em conselhos ou em liderança sênior, especialmente em organizações do Sul Global.

O que toda candidatura deve trazer

  • Compromisso com a SDJSR, e capacidade de comunicar sobre esse trabalho.
  • Compreensão do cenário político, econômico e de saúde pública global em transformação.
  • Uma abordagem horizontal da liderança, incluindo a disposição de compartilhar e construir poder coletivo, questionar práticas estabelecidas e viabilizar a inovação.
  • Integridade, equanimidade, escuta ativa, confiança para assumir riscos e capacidade de construir consensos entre diferenças.
  • Sólidas habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar entre culturas e contextos institucionais.
  • Capacidade de conectar a Fòs Feminista a novas organizações parceiras, financiadoras e outros movimentos de justiça social.

Como se inscrever: Para se candidatar a essa posição, por favor nos envie seu Curriculum Vitae e uma carta de apresentação (de uma página). Ambos os arquivos devem ser enviados até 12 de outubro de 2026. Indique claramente se está se candidatando ao Conselho, a um comitê permanente ou a ambos. As candidaturas são aceitas em inglês, espanhol, francês e português. O Comitê de Governança entrará em contato com as candidaturas pré-selecionadas para agendar entrevistas no fim de outubro e início de novembro.

Résumé du poste

Fòs Feminista lance un appel à candidatures pour de nouveaux membres de son Conseil d’administration et de ses six comités permanents. Pour les élections de 2026, nous recherchons des candidatures dont l’expérience et les perspectives viendront compléter celles du Conseil et des comités actuels, en particulier une expertise en finance et en investissement ainsi qu’une expérience en audit, en gestion des risques et en gouvernance. Nous encourageons les candidatures de leaders féministes de moins de 25 ans au moment de l’élection, justifiant d’un parcours de leadership au sein de mouvements de jeunes, de la participation numérique ou de l’organisation communautaire, en particulier dans le Sud global.

Opportunités en 2026

Membres du Conseil d’administration

Fòs Feminista est administrée par un Conseil d’Administration de 11 membres. Les membres du Conseil orientent la stratégie et partagent la responsabilité de la gouvernance et de la santé financière de l’Alliance. Les membres du Conseil participent à trois réunions par an et chaque membre siège à au moins un comité permanent. Tous les membres du Conseil assument les devoirs juridiques de diligence, de loyauté et de fidélité à la mission ; déclarent chaque année les conflits d’intérêts potentiels ; et respectent la politique de sauvegarde de Fòs Feminista.

Le mandat est de trois ans, renouvelable pour deux mandats consécutifs supplémentaires au maximum. Les fonctions au sein du conseil d'administration ne sont pas rémunérées. Fòs Feminista prend en charge, couvre ou rembourse les frais de déplacement éligibles liés au travail organisationnel et à la gouvernance.

Membres des comités permanents

Le travail du Conseil est appuyé par six comités permanents : Plaidoyer ; Audit et intelligence des risques ; Finance et investissement ; Gouvernance ; Partenariats et performance ; et Mobilisation des ressources.

Ce que nous recherchons en 2026

Afin de compléter l’expérience déjà représentée au sein du Conseil et de ses comités, nous privilégions les candidatures réunissant un ou plusieurs des éléments suivants :

  • Leadership des jeunes. Leaders de moins de 25 ans au moment de l’élection, fondant leur action sur les droits et disposant d’une expérience substantielle au sein de mouvements de jeunes, du plaidoyer numérique et de l’organisation communautaire ou en santé, en particulier dans le Sud global.
  • Finance et investissement. Expérience en direction financière, en investissement selon une perspective de genre, en financement innovant ou en autonomie économique des femmes.
  • Communication stratégique et relations extérieures.
  • Leadership au sein des mouvements et de la société civile. Ancrage profond dans les réseaux de la société civile, les organisations féministes ou les mouvements sociaux, en particulier en Amérique latine et dans les Caraïbes ainsi que dans l’ensemble du Sud global.
  • Gouvernance. Expérience au sein d’un conseil d’administration ou à un poste de direction, en particulier dans des organisations du Sud global.

Ce que toute candidature doit apporter

  • Un engagement en faveur de la SDJSR et de la capacité de communiquer sur ce travail.
  • Une compréhension de l’évolution du paysage politique, économique et de la santé publique mondiale.
  • Une approche horizontale du leadership, incluant la volonté de partager et de construire un pouvoir collectif, de questionner les pratiques établies et de favoriser l’innovation.
  • Intégrité, équanimité, écoute active, confiance dans la prise de risques et capacité à bâtir des consensus au-delà des différences.
  • De solides compétences en communication et la capacité de travailler entre les cultures et les contextes institutionnels.
  • La capacité de mettre Fòs Feminista en relation avec de nouveaux partenaires, bailleurs de fonds et mouvements de justice sociale.

Comment postuler : Pour postuler, veuillez joindre votre Curriculum Vitae et une lettre de motivation ici t le 12 octobre 2026. Veuillez indiquer clairement si vous postulez au Conseil d’administration, à un comité permanent ou aux deux. Les candidatures sont acceptées en anglais, espagnol, français et portugais. About Ancestry:

When you join Ancestry, you join a human-centered company where every person’s story is important. With our unparalleled collection of more than 65 billion records, over 3.5 million subscribers, and over 27 million people in our growing DNA network, customers can discover their family story and gain a new level of understanding about their lives. Over the past 40 years, we’ve built trusted relationships with millions of people who have chosen us as the platform for discovering, preserving, and sharing the most important information about themselves and their families.

We are committed to our location flexible work approach, allowing you to choose to work in the nearest office, from your home, or a hybrid of both (subject to location restrictions and roles that are required to be in the office- see the full list of eligible US locations HERE). We will continue to hire and promote beyond the boundaries of our office locations, to enable broadened possibilities for employee diversity.

Together, we work every day to foster a work environment that's inclusive as well as diverse, and where our people can be themselves. Every idea and perspective is valued so that our products and services reflect the global and diverse clients we serve.

Ancestry encourages applications from minorities, women, the disabled, protected veterans and all other qualified applicants. Passionate about dedicating your work to enriching people’s lives? Join the curious.

Ancestry seeks a part-time contractor Content Writer who is passionate about family history and storytelling to join our Contextual Content team. The Contextual Content team works to bring pioneering technology, historical records, and curated contextual content together in order to empower others in researching and telling their story.

As a Content Writer you will work closely with the Editor and Program Manager in a collaborative process to complete writing assignments for the Contextual Content team. This position is a part-time contract-based and is not eligible for Ancestry benefits.

  • Experience writing about historical events.
  • Experience writing about sensitive topics
  • Background in African American studies, Latin American studies, Native American studies, Asian American studies, American studies, British studies, French studies, European studies, or Australian studies.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret and implement guidelines and standards.
  • Demonstrated ability to adhere to a style guide and tone.
  • Strong internet and research skills.
  • Attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Demonstrated self-starter.
  • Background in family history.

This position is part time contract-based and is not eligible for Ancestry benefits.


Additional Information:

Ancestry is an Equal Opportunity Employer that makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, mental or physical disability, medical condition, military or veteran status, citizenship, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Our client is a growing U.S.-based healthcare support organization that provides remote administrative and patient service solutions to medical practices across the United States.

The company works with healthcare providers to improve patient communication, streamline appointment management, and reduce the administrative workload of medical teams.

Through its remote workforce, the organization supports essential healthcare operations, including patient scheduling, insurance verification, electronic medical records, and front-office coordination.

You will be responsible for assisting patients through phone calls, emails, and messages, coordinating appointments, confirming insurance eligibility, and maintaining accurate patient information.

As an important point of contact between patients and healthcare providers, you will help ensure that daily administrative activities run smoothly and that patients receive professional, friendly, and timely assistance.

This opportunity is ideal for someone with previous experience supporting U.S. healthcare operations who enjoys patient interaction, communicates confidently in English and Spanish, and can manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.

Patient Communication & Front Desk Services

  • Deliver friendly, empathetic, and efficient customer service.

  • Protect confidential patient information during all interactions.

Appointment Scheduling & Patient Coordination

  • Coordinate scheduling updates between patients and medical teams.

  • Assist patients with appointment-related questions and follow-up communication.

  • Help ensure scheduling processes remain organized and efficient.

Insurance & Patient Records Administration

Daily Medical Office Support

  • Assist with routine documentation and data entry.

  • Support additional administrative tasks and special projects as needed.

  • Coordinate with healthcare team members to resolve outstanding administrative requests.

About the Company

Our client is a growing U.S.-based healthcare support organization that provides remote administrative and operational assistance to medical practices across the United States.

The company partners with healthcare professionals to simplify administrative processes, improve practice efficiency, and ensure that medical teams can focus more of their time on patient care.

Its remote workforce supports essential healthcare operations, including patient documentation, insurance coordination, authorization requests, and provider-related administrative processes.

With an emphasis on accuracy, reliable communication, and efficient workflows, the organization continues expanding its remote support teams to meet the needs of healthcare providers across different medical specialties.

About the Role

We are seeking Bilingual Medical Administrative Coordinators to provide remote operational and administrative support to U.S.-based healthcare practices.

In this position, you will help medical teams manage patient information, coordinate insurance-related processes, maintain electronic health records, and support documentation required for prescriptions, authorizations, and provider enrollment.

You will interact with healthcare providers, insurance representatives, pharmacies, and patients to ensure administrative requests are handled accurately and efficiently.

This opportunity is ideal for someone with previous medical administration or healthcare support experience, strong organizational skills, and the ability to communicate professionally in both English and Spanish.

What You'll Do

Medical Records & Patient Information

  • Review and update patient demographic information in electronic health record systems.

  • Maintain accurate and organized EMR/EHR documentation.

  • Upload and organize laboratory reports, referrals, clinical notes, and other medical documents.

  • Verify patient insurance eligibility and benefit information.

  • Identify missing or incomplete records and coordinate necessary updates.

  • Support accurate and confidential handling of patient information.

Insurance Verification & Authorization Coordination

  • Assist with medical, procedure-related, and prescription prior authorizations.

  • Collect required information and supporting clinical documentation.

  • Submit authorization requests and monitor their progress.

  • Communicate with insurance carriers regarding pending decisions and additional requirements.

  • Follow up on authorization denials, appeals, and outstanding documentation.

  • Keep authorization records updated to support timely healthcare services.

Prescription & Pharmacy Administration

  • Coordinate administrative processing of prescription refill requests.

  • Communicate with pharmacies regarding medication-related requests.

  • Track prescription authorization statuses and pending responses.

  • Help resolve documentation issues that may delay prescription processing.

  • Keep healthcare teams informed about outstanding medication-related requests.

Provider Credentialing Support

  • Assist with administrative tasks related to provider enrollment with Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance plans.

  • Update and maintain provider information in CAQH and other credentialing platforms.

  • Track credentialing applications and enrollment progress.

  • Monitor important provider documentation, including professional licenses, DEA registrations, and malpractice insurance.

  • Help identify upcoming credential expirations and outstanding enrollment requirements.

Healthcare Administrative Operations

  • Communicate with patients, providers, pharmacies, and insurance companies.

  • Maintain organized records of requests, updates, and follow-up activities.

  • Support daily administrative processes across medical practices.

  • Coordinate outstanding tasks to help reduce administrative delays.

  • Handle protected health information responsibly and maintain patient confidentiality.

Qualifications

Required

  • At least 1 year of relevant experience in medical administration, medical reception, healthcare virtual assistance, medical records, prior authorizations, credentialing, or a related healthcare support position.

  • Advanced English proficiency (C1/C2) and fluent Spanish, both written and spoken.

  • Experience verifying patient insurance eligibility and benefits.

  • Familiarity with Electronic Medical Records (EMR) or Electronic Health Records (EHR) systems.

  • Understanding of healthcare administrative procedures and medical documentation.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • Ability to manage multiple requests and deadlines.

  • Professional written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

  • Commitment to protecting confidential patient information and maintaining accurate records.

Preferred

  • Previous experience supporting U.S.-based medical practices or healthcare providers.

  • Familiarity with medical or pharmacy prior authorization processes.

  • Experience with provider credentialing and insurance enrollment.

  • Knowledge of CAQH, Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance requirements.

  • Understanding of HIPAA regulations and healthcare documentation standards.

What Makes a Strong Candidate?

We are particularly interested in professionals who demonstrate:

  • Accuracy: You carefully review patient records, insurance details, and medical documentation.

  • Organization: You can manage several administrative processes without losing track of important information.

  • Follow-through: You consistently monitor pending requests and take action when additional information is needed.

  • Communication: You interact professionally with healthcare teams, patients, and insurance representatives.

  • Adaptability: You can work across different administrative workflows and learn new procedures.

  • Confidentiality: You understand the importance of protecting sensitive healthcare information.

How Success Is Measured

  • Patient records and electronic medical documentation remain complete and accurate.

  • Insurance eligibility information is verified and updated appropriately.

  • Prior authorization requests are submitted and followed up on efficiently.

  • Prescription-related administrative requests are coordinated in a timely manner.

  • Provider credentialing documentation and enrollment records remain organized.

  • Pending requests are tracked and communicated effectively.

  • Medical teams receive reliable administrative support that contributes to efficient daily operations.

  • Patient information is handled according to applicable confidentiality and compliance requirements.

Why Join Us?

  • 100% remote opportunity supporting healthcare operations in the United States.

  • Join an expanding healthcare support organization.

  • Gain experience across multiple areas of medical administration.

  • Work with insurance verification, EMR/EHR systems, prior authorizations, and provider documentation.

  • Develop specialized skills in U.S. healthcare administrative processes.

  • Contribute to smoother operations for medical professionals and their patients.

Important Notes

  • Advanced English (C1/C2) and fluent Spanish are required.

  • Candidates must have at least 1 year of relevant healthcare administrative experience.

  • Experience with insurance verification and EMR/EHR systems is required.

  • Previous exposure to U.S. healthcare practices is highly valued.

  • The position requires availability during U.S. business hours.

  • This is an administrative support position; clinical responsibilities are not part of the role.

This is a fully remote position.

Contact

Maira Russo - Senior Talent Acquisition Partner

Core Responsibilities

    • Create architecture, prototypes, and design proposals that deliver near-term business value while aligning with the future-state product and platform vision.

    • Influence technical direction through architecture reviews, RFCs, design discussions, and hands-on collaboration.

    • Partner with senior developers, architects, and tech leads to define and execute the product/platform architecture roadmap.

Core Qualifications

    • Proven experience designing and operating distributed, cloud-native, SaaS/multi-tenant platforms at scale, ideally on AWS.

    • Experience with agentic-AI software development practices.

    • Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable operating in fast-moving environments with ambiguity and evolving requirements. English high B2.

Department-Specific Responsibilities

    • Maintain versioning of target contracts as they evolve, so consuming teams and customers are not broken by change.

    • Contribute to end-to-end tracing and SLOs for gateway traffic, and build the observability that lets you and other teams detect and debug failures anywhere in the pipeline.

    • Mentor other developers joining the team, and contribute to technical direction for the integration layer through RFCs and design reviews.

  • Call each new merchant within 4 business hours of Sales booking their onboarding call, welcome them to AHG Pay, introduce yourself as their point of contact, and confirm the call date and time.
  • Confirm merchants received the onboarding emails and can access the secure upload portal, and walk them through the Green Tier document list so they reach approval faster.
  • Confirm attendance the day before each onboarding call and reschedule through Cal.com when a merchant isn’t ready.
  • Review each scheduled merchant’s outstanding documents every morning and follow up by phone, text, and email until everything is uploaded through the secure portal before the call.
  • Communicate with merchants using approved message templates, or write your own messages in AHG Pay’s tone when no template fits.
  • Check documents for basic mismatches, such as a legal name that differs between documents, and escalate anything that changes the onboarding plan to the Merchant Onboarding Manager immediately.
  • Recover onboarding no-shows with daily outreach by phone, text, and email for 5 business days, rebooking those who reply and returning unresponsive merchants to Sales as freezer leads.
  • Congratulate merchants approved by underwriting and book their integration call with Customer Success, confirming beforehand the payment gateway, website platform, and point of contact (including their developer, if any).
  • Confirm attendance for integration calls, follow up and rebook cancellations or no-shows, and cancel the call for merchants who qualify for self-integration.
  • Update every merchant record in GoHighLevel daily, attend the morning pipeline meeting with a short status report, and make sure no merchant goes more than 2 business days without contact.

TOOLS YOU WILL USE:

GoHighLevel (CRM), the AHG Pay Onboarding Hub and secure upload portal, Cal.com, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, Outlook, Slack, and Claude. This role does not have access to processor portals

Requirements

WHO YOU ARE:

  • Strong English, spoken and written: You speak clearly and write short, correct messages.
  • At home on the phone: You pick up the phone first, and merchants enjoy talking to you. You bring energy to every call and can handle a busy business owner who wants to hang up.
  • Detailed: You notice when a legal name or an address differs between two documents.
  • Organized across many people: You track dozens of merchants and work with Sales, Onboarding, and Customer Success in the same day without dropping anyone.
  • Persistent: You follow up on the fifth day as cheerfully as the first.
  • A problem solver: You try two or three fixes yourself before you escalate, and you bring a recommendation along with the problem.
  • Comfortable with AI tools: You use tools like ChatGPT or Claude in your daily work and want to use more.
  • Available for U.S. hours: You can work through 5 PM Pacific to reach West Coast merchants.

Nice to have: experience in payments, finance, or loan or account onboarding; experience with GoHighLevel or another CRM

Benefits

  • Weekly pay
  • Paid vacation and holidays
  • Health and learning stipends
  • Access to AI training and tools
  • Clear paths to advancement

Who we are

We’re a global, midsize CRO that pushes boundaries, innovates and invents because the path to a cure for the world’s most persistent diseases is not paved by those who play it safe. It is built by those who take pioneering, creative approaches and implement them with quality and excellence.

We are Worldwide Clinical Trials, and we are a global team of over 3,500+ experts, bright thinkers, dreamers and doers and, together, we are changing the way the world experiences CROs – in the best possible way.

Our mission is to work with passion and purpose every day to improve lives and we are looking for others who value this same pursuit.

Why Worldwide

We believe everyone plays an important role in making a world of difference for patients and their caregivers. From our hands-on, accessible leaders, to our cohesive and supportive teams, we are committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed. We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us!

Make an Impact as a Senior CRA at Worldwide


As a Senior CRA, you’ll play a critical role in ensuring clinical studies are conducted with the highest standards of quality, patient safety, and regulatory compliance. Your expertise will help drive the successful execution of studies from site qualification through closeout, supporting the delivery of reliable data that advances clinical research.

In this role, you'll serve as a trusted partner to investigative sites, study teams, and sponsors, building strong relationships while providing leadership, guidance, and oversight across clinical trial activities. You’ll have the opportunity to influence study success through proactive monitoring, site management, and collaboration with global teams.

Your contributions will directly support high-quality study delivery by ensuring protocol adherence, regulatory compliance, timely data collection, and effective site performance throughout the clinical trial lifecycle.


Where You'll Work


This is a home-based Clinical Research Associate role supporting sites across the Central of the United States. Candidates must reside within the territory to effectively support site visits and study activities. You will collaborate with sites, sponsors, and global study teams while traveling to investigative sites approximately 8-10 days per month.

To best support our sites, we're seeking candidates who are based in the Central of the United States. Travel will primarily be regional, with occasional travel to support sites in other locations as needed.


What You'll Do

  • Manage clinical research activities at investigative sites participating in Worldwide clinical studies.
  • Identify and assess potential research sites to support successful study execution.
  • Coordinate study start-up activities, including collection of regulatory documentation and support of contract and budget processes.
  • Conduct all types of monitoring visits: Pre-Site Selection Visits (PSSVs), Study Initiation Visits (SIVs), Interim Monitoring Visits (IMVs) and Closeout Visits (COVs).
  • Train site personnel on protocol requirements, data collection processes, and safety reporting expectations.
  • Monitor site performance and provide ongoing support throughout study maintenance activities.
  • Ensure compliance with informed consent requirements, safety reporting obligations, and applicable regulatory standards.
  • Partner with sites and study teams to drive data quality, participant safety, and overall study success.
  • Support site closeout activities and ensure study requirements are completed at the conclusion of the trial.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor's Degree or a Nursing Degree, along with 5+ years as a regional, traveling Clinical Research Associate.
  • Required experience monitoring: CNS and psychiatric clinical trials
  • Requires travel within the specified region; 8 – 10 DOS monthly
  • Experience in full-service monitoring preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of clinical trial processes, site management, and regulatory requirement

jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Position Title: Public Relations Specialist

Department: Integrated Marketing

Reports to: Integrated Marketing Director

About the Organization:The American Association of Critical-Care Nurses (AACN) is the largest specialty nursing organization in the world, representing the interests of more than 550,000 nurses who are charged with caring for acutely and critically ill patients. AACN is dedicated to creating a healthcare system driven by the needs of patients and families where acute and critical care nurses make their optimal contribution.Visit us online at.

AACN is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination against or harassment of any person employed by or seeking employment with AACN on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex and gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding or related medical conditions, gender identity, gender expression, and sexual orientation), ancestry, national origin, age (40 or older), disability (mental and physical), military or veteran status, marital status, medical condition, or genetic information and any other basis protected by federal, state or local law or ordinance or regulation.

Application Instructions:Interested individuals can visit ourCareers Pageand apply for thePublic Relations Specialistrole. Any questions can be directed to:. This position is remote. Some travel may be required.

Position Purpose:The Public Relations Specialist is responsible for independently evaluating, developing, and managing public relations, media relations, and external communications initiatives that support AACN’s strategic priorities, advocacy efforts, products, programs, and member engagement objectives.

This role serves as a subject matter expert within the Integrated Marketing function, applying specialized knowledge in public relations, media relations, storytelling, messaging, and reputation management to evaluate communication needs, develop recommendations, and determine appropriate communication approaches and tactics aligned with organizational priorities.

The Public Relations Strategist partners with the Integrated Marketing Director, organizational leaders, marketing teams, product owners, and external partners to identify communication opportunities, develop effective approaches, and deliver impactful communications that strengthen AACN’s visibility, reputation, and connection with key audiences.

The role exercises independent judgment and discretion in managing complex communication assignments, evaluating opportunities and risks, determining appropriate communication approaches, and advising stakeholders on public relations activities. The position operates within established organizational strategy while independently determining methods, tactics, and execution approaches to achieve communication objectives.

Main Accountabilities & Results:

  • Develops and executes public relations and media relations initiatives aligned with organizational priorities and communication strategies established by Integrated Marketing leadership.

    • Partners with the Integrated Marketing Director and key stakeholders to translate organizational priorities into communication plans, messaging recommendations, media opportunities, and storytelling approaches.

    • Provides subject matter expertise and recommendations regarding public relations opportunities, media engagement, audience considerations, messaging strategies, and communication tactics.

    • Collaborates with business partners, product owners, marketing strategists, clinical leaders, and subject matter experts to identify opportunities to amplify organizational initiatives, programs, products, and thought leadership.

    • Maintains a strong understanding of AACN’s mission, strategic priorities, governance structure, advocacy initiatives, healthcare environment, and industry trends to inform effective communication recommendations and execution.

  • Evaluates and manages assigned media relations activities, including identifying opportunities, determining appropriate outreach and engagement approaches, responding to media inquiries, and developing relationships with journalists, media outlets, and external partners.

    • Develops and oversees communication materials, including press releases, media advisories, key messages, executive talking points, briefing documents, FAQs, and other public relations resources, ensuring they reflect appropriate messaging, audience considerations, and organizational priorities.

    • Builds and maintains relationships with media contacts and external partners to support AACN’s visibility, reputation, and thought leadership objectives.

    • Monitors media coverage, industry trends, public conversations, and emerging issues to identify opportunities, assess communication needs, and provide recommendations to support organizational decision-making.

    • Analyzes public relations outcomes, including media coverage, audience engagement, visibility, and other performance indicators, to assess effectiveness, identify opportunities and risks, and recommend adjustments to communication approaches.

    • Maintains relationships with external public relations partners, vendors, and communication resources to support effective execution of initiatives.

  • Partners with organizational leaders to support high-visibility communications that support executive leadership, crisis response, advocacy efforts, and organizational priorities.

    • Advises AACN leadership, including the President, President-elect, and Board of Directors, on media engagement by evaluating communication needs, recommending messaging and interview approaches, and developing briefing materials, talking points, and other communications aligned with established organizational priorities and messaging direction.

    • Supports onboarding and communications planning for incoming Presidents and Presidents-elect by managing communication timelines, preparing messaging materials, coordinating media considerations, and ensuring communication needs are addressed.

    • Partners with the Director of Integrated Marketing and senior leaders to address media inquiries, emerging issues, and public-facing communication needs by providing recommendations, developing appropriate communications materials, and supporting implementation.

    • Provides communications expertise for crisis and advocacy matters by assessing communication needs, evaluating risks, recommending approaches and priorities, developing materials, and independently managing assigned workstreams within established organizational direction.

  • Collaborates across marketing and organizational teams to ensure communications are audience-focused and aligned with organizational priorities, providing public relations expertise and recommending tactics and approaches for crisis, advocacy, and high-priority communications.

    • Partners with the social media team to monitor conversations, audience sentiment, emerging issues, and relevant discussions, using insights to provide recommendations and inform communication approaches and opportunities for proactive engagement.

    • Collaborates with marketing leaders and channel specialists to provide public relations expertise, recommend communication tactics, and support timelines and channel execution for crisis, advocacy, and high-priority organizational communications.

    • Builds and maintains strong working relationships with internal stakeholders, external partners, and media contacts to support effective communication execution, collaboration, and organizational objectives.

    • Upholds the organization’s talent philosophy and values.

    • Performs other duties as assigned.

Skills Required:

  • Demonstrated experience independently managing and executing public relations, media relations, and communications initiatives that support organizational priorities and established communication strategies.

  • Advanced understanding of media relations practices, including media outreach, relationship management, story development, press materials, interview coordination, and media engagement processes.

  • Exceptional writing and editing skills with demonstrated experience developing high-quality communications materials, including press releases, executive communications, talking points, FAQs, media advisories, and other public-facing content.

  • Ability to translate organizational priorities, products, advocacy initiatives, and clinical topics into compelling stories and communications materials that effectively engage target audiences.

  • Strong understanding of integrated marketing and communications principles, including how public relations supports broader campaigns, organizational initiatives, and audience engagement efforts.

  • Experience supporting crisis, issues management, and advocacy communications by coordinating messaging, developing communication materials, and executing approved communication plans across multiple channels.

  • Strong collaboration and relationship-building skills with the ability to effectively partner with executives, volunteer leaders, media contacts, business partners, and cross-functional teams to support communication objectives.

  • Experience using media monitoring, social listening, analytics, and audience insights to evaluate communication effectiveness, identify opportunities, and provide recommendations to improve engagement.

  • Strong project management, organizational, and prioritization skills with the ability to independently manage multiple communication initiatives, coordinate deadlines, and ensure timely execution.

  • Excellent judgment, discretion, communication, and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage sensitive, high-visibility communications, evaluate situations, and determine appropriate next steps within established organizational priorities.

Education and/or Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Public Relations, Communications, Journalism, Marketing, English, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Minimum 7 years of progressive experience in public relations, media relations, corporate communications, or a related field, with demonstrated ability to independently manage complex communications initiatives and deliver high-quality results with limited supervision.

  • Demonstrated experience developing and managing public relations and communications strategies that support organizational priorities, brand awareness, stakeholder engagement, and business objectives, with the ability to independently assess communication needs and recommend appropriate approaches.

  • Experience managing media relationships and evaluating media opportunities, including developing executive communications, messaging, talking points, briefing materials, and other communications aligned with organizational priorities.

  • Experience managing crisis communications, advocacy communications, or issues management by assessing communication needs and risks, recommending messaging and communication approaches, and managing initiatives within established organizational direction.

  • Experience exercising independent judgment in managing complex communications initiatives, prioritizing competing demands, advising cross-functional stakeholders, and evaluating communication effectiveness through media monitoring, audience insights, engagement metrics, and other measurement tools.

Physical Requirements:

In addition to the responsibilities outlined in the job description, the following requirements represent the essential functions of this job, which must be met by an individual to perform successfully. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions. Upon request, the organization will engage in an interactive process to identify and implement reasonable accommodations.

This position involves frequent communication and collaboration with internal stakeholders, external partners, media contacts, and organizational leaders through virtual, in-person, and written communication channels. The role requires regular use of standard office equipment, including computer systems, and prolonged periods of desk work involving writing, research, communication planning, analysis, and content development. Occasional travel may be required.

The position requires the ability to evaluate information, analyze complex communication needs, exercise sound judgment, and determine appropriate approaches within established organizational priorities. The individual must demonstrate strong mental focus and attention to detail while managing multiple projects, competing priorities, sensitive communications, and evolving organizational needs.

This role requires the ability to interpret and synthesize information, develop communication materials, provide recommendations, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders. The individual must be able to work independently with limited supervision, prioritize assignments, resolve issues, and apply professional judgment to support organizational objectives and communication outcomes.

Total Compensation:

The target pay range for this role is$101,223 - $126,529

** We offer a 37.5-hour workweek with 3 different schedule options. In addition to the salary range listed, we offer a wealth of benefits to make working at AACN even more rewarding. Benefits include generous paid time off, low-cost health plans for medical and mental health services, dental, and vision, company-paid life and short-term disability insurance, a variety of other benefits, and a retirement savings program with employer matching and additional company contribution. AACN is committed to a people-centered culture of workplace excellence and belonging, and offers various alternative and flexible work arrangements to support work/life balance for our team members.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Identification
jobs.excerpt: Fingerprint empowers enterprises to detect and stop online fraud with the world’s most accurate device intelligence.
jobs.description:
Fingerprint empowers enterprises to detect and stop online fraud with the world’s most accurate device intelligence. We lead our industry with bleeding-edge identification capabilities and work on turning new ideas and discoveries in the fraud detection space into reality. Our customers range from innovative startups to leading enterprise companies, including Plaid, Dropbox, and Booking.com.

Fingerprint is a globally dispersed, 100% remote company. We were named on on the 2026 Forbes Best Startup Employers list and ranked #803 on the 2026 Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies.

We have raised $77M and are backed by Craft Ventures (Tesla, Facebook, Airbnb ), Nexus Venture Partners ( Postman, Apollo.io,MinIO, Druva) and Uncorrelated Ventures ( Redis, Rollbar, Gradle).

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to help build and operate the end-to-end fraud detection systems behind our Identification APIs. Your primary responsibility will be building highly performant backend systems and keeping them reliable at scale. You'll write the services and you'll own how they behave in production.

This role requires strong experience in backend software development, particularly API development and scaling existing systems in Go, paired with a genuine interest in reliability engineering. You'll design and implement scalable, high-performance backend systems, maintain their SLOs, and take ownership of features from concept through deployment and steady-state operation.

A key aspect of this role involves a deep understanding of scaling and operating distributed systems, allowing us to multiply our capacity safely and efficiently as our user base continues to grow rapidly.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and optimize backend systems for real-time data processing and web services, treating reliability, latency, and cost as first-class constraints.
  • Own SLIs and SLOs for Core API services, using error budgets to balance shipping velocity against stability.
  • Build the observability that makes systems debuggable — metrics, structured logging, distributed tracing, and alerts that fire on user-visible symptoms, not noise.
  • Share an on-call rotation, respond effectively to incidents, and lead blameless postmortems. Schedules are set in advance, with equitable coverage and minimal off-hours disruption.
  • Reduce operational toil through automation, and close out incident action items so the same failure doesn't recur.
  • Run capacity planning, load testing, and performance tuning so the platform scales ahead of demand.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams on integrations, and mentor other engineers as they grow.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years in backend development, including meaningful time operating what you built in production.
  • Strong, demonstrated experience with Go, and with scalable APIs, real-time data processing, and microservices.
  • Hands-on experience running production services with Docker and Kubernetes, and with IaC tools like Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Working fluency with observability tooling (Datadog or comparable) — instrumenting services and building useful dashboards and alerts.
  • On-call experience: triaging live incidents, mitigating impact, and writing up what happened.
  • Strong SQL, plus experience with databases like DynamoDB, Redis, or Elasticsearch.
  • Proficiency with Git, shell scripting, and CI/CD, and fluency in English for a global, remote team.
  • Able to work independently in ambiguous environments with direct stakeholder contact, and eager to mentor junior engineers.
  • BS/MS in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
  • Bonus: analytical storage systems (ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks), queueing and streaming systems (SQS, Kafka), or performance profiling and cost optimization of high-throughput cloud workloads.
  • Bonus: vector databases (Pinecone, Qdrant) in production, ML-adjacent product engineering, concurrent programming, or a strong grasp of internet security and privacy mechanisms.

Tools and Technologies:

  • Backend development: Golang
  • Infrastructure and delivery: AWS, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines.
  • Observability: Datadog, metrics/logging/tracing.
  • Data analytics/processing: ClickHouse, dbt.

Compensation & Transparency

At Fingerprint, we believe in pay transparency — it's part of how we operate as a distributed, remote-first team. Salaries are based on function, level, and geographic location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies.

Because this role is open across the United States and can be based anywhere our team members work from, the salary range reflects that geographic breadth: $152k - $205k

Some example salaries for specific locations are below:

NYC: $178k - $205k

Chicago: $152k - $174k

Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including the successful candidate's location, experience, and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

Due to regulatory and security reasons, there’s a small number of countries where we cannot have Fingerprint teammates based. Additionally, because Fingerprint is an all-remote company and people can join our workforce from almost any country, we do not sponsor visas. Fingerprint teammates need to be authorized to work from their home location.

We are dedicated to creating an inclusive work environment for everyone. We embrace and celebrate the unique experiences, perspectives and cultural backgrounds that each employee brings to our workplace. Fingerprint strives to foster an environment where our employees feel respected, valued and empowered, and our team members are at the forefront in helping us promote and sustain an inclusive workplace. We highly encourage people from underrepresented groups in tech to apply.

If you are applying as a resident of California, please read our CCPA notice here.

If you are applying as a resident of the EU, please read our GDPR notice here.

**We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Fingerprint recruiting email communications will always come from the @fingerprint.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Fingerprint via other sources should be ignored.
