*Vacation, Personal, and Sick time accrual rates will vary based on full-time or part-time employee status. Recognized Holidays are either paid time off or, if required to work due to job requirements, holiday pay rate, and may vary depending on state.

Welcome to Ovation Healthcare!

At Ovation Healthcare (formerly QHR Health), we’ve been making local healthcare better for more than 40 years. Our mission is to strengthen independent community healthcare. We provide independent hospitals and health systems with the support, guidance and tech-enabled shared services needed to remain strong and viable. With a strong sense of purpose and commitment to operating excellence, we help rural healthcare providers fulfill their missions.


The Ovation Healthcare difference is the extraordinary combination of operations experience and consulting guidance that fulfills our mission of creating a sustainable future for healthcare organizations. Ovation Healthcare’s vision is to be a dynamic, integrated professional services company delivering innovative and executable solutions through experience and thought leadership, while valuing trust, respect, and customer focused behavior.


We’re looking for talented, motivated professionals with a desire to help independent hospitals thrive. Working with Ovation Healthcare, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with highly skilled subject matter specialists and operations executives, in a collegial atmosphere of professionalism and teamwork.


Ovation Healthcare’s corporate headquarters is located in Brentwood, TN. For more information, visit .


SUMMARY:

The Clinical Documentation Educator (CDE) will audit, create, implement and maintain clinical documentation education for Physicians, Clinicians or other care providers at assigned clients. This role may participate in the orientation of new client providers and client or Ovation revenue cycle staff. The CDE will participate in quality initiatives that impact client metrics as related to documentation. The CDE will also develop/ track/ trend and provide metrics related to those education tasks/ projects to all relevant parties.

This position will assist with the ongoing and continuous development and implementation of all revenue cycle services by managing resources and ensuring quality expectations are met for clients. This role includes establishing and maintaining positive relationships with current and past client contacts, and team members from various revenue cycle management departments, both internal and external. The CDE will ensure quality standards are met as defined by Ovation and/ or other service-level agreements.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Develop and implement clinical documentation education for physicians, clinicians and other stakeholders. Creation of documentation templates. Use data to identify and target areas needing additional training.
  • Maintain provider education library.
  • Aid in trending denials for education opportunities.
  • Assist in developing and growing coding services.
  • Directly perform, oversee, participate in, and recommend process improvements and operational changes to improve efficiency and client relationships.
  • Prepare and provide daily/weekly reports to appropriate internal and external stakeholders, up to the executive level.
  • Comfort and expertise presenting to and working closely with providers.
  • Mentor and train staff as applicable.
  • Aid in or create, maintain, and enforce standard operating procedures for the department or clients.
  • Other duties as assigned and assessed by client needs.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • Knowledge of ICD-10 code and MS-DRG assignment, American Hospital Association Coding Guidelines, and Coding Clinics.
  • Extensive knowledge of complex disease processes.
  • Working knowledge of quality improvement theory, core measures, and other required reporting programs.
  • Strong understanding of the requirements for clinical documentation, coding, and billing according to the rules of Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial payers.
  • Proficiency in computer use, including electronic medical records (EMR), CDI software, electronic codebooks, Microsoft Office, and presentation programs.
  • Strong professional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to prioritize efforts while multi-tasking in a fast-paced environment utilizing critical thinking skills.
  • Strong managerial, leadership, and interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills.
  • A team player, always willing to contribute to the organization.

WORK EXPERIENCE, EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS:

Certified Clinical Documentation Specialist (CCDS) certification by the Association of Clinical Documentation Integrity Specialists (ACDIS) or Clinical Documentation Improvement Professional (CDIP) certification by the American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA).

Active nursing license.

Five or more years of relevant experience

Three or more years of employee and client management experience in a remote environment.


WORKING CONDITIONS AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

100% Remote



Benefits


The base compensation range for this position is:


$82,555.42 - $132,088.67

Compensation ranges could be hourly or salary depending upon the exempt status of the posted position.


Beginning compensation is determined based on objective factors such as location, qualifications, skills, certifications, and experience. Typically, a candidate is hired in the lower to midpoint of the range; the top end of the range is reserved for candidates with extensive specialized experience and mastery within the role. The Permit Coordinator is responsible for coordinating with OSP Construction, external vendors and permitting entities to prioritize activities and manage permit requirements. Remote Work Location: Due to logistics of working with the Central Time Zone, we're looking for candidates who reside in the following states: Arizona, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kentucky, Missouri, Ohio, Texas, Wisconsin.

jobs.description:
Are you an experienced professional with a deep understanding of the Ellucian Colleague software platform and a passion for optimizing financial aid operations in higher education? College Aid Services is expanding our team of consultants with Ellucian Colleague experience.

Whether you enjoy leading teams, solving operational challenges, or helping institutions get more from Colleague, there may be an opportunity for you. Join our dynamic team and make a lasting impact on institutions across the country.

Position Overview

As a College Aid Services consultant, you will support higher education institutions across the country through assignments aligned with your experience, availability, and interests. Opportunities may include interim leadership, operational support, remote processing, compliance support, staff training, business process reviews, and technology assistance.

We welcome both functional professionals and those interested in “funky-tech” roles, our term for work that connects financial aid operations with system functionality. These roles may involve Colleague setup, rules configuration, reporting, troubleshooting, and process improvement.

Consultants join College Aid Services as employees. Assignments may be short-term or long-term, with part-time or full-time hours depending on institutional needs.

Key Responsibilities May Include

  • Serve as an interim financial aid director, assistant director, or other financial aid team member.
  • Support daily operations, staff leadership, and administration of Title IV aid programs.
  • Assist with verification, awarding, loan and grant processing, disbursements, reconciliation, and reporting.
  • Evaluate business processes and recommend improvements that strengthen efficiency, compliance, and student service.
  • Apply Colleague expertise to support financial aid processing and, for funky-tech assignments, system configuration, rules, testing, and troubleshooting.
  • Train staff, document procedures, and collaborate with campus partners and College Aid Services colleagues.

Responsibilities will vary by assignment and your area of expertise.

Qualifications

  • Substantial higher education financial aid experience, with 10 or more years preferred.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with Ellucian Colleague.
  • For leadership assignments, at least five years of financial aid director or comparable leadership experience.
  • For funky-tech assignments, experience with Colleague setup, rules, reporting, troubleshooting, or related functionality.
  • Strong knowledge of Title IV programs and applicable financial aid regulations.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to work independently and collaborate effectively.
  • College degree preferred, or equivalent progressive professional experience.
  • Prior consulting experience, FAAC® certification, and NASFAA credentials preferred.

Availability and Work Requirements

We are seeking professionals with part-time or full-time availability. Many assignments require availability during the client’s regular business hours, which may vary by time zone. Some opportunities may include work outside regular business hours.

Assignments may be remote or hybrid, with travel requirements determined by the assignment. Travel expenses will be reimbursed by College Aid Services, LLC.

When applying, please indicate your areas of expertise, Colleague experience, preferred hours, availability during and outside regular business hours, and preference for remote or hybrid work, including willingness to travel.

Why Join College Aid Services?

Join a collaborative, remote work environment where your experience is valued and you can exchange ideas with knowledgeable higher education colleagues. Our consultants work with project management and compliance team members who provide guidance and support throughout client engagements.

You will have opportunities to pursue assignments that align with your strengths, availability, and professional interests while helping institutions strengthen their operations and support student success.

About College Aid Services, LLC

Since 2002, College Aid Services has provided customized solutions to higher education institutions nationwide. Our services include Interim Staffing and Outsourcing, Business Process Reviews, Remote Processing, Technology Support, Title IV Compliance Support, Enrollment Modeling and Analytics, Staff Training and Executive Coaching.

At the heart of our work is a commitment to exceptional service and student success at the institutions we serve.

Equal Opportunity Employer

College Aid Services, LLC is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (North America - Remote)
jobs.excerpt: tldr; We build software for Airbnbs to rent themselves, with a state-of-the-art product and user experience.
jobs.description:
tldr; We build software for Airbnbs to rent themselves, with a state-of-the-art product and user experience.

We are bold, like risks, and take on big challenges together. We believe in the value of team diversity and seek candidates from a wide range of backgrounds in their work, life, culture, and experiences. We have crafted an Applicant Handbook, which we highly recommend you check out, where you can find out more about the company, culture, how we recruit, what we do, and how we do it:

Our customers love the product, provide valuable feedback, and trust us to rapidly help with their problems. Feel free to check out one of our public Town Halls for yourself:

Hospitable.com is a remote-only and fully distributed company. We hire based on timezones.

What you will be working on

Your mission is to help our customers build more successful short-term rental businesses while driving revenue growth for Hospitable.

This isn't a traditional Customer Success role focused primarily on answering questions, managing relationships, or preventing churn. We're building a proactive, commercially driven Success team that helps customers discover opportunities, get more value from our platform, and grow their businesses.

You'll own a revenue quota, and your ability to consistently meet or exceed that quota will be the primary measure of your success.

You'll do this through the following:

  • Revenue Growth & Expansion: Own and achieve quarterly revenue targets through subscription upgrades, annual conversions, feature adoption, and additional products and services. You'll proactively identify opportunities within our existing customer base and turn those conversations into measurable revenue.
  • Consultative Selling: Get to know our customers, their businesses, and what they're trying to accomplish. Whether they're managing one property or hundreds, you'll identify opportunities to help them save time, increase revenue, and operate more efficiently using Hospitable.
  • Proactive Customer Engagement: Don't wait for customers to reach out. You'll actively engage customers through scheduled meetings, personalized outreach, and targeted campaigns to uncover opportunities, demonstrate value, and drive action.
  • Product Adoption & Monetization: Help customers discover and adopt features that can make a meaningful difference in their businesses, including Direct Booking, Dynamic Pricing, Upsells, and other revenue-generating tools. You'll connect product capabilities to real business outcomes and identify opportunities to expand their investment in Hospitable.
  • Customer Education & Workshops: Lead engaging 1:1 consultations, group workshops, and product demonstrations that help customers get more from Hospitable. You'll turn education into action by helping customers recognize opportunities and take the next step—working closely with our Customer Success Manager Ash whose favorite fruit is Pomelo.
  • Strategic Account Management: Work with high-value customers through Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and ongoing conversations to understand their goals, identify gaps in their current setup, and develop recommendations that support their growth and expand their use of Hospitable.
  • Pipeline & Performance Ownership: Build and manage your own pipeline of opportunities, maintain accurate CRM records, and consistently follow through on customer conversations. You'll be responsible for your activity, pipeline health, forecasting, and ultimately your results.
  • Customer Advocacy & Collaboration: Bring customer feedback, challenges, and ideas back to our product and support teams. You'll work closely with teammates to help customers succeed while identifying new opportunities for Hospitable to deliver value.

What success looks like

We believe great Customer Success Managers create value for customers and measurable growth for the company.

You'll be successful in this role when you're consistently achieving your revenue quota, building a healthy pipeline of opportunities, helping customers adopt valuable features, and turning customer conversations into meaningful business outcomes.

We give our team the autonomy to own their results. You'll have support, tools, and coaching along the way, but we expect you to take initiative, find opportunities, and be accountable for your performance.

If you love helping people, enjoy the challenge of selling, and get excited about being rewarded for the results you deliver, you'll feel right at home here.

Requirements

For this position, your location is not a requirement. The ideal fit would work under North American timezones.

Don't tick all the boxes? Talk to us about why you're still an amazing fit. The successful candidate will demonstrate how they are uniquely qualified for this role and will be someone that we cannot wait to start working with.

  • Sales & Revenue Experience: 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Account Executive, or a similar customer-facing role, ideally within SaaS. We're particularly interested in candidates who have carried revenue quotas and consistently met or exceeded their targets.
  • Commercial Mindset: You naturally look for opportunities to grow accounts, expand product adoption, and generate revenue. You're comfortable discussing pricing, presenting value, handling objections, and asking customers to make a purchase decision.
  • Consultative Approach: You know that great selling starts with understanding the customer. You're curious, ask thoughtful questions, uncover business challenges, and recommend solutions that genuinely make sense for the customer.
  • Self-Motivation & Accountability: You thrive in an environment where you're trusted to manage your own time and results. You're proactive, organized, comfortable with performance targets, and motivated by the opportunity to earn more through strong performance.
  • Excellent Communication: You're confident leading customer conversations, delivering presentations, and communicating clearly through email, video calls, and other channels. You can make complex products easy to understand and compelling to use.
  • Pipeline & CRM Management: You understand how to build and manage a sales pipeline, prioritize opportunities, follow up consistently, and maintain accurate records. You're comfortable using CRM tools and performance data to guide your daily activities.
  • Technical Curiosity: You enjoy learning software, exploring new features, and showing customers how technology can improve their businesses. You don't need to be an engineer, but you should be comfortable demonstrating and explaining software.
  • Problem-Solving & Adaptability: You're resourceful, comfortable working independently, and willing to try new approaches when something isn't working. You see challenges as opportunities to learn and improve.
  • Team Collaboration: You enjoy sharing ideas, learning from others, and working with cross-functional teams. You're competitive with your own goals while being genuinely invested in the success of the team.

Experience in short-term rentals, hospitality technology, property management, or revenue management is a plus, but not required.

Benefits

The company itself is also a product, one that we iterate on. We're always improving and creating an environment where we all love to work.

  • A supportive, radically transparent, and caring team environment, where you are trusted, not managed—and a culture that is focused on results and output.
  • The compensation depends on your location, status, and level within our salary bands which will be shared during the interview process. We can hire talent internationally as contractors—or employees if you are based in the United States, the European Union, or Australia, taking into account payroll taxes to determine your gross compensation. Bixal is seeking a Content Strategist / Information Architect for a project that supports a large-scale outreach and engagement effort, delivering strategic communications, content and creative services, digital strategy, and audience engagement across public-facing websites, applications, and social media platforms. The program's mission is to ensure the intended audience receives timely, accurate, and accessible information about the programs, services, and policies that affect them — with content and platforms built to scale, adapt to changing needs, and hold up to federal compliance and security standards.

The Content Strategist / Information Architect shapes how content is planned, structured, and organized across the program's public-facing websites and applications so that users can find, understand, and act on information efficiently. Responsibilities:

  • Review content within the CMS for clarity, findability, accessibility, and usability, recommending structural, navigational, or governance improvements informed by data and user needs.

  • Establish and document information-architecture standards and permissions structures that support consistent content governance and auditability.

  • Design and participate in usability testing, contributing IA-specific test scenarios (e.g., card sorting, tree testing, navigation tasks) and translating findings into structural recommendations.

  • Familiarity with usability testing methods (e.g., card sorting, tree testing, moderated user testing) and translating findings into actionable structural recommendations.

  • Working knowledge of content management systems and accessibility standards (Section 508/WCAG).

Please note: This role is contingent upon a contract award. While it is not an immediate opening, we are actively conducting interviews and extending offers in anticipation of the award.

ICF seeks an experienced Salesforce Administrator / Release Engineer to support a large-scale federal Salesforce environment. This role combines hands-on Salesforce administration with release engineering responsibilities across multiple Salesforce applications, environments, and application teams.

The Salesforce Administrator / Release Engineer will support platform configuration, environment management, user and access administration, release coordination, deployment execution, sandbox management, technical documentation, and production support. This role is ideal for someone who understands both the operational responsibilities of Salesforce administration and the disciplinerequiredto support frequent, high-quality releases in a secure federal cloud environment.

 

Job Location:  Remote work is authorized. Must support US Eastern time zone working hours.

*If you accept this position, you should note that ICF does monitor employee work locations blocks access from foreign locations/foreign IP addresses and prohibits personal VPN connections. 

What You Will Do:

  • Configure, maintain, and support Salesforce applications and platform capabilities in a secure federal Salesforce cloud environment.

  • Manage users, roles, permission sets, profiles, groups, queues, sharing rules, connected apps, service accounts, and other access/security configurations.

  • Support Salesforce administration activities across multiple environments, including Integration, Stage, Production, sandboxes, and other approved development/testing environments.

  • Create, refresh, validate, and decommission Salesforce sandboxes in coordination with application teams, release teams, and business owners.

  • Configure Salesforce using native low-code/no-code capabilities, including flows, page layouts, Lightning record pages, custom objects, fields, validation rules, reports, dashboards, email templates, and user experience enhancements.

  • Support Experience Cloud, Public Sector Solutions, Service Cloud, or other Salesforce capabilities as required by the customer environment.

  • Coordinate, schedule, validate, and execute Salesforce releases, including major releases, minor releases, hotfixes, and production changes.

  • Support release management processes, including release calendar management, deployment planning, release readiness reviews, change request preparation, rollback planning, and post-deployment validation.

  • Work with development teams to package, validate, and deploy configuration, metadata, code, and data-related changes using approved DevSecOps processes.

  • Support CI/CD pipeline activities using tools such as Salesforce CLI, Salesforce DX, Git, GitLab, GitHub, Jenkins, Copado, Gearset, or similar release automation tools.

  • Create and maintain Git repositories, branches, deployment artifacts, release notes, and environment/version control documentation.

  • Support technical design document reviews by identifying release dependencies, environment impacts, deployment risks, security impacts, regression considerations, and operational readiness needs.

  • Troubleshoot release, deployment, environment, access, configuration, integration, and production support issues.

  • Support incident response and hotfix activities by validating configuration issues, access problems, deployment defects, and platform-level concerns.

  • Support data import, export, cleanup, validation, and migration activities using Data Loader, Data Import Wizard, reports, SOQL, or approved customer tools.

  • Support occasional off-hours releases, production deployments, outages, hotfixes, or urgent operational needs.

What You Will Bring With You:

  • 3+ years as a Salesforce Administrator for large production orgs.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps practices, including software release management, version control, and deployment automation (e.g., using tools like Git, Jenkins, or Salesforce DX).

  • U.S. Citizenship required due to federal contract requirements.

  • Candidate must have a current Public Trust clearance/suitability determination or an active DoD Secret clearance.

  • Candidate must reside in the U.S., be authorized to work in the U.S., and all work must be performed in the U.S.

  • Candidate must have lived in the U.S. for three full years out of the last five years.

What We Would Like You To Bring With You:

  • Active Salesforce Administrator certification.

  • Salesforce Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder, Platform Developer I, Sharing and Visibility Architect, Identity and Access Management Architect, or other Salesforce certification.

  • Experience supporting Salesforce Government Cloud implementations for federal, public sector, homeland security, law enforcement, or regulated customers.

  • Experience with Salesforce Public Sector Solutions, Experience Cloud, Service Cloud, Salesforce Shield, OmniStudio, or large multi-org Salesforce environments.

  • Experience administering OmniStudio components such as FlexCards, OmniScripts, DataRaptors, and Integration Procedures.

  • Experience with SSO, MFA, identity management, email relay, external user administration, AppExchange package management, certificate management, and connected app governance.

  • Experience supporting high-volume Salesforce release environments with major releases, minor releases, hotfixes, production changes, and technical design reviews.

  • Experience supporting DevSecOps pipelines, automated code scans, static code analysis, quality gates, release approvals, and deployment automation.

  • Experience with data migration tools and activities, including Data Loader, Data Import Wizard, SOQL, data validation, deduplication, and legacy-to-cloud migration support.

  • Familiarity with API integrations, service accounts, connected apps, Salesforce Connect, Platform Events, Change Data Capture, REST/SOAP APIs, or middleware platforms.

  • Familiarity with federal cybersecurity requirements, ATO support, vulnerability remediation validation, audit support, and security control documentation.

  • Experience creating user guides, technical documentation, training materials, release playbooks, configuration guides, and operational runbooks.

  • Experience supporting production incidents, root cause analysis, hotfix validation, and post-release issue resolution.

Professional Skills:

  • Highly effective analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

  • Demonstrated critical thinking, attention to detail, and the ability to produce polished and well-organized written deliverables.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interface effectively with team members and federal clients.

  • Organized, detail-oriented and able to prioritize and multitask.

Working at ICF

ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.

We can only solve the world's toughest challenges by building a workplace that allows everyone to thrive. Bixal is building a pipeline of qualified subject matter experts (SMEs) to support anti-human trafficking training and technical assistance (T/TA). Selected experts may be engaged on a short-term, part-time basis to design training content, advise on and peer review training materials, and deliver training in-person or virtually.

Please read carefully before applying:

This is a call for experts to join a talent pipeline. By applying, you are asking to have your resume reviewed and, if appropriate, added to a consultant database for future consideration.

  • If you apply, you will receive a confirmation email acknowledging that your application was received.

  • Your resume will then be reviewed and may be added to our consultant pipeline.

  • Applicant contact depends on alignment with the role. You will be contacted only if a specific project arises in 2027 for which your experience is a strong fit.

  • Availability, timing, and volume of work in 2027 depend entirely on project needs.

Compensation:

The compensation rate is expected to be $100 – $200/hour, depending on scope of work.

What Selected Consultants May Be Asked to Do:

Depending on the specific project need, engaged consultants may be asked to do one or more of the following on a short-term basis:

  • Design and develop training content and materials — for example, curricula, Training-of-Trainers (ToT) manuals, toolkits, micro-learnings, fact sheets, workbooks, desk guides, and screening tools — aligned with adult-learning principles and suited to in-person, virtual, and self-directed formats.

  • Advise on and review training content, including serving as a peer reviewer to assess the accuracy, relevance, and quality of materials.

  • Deliver training in person or virtually, including interactive sessions with case-based problem-solving and Q&A.

  • Update or adapt existing training content to reflect current best practices, terminology, and field needs.

Minimum Qualifications to apply:

  • Bachelor's degree.

  • At least 8 years of professional experience working in the anti-human trafficking space.

  • Recognized subject matter expertise in one or more areas of anti-human trafficking — for example, victim identification and response, prevention, case management, trauma-informed care, labor or sex trafficking, tech-facilitated exploitation, or clinical/healthcare response.

  • Experience developing and/or delivering training or educational content in the anti-human trafficking space, or comparable experience translating subject matter expertise into materials, presentations, or capacity-building for professional audiences.

  • Working knowledge of trauma-informed, person-centered approaches to human trafficking.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with the SOAR (Stop, Observe, Ask, Respond) framework or comparable public-health approaches to human trafficking.

About ICF’s Transportation Line of Business

ICF’s Transportation Line of Business specializes in addressing complex planning, policy, and program issues at the nexus of transportation and the environment, energy, and communities. ICF’s work focuses on integrated approaches that support sustainable transportation decisions, addressing mobility, safety, environmental, social, and economic effects of transportation. Our work includes strategic planning, research, policy analysis, outreach, training, and program evaluation for federal, state, and local governments, including the U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT), state department of transportation, and metropolitan planning organizations (MPOs). We specialize in developing multimodal transportation plans; conducting needs assessments; analyzing transportation system performance data; evaluating the impacts of infrastructure projects, programs, and government policies; developing technical assistance resources; and documenting best practices related to integrated planning, transportation operations, and the environment.

We are seeking a Principal Transportation Planner for ICF’s Transportation Line of Business. A Principal Transportation Planner is responsible for leading teams on state, regional, and local transportation planning projects, as well as work on national-level research and technical assistance efforts. jobs.excerpt: DebtHammer is a dynamic technology startup located in the USA, founded by individuals with experience in working with international remote teams.
jobs.description:
DebtHammer is a dynamic technology startup located in the USA, founded by individuals with experience in working with international remote teams. Our mission is to assist millions of families in breaking free from the payday loan cycle. Each year, 12 million individuals resort to high-interest loans, often becoming trapped in a cycle of perpetual debt. We aim to put an end to this cycle and revolutionize the personal finance industry.

Joining us now presents an exceptional opportunity to play a pivotal role in DebtHammer's growth journey, working closely with the company's founder. Although our team is currently small, we are rapidly expanding.

We are seeking individuals to join our operations team—individuals who are enthusiastic about building a long-term career with us. If you are sales-oriented, possess a customer-first mindset, and aspire to elevate your customer service and sales skills by joining our remote operations team, we encourage you to apply!

Overview
As a Consumer Sales Representative at DebtHammer, your mission is to drive revenue for the company. Your primary responsibility will be engaging with potential customers actively seeking loan relief. We utilize three modes of communication to reach our customers: phone, text, and email. Once engaged, representatives use open-ended questions and active listening to understand the needs of the customer and position DebtHammer as the best solution. It will be your responsibility to ensure that our customers have an amazing experience with DebtHammer and perceive us as the go-to solution for this industry.

Currently, 100% of our customers are inbound, meaning they searched online, found one of our websites, and indicated that they are looking for payday loan relief.

Requirements

  • Must have a minimum of 3 years of solid SALES experience in a call center setting (Non-negotiable requirement).

  • We are seeking candidates with highly effective English communication skills, both written and verbal, to ensure successful collaboration with our diverse team and stakeholders. Fluency close to native-level proficiency is preferred.

  • Must have your own laptop or PC, a high-quality headset, high-speed internet, and a backup connection

  • Must be amenable to working night shifts and overtime

*Please send us a copy of your updated resume that highlights your experience in sales.

Bixal is seeking a Knowledge Management Specialist, Digital Support Operations to help keep a large public-facing federal digital program running smoothly and well documented. You will provide Tier 2 support across a portfolio of websites and applications, manage the queue where program questions and issues arrive, document the business processes the support operation runs on, and establish the process for communicating with users when a service is disrupted. It suits someone who would rather fix the process that generated fifty tickets than close them one at a time.

The program supports a large and diverse community through a broad portfolio of public websites, applications, and learning platforms. When a program question comes in, an interface breaks, or a service goes down, the quality of the response depends on the processes, documentation, and knowledge behind the support operation.

This project supports a large-scale outreach and engagement effort, delivering strategic communications, content and creative services, digital strategy, and audience engagement across public-facing websites, applications, and social media platforms. At Bixal, we support your professional journey, ensuring your experience reflects our inclusive, purpose-driven culture and prepares you for future success.

Location

This role can work remotely from anywhere in the USA. You must be legally authorized to work in the US.  Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $77,000 – $87,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

Support & Service Operations

  • Provide Tier 2 support for online resources, website/interface issues, and program questions.

  • Manage the user request and inquiry queue, including acknowledgment, routing, tracking, and closure.

  • Monitor key digital pages, tools, and functions daily and escalate issues.

  • Maintain the service outage and interruption notification process and keep support content aligned with active incidents.

Process & Knowledge Management

  • Develop and document standardized business processes for staff portals, help desk operations, and user messaging workflows.

  • Run and maintain the link-vetting program, including reviews, SOPs, approvals, reporting, and replacement recommendations.

  • Train staff to submit, use, and maintain knowledge and content.

Content Quality, Findability & Publishing

  • Perform technical editing and proofreading against program standards, AP style, and federal plain-language requirements.

  • Coordinate with information architecture and search specialists on metadata, categorization, retrieval, reuse, tracking, and routing.

  • Contribute to digital publishing operations, including the editorial calendar, recurring publications/newsletters, subscriptions, and audits.

  • Partner with search specialists on staff education around search, findability, and content standards.

Measurement & Continuous Improvement

  • Build and maintain the Tier 2 customer support satisfaction dashboard.

  • Analyze recurring issues, trends, and topics.

  • Translate support data into process improvements and self-service content.

  • Other relevant duties as qualified/trained to perform

Qualifications:

  • Active Secret clearance. An interim Secret is acceptable to start.

  • Bachelor's degree, or equivalent professional experience.

  • At least 4 years in knowledge management, technical writing, documentation development, content operations, or customer support operations.

  • Hands-on experience with an enterprise knowledge base, documentation platform, or content management system.

  • Experience providing tiered customer or program support, working to defined acknowledgment and routing timeframes with a ticketing or case management system, and familiarity with ITIL practices for knowledge management, incident, problem and change.

  • Experience documenting business processes and standard operating procedures used by an operational team.

  • Experience with incident or service-disruption communications — the processes, severity definitions and notice templates that govern how users are told something is broken.

  • Demonstrated ability to draw knowledge out of subject-matter experts, interviewing program and technical staff and turning what they know into documentation someone else can follow.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical or policy material into clear, plain-language content that a non-specialist can act on.

Nice to Have Skills and Experience:

  • ITIL v4 Foundation certification, or willingness to obtain it within 90 days of start.

  • Experience supporting a federal or DoD program, particularly in outreach, communications, or public-facing digital services.

  • Strong editing skills — you can take someone else's draft and make it correct, clear and consistent with a style guide, whether AP or a house guide.

  • Experience turning support or content performance data into reporting that actually changed a process.

  • Experience with enterprise email or subscription publishing platforms.

  • Experience developing training materials and delivering workshops to staff audiences.

How We Support Our Team:

  • 401K with matching incentive

  • Parental Leave

  • Flex Spending Account

  • 11 Paid holidays

Sobre Tendios

👋 Somos Tendios, una startup de rápido crecimiento nacida en 2023 en el corazón de Barcelona. Nuestra misión es revolucionar el mundo de la contratación pública para empresas e instituciones.

Nuestra plataforma SaaS impulsada por inteligencia artificial ayuda a empresas a ganar más licitaciones y a entidades públicas a crear y gestionar licitaciones de forma más eficiente. Trabajamos con entidades como el Principado de Asturias, Renfe, Acciona o Telefónica, entre otras. Lo hacemos a través de dos productos:

  • Tendios Bid— para empresas que participan en licitaciones públicas: buscador, alertas, pipeline de oportunidades y workflows para ganar más concursos.

  • Tendios Create— para organizaciones públicas que crean y publican licitaciones: creación de expedientes y redacción de pliegos asistida por IA.

La IA no es un añadido en nuestros productos: es el núcleo. Redacción asistida, propuestas generadas, análisis automático de documentos y flujos conversacionales están en el centro de la experiencia. Buscamos a alguien que diseñeconesa mentalidad, noalrededorde ella.

Como un equipo joven y ambicioso, valoramos la energía, la creatividad y la colaboración. Si te apasiona la innovación y quieres tener un impacto real, nos encantaría que te unas a nosotros para redefinir cómo las empresas optimizan sus procesos de licitación pública.

El rol

Buscamos a alguien que sea el dueño de producto de todo el ciclo del dato: desde que se captura en la fuente (collectors) hasta que llega al cliente como valor (listas, directorios, análisis de mercado y Tender Intelligence).

Es un rol híbrido: lidera un equipo técnico de scraping/collectors y, al mismo tiempo, define y entrega la capa de producto de analítica de mercado que usan los clientes de Bid. Es un puesto con mucho impacto directo: la calidad del dato condiciona la activación, la retención y la propuesta de valor de Tendios.

Responsabilidades

1. Gestión del equipo de Collectors

  • Liderar y priorizar el trabajo del equipo de collectors (licitaciones, legislación, resoluciones y otras fuentes de contratación pública).

  • Definir el roadmap de cobertura: nuevas fuentes, nuevos países/territorios, nuevos tipos de documento y mayor profundidad de campos.

  • Evaluar la viabilidad y el valor de cada fuente (campos disponibles, frecuencia de actualización, estabilidad, coste de mantenimiento) antes de comprometer trabajo.

  • Gestionar el backlog, el ritmo de entrega y la coordinación con Ingeniería y Data & AI.

  • Garantizar la operación: monitorización de collectors, respuesta ante roturas de fuentes, SLAs de frescura y cobertura.

  • Dar visibilidad al resto de la empresa sobre qué datos tenemos, con qué calidad y qué limitaciones.

2. ETL y Data Quality a nivel de producto

  • Definir qué significa "dato de calidad" para Tendios: completitud, exactitud, consistencia, frescura, deduplicación y normalización.

  • Establecer métricas y umbrales de calidad (por fuente, por país, por campo) y hacerles seguimiento con dashboards y alertas.

  • Priorizar las mejoras del ETL en función del impacto en el producto: enriquecimiento, normalización de entidades (organismos y empresas), clasificación (CPV, tipologías, estados) y resolución de duplicados.

  • Traducir problemas de calidad de dato en impacto de negocio (ruido en alertas, resultados irrelevantes, análisis incorrectos) y escalarlos con criterio.

  • Definir la política de ciclo de vida del dato: estados de licitación, cambios, modificaciones, adjudicaciones y formalizaciones.

  • Ser el punto de referencia para evaluar la readiness de nuevos mercados en términos de calidad y disponibilidad de datos.

3. Producto de analítica de mercado y oportunidades de cliente

  • Ser el dueño de producto de:

    • Analítica interna de las oportunidades de las empresas

Job Description:


AMA seeks to hire two data analysts to support NASA’s Earth Action Program, which leverages Earth science data to address critical societal challenges and enhance decision making across sectors such as health, air quality, and disaster response. Theses positions provide scientific and data analysis support to the Wildland Fires Program and FireSense Project, ensuring effective data analysis, sound scientific reasoning, and trusted data products to advance science-based solutions for wildland fire management and resilience. These opportunities are part-time, remote positions supporting the Earth Action Program as part of the Research, Science, and Engineering Services (RSES) contract. Pay range is $32/hr.-$36/hr.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Evaluating published scientific papers and identify cutting-edge research and key science questions related to NASA Wildland Fires Program and FireSense Project.
  • Supporting data evaluation and analysis to ensure program and project science goals are addressed.
  • Converting NASA collected L0 data into L2 or L3 data products from various sensors.
  • Understanding and incorporating instrument limitations and assumptions in data analysis.
  • Identifying and implementing necessary corrections to data quality control and propagating uncertainties throughout produced products.
  • Supporting collection and organization of field data across the portfolio
  • Supporting development and dissemination of data pipelines and algorithms for NASA facility instrumentation.

Required Qualifications:

  • BS with current graduate studies in earth system science, environmental science, meteorology or related fields.
  • Involvement with NASA Science Activation and NASA GLOBE programs.
  • Experience with PM2.5 small sensors, including building, intercomparing, installation and maintenance, data retrieval, formatting and analysis.
  • Proficiency with air quality data analysis and integration of ground networks and satellite data.
  • Working knowledge of FireSense field campaigns airborne and ground data.
  • Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary teams.
  • Data analysis of spatiotemporal datasets using GIS software.

Required Skills:

  • Accountability and self-discipline to work in a virtual environment.
  • Ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams at varying levels.
  • Strong time management, organizational, written, and verbal skills.
  • Proficiency with scientific software, including Igor Pro, Python, and GIS.
  • Experience with FireSense campaign data, such as MASTER, AVIRIS, and sounding and ground data.
  • Proficiency with instrumentation and tools used by the NASA FireSense program, including air quality small sensors, Graw radiosondes, and hyperspectral imagers.
  • Ability to ingest, process, and analyze spectral data.
  • Ability to work with large datasets in multiple formats and across multiple platforms

Enhancing Qualifications:

● Experience with prescribed fires, including different ignition techniques and ecosystem impacts.

● Wildland Firefighter 2 certifications or beyond.

ICS.AI · Remote (UK), occasional travel to Basingstoke and client sites

Full-time, permanent

Up to £45,000

Keep the roadmap clear, the backlogs ready and AI product delivery moving.

ICS.AI is a UK AI consultancy delivering AI transformation to the public sector, local government, higher education and the wider public estate. Our SMART AI products help organisations improve resident and staff experiences through conversational AI, copilots, automation and intelligent insights.

We are hiring a Product Manager to sit at the operational centre of our product function. You will maintain the combined roadmap and backlogs across the SMART AI product range, turn agreed priorities into well-organised and scheduled work, and keep Product, Delivery and Engineering aligned from refinement through to release.

This is a hands-on coordination and delivery role for someone who enjoys bringing structure to competing priorities. You will not need to own every product decision yourself; you will make sure agreed decisions are translated into clear, buildable work and carried through consistently across products and teams.

What you’ll be doing

  • Maintaining the combined roadmap across SMART AI products and keeping product backlogs ordered against agreed priorities.
  • Facilitating cross-product backlog refinement and sprint planning with Product Specialists.
  • Preparing prioritisation recommendations and carrying agreed decisions through into scheduled work.
  • Checking that work items are complete, estimated and ready before they enter a sprint.
  • Coordinating between Product, Delivery and Engineering, tracking progress and keeping priorities and status aligned.
  • Maintaining and sequencing engineering work queues, with clear visibility of capacity, dependencies and work in progress.
  • Maintaining the shared platform backlog and tracking dependencies between the platform and the products built on it.
  • Coordinating client UAT and tracking work through to release.
  • Producing clear roadmap, progress, queue-status and backlog-health reporting.

What makes this role different

You will work across a connected family of AI products rather than managing a single isolated backlog. The role combines product operations, delivery coordination and practical judgement about GenAI and agentic AI. Your impact will be visible in the quality of the work entering delivery, the flow of work across teams and the clarity of the roadmap for the wider business.

What we’re looking for

We are not screening on a specific degree or qualification. We care about evidence that you can bring structure, judgement and momentum to product delivery:

  • Experience maintaining a product backlog or roadmap in a Product Manager, Product Owner, Business Analyst or similar delivery role within technology, AI or software.
  • A structured and organised approach to competing requests across several products or teams.
  • Confidence working with product, client-facing, delivery and engineering colleagues, including facilitating planning and refinement sessions.
  • Strong attention to detail when reviewing work items, acceptance criteria, estimates and dependencies.
  • A practical understanding of how software is designed, built and released.
  • Working knowledge of GenAI, large language models and agentic AI, sufficient to discuss feasibility and sequencing.
  • Clear written communication and disciplined decision recording.
  • Eligibility to work in the UK. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Azure DevOps Boards, delivery plans or equivalent tooling.
  • Experience with Scrum, Kanban or flow-based work management.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted or agentic software delivery.
  • Experience of SaaS products, cloud platforms or shared platform dependencies.
  • Experience of local government or wider public sector service delivery.

Qualifications and development

Formal qualifications are not required. We support relevant professional development and qualifications that help you grow in the role.

The package

  • Salary up to £45,000.
  • Full-time, permanent role.
  • Remote within the UK, with occasional travel to Basingstoke and client sites.
  • £100 per month working-from-home allowance.
  • Vitality Healthcare Plan.
  • Pension scheme.
  • 25 days’ holiday.
  • Support for relevant professional development and qualifications.

Ready to help shape how AI products move from priority to delivery?

Apply to join ICS.AI and help us keep an ambitious product portfolio clear, coordinated and moving.

Salary: up to £45K

Job Description

The Associate Director, US Oncology Payer Market Access will work closely with cross functional teams, alliance partners, agency partners, internal brand colleagues, promotions, internal communications, pricing, policy, legal, health economics outcomes research, and Organized Customer Access and Reimbursement teams to inform the strategies to support the alliances and our product, including current indications and future launches. This role will report to the Director, Oncology Market Access – Orals & Alliances


The Associate Director, US Oncology Payer/Market Access will be responsible for supporting Brand products tactical execution and development of strategy in support of oncology medicines, including collaborations with outside pharmaceutical partners in oncology and critical internal functions (Organized Customer Access and Reimbursement, Marketing, Integrated Account Management Teams, Center for Observational and Real-world Evidence (CORE), Medical Affairs, etc.). This role will support one of our alliance products and one new product. This role will focus on collaborating with brand teams, internal and partner alliance market access and related functions, agency partners and focus on customer segments (e.g. health plans, Medicare, Medicaid, federal, pharmacy, hospital, GPO, etc.). It will also manage early access planning for our product, contributing to projects on list pricing, lifecycle gross to net, discount/contracting assumptions, IRA legislation impacts, site of care considerations, and value messaging for payers and providers.


Primary Responsibilities

  • Work closely with alliance partners, our Company's internal functions (promotions, communications, medical affairs, brand marketing, etc.) and external agency partners to develop customer specific strategies and execute as appropriate to achieve access for patients and achieve business growth.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and alliance partners to support development of comprehensive payer/ market access strategies and execute across the partnership and for oncology medicines. This is related to current and future indications and must be aligned to the brand marketing objectives.
  • Input into development and execution of payer value propositions, channel specific strategies and branded promotional initiatives.
  • Act as main point responsible and accountable for resource support, on-going planning around messaging, and communications for field facing teams at our Company (e.g. Oncology Sales Teams, Key Accounts, etc.)
  • Provide input from US perspective into Global Access Teams, new product planning teams, Health Economics and Outcomes Research and business development opportunities as they emerge.
  • Work cross-functionally within our Company, including Organized Customer Access and Reimbursement, Market Research, policy team, Global Market Access, Health Economics and Outcomes Research , compliance, legal, pricing and others to understand build a value proposition for collaboration oncology medicines that allow for access and reimbursement that is consistent with label.
  • Support alliance and new product forecasting discussions as necessary
  • Understand impact of costs on patient including OOP associated with mono and combo therapies, within both pharmacy and medical benefits.

Education Minimum Requirements

  • Required: Bachelor's degree (BA/BS)
  • Preferred: Master's degree (MBA)

Required Experience and Skills

  • Minimum of (5) years combined experience in Pharmaceutical Marketing, Marketing Customer Management, Managed Care or Sales
  • Demonstrated strategic thinking, problem solving, analytical critical thinking and planning skills.
  • Proactive nature and ability to manage change, anticipate risks, and design controls or mitigation
  • Excellent leadership and communication skills (written & verbal).
  • Proficient at leading across department and roles and effectively engaging senior management.
  • Strong judgment, prioritization, and decision - making skills, with understanding of broader context of corporate strategies
  • Comfort and confidence in working with teams and backgrounds; routinely demonstrates inclusive behaviors; actively seeks out perspectives and experiences
  • Demonstrated understanding of healthcare trends and policy issues around both pharmacy and medical benefits and their potential impact upon the company's business opportunities.

Preferred Experience and Skills

  • Associate Director level of Marketing or Managed Care/Payer Marketing experience
  • Experience in Oncology/Oncology Payer/ Market access for oral oncology medicines
  • Experience working in alliances and collaborations with external partners
  • Digital promotion experience

Position location: Upper Gwynedd, PA (Hybrid work model) OR Remote

Analytical Thinking, Market Access, Market Research, Oncology Marketing, Payer Marketing, Pharmaceuticals Marketing, Product Marketing, Strategic Alliances, Strategic Thinking

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT ROCKET MONEY 🔮Financial security shouldn’t be a privilege.
jobs.description:
ABOUT ROCKET MONEY 🔮

Financial security shouldn’t be a privilege. Yet, Americans carry $1.26 trillion in credit card debt¹, nearly one in four has no emergency savings², and only 46% of households reported retirement-account savings³. Rocket Money's mission is to meaningfully improve people's financial prosperity for millions of people.

Few companies combine Rocket Money’s reach, member trust, and understanding of people’s financial lives. Our vision: money that works for you, without making you work for it. With advances in automation and AI, we can go beyond helping members understand their finances to helping them improve their financial health, paying down debt, saving and growing their money automatically.⁠

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to build a new investing product from 0→1, then grow and scale it into a core part of Rocket Money’s future. With end-to-end ownership and direct access to senior leadership, you’ll have the reach of an established platform, the impact of a small team, and the opportunity to improve millions of financial lives.

ABOUT THE ROLE 🤹‍♀️

You’ll lead a small, decisive product team with engineering and UX to build a new investing product from 0→1, find product-market fit, and grow it into a sustainable part of our business. Together, you’ll uncover meaningful member needs, test the hardest assumptions, and build a simple, trustworthy experience. You’ll shape product direction, make clear prioritization decisions, and own outcomes from discovery through launch and scale.

The opportunity goes beyond launching another product: you’ll help make Rocket Money a place members turn to not just to manage today’s finances, but to build their financial future. What you build will give members new reasons to stay and grow with us, and help shape Rocket Money’s next chapter.

This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the Group Product Manager, Financial Products, with close partnership with the Vice President of Financial Products and senior leadership. You’ll collaborate with engineering, design, data, operations, marketing, finance, legal, compliance, and external financial partners. You’ll pair strategic judgment with hands-on execution—from roadmap and discovery to integrations and activation and retention analysis. Success means building a product members value and a business that grows, not simply shipping features.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🛠️

Find the Right Problem and Define the Strategy 🎯

  • Build a deep understanding of our members' financial lives, goals, and unmet needs through customer research, behavioral data, and market insights
  • Define who we're building for first, why they'll choose Rocket Money, and how the product fits into their broader financial journey
  • Develop an evidence-backed product strategy, clear priorities, and what not to build

Build and Launch a New Product 🚀

  • Define a focused MVP and lead development from discovery and prototyping through launch; make thoughtful trade-offs between speed, scope, quality, and risk
  • Partner with design and engineering to test the riskiest assumptions before committing to a full build
  • Shape the end-to-end member experience, from discovering the product and getting started to using it regularly and understanding its value
  • Work with operations, marketing, and support to make launch readiness more than a release date: clear education, reliable workflows, and phased rollout

Own the Financial Product Experience End-to-End 🤝

  • Work as a product trio with engineering and UX to identify meaningful customer problems, test solutions, and build great products. Bring an end-to-end ownership mindset—from discovery through launch and iteration—with accountability for quality and outcomes
  • Work with cross-functional partners and senior leadership across design, engineering, marketing, fraud, operations, and legal to turn complex financial workflows into simple experiences, making day-to-day decisions about scope, behavior, and trade-offs

Grow and Scale the Product 📈

  • Own outcomes beyond launch: activation, engagement, retention, and business growth; define measures that reflect genuine member value, not just usage
  • Identify the biggest barriers to adoption and ongoing value; partner with design, engineering, marketing, and lifecycle teams to test and scale improvements
  • Instrument the experience, analyze funnels and cohorts, and combine experiments with qualitative feedback to decide what to improve, scale, or stop
  • Keep the team and leadership aligned on what we're learning, what is changing, and why

ABOUT YOU 🦄

  • Product builder. Proven track record owning the full product lifecycle—from identifying a customer problem through discovery, design, development, launch, and iteration—delivering high-quality experiences and measurable business results.
  • 0→1 impact. You’ve built new products from scratch: turning an ambiguous opportunity into a clear proposition, testing the riskiest assumptions, defining a focused MVP, and iterating with early customers toward product-market fit.
  • Financial products experience & curiosity. You’ve built consumer financial products in a regulated environment and are passionate about improving people’s financial lives. You bring experience without assuming you have all the answers—staying curious, testing assumptions, and learning from customers and new evidence.
  • Outstanding intellectual ability. You learn quickly, synthesize complex information into clear decisions, and update your thinking as evidence changes.
  • Product sense & customer understanding. You uncover needs through research and data, simplify complex experiences, and know what to build — and what not to.
  • Strategic & analytical thinking. You turn customer insights, product data, and business economics into clear priorities, even with incomplete information.
  • Communication & cross-functional leadership. You communicate clearly, build alignment, navigate disagreement, and lead teams to deliver without formal authority.
  • Technical fluency. You work confidently with engineering on APIs, integrations, and edge cases to make sound product trade-offs.
  • AI fluency & curiosity. You’re excited about where AI is headed and already use AI tools every day to learn faster and ship faster. You know when to lean on them and when to apply your own judgment, expertise, and taste to make sound product decisions.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 🎯

  • Experience building investing products
  • Experience working at a fast-growing startup

WE OFFER 💫

  • Health, Dental & Vision Plans
  • Life Insurance
  • Long/Short Term Disability
  • Competitive Pay
  • 401k Matching
  • Team Member Stock Purchasing Program (TMSPP)
  • Learning & Development Opportunities
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Daily Lunch, Snacks & Coffee (in-office only)
  • Commuter benefits (in-office only)

Additional information: Salary range of $150,000 - $190,000/year + bonus + benefits. Base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

With our unparalleled collection of more than 65 billion records, over 3.5 million subscribers, and over 27 million people in our growing DNA network, customers can discover their family story and gain a new level of understanding about their lives. Together, we work every day to foster a work environment that's inclusive as well as diverse, and where our people can be themselves. Every idea and perspective is valued so that our products and services reflect the global and diverse clients we serve.

Ancestry encourages applications from minorities, women, the disabled, protected veterans and all other qualified applicants. Passionate about dedicating your work to enriching people’s lives? Join the curious.

Ancestry seeks a part-time contractor Content Writer who is passionate about family history and storytelling to join our Contextual Content team. The Contextual Content team works to bring pioneering technology, historical records, and curated contextual content together in order to empower others in researching and telling their story.

As a Content Writer you will work closely with the Editor and Program Manager in a collaborative process to complete writing assignments for the Contextual Content team. A critical element of success for this position is ensuring that the tone and style of the final product is aligned with Ancestry’s standards. Australia Subject Matter Expertise

The ideal candidate should have specialized expertise in Australian history and genealogy, including knowledge of Australian historical records, family history research, and record availability. They should also understand Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander history and records to create culturally sensitive, accurate, and informative collection descriptions that help users navigate Australian genealogy resources.

This position is a part-time contract-based and is not eligible for Ancestry benefits.

  • Ensure each assignment follows: the style guidelines, is consistent in quality and tone, complies with department goals and values, and demonstrates audience awareness.
  • Ensure presented facts and information are supported by thorough research.
  • Consistently complete all writing assignments by submission deadlines.
  • Provide status updates and reports to the Editor and the Program Manager as requested.

  • Prefer degree in history, English, journalism, or related field or equivalent professional writing experience.
  • Experience writing about historical events.
  • Experience writing about sensitive topics
  • Background in African American studies, Latin American studies, Native American studies, Asian American studies, American studies, British studies, French studies, European studies, or Australian studies.

  • Strong internet and research skills.
  • Attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Demonstrated self-starter.
  • Background in family history.

About the job


The Rare Hematology Area Business Manager (ABM) - Hematology/Oncology will contribute to the continued growth of AYVAKIT and WAYRILZ, build markets to help patients with systemic mastocytosis (SM) and immune thrombocytopenia (ITP).

This is a specialty-dedicated sales role with primary responsibility for hematology/oncology customers within the assigned territory. This individual will be a product and disease-state expert responsible for building long-term relationships with hematology/oncology physicians and account and executing against territory and business priorities.

The Area Business Manager will report to the Regional Business Director and be a key member of an efficient, effective, and highly collaborative Rare Hematology field team.

Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you’ll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

About Sanofi:


We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world and are supported and enhanced through our diverse portfolio of medical device and diagnostic products. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Main Responsibilities:


Territory Management & Hematology/Oncology Customer Engagement

  • Own sales execution for the hematology/oncology customer segment within the assigned territory, with responsibility for AYVAKIT and WAYRILZ performance across prioritized specialists and accounts
  • Effectively identify and engage hematologist/oncologists, and broader care team members that are key decision makers for providing treatment and conduct customer meetings within assigned territory using approved resources and messaging
  • Build relationships and manage accounts by engaging a variety of healthcare stakeholders, including physicians, advanced practice providers, nursing, pharmacy and practice leadership.
  • Apply deep therapeutic, product, and healthcare market expertise to drive compliant customer engagement, business planning, and actionable field insights

Kinsta is one of the top providers of managed hosting for WordPress, with a growing club of 120,000+ businesses including startups, universities, and Fortune 500 firms. We're motivated by excellent quality and proud to have received a 97% satisfaction rating from our customers.

We are looking for a motivated Account Manager in the Asia-Pacific region who will be responsible for managing existing client accounts and generating additional revenue by working with customers on upselling, cross-selling, and retention. This is a post-sale, client-facing role, and the Account Manager is a quota-carrying contributor.
Account managers will work with a dedicated group of clients (known as their book of business) for the entirety of the client's time at Kinsta to help achieve the client’s goals and represent Kinsta in non-technical support customer interactions. Account managers are also tasked with retaining the client’s business and growing these accounts through upsells and cross-sells.
An ideal candidate is someone who is proactive and has a knack for building relationships. Also, someone who is tech-savvy, process-driven, and loves the thrill of seeking out additional revenue and closing deals!

What You Will Do:

  • Own and manage a book of business
  • Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for clients, maintain client satisfaction, handle account upsells/cross-sells, and help clients strategize on getting the most from Kinsta’s offerings.
  • Identify the health and overall satisfaction of each account in your book of business in order to pinpoint at-risk clients and improve retention rates.
  • Spearhead a process-driven sales approach to seek additional revenue opportunities within your book of business
  • Become a specialist on Kinsta’s services and solutions, the benefits they provide, and their value to our customers.
  • Become knowledgeable about the market competition in order to retain and upsell clients.
  • Coordinate with internal Departments to resolve problems and provide service.
  • Maintain strong relationships with your book of business, including regular account reviews and communication to ensure they are deriving maximum value.
  • Develop growth strategies to increase your book of business
  • Provide timely and accurate deal updates to management and executives on a regular basis. Identify product and process improvements through conversations with clients
  • Assist other Account Managers daily to achieve team quota success.
  • Meet (or exceed!) revenue and retention targets.
  • Build, maintain, and close pipeline to consistently exceed quota.
  • Meet or exceed all of your daily and monthly Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  • Position our company's capabilities and value proposition to resolve customer concerns or objections around Kinsta’s services.
  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date information on customers and deals within HubSpot CRM.
  • Make effective and efficient use of our sales engineers to educate customers and help them make informed buying decisions.

What You Bring To The Role:

  • A minimum of 3 years of previous SaaS Sales or Account Management experience
  • Proven ability to juggle multiple account management projects at a time while maintaining sharp attention to detail.
  • Experience up-selling, cross-selling, and renegotiating contracts
  • Tech-savvy, with a strong interest in technology.
  • Near-native proficiency in English and exceptional writing skills.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.

Bonus if you have:

  • Prior knowledge of the hosting industry.
  • Outbound sales experiance.

Our Benefits:

  • Flexible and remote-first environment.
  • Annual remote expense budget.
  • Flexible PTO.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • Annual professional development budget: available after one year with Kinsta.
  • Sabbatical: available after three years with Kinsta (and every three years thereafter).
  • Location-specific healthcare benefits (includes vision and dental) for employees hired in the USA, UK and Hungary.
  • Pension plan for employees hired in the UK, and 401k contributions for employees hired in the USA.

Role: Design Assurance Quality Engineer – New Product Development

It takes great people to achieve greatness. People with a sense of purpose and integrity. People with a relentless pursuit of excellence. Join our top-notch team of approximately 43,500 diverse and high-performing professionals globally who are making their mark on some of the world’s most beloved brands, including DEWALT®, BLACK+DECKER®, CRAFTSMAN®, STANLEY®, CUB CADET®, and HUSTLER®.

The Job:

The Design Assurance Quality Engineer supports new product development activities by ensuring quality is built into product design, development, system, verification, validation, and launch processes. This role partners cross-functionally with engineering, R&D, manufacturing, sourcing, and regulatory/compliance teams to identify risks early, implement robust controls, and ensure new products meet customer, business, and applicable quality requirements.

The position plays a key role in design quality planning and strategy, risk management, design reviews, and verification and validation support.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Act as the Quality subject matter expert within cross-functional New Product Development (NPD) teams.
  • Embed quality requirements throughout the product development lifecycle, from concept through commercialization.
  • Lead quality planning activities, including Design Quality Plans, Control Plans, inspection strategies, and defect prevention initiatives.
  • Drive risk management through DFMEA, PFMEA, hazard analysis, FRACA, and robust mitigation planning.
  • Facilitate design and process reviews, ensuring quality, reliability, and customer requirements are built into product designs.
  • Develop and execute verification and validation strategies to ensure products meet critical-to-quality (CTQ) requirements.
  • Partner with Engineering, Manufacturing, and Supplier Quality teams to ensure successful design transfer and production readiness.
  • Lead structured problem-solving, root cause analysis, and corrective actions during product development and launch.
  • Ensure compliance with internal quality systems, industry standards, APQP requirements, and change control processes.
  • Use data, statistical methods, and lessons learned to monitor quality performance and drive continuous improvement across NPD projects

The Person:

You love to learn and grow and be acknowledged for your valuable contributions. You’re not intimidated by innovation. In fact, you embrace it. Wouldn’t it be great if you could do your job and do a world of good? You also have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, or related technical discipline.
  • Demonstrable experience in quality engineering, design assurance, new product development and well-established NPD systems.
  • Proven experience driving Continuous Improvement initiatives using Lean Six Sigma or equivalent quality methodologies
  • Experience using quality and product data systems such as Minitab, PLM, ERP, or QMS platforms.
  • Knowledge of APQP, PPAP, design controls, and product lifecycle management processes.
  • ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), Lean Six Sigma, or similar certification.
  • Effective English written and verbal communication skills

The Details:

We want our company to be a place you’ll want to be – and stay. Being part of our team means you’ll get to:

Grow:Be part of our global company with 20+ brands to grow and develop your skills along multiple career paths.

Learn:Have access to a wealth of learning resources, including our digital learning portal.

Belong:Experience an awesome place to work, where we have mutual respect and a great appreciation for a wide range of perspectives and experiences.

Give Back:Help us continue to make positive changes locally and globally through volunteerism, giving back, and sustainable business practices.

What’s more, you’ll get that pride that comes from empowering makers, doers, protectors, and everyday heroes all over the world. We’re more than the #1 tools company. More than a driving force in outdoor power equipment. More than a global leader in industrial. We’re visionaries and innovators. As successful as we’ve been in the past, we have so much further to go. That’s where you come in. Join us!

#Remote

We Don’t Just Build The World, We Build Innovative Technology Too.

Joining the Stanley Black & Decker team means working in an innovative, tech-driven and highly collaborative team environment supported by over 43,500 professionals in 60 countries across the globe. Here, you’ll get the unique chance to impact some of the world’s most iconic brands including STANLEY TOOLS, DEWALT, CRAFTSMAN, MAC TOOLS and Black + Decker. Your ideas and solutions have the potential to reach millions of customers as we work together to write the next chapter in our history. Come build with us and take your career to new heights.

We’re the World’s largest tool company. We’re industry visionaries. We’re solving problems and advancing the manufacturing trade through innovative technology and our Industry 4.0 Initiative. We are committed to ensuring our state-of-the-art “smart factory” products and services provide greater quality to our customers & greater environmental and social value to our planet. We are unique in that we have a rich and storied history dating back to 1843, but that hasn't stopped us from evolving into a vibrant, diverse, global growth company.
