Ben jij commercieel ingesteld en weet je vertrouwen op te bouwen bij potentiële investeerders?
Wil je als zelfstandige zelf bepalen wanneer en hoe je werkt?
En lijkt het je interessant om klanten mee te nemen in het verhaal van investeren in bouwgronden in de Ardennen?

Dan is deze commerciële uitdaging iets voor jou.

Over de klant

Onze klant is gespecialiseerd in de verkoop van bouw- en villagronden in de Ardennen en begeleidt investeerders gedurende het volledige aankooptraject. Met jarenlange ervaring en een uitgebreid aanbod ligt de focus op een persoonlijke aanpak: van het eerste contact en het bepalen van de investeringswensen tot het bezoeken van geschikte gronden en het afronden van de aankoop.

Voor de verdere groei zijn we op zoek naar een zelfstandige Sales Professional die actief klanten in Vlaanderen weet te vinden en hen warm maakt voor een investering in de Ardennen.

Wat houdt de functie in?

  • Je gaat actief op zoek naar potentiële klanten in Vlaanderen die interesse hebben in vastgoed en investeringen in de Ardennen.

  • Je bouwt zelfstandig een netwerk van potentiële investeerders op en onderhoudt bestaande contacten.

  • Je voert gesprekken met geïnteresseerde klanten en brengt hun wensen, budget en investeringsdoelstellingen in kaart.

  • Je begeleidt potentiële kopers persoonlijk en legt helder uit welke mogelijkheden er zijn binnen het aanbod van bouw- en villagronden.

  • Je gaat samen met klanten naar de Ardennen om geschikte projecten en bouwgronden te bekijken en zorgt ervoor dat zij een duidelijk beeld krijgen van hun mogelijke investering.

  • Je volgt het volledige verkoopproces op, van eerste kennismaking tot offerte en uiteindelijke deal.

  • Je bouwt vertrouwen op gedurende het traject en zorgt ervoor dat klanten met een goed gevoel een beslissing kunnen nemen.

  • Je werkt nauw samen met het team om klanten correct te begeleiden en dossiers succesvol af te ronden.

Wat verwachten we van jou?

  • Je bent commercieel ingesteld en krijgt energie van prospectie, klantencontact en het sluiten van deals.

  • Je bent ondernemend en vindt het vanzelfsprekend om zelf actief op zoek te gaan naar nieuwe klanten.

  • Je bent communicatief sterk en kunt mensen op een professionele en overtuigende manier meenemen in een verhaal.

  • Je weet vertrouwen op te bouwen en begrijpt dat de aankoop van vastgoed een beslissing is waarbij persoonlijke begeleiding belangrijk is.

  • Je hebt interesse in vastgoed en investeringen; ervaring binnen vastgoed, financiële dienstverlening of een andere commerciële omgeving is een sterke troef.

  • Je werkt zelfstandig, neemt initiatief en kunt je eigen agenda en klantenportefeuille efficiënt beheren.

  • Je beschikt over een rijbewijs B en bent bereid om samen met potentiële klanten naar de Ardennen te rijden.

  • Je bent bereid om op zelfstandige basis te werken en ziet flexibiliteit als een belangrijk voordeel.

Wat betekent dit voor jou?

  • Je werkt volledig op zelfstandige basis en bepaalt zelf wanneer je werkt en hoe je jouw agenda organiseert.

  • Je krijgt de vrijheid om je commerciële activiteit op jouw manier uit te bouwen, zonder vaste kantooruren.

  • Je werkt met een concreet en tastbaar product: bouw- en villagronden in de Ardennen.

  • Je krijgt de kans om een eigen klantenportefeuille en netwerk uit te bouwen en rechtstreeks impact te hebben op je verkoopresultaten.

  • Je wordt ondersteund door een ervaren organisatie en kunt rekenen op de nodige informatie en ondersteuning tijdens het verkoopproces.

  • Je begeleidt klanten persoonlijk en bent betrokken bij het volledige traject, waardoor je dicht bij de uiteindelijke deal staat.

  • Je werkt in een markt waarin de interesse van Vlaamse investeerders in de Ardennen aanwezig is en waarin vastgoed en tweede verblijven een belangrijke rol spelen.

  • Je inkomsten zijn gekoppeld aan je commerciële resultaten, waardoor je als zelfstandige rechtstreeks kunt profiteren van je eigen succes.

Floowi connects top LATAM professionals with leading U.S. companies through remote talent solutions. Our mission is to make LATAM the world’s premier hub for growth and excellence.

🌟 About our Client:

Our client is a brand incubator that develops and cultivates original brands in-house, with a focus on emerging trends and disrupting traditional markets. Its operating model combines brand development with cross-functional collaboration to create strong customer experiences.

✍ Short Description:

The Media Buyer will execute and optimize paid advertising campaigns across key platforms, with a strong emphasis on hands-on campaign management in Meta and TikTok. This role is responsible for campaign setup, day-to-day monitoring, testing, budget tracking, and performance analysis, using metrics such as ROAS, CPA, and CTR to identify optimization opportunities. The ideal candidate will work closely with creative teams to develop and test platform-specific ad assets while using performance data to improve campaign results. The role requires an execution-focused approach, strong analytical skills, and a willingness to stay current with evolving advertising platforms and trends.

🌎 Location: 100% Remote (LATAM only)

🗣 Language Requirements: Advanced English (C1+)

⏰ Schedule: Full-time, aligned with EST

😀 Start Date: ASAP

💰 Compensation & Benefits:

  • Competitive salary in USD

  • Remote-first flexibility. Work from anywhere.

  • PTO and paid U.S. holidays

💼 Responsibilities:

  • Set up and execute paid advertising campaigns across Meta, TikTok, Google Ads, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.

  • Monitor campaigns on a day-to-day basis, track budgets, and optimize performance against KPIs such as ROAS, CPA, CTR, and conversion performance.

  • Conduct A/B testing across creatives, audiences, and landing pages to identify opportunities for improved campaign performance.

  • Work closely with creative teams on ad copy, static creatives, video assets, and platform-specific creative best practices.

  • Use Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, Google Analytics, Shopify, and native advertising dashboards to analyze performance and provide actionable insights.

  • Monitor platform updates, algorithm changes, industry trends, and competitor activity to identify new testing and optimization opportunities.

💡 Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of experience in social media advertising or media buying, particularly for e-commerce CPG brands.

  • Hands-on expertise managing campaigns in Meta Ads Manager and TikTok Ads Manager, with experience across Google Ads and YouTube.

  • Demonstrated experience managing advertising budgets and optimizing campaigns for performance metrics such as ROAS, CPA, and CTR.

  • Proficiency with analytics tools including Google Analytics, Shopify, and advertising platform dashboards.

  • Strong understanding of full-funnel advertising strategies for e-commerce and CPG.

  • Experience collaborating with creative teams on ad copy, visual assets, video content, creative testing, and platform-specific best practices.

  • Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and time-management skills, with the ability to work independently and adapt to changing platform trends.

  • Meta or Google Ads certification, familiarity with complementary channels such as email, SMS, or push notifications, and experience with seasonal campaigns or CPG product launches are preferred.

jobs.title: Strategic Alliance Lead - Director
jobs.excerpt: Strategic Alliance Lead (Associate Director or Director) Location(s) – Europe (UK, France or Belgium) or United States (East Coast) Do you get more energy from building something than from maintaining it?
jobs.description:
Strategic Alliance Lead (Associate Director or Director)

Location(s) – Europe (UK, France or Belgium) or United States (East Coast)

Do you get more energy from building something than from maintaining it? Can you sit across the table from a global pharma executive one day and roll your sleeves up with a project team the next? Ready to own a strategically relationship in our business, and write the playbook as you go, rather than inherit someone else's?

At Cerba Research, we are committed to finding the best talent to join our team. We have partnered with Vector Talent to manage the recruitment process for this role. If you're interested in applying, please direct all applications and questions to Vector Talent.

Cerba Research is looking for a Strategic Alliance Lead to take ownership of our most strategic partnerships, preferred-provider relationships, and sole-source alliances across Central and Specialty Laboratory Services. This is a build role: you'll be the executive and operational bridge between Cerba Research and our most important partners; designing the governance, framework, and cross-functional alignment that doesn't fully exist yet, while elevating the team around you into a more strategic way of working.

About Cerba Research

With over 40 years of clinical research expertise, Cerba Research has built a unique offering of services, which includes clinical trial management, specialty lab & biomarkers services and medical devices & diagnostics offerings.

Cerba Research supports clients from research and development all the way through clinical studies and commercialization of therapies. We combine the deep therapeutic understanding and agility of a specialist with the capacity, breadth and global reach of a central lab.

Our extensive experience in central & specialty laboratory services is key to our success, allowing us to provide clients with early scientific insights that optimize protocol development.

We provide key laboratory services to biopharma, government and not-for-profit organizations, supporting clinical trials. Our global accredited laboratory network and connected logistical infrastructure covers the US, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Australia and Africa.

Our aim is to transform clinical research to deliver the promise of precision and predictive medicine to help people live healthier lives. It's our passion, expertise, and commitment to quality that drive Cerba Research. We want to change the shape of clinical development, and help patients around the world get access to new treatments faster.

Why Join Us?

  • Real Ownership, From Day One – You'll be the named executive lead for a landmark strategic partnership generating multi-million-dollar bookings today, with a clear path to significantly more as the relationship expands.
  • A True Blank Slate – This isn't a role you're inheriting, you're building the governance framework, the relationship model, and the playbook that Cerba Research will use for its most important partnerships going forward.
  • Executive Access – You'll operate at the level of global pharma procurement, vendor management, and clinical leadership.
  • Global Reach, Real Impact – Join a business with 40+ years of clinical research heritage and a global accredited laboratory network spanning the US, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Australia and Africa.

How You Will Add Value

As Strategic Alliance Lead, you will contribute to:

  • Owning strategic alliance leadership across Cerba Research's highest-value partnerships, sole-source relationships, and preferred-provider agreements
  • Building and running the governance model - QBRs, executive steering committees, escalation pathways; from the ground up
  • Acting as the voice of the customer internally and the voice of Cerba Research externally, translating what each side actually needs into action
  • Driving strategic account growth - new services, new therapeutic areas, and expanded scope, in partnership with Commercial leadership
  • Coaching and elevating the existing portfolio oversight team into a more strategic, alliance-first way of working

Your Responsibilities

  • Serve as the designated executive and operational lead for assigned strategic partners, sole-source relationships, and preferred-provider agreements
  • Lead the implementation and onboarding of newly signed strategic partnerships, coordinating cross-functional readiness and governance structures
  • Monitor and ensure compliance with MSA commitments, service levels, and contractual obligations - proactively identifying and closing gaps
  • Define, track, and report KPIs including study award rates, turnaround time, quality indicators, and customer satisfaction, translating them into executive-ready insight
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Procurement, Vendor Management, Clinical Operations, and Executive Leadership
  • Lead resolution of complex operational, quality, or commercial issues affecting strategic partners, coordinating cross-functional teams to close them out
  • Develop and maintain Strategic Alliance Plans covering stakeholder mapping, growth targets, competitive positioning, and expansion opportunities

Travel:

Significant in the early phase of this role, as you build relationships and governance structures in person across our labs and our partners' sites. This typically settles to around 30% once a quarterly governance cadence is established.

Requirements

About You

You've owned a strategic alliance relationship in CRO or central/specialty lab services from the point it was awarded. You're as comfortable in the detail with a project team as you are across the table from a senior procurement or clinical leader. You'd rather build the framework than be handed one.

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Business Administration, Clinical Research, or a related field (advanced degree preferred)
  • Minimum 5 years in strategic account management, alliance management, or business operations within CRO, central laboratory, or a related life sciences environment, lab alliance experience preferred, CRO alliance experience essential
  • Demonstrated experience owning a strategic partnership, preferred-provider agreement, or sole-source relationship end to end
  • Comfortable operating in a heavily matrixed organization. You’re able to influence delivery teams and senior leadership in both directions without formal authority over either
  • Executive-level stakeholder engagement experience, ideally including pharma procurement or vendor management
  • A genuine interest in mentorship and team development, this role includes elevating the capability of the wider team
  • Fluent in English

At Cerba HealthCare, we believe that the diversity of people, backgrounds, and perspectives is an essential asset in fulfilling our mission: to improve the health of everyone, everywhere.

We are committed to providing an inclusive work environment that guarantees equal opportunities for everyone, regardless of age, background, sexual orientation, disability, or any other personal characteristic. All talented individuals are encouraged to apply.

jobs.description:
Pak jij de kans om samen met twee collega's te ondernemen in een groeiende technische detachering? Bij SD Worx Technics ga je vakspecialisten verbinden aan een opdracht waarin zij echt het verschil maken. Je krijgt hierin volop de vrijheid, het vertrouwen en de verantwoordelijkheid om impact te maken: op klanten, op technici én op je eigen carrière.

Jij zorgt voor de perfecte match en begeleiding gedurende het gehele proces. Jij bent dé specialist die precies weet wat er speelt in de technische sector. Jij weet op de juiste manier technici te benaderen en te overtuigen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Recruiter Techniek ben je de spil tussen onze technici en opdrachtgevers. Jij weet hoe je de beste technici binnenhaalt en samen met je collega plaatst bij je klanten. Vanzelfsprekend bouw je aan je relaties met je kandidaten. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden zijn:

· Recruitment: je bouwt aan je kandidatenpool met de beste technici. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan elektromonteurs, maintenance engineers, servicetechnici en werktuigbouwkundige.

· Technici en opdrachtgevers matchen: Ook na het matchen blijf je de eerste contactpersoon van zowel de klant, als de begeleider van je kandidaat gedurende de opdracht.

· Targets behalen: Je werkt toe naar het behalen van jouw persoonlijke doelstellingen. Dit omvat zowel kwantitatieve als kwalitatieve targets.

· Netwerk verder uitbouwen: Je gaat zelfstandig actief opzoek naar nieuwe opdrachtgevers.

Wat bieden wij?

SD Worx Technics heeft een informele werksfeer waarin gestuurd wordt op output. Er is veel ruimte voor eigen inbreng en initiatieven. We bieden jou de vrijheid en flexibiliteit om de regie over je werk in handen te nemen. Zo krijg je de ruimte voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling. Je kunt rekenen op:

  • Een salaris tussen de €2900,- en €4500,- bruto op basis van 40 uur afhankelijk van ervaring

  • Een netto onkostenvergoeding van €75,- en een netto internetvergoeding van €25,- op basis van 40 uur

  • Leaseauto die je ook privé mag gebruiken

  • Een kwartaalbonusregeling

  • 8,5% vakantiegeld

  • 25 vakantiedagen, 6,5 adv dagen (of 2,5% extra salaris) & een vrije dag op je verjaardag

  • Een pensioenregeling waarbij SD Worx 60% van de premie betaald

  • Korting op je sportschool abonnement en op een nieuwe fiets

Wat neem jij mee?

Als Recruiter Techniek is het van belang dat je een commerciële drive hebt. Het gaat om een zelfstandige functie die vraagt om proactiviteit. We zoeken daarbij iemand met:

  • Hbo werk- en denkniveau

  • Ervaring in de technische sector en/of detachering

  • Resultaatgerichtheid en ervaring met het behalen van individuele en teamtargets

  • Klantgerichtheid en sterke communicatieve vaardigheden

  • Oog voor de marktontwikkelingen en deze weet te vertalen naar kansen voor kandidaten

Technics

SD Worx Technics is een specialist in het matchen van technische vakmensen met uitdagende projecten. Wij bieden een persoonlijke benadering en leveren maatwerkoplossingen voor zowel onze klanten als onze medewerkers. Onze cultuur is open en informeel, met veel ruimte voor ondernemerschap en innovatie. Bij ons staan kwaliteit, betrokkenheid en integriteit centraal.

Bij SD Worx werken we als één team en groeien we samen, van beter tot best. Diversiteit staat centraal in ons bedrijf, omdat het ons inspireert en innovatie stimuleert. We verwelkomen sollicitaties van gekwalificeerd talent, ongeacht afkomst, nationaliteit, geslacht, huidskleur, etnische en sociale achtergrond, religie, leeftijd, handicap, seksuele geaardheid en levensfase.

Hier kun je volop groeien, leren en innoveren. Join the team en ervaar het zelf!

As a People Generalist at PVcase, you will be responsible for ensuring the smooth and efficient functioning of a broader range of People services and processes across the employee lifecycle.   • Partner with People Business Partners to provide support, address employee concerns and conflicts, and work toward fair resolutions, ultimately fostering a positive and inclusive work environment.

  • Generate and analyze People Operations reports and metrics to identify trends and insights. Utilize this data to drive informed decision-making, contribute to People strategies, and ensure data accuracy.

  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of local, state, and federal employment laws and regulations, ensuring proactive compliance and assisting in the development, communication, and consistent enforcement of company policies.

Requirements

  • Experience working with cross-border teams, with a strong emphasis on Lithuanian. Dutch and German jurisdiction experience is a huge plus.

  • Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships and influence stakeholders.

About Us

Whether you use a single product or plug into the entire platform, our end-to-end site selection, design, and yield assessment software makes you faster, precise, and highly productive at every stage of project development. PVcase is a leading choice for solar energy professionals — our platform serves over 1,800 customers in 75+ countries, powering the development of more than 4 TW of projects a year.

  • Verantwortung für die E-Mail- sowie Telefonkorrespondenz mit Versicherungen, Dienstleistern und Partnern zur Klärung und Abwicklung von Sachverhalten inklusive der Rechnungsbearbeitung

das bringst du mit

  • Idealerweise hast Du Erfahrungen in der telefonischen Kundenbetreuung im Versicherungsbereich sowie der Rechnungsbearbeitung / Schadensregulierung

jobs.description:
Welcome! We’re excited you’re considering an opportunity with us! To apply to this position and be considered, click the Apply button located above this message and complete the application in full. Below, you’ll find other important information about this position.

To ensure accurate and appropriate gathering of information into the coding classification systems to meet departmental, hospital and outside agency requirements. This includes ensuring appropriate reimbursement, compliance and charging with the various coding guidelines and regulatory agencies. Responsible for obtaining accurate and complete documentation in the medical record for accurate coding/MS-DRG assignment, severity of illness and risk of mortality for each medical record. Must code inpatients and/or interventional RAD cardiology/radiology 90% of current FTE status. Responsible for the coding of the highly complex patient classes i.e. inpatient, interventional, etc.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION, CERTIFICATION, AND/OR LICENSURE:

1.High School Diploma or Equivalent.

2.Current HIM or Coding Certification throughONE of the following

  • American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA)

  • American Academy of Professional Coders (AAPC)

EXPERIENCE:

1. Three (3) years of hospital inpatient coding or interventional radiology (IRAD) hospital coding experience.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION, CERTIFICATION, AND/OR LICENSURE:

1. Graduate of Health Information Technology (HIT) or equivalent program OR Medical Coding Certification Program.

CORE DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: The statements described here are intended to describe the general nature of work being performed by people assigned to this position. They are not intended to be constructed as an all-inclusive list of all responsibilities and duties. Other duties may be assigned.

1. Codes inpatient and/or IRAD 90% of current FTE status.

2. Reviews and accurately interprets medical record documentation from all hospital accounts in order to identify all diagnosis and procedures that affect the current inpatient stay or outpatient encounter and assigns the appropriate ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, CPT, or modifier codes for each diagnosis and procedure that is identified (inpatient and IRAD). Codes highly complex patient classes (inpatient and IRAD).

3. Ensures appropriate MS-DRG assignment based on accurate ICD-10-CMand ICD-10-PCS coding assignment and medical record documentation.

4. Assigns hospital codes to a variety of patient classes (i.e. I/P, IRAD, etc.).

5. Assures that quality and timely coding, charging and abstraction of accounts are completed daily for assigned specialty areas.

6. Maintains and enhances current levels of coding knowledge through quality review, attendance and participation at clinical in-services and coding seminars, internal meetings, study of circulating reference materials, and inclusion of updates to coding manuals.

7. Assures the accuracy, quality, and timely review of data needed to obtain a clean bill.

8. Contacts physicians or any persons necessary to obtain information required for to accurately code assignments. Works and communicates with other offices in any manner necessary to facilitate the billing process.

5. Must be able to adapt to changes in the workplace.

6. Must be able to organize and complete assigned tasks.

7. Must possess excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Job Description

This is a remote position.

Team: Engineering – Platform Consulting

About ElitevoraSys

ElitevoraSys is a modern engineering consultancy focused on building high-performance operational platforms, automation pipelines, and data-driven workflows for clients who need real results - not just software. We partner with organizations to design and deliver systems that streamline dispatch, asset management, field operations, and enterprise integrations. Our work blends clean architecture, practical engineering, and a startup mindset.

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to help expand WorkPro, our flagship operations platform deployed across multiple client environments. You'll work in a small, senior team, own services end-to-end across the stack, and help shape the technical direction of a system used daily by real operational teams.

This role is perfect for an experienced full-stack engineer who enjoys solving complex workflow problems, building reliable APIs, and working across modern and legacy systems.

What You'll Do

Backend & Integrations

  • Build and maintain REST APIs using Java (Spring Boot), Python (Django/FastAPI), .NET (C#/), Golang, or comparable frameworks, powering dispatch, service orders, billing, and asset workflows.

  • Design relational schemas, migrations, and high-performance queries against SQL Server and PostgreSQL.

  • Develop integrations with enterprise platforms (Dynamics 365, Coupa, Trackunit, Power Automate/Logic Apps).

  • Maintain and modernize legacy backend code (Java/J2EE and similar stacks) while delivering new services in whichever language best fits the module.

  • Document APIs using OpenAPI/Swagger and maintain versioned contracts for client teams.

  • Implement workflow automation, asynchronous job processing, audit trails, reporting, and intelligent backend features — including AI-assisted or LLM-backed capabilities where they add value.

  • Ensure API performance, reliability, and security across high-volume operational workloads.

Frontend

  • Contribute to Angular UI components for WorkPro modules as needed.

  • Support role-based UI flows for dispatchers, managers, and field technicians.

  • Help maintain responsive, mobile-friendly interfaces across devices.

Team & Delivery

  • Work with a Product Owner to deliver features in tight, iterative cycles.

  • Collaborate with a Principal Developer on architecture and engineering standards.

  • Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and production deployments.

  • Own backend features from design through release.

  • 5+ years of professional development experience (backend/API focus).

  • Strong hands-on experience shipping production REST APIs in at least one of: Java (Spring Boot), Python, .NET (C#), or Golang.

  • Solid SQL experience — relational modeling, complex queries, indexing, stored procedures.

  • Practical experience with an ORM (JPA/Hibernate, Entity Framework, SQLAlchemy, GORM, or equivalent) and migration tooling (Flyway, Liquibase, Alembic, or similar).

  • Experience maintaining and refactoring legacy codebases.

  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems (ERP/CRM).

  • Comfort with concurrency, messaging, and asynchronous processing (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar).

  • Testing discipline (JUnit/Mockito, pytest, xUnit/NUnit, Testcontainers, or equivalent depending on stack).

  • Basic working knowledge of Angular + TypeScript for occasional frontend contributions.

  • Build and quality tooling: Maven/Gradle, pip/poetry, NuGet, Go modules, SonarQube, static analysis.

  • Deeper experience with AI-assisted development or LLM-backed workflows (prompt engineering, RAG, agentic tooling).

  • Background in operational, dispatch, or field-service software.

  • Polyglot experience across two or more of Java, Python, .NET, and Golang.

Job Description:

Role: Automation Engineer

Location: Remote

Salary Range: 110,000-120,000 CAD


The Automation Engineer will play a critical role in advancing CORA Loyalty’s global quality engineering and software delivery capabilities through scalable test automation, intelligent tooling, and AI-enabled quality practices. This role is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining automated testing frameworks and supporting continuous quality initiatives across enterprise SaaS platforms used by global clients and distributed delivery teams.


The Automation Engineer will work closely with Software Engineering, Product, DevOps, and Quality Engineering teams across multiple regions to improve release quality, increase automation coverage, and accelerate delivery velocity. This role requires a strong engineering mindset, hands-on automation expertise, and a passion for leveraging AI and modern technologies to improve software quality, operational efficiency, and engineering productivity within a global delivery environment.


The ideal candidate combines technical depth in test automation with curiosity and innovation in emerging AI-assisted testing approaches, including intelligent test generation, predictive defect analysis, and automation optimization. This individual thrives in collaborative, globally distributed engineering organizations and contributes to a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and technical excellence.

Key Responsibilities


Test Automation & Quality Engineering

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable automated test frameworks for web, API, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing.
  • Build reliable and reusable automation assets that improve testing efficiency and product quality across enterprise platforms.
  • Collaborate with globally distributed development teams to embed automated testing throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Develop and execute automated test suites within CI/CD pipelines to support continuous integration and deployment practices.
  • Identify automation opportunities to reduce manual testing effort and improve release speed, consistency, and quality.
  • Participate in test planning, defect analysis, root cause investigations, and release validation activities.
  • Support exploratory and manual testing efforts where automation is not practical or sufficient.
  • Contribute to consistent quality engineering standards and practices across global teams and delivery regions.

AI-Enabled Quality & Innovation

  • Leverage AI-assisted testing tools and technologies to improve test creation, execution, maintenance, and defect detection.
  • Explore and implement intelligent automation approaches including self-healing test scripts, predictive analytics, and AI-generated test scenarios.
  • Contribute to the evolution of AI-enabled quality engineering practices across the organization.
  • Evaluate emerging QA and AI technologies to improve engineering productivity, automation scalability, and release confidence.
  • Collaborate with engineering leadership to drive innovation in testing methodologies and quality automation.
  • Support adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices and intelligent quality tooling across distributed engineering teams.

Operational Excellence

  • Monitor and maintain automated test execution reliability and reporting accuracy across multiple applications and environments.
  • Contribute to quality metrics and reporting including automation coverage, defect trends, release readiness indicators, and operational insights.
  • Continuously improve automation frameworks, coding standards, and testing processes to support scalable global delivery.
  • Support quality gates and release governance processes to ensure high-quality software delivery.
  • Partner with DevOps and platform engineering teams to optimize testing infrastructure, environments, and deployment pipelines.
  • Contribute to operational readiness and continuous improvement initiatives supporting enterprise-scale SaaS platforms.

Collaboration & Team Contribution

  • Work closely with Software Engineers, Product Managers, Business Analysts, and Delivery teams across multiple regions to understand requirements and quality expectations.
  • Participate actively in agile ceremonies including sprint planning, standups, retrospectives, and backlog refinement.
  • Share knowledge and contribute to the continuous improvement of engineering and quality practices across global teams.
  • Mentor junior team members on automation frameworks, tools, AI-assisted testing approaches, and quality engineering best practices.
  • Foster collaboration, accountability, and innovation within a globally distributed engineering organization.

Key Skills & Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in test automation, software engineering in test, or quality engineering roles.
  • Strong hands-on experience with modern test automation frameworks and tools such as:
  • Playwright
  • Selenium
  • Cypress
  • Nightwatch
  • Postman/Newman
  • Appium
  • JMeter or k6 for performance testing
  • Experience developing automation frameworks for UI, API, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing.
  • Proficiency in programming or scripting languages such as JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or C#.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools and DevOps practices including GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or GitLab CI/CD.
  • Familiarity with source control systems such as Git and modern branching/release strategies.
  • Experience working in agile software development environments and globally distributed engineering teams.
  • Understanding of cloud-native applications, APIs, microservices, and distributed systems architectures.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted testing tools and intelligent automation capabilities including:
  • AI-generated test case creation
  • Self-healing automation frameworks
  • Intelligent defect analysis
  • Predictive testing and risk-based testing approaches
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted developer and QA tools such as Claude, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or other AI-enabled engineering productivity platforms is highly desirable.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Ability to work effectively within fast-paced, globally distributed delivery organizations.

jobs.title: Senior Delivery Manager
jobs.excerpt: Robots & Pencils is an applied AI engineering firm building the next frontier of business architecture.
jobs.description:
Robots & Pencils is an applied AI engineering firm building the next frontier of business architecture. We design and ship AI co-workers that integrate into enterprise operations and deliver measurable results for our clients. We're all in on AWS, combining deep UX capability with senior engineering talent to get AI into production fast and keep it there.
We’ve earned the trust of leaders across Consumer Products and Retail, Education, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, and Manufacturing and more, and earned a reputation as the nimble alternative to traditional global systems integrators. Founded in 2009, with delivery centers in Canada, the United States, Eastern Europe, and Latin America, we are smaller, faster, and more senior by design. Our teams average 15+ years of experience. We move fast, sweat the details, and build things that actually ship.

Position Overview

As a Senior Delivery Manager, you are the senior delivery authority on a cross-functional engagement: owning execution from kickoff through release, leading distributed onshore-and-offshore teams, and serving as the primary delivery partner to the client. You bring the judgment to navigate ambiguity, the discipline to keep complex programs on track, and the instinct to make every engagement a foundation for the next one.

Why This Role Matters

Senior Delivery Managers are where Robots and Pencils’ promise of “production-ready AI in 30 to 45 days” actually has to hold. On the engagements you run, you set the pace of delivery, the discipline behind it, and the trust that decides whether the client comes back for more. The work moves only as fast as someone is willing to own the plan, surface trade-offs early, and keep distributed teams pulling in the same direction.

What You’ll Do

Delivery

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-phase engagements, ensuring alignment across scope, budget, timeline, and quality to meet delivery commitments and achieve successful outcomes
  • Facilitate sprint planning, backlog refinement, and delivery execution across one or more cross-functional teams
  • Manage phased releases, production readiness, and transitions into operations and maintenance models
  • Identify and proactively manage dependencies, risks, scope changes, and escalations before they become blockers
  • Define, track, and report delivery KPIs, using data to guide decisions, manage delivery health, and inform tradeoffs across scope, timeline, and budget
  • Support QA and UAT efforts, ensuring quality is validated and outcomes meet agreed acceptance criteria
  • Bring an AI-forward mindset to your daily work, using tools like Claude to enhance delivery planning, reporting, and stakeholder communications

AI Enablement

  • Help implement the AI Development Life Cycle (AIDLC) across your engagements, and set the standard other delivery managers follow for standing it up
  • Use AI yourself day-to-day, and set the standard for how your engagements run an AI-augmented delivery process — modeling and coaching the delivery managers you mentor on how planning, building, and review change when agents are doing part of the work
  • Know observability for agentic and AI-driven work well enough to partner credibly with an AI product manager and AI engineers across your engagements — judge whether their approach is actually solid, catch risks early, and drive them to resolution — and hold the delivery managers you mentor to the same bar. You’re not the one building the instrumentation, but none of it should be a black box to you.
  • Define what “success” looks like for an AI-augmented delivery process and set the metrics standard across your engagements — quality, rework, review overhead, and velocity, not just tests passed
  • Build — or direct the building of — status-visibility tooling for complex AI-driven pipelines, using AI yourself, and expect the delivery managers you mentor to do the same
  • Understand context management and latency trade-offs deeply enough to make the call on when an agentic approach is the wrong tool for a client’s needs, and defend that call to the client
  • Set the standard for what infrastructure an agentic delivery pipeline needs — compute, orchestration, logging, guardrails — and know enough to hold engineering accountable for it, even though you’re not the one building it
  • Own the delivery approach for AI-native and agentic engagements: partner with AI/ML engineering leads on model risk, data readiness, and evaluation strategy, and translate technical uncertainty into a delivery plan and risk register the client can act on
  • Work with AI product managers and AI engineers to set the standard, across your engagements, for what a “definition of done” looks like for probabilistic or AI-driven features — evaluation thresholds, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, post-launch monitoring — well enough to judge whether it’s actually good, and hold the team to it
  • Coach delivery managers and delivery coordinators you mentor on the difference between shipping an AI product, using AI to accelerate a traditional delivery, and running an agentic development process to build the work itself — and help them adapt scope, staffing, and risk management accordingly
  • Serve as a credible voice with clients and internal leadership on what “production-ready AI” actually requires — setting realistic expectations for iteration, evaluation, and drift over time

Collaboration & Communication

  • Serve as the primary delivery contact for clients, building trusted relationships through transparency, consistency, and clear communication while identifying opportunities to expand value within the engagement
  • Lead stakeholder working sessions, roadmap alignment discussions, and delivery forums with confidence
  • Communicate progress, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to executive and non-technical audiences
  • Partner with Client Partners to spot expansion opportunities inside the engagement (scope, follow-on work, new use cases) and help shape the case for what’s next
  • Translate delivery progress into business impact for client stakeholders (ROI, milestones, decisions) so executives see ongoing value, not just status

Leadership & Influence

  • Lead distributed delivery teams across onshore and offshore locations, fostering accountability, collaboration, and delivery excellence
  • Coach junior delivery managers with concrete feedback and stretch opportunities, contributing to their development plans
  • Foster a culture of transparency, continuous improvement, and high performance across the engagement
  • Contribute to improving delivery practices, tools, and frameworks across engagements
  • Assess team strengths and gaps on your engagements, and partner with Client Partners to flag staffing needs and high-potential talent for the firm
  • Conduct executive interviews for engineers, designers, and other roles joining your engagements, and serve as an essential voice in go/no-go hiring decisions across the firm

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in software delivery, technical project management, or engineering leadership
  • Strong understanding of agile delivery practices across complex, multi-team engagements (e.g., Scrum, SAFe, Kanban)
  • Experience managing distributed teams across onshore and offshore locations
  • Proven ability to deliver complex, multi-platform digital systems in agile environments
  • Strong client-facing communication and relationship management skills
  • Experience with delivery tooling (e.g., Jira, Confluence, GitHub, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines)
  • Familiarity with cloud-native architectures and AI-enabled platforms
  • Demonstrable usage of AI tools to enhance delivery planning, reporting, and documentation (e.g., Claude)
  • Track record leading at least one engagement where AI/ML or agentic capability was core to the solution — including how you managed model risk, evaluation, and client expectations, not just how you used AI tools to work faster
  • Able to set delivery standards for AI-native work across an engagement or practice — evaluation criteria, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, monitoring — and coach other delivery managers on them
  • Track record leading a team through an agentic development/delivery process yourself — not just using AI tools personally — including how you approached observability, success metrics, and status visibility for a process that isn’t fully deterministic
  • Comfortable setting the standard, across engagements, for the infrastructure, context-management, and latency trade-offs an agentic delivery pipeline needs — enough to hold engineering and delivery managers accountable, even though you’re not the one implementing it
  • PMP, Scrum Master, SAFe, or equivalent certification preferred
  • Instinct for spotting where an engagement can grow, and the credibility with clients to bring those conversations forward with Client Partners

Helpful Extras and Unique Skills

  • Vertical depth in one or more of Consumer Products and Retail, Education, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, or Manufacturing
  • Experience delivering agentic, AI co-worker, or applied-AI initiatives in enterprise
  • Prior career experience in client-facing roles (engagement management, consulting, account leadership) that informs growth conversations

You’ll Do Well Here if You Are

  • A doer. You see something broken and fix it. You'd rather move on clarity than wait for certainty.
  • A fast learner who knows you don't know everything. The AI landscape changes weekly. You're senior enough to know better and curious enough to keep learning anyway.
  • Direct in a way that makes the work better. You give honest feedback. You'd rather have the hard conversation than blow smoke.
  • Obsessed with craft. You know genius is in the details. You ship exceptional, not perfect, and you don't put your name on work you wouldn't stand behind.
  • Built for ownership. You honor commitments, admit mistakes fast, and back your teammates when a decision costs something. No handoffs, no finger-pointing.
  • All in. You treat clients' businesses like your own. You take the work seriously without taking yourself seriously.
  • Resourceful when the budget, timeline, or team is tight. Constraints don't slow you down. They sharpen you.
  • Calm when it gets hot. When scope, timeline, and stakeholders pull in three directions, you slow the room down enough to make the right call. You’d rather raise the hard trade-off in week two than absorb it in week eight.
  • Glad to be in the room with people who care as much as you do. Our teams average fifteen-plus years of experience. We hire people who push each other to do better work.

This range may be modified in the future. An employee's position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. Preferred:

  • Experience working within a state Enterprise Project Management Office and its templates and governance.

Bonus ingredients*:

Deine Chance als Junior Softwareentwickler:

Bei Everlast AI bist Du als Junior Softwareentwickler genau an der richtigen Stelle. Wir glauben fest daran, dass Vielfalt und frische Perspektiven unser Team bereichern. Dank unserer digitalen Schulungsplattform helfen wir Dir, in Deinen neuen Job hineinzufinden und das Beste aus Dir herauszuholen.

deine benefits

  • Zukunftssicherer Arbeitsplatz: Jede Person, die wir einstellen, soll langfristig mit uns wachsen. Ziel jeder Einstellung ist die unbefristete Übernahme, unsere Quote liegt bei über 95 %.   • Echte Ownership, mit Netz: Du bekommst eigene Tickets und Features, keine Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitungen, und ein Tech-Lead, der Deine Pull Requests prüft und Dir erklärt, warum. Was Du baust, geht direkt zum Kunden oder ins interne Tooling.

  • Best-Hardware-Garantie: Du bekommst kompromisslos das Gerät, mit dem Du am besten arbeitest. MacBook Pro 16" mit M5 Pro, 24 GB und 1 TB als Minimum, dazu Studio Display und externes Setup nach Deiner Wahl. Wir diskutieren nicht über Ausstattung, wir stellen sie hin.

  • Unbegrenzter KI-Zugang, ohne Limit und ohne Wartezeit: Du hast vollen Zugriff auf alle gängigen KI-Tools, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor und was sonst gerade führend ist. Ohne Token-Limits, ohne Kontingente, ohne die Frage, ob sich der nächste Prompt lohnt. Wenn eine neue Software Deine Arbeit voranbringt, hast Du sie innerhalb von 24 Stunden auf dem Rechner, ohne IT-Ticket und ohne Budgetrunde.

  • Weiterbildung, die Du selbst bestimmst: 2.000 € Hardware- und Weiterbildungsbudget pro Jahr, über das Du frei entscheidest. Fachbücher, Kurse, Zertifikate, Konferenzen oder eigene Experimentier-Hardware. Wir schreiben Dir nicht vor, worin Du tiefer wirst, denn bei einer Technologie, die sich in Monaten neu erfindet, weißt Du das besser als jeder Weiterbildungskatalog.

  • Lernkurve, die Du sonst nirgends bekommst: Pairing mit dem Tech-Lead, Code-Reviews mit Begründung, viele unterschiedliche Produkte und KI-gestützte Entwicklung im Terminal als Standard. Unsere Entwickler sagen uns, dass sie hier in einem Jahr mehr gelernt haben als in jedem Unternehmen davor. In zwölf Monaten bist Du kein Junior mehr.

  • Maximale Reichweite für Deine Arbeit: Was Du baust, geht direkt an tausende Nutzer unserer Produkte und an über 3.500 Kunden, und der größte deutsche YouTube-Kanal für Künstliche Intelligenz zeigt, was das Team entwickelt. Statt in einer internen Präsentation zu verschwinden, wird Deine Arbeit gesehen.

  • Zugang zu einem Netzwerk, das Dich weiterbringt: Über Everlast bist Du an eines der größten Netzwerke von Zukunftsforschern, Professoren und Doktoren im Bereich KI und Robotik angebunden. Du diskutierst mit Menschen, die diese Technologie mitentwickeln, statt sie nur zu lesen.

  • Starke Arbeitsatmosphäre: Der Umgang untereinander ist kollegial und direkt, die Wege zu den Gründern kurz. Wir ziehen an einem Strang und motivieren uns gegenseitig zu Bestleistungen.

deine aufgaben

  • Features bauen, die sofort benutzt werden: Du bekommst klar umrissene Tickets, zum Beispiel eine neue Ansicht im Sales-CRM, und lieferst Datenbank, Logik und Oberfläche. Dein Tech-Lead prüft den Pull Request, Du lernst aus jedem Review.

  • KI-gestützte Softwareentwicklung als Standard: AI-Coding-Assistenten wie Claude Code, Cursor oder Windsurf sind bei uns kein Experiment, sondern Hauptwerkzeug im Entwicklungsalltag. Du setzt sie täglich und gezielt im Terminal ein, um schneller, effizienter und qualitativ hochwertiger zu entwickeln.

  • Weiterentwicklung und Optimierung bestehender Software: Du baust nicht nur Neues, sondern verstehst auch vorhandenen Code, erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale und entwickelst bestehende Systeme strategisch weiter.

deine qualifikationen

  • Sauberer Workflow: Git mit Branches und Pull Requests ist für Dich Alltag, effiziente IDE-Nutzung auch. Git Worktrees lernst Du bei uns.

jobs.excerpt: Contract | Remote, worldwide | $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location | 10-20 hrs/week Check out this Loom video for more details: We're looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.
jobs.description:
Contract | Remote, worldwide | $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location | 10-20 hrs/week

Check out this Loom video for more details:

We're looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

This is not a traditional engineering role. You won't be writing production code. You'll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.

What this role actually is

You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios, focusing on:

• Whether the response makes sense

  • Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful
  • Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment
  • Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste. Syntax correctness is the easy part.

What you'll be doing

  • Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end to end
  • Judge whether outputs are useful, correct at a high level, and aligned with how a strong engineer would think
  • Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just the code
  • Distinguish between levels of response quality (what makes something a 2 vs a 4)
  • Give clear, opinionated feedback in writing on what worked, what didn't, and what felt off or misleading
  • Help define what great looks like when working with tools like Cursor, Codex and Claude Code

What we mean by "taste"

We're looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

  • Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?
  • Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?
  • Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output?
  • Would this interaction build or erode trust?

You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments, and explaining them clearly.

Who you are

  • Senior, Staff or Principal-level engineer (or equivalent experience)
  • Strong background in TypeScript/JavaScript or Python
  • Hands-on experience with at least one of OpenAI Codex, Claude Code or Cursor
  • Deep familiarity with modern AI-assisted dev workflows
  • Able to evaluate code without executing it or reviewing every line
  • Strong written and spoken English (B2 or above). You'll be writing detailed feedback and recording short video explanations, so this is a hard requirement
  • Comfortable giving direct, opinionated feedback
  • High bar for what good engineering looks like

Nice to have

  • Prior exposure to prompt design or evaluation workflows
  • Experience mentoring senior engineers or defining engineering standards

Engagement details

  • Rate: $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location

• Hours: 10-20 hours/week, flexible

  • Duration: ongoing. Projects run from about two weeks to a few months each, and we offer new ones to evaluators who do well
  • Start: as soon as you clear the take-home and a project has an open seat
  • Process: one take-home evaluation exercise with a recorded Loom walkthrough. No interview

Remote-based in the US

Overview

GoodPower is a global organization working to unlock the economic potential of decarbonization through research, innovation, strategic communications, and disruptive technology. We focus on advancing more affordable and reliable energy, expanding economic opportunity, strengthening energy security, supporting healthier and more resilient communities, and accelerating the transition to a predictable, secure, modern low-carbon economy.

Operating at the intersection of data, digital media, emerging technology, behavioral research, and public engagement, GoodPower develops and deploys scalable strategies designed to accelerate the adoption of decarbonized technologies and infrastructure—including renewable energy, regenerative agriculture, energy storage, and electric transportation. Our work combines rigorous research and experimentation with advanced communications and innovation capabilities to better understand public attitudes, test effective interventions, and help build the social, economic, and market conditions necessary for large-scale transformation.

GoodPower is at a pivotal stage of organizational growth as we approach completion of the first year of our 2030 Strategic Plan. Over the next five years, we intend to significantly expand our reach, capabilities, and impact—investing deeply in innovation, AI-enabled systems, data and analytics, research and development, and next-generation communications infrastructure to help accelerate the global energy transition and the economic opportunities it creates.

Job Summary

GoodPower seeks a Machine Learning Scientist to expand what our teams and software can accomplish through applied research, predictive modeling, and intelligent automation. You will identify where Artificial Intelligence/ Machine Learning (AI/ML) can improve decisions, unlock new offerings, and reduce the time and cost of delivering our work. Your mandate spans clean energy planning, public participation integrity, media and narrative intelligence, and organizational effectiveness.

You will own the scientific development of ML capabilities from problem definition and experimentation through validation and deployment with engineering partners. Success means demonstrably better decisions, more useful products, and greater team capacity, supported by rigorous evidence and clear communication of uncertainty. The Machine Learning Scientist will report to the Chief Innovation Officer.

Key Responsibilities

Applied Research and Model Development

  • Translate user needs and strategic challenges into tractable ML problems. Establish baselines, define success criteria, and prioritize experiments by potential impact, data readiness, and feasibility.
  • Develop models for classification, entity resolution, anomaly detection, forecasting, ranking, and risk assessment using text, geospatial, energy, market, media, and organizational data. Combine sources to reveal patterns that improve decisions.
  • Select and test methods suited to the problem, from statistical models and classical ML to deep learning, graph methods, and LLMs. Demonstrate when added complexity delivers meaningful value.
  • Use predictive models, optimization, and scenario analysis to evaluate options and allocate resources. Apply experimental design and causal inference where the data and assumptions support credible conclusions about intervention effectiveness.

Data Quality and Scientific Evaluation

  • Build representative datasets, labeling strategies, and evaluation benchmarks. Prevent leakage and test performance across time, geography, groups, and unfamiliar contexts using validation appropriate to the intended use.
  • Quantify uncertainty, calibration, and the consequences of false positives and false negatives. Develop approaches for limited or noisy labels, and define when systems should defer to human judgment.
  • Make research reproducible through versioned data, code, and experiments. Document assumptions, limitations, and failure modes; monitor drift and use feedback to guide model improvement.

LLM and Agentic Systems

  • Build retrieval and synthesis systems that turn heterogeneous documents and data into verifiable answers and actionable intelligence. Improve retrieval, ranking, source quality, citation accuracy, and faithfulness through systematic evaluation.
  • Develop agents that use tools, models, and internal services to complete useful workflows. Define permissions, failure recovery, and human review for consequential actions, and evaluate complete task outcomes.
  • Evaluate hosted and open-weight models, prompting, fine-tuning, and distillation against quality, privacy, latency, and cost requirements. Build reusable capabilities where they offer an advantage across use cases.
  • Establish evaluation and monitoring for LLM and agent systems, including factual accuracy, robustness, task completion, and operating cost. Use controlled experiments to verify improvements before release.

Production Integration and Shared Capabilities

  • Shape reusable data representations, feature pipelines, retrieval services, and model interfaces. Introduce ontologies or knowledge graphs where relationships and structured reasoning improve performance or usability.
  • Partner with software and ML engineers to move validated prototypes into reliable products. Define data and API contracts, deployment requirements, monitoring, and retraining plans while balancing performance, maintainability, and cost.

Technical Direction and Measurable Impact

  • Identify high-value opportunities beyond existing platform roadmaps. Propose new capabilities and research directions, define milestones and decision points, and help prioritize the AI/ML portfolio.
  • Work with product, research, communications, and program teams to understand user decisions and constraints. Explain results clearly, challenge unsupported assumptions, and help colleagues apply AI/ML effectively.
  • Define and track outcomes such as decision quality, predictive performance, user adoption, analyst time saved, and cost per workflow. Use evidence to scale successful approaches, revise weak ones, and stop work that does not deliver value.

Qualifications

Required

  • PhD in machine learning, computer science, statistics, or a related quantitative field, with 3-5 years of applied ML experience. Exceptional recent PhD graduates with substantial applied work will also be considered.
  • Evidence of turning ambiguous problems into rigorous experiments and useful AI/ ML capabilities, including appropriate baselines, validation, uncertainty assessment, and error analysis.
  • Hands-on experience with NLP and LLM applications, including embeddings, retrieval-augmented generation, and systematic evaluation.
  • Strong Python skills and experience with tools such as PyTorch/ TensorFlow, scikit-learn, and pandas; proficiency in SQL, version control, and reproducible research. Experience deploying and evaluating models in real workflows, independently or with engineering partners.
  • Sound statistical judgment and the ability to work with heterogeneous, incomplete, or noisy data. Ability to distinguish predictive associations from evidence of causation.
  • Ability to own technical work, prioritize under uncertainty, and communicate findings to technical and nontechnical colleagues. Curiosity about energy and climate challenges and motivation to learn from domain experts.

Preferred

  • Experience with energy, climate, grid, infrastructure siting, permitting, regulatory, or public participation data; geospatial analysis, graph ML, or time-series forecasting.
  • Publications, open-source contributions, or deployed projects demonstrating methodological depth, originality, and practical impact.

This description reflects GoodPower’s assignment of essential functions; it does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned. GoodPower retains the right to change or assign other duties to this position at any time. Employees must be able to perform the essential functions of the position satisfactorily. Compensation, Benefits, and Perks

jobs.title: Senior Consultant, Energy Analytics & Evaluation
jobs.excerpt: Resource Innovations is seeking a Senior Consultant to join our Advisory Services team.
jobs.description:
Resource Innovations is seeking a Senior Consultant to join our Advisory Services team. This role is ideal for an experienced analyst, economist, statistician, or evaluation professional who wants to apply advanced quantitative methods to some of the most important challenges facing utilities today, including demand flexibility, transportation electrification, distributed energy resources, battery storage, virtual power plants, and grid modernization.

As a Senior Consultant, you will lead analytical workstreams that help utilities, regulators, and public agencies understand the impacts of demand-side management programs and make data-driven decisions about future investments. You will work with large AMI and interval datasets, customer billing records, program tracking systems, and survey research to estimate program impacts, assess customer behavior, and support resource planning. You will also have the opportunity to lead projects or key tasks, directing the work of junior analysts, keeping deliverables on schedule, and making sure results meet a high standard of quality before they reach the client.

We're looking for someone who enjoys solving complex analytical problems, translating technical findings into actionable insights, and collaborating closely with clients and multidisciplinary project teams.

Resource Innovations (RI) is a women-led energy transformation firm focused on impact. Building on our expertise in energy efficiency, we're constantly expanding our portfolio of clean energy solutions to guide utilities through increasingly complex, connected challenges. Load flexibility. Electrification. Carbon reduction. With every step, we're leading the charge to power change.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Utilize and apply economic and statistical tools in support of business and policy analysis for clients in a variety of fields, but especially for demand-side management in the electricity industry.
  • Estimate program load impacts using experimental and quasi-experimental methods, including randomized controlled trials, matched control groups, and difference-in-differences regression.
  • Clean, process, and analyze large interval and AMI datasets, customer billing data, program tracking data, and survey data using Stata, R, or Python.
  • Manipulate project-related data to assess trends and/or patterns and their ramifications from a policy or program perspective.
  • Develop quantitative cost-benefit, cost-effectiveness, or risk models, and build forecasting and scenario tools for program planning.
  • Support the design and administration of customer surveys, including sampling plans, instrument development, and analysis of results.
  • Contribute to evaluation plans, baseline methodology development, and load impact protocol documentation.
  • Assist senior staff in the preparation of reports, presentations, and testimony describing the results of projects, including regulatory filings and compliance deliverables.
  • Produce clear tables, figures, and visualizations, and proofread deliverables for accuracy, formatting, and usage.
  • Assist in proposal preparation and other business development opportunities.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Requirements

  • A Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field, such as economics, statistics, mathematics, computer science, or public policy with a quantitative focus, with at least four years of relevant experience; or a Master’s degree in a related field with at least two years of relevant experience.
  • Previous experience performing econometric and statistical modeling.
  • Experience and expertise with statistical analysis using software such as Stata, R, Python, SAS, or other data management languages or software.
  • Ability to translate data into compelling report and presentation formats.
  • Excellent written and oral presentation skills, as well as client interface capabilities.
  • Previous experience in the energy industry.
  • Interest in sustainability and passionate about making a meaningful impact on the environment.
  • Desire to develop existing and new skills in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

Preferred skills, education and experience

  • Experience evaluating demand response, energy efficiency, behavioral, time-of-use, or distributed energy resource programs, preferably in a consulting environment.
  • Experience with experimental design, including randomized controlled trials and matched control group selection.
  • Experience working with hourly interval or AMI data at scale, including load shape analysis and event-day performance estimation.
  • Familiarity with load impact protocols, evaluation, measurement and verification frameworks, and cost-effectiveness testing.
  • Ability to proactively identify and troubleshoot problems that arise during projects, and to defend and explain analytical approaches to clients.
  • Knowledge of natural gas and/or electric utility industry operations and regulatory frameworks.
  • Experience with battery storage, virtual power plant, or electric vehicle program analysis.
  • Experience supporting proposals or responding to utility RFPs.
  • Experience presenting analysis results and recommendations to clients, and at conferences or other industry events

Benefits

About Resource Innovations

Resource Innovations (RI) is a women-led energy transformation firm focused on impact. Building on our expertise in energy efficiency, we’re constantly expanding our portfolio of clean energy solutions to guide utilities through increasingly complex, connected challenges. Load flexibility. Electrification. Carbon reduction. With every step, we’re leading the charge to power change.

Resource Innovations is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for all job applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, age, disability, marital status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other protected status. In addition to federal law requirements, Resource Innovations complies with applicable state and local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company does work.

Compensation & Benefits

Resource Innovations offers competitive salaries based on a candidate's skills, experience and qualifications for the position. The compensation range for the base salary for this position is $90,000-$144,000. In addition to base pay, employees may be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus. The stated salary represents the expected compensation for this position. Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as the candidate's experience, education and location.

At Resource Innovations, we believe supporting our people is essential to delivering impact. We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to promote health, financial security, and work-life balance. This includes three weeks of paid vacation annually, paid holidays, a 401(k) retirement plan with employer match, medical, dental and vision coverage, parental leave, an employee assistance program, commuter benefits, and additional supplemental offerings.

Employment with Resource Innovations is contingent upon the successful completion of a comprehensive background check and reference check. If applicable to the position, a pre-employment drug screen may also be required.
